## File: `res://autoload/ApiClient.gd`

```gdscript
extends Node
class_name ApiClient

# ============================================================
#  API CLIENT — autoload singleton ("API")
#  Talks to the Vision Master backend:
#    * phone OTP auth (request/verify/refresh/logout)
#    * subscription status (/me)
#    * progress sync (GET/PUT /progress)
#  Tokens persist in user://auth.json so the user stays logged in.
#
#  Base URL comes from the project setting `vision_master/api_base_url`
#  so it can be pointed at a dev/staging/prod server without code changes.
# ============================================================

signal logged_in(user: Dictionary)
signal logged_out()
signal subscription_updated(subscription: Dictionary)
signal token_refreshed(success: bool)

const AUTH_PATH := "user://auth.json"

var _base_url: String = ""
var _access_token: String = ""
var _refresh_token: String = ""
var _phone: String = ""
var _user_id: String = ""
var _subscription: Dictionary = {}
var _expiry_unix: int = 0

# Guards against firing several refreshes at once (e.g. many queued downloads
# all receiving 401 at the same time).
var _refresh_in_flight: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	_base_url = str(ProjectSettings.get_setting("vision_master/api_base_url", "")).strip_edges()
	if _base_url.ends_with("/"):
		_base_url = _base_url.substr(0, _base_url.length() - 1)
	if _base_url == "":
		# Informational: the app runs fully offline until a server URL is set.
		print("[API] vision_master/api_base_url is not set — server features are disabled.")
	_load_auth()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# STATE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func is_configured() -> bool:
	return _base_url != ""


func is_logged_in() -> bool:
	return _access_token != "" or _refresh_token != ""


func get_access_token() -> String:
	return _access_token


func get_phone() -> String:
	return _phone


func get_user_id() -> String:
	return _user_id


func get_subscription() -> Dictionary:
	return _subscription.duplicate(true)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# AUTH
# ------------------------------------------------------------

## Ask the server to text a one-time code to `phone`.
## callback(ok: bool, error: String, retry_after: int)
func request_otp(phone: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_post("/auth/request-otp", {"phone": phone}, false,
		func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
			if _ok(result, code):
				callback.call(true, "", 0)
			else:
				callback.call(false, _error_of(body, code), int(body.get("retry_after", 0)))
	)


## Verify the code and log in. callback(ok: bool, error: String)
func verify_otp(phone: String, code: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_post("/auth/verify-otp", {"phone": phone, "code": code}, false,
		func(result: int, http_code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
			if not _ok(result, http_code):
				callback.call(false, _error_of(body, http_code))
				return
			_store_tokens(body)
			_phone = str(body.get("phone", phone))
			_user_id = str(body.get("user_id", ""))
			_subscription = body.get("subscription", {})
			_save_auth()
			logged_in.emit({"phone": _phone, "user_id": _user_id, "subscription": _subscription})
			subscription_updated.emit(_subscription)
			callback.call(true, "")
	)


## Log out locally and best-effort revoke the refresh token on the server.
func logout() -> void:
	if _refresh_token != "":
		_post("/auth/logout", {"refresh_token": _refresh_token}, false,
			func(_r: int, _c: int, _b: Dictionary) -> void: pass)
	_access_token = ""
	_refresh_token = ""
	_phone = ""
	_user_id = ""
	_subscription = {}
	_expiry_unix = 0
	_clear_auth()
	logged_out.emit()


## Refresh the access token. Emits `token_refreshed(success)`.
func refresh_tokens() -> void:
	if _refresh_in_flight:
		return
	if _refresh_token == "":
		token_refreshed.emit(false)
		return
	_refresh_in_flight = true
	_post("/auth/refresh", {"refresh_token": _refresh_token}, false,
		func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
			_refresh_in_flight = false
			if _ok(result, code) and body.has("access_token"):
				_store_tokens(body)
				_save_auth()
				token_refreshed.emit(true)
			else:
				token_refreshed.emit(false)
	)


## Ensure we have a non-expired access token; if not, refresh first.
## callback(ok: bool) runs after the token is (or is not) available.
func ensure_token(callback: Callable) -> void:
	if is_logged_in() and _token_valid():
		callback.call(true)
		return
	if _refresh_token == "":
		callback.call(false)
		return
	# One-shot so a single refresh answer wakes every waiting caller and then
	# disconnects itself.
	token_refreshed.connect(_on_ensure_token_done.bind(callback), CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
	refresh_tokens()


func _on_ensure_token_done(success: bool, callback: Callable) -> void:
	callback.call(success)


## Fetch the current user + subscription from the server.
## callback(ok: bool, data: Dictionary)
func fetch_me(callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/me",
		func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
			if _ok(result, code):
				_phone = str(body.get("phone", _phone))
				_user_id = str(body.get("user_id", _user_id))
				_subscription = body.get("subscription", _subscription)
				_save_auth()
				subscription_updated.emit(_subscription)
			callback.call(_ok(result, code), body)
	)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PROGRESS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

## Pull the server progress blob. callback(ok: bool, data: Dictionary)
func fetch_progress(callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/progress",
		func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
			if _ok(result, code):
				callback.call(true, body.get("data", {}))
			else:
				callback.call(false, {})
	)


## Push a progress blob. callback(ok: bool)
func push_progress(data: Dictionary, callback: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
	_authed_put("/progress", {"data": data},
		func(result: int, code: int, _body: Dictionary) -> void:
			if callback.is_valid():
				callback.call(_ok(result, code))
	)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DAILY WORD CHALLENGES + LEADERBOARDS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

## All official challenge APIs are authenticated and server-authoritative.
## callbacks receive (ok: bool, data: Dictionary); failures carry {error: ...}.
func fetch_challenge_date(callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/challenge/date", func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func fetch_challenge_calendar(callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/challenge/calendar", func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func fetch_challenge_summary(date: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/challenge/summary?date=" + date.uri_encode(), func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func fetch_challenge_attempt(attempt_id: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_get("/challenge/attempts/%s" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func start_challenge_attempt(date: String, game_type: String, idempotency_key: String, callback: Callable, practice: bool = false) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts", {
		"date": date,
		"gameType": game_type,
		"idempotencyKey": idempotency_key,
		"practice": practice,
	}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func submit_wordle_guess(attempt_id: String, guess: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/wordle-guess" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {"guess": guess}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func abandon_challenge_attempt(attempt_id: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/abandon" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func next_wordef_question(attempt_id: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/wordef-next" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func answer_wordef_question(attempt_id: String, index: int, option: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/wordef-answer" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {
		"index": index,
		"option": option,
	}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func reveal_unscramble_clue(attempt_id: String, index: int, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/clue" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {"index": index}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func solve_unscramble_word(attempt_id: String, index: int, word: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/unscramble-solve" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {
		"index": index,
		"word": word,
	}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


func settle_challenge_attempt(attempt_id: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_authed_post("/challenge/attempts/%s/submit" % attempt_id.uri_encode(), {}, func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))

	_authed_get("/challenge/leaderboard/lifetime?limit=%d&offset=%d" % [limit, offset], func(result: int, code: int, body: Dictionary) -> void:
		callback.call(_ok(result, code), body))


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# LOW-LEVEL HTTP
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func _ok(result: int, code: int) -> bool:
	return result == HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS and code >= 200 and code < 300


func _error_of(body: Dictionary, code: int) -> String:
	var err := str(body.get("error", ""))
	if err != "":
		return err
	return "http_%d" % code


func _token_valid() -> bool:
	return _access_token != "" and (Time.get_unix_time_from_system() + 30.0) < float(_expiry_unix)


func _authed_get(path: String, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_with_token(func(header: PackedStringArray) -> void:
		_request(HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, path, null, header, true, callback))


func _authed_put(path: String, body: Dictionary, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_with_token(func(header: PackedStringArray) -> void:
		_request(HTTPClient.METHOD_PUT, path, body, header, true, callback))


func _authed_post(path: String, body: Dictionary, callback: Callable) -> void:
	_with_token(func(header: PackedStringArray) -> void:
		_request(HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, path, body, header, true, callback))


func _with_token(run: Callable) -> void:
	if not is_logged_in():
		run.call(PackedStringArray())
		return
	ensure_token(func(ok: bool) -> void:
		if ok:
			run.call(PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + _access_token]))
		else:
			run.call(PackedStringArray()))


func _post(path: String, body: Dictionary, need_auth: bool, callback: Callable) -> void:
	var header := PackedStringArray()
	if need_auth and _access_token != "":
		header.append("Authorization: Bearer " + _access_token)
	_request(HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, path, body, header, false, callback)


## Generic request. On 401 with `allow_refresh`, refreshes once then retries.
func _request(method: int, path: String, body: Variant, header: PackedStringArray,
		allow_refresh: bool, callback: Callable) -> void:
	if _base_url == "":
		callback.call(HTTPRequest.RESULT_CANT_CONNECT, 0, {"error": "no_base_url"})
		return
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	http.timeout = 20.0
	add_child(http)
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Content-Type: application/json", "Accept: application/json"])
	headers.append_array(header)
	http.request_completed.connect(
		func(result: int, code: int, _h: PackedStringArray, bytes: PackedByteArray) -> void:
			http.queue_free()
			var parsed: Dictionary = _parse_dictionary(bytes)
			if code == 401 and allow_refresh and _refresh_token != "":
				# Refresh once, then retry the same request with the new token.
				token_refreshed.connect(
					_retry_after_refresh.bind(method, path, body, callback), CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
				refresh_tokens()
				return
			callback.call(result, code, parsed)
	)
	var payload := ""
	if body != null:
		payload = JSON.stringify(body)
	var err := http.request(_base_url + path, headers, method, payload)
	if err != OK:
		http.queue_free()
		callback.call(HTTPRequest.RESULT_CANT_CONNECT, 0, {"error": error_string(err)})


func _parse_dictionary(bytes: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
	if bytes.is_empty():
		return {}
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(bytes.get_string_from_utf8())
	if parsed is Dictionary:
		return parsed
	return {}


func _retry_after_refresh(success: bool, method: int, path: String, body: Variant, callback: Callable) -> void:
	if success:
		var header := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + _access_token])
		_request(method, path, body, header, false, callback)
	else:
		callback.call(HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS, 401, {"error": "unauthorized"})


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TOKEN PERSISTENCE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func _store_tokens(body: Dictionary) -> void:
	_access_token = str(body.get("access_token", _access_token))
	if body.has("refresh_token"):
		_refresh_token = str(body.get("refresh_token", _refresh_token))
	var ttl := int(body.get("expires_in", 3600))
	_expiry_unix = int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) + ttl


func _save_auth() -> void:
	var data := {
		"access_token": _access_token,
		"refresh_token": _refresh_token,
		"expiry_unix": _expiry_unix,
		"phone": _phone,
		"user_id": _user_id,
		"subscription": _subscription,
	}
	var file := FileAccess.open(AUTH_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_error("API: could not write %s" % AUTH_PATH)
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(data))
	file.close()


func _load_auth() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(AUTH_PATH):
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(AUTH_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return
	var text := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(text)
	if not (parsed is Dictionary):
		return
	var data: Dictionary = parsed
	_access_token = str(data.get("access_token", ""))
	_refresh_token = str(data.get("refresh_token", ""))
	_expiry_unix = int(data.get("expiry_unix", 0))
	_phone = str(data.get("phone", ""))
	_user_id = str(data.get("user_id", ""))
	_subscription = data.get("subscription", {})


func _clear_auth() -> void:
	if FileAccess.file_exists(AUTH_PATH):
		DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(AUTH_PATH))
```

```gdscript
extends Control

# ============================================================
#  BACK BUTTON HANDLER
#  Base script for handling Android back button
#  Extend this script in all scenes that need back button support
# ============================================================

var back_pressed_time: float = 0.0
var double_back_timeout: float = 2.0  # seconds to wait for second back press


func _ready() -> void:
	# Make sure the scene can receive input
	set_process_input(true)


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey:
		if event.echo:
			return
		# Android's back button can surface as either keycode or
		# physical_keycode depending on the device/platform — check both.
		if event.pressed and (event.keycode == KEY_BACK or event.physical_keycode == KEY_BACK):
			_on_android_back_pressed()


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	# Override this in child scenes
	pass


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  APP-WIDE HEADER BAR
#
#  Every screen carries the same authored HeaderBar block (200 px white
#  surface, back arrow, title). HeaderBarStyler gives it its look; this
#  helper only connects it to the screen:
#    * the back arrow runs the screen's Android-back handler,
#    * the title text can be overridden (for dynamic screens),
#    * the bar is lifted above the page so it paints over scrolling content.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func wire_header_bar(title: String = "") -> void:
	var header: Control = get_node_or_null("HeaderBar") as Control
	if header == null:
		return

	if not title.is_empty():
		var label: Label = header.get_node_or_null("HeaderContent/HeaderTitle") as Label
		if label != null:
			label.text = title

	var back_button: Button = header.get_node_or_null("HeaderContent/BackButton") as Button
	if back_button != null:
		var handler: Callable = Callable(self, "_on_android_back_pressed")
		if not back_button.pressed.is_connected(handler):
			back_button.pressed.connect(handler)
	# Apply the app-wide canonical look: white 200 px surface, square icon
	# buttons in fixed slots, home removed, centred title ramp.
	Global.style_header(header)

	raise_header_bar()


## Puts the header bar last among the scene's children, so it is drawn — and
## receives mouse input — above the page. A scene that authors the bar last is
## already correct and this is a no-op; screens that build their page in code
## must call it once their content exists (and before adding any modal, which
## is expected to sit on top of the bar).
func raise_header_bar() -> void:
	var header: Control = get_node_or_null("HeaderBar") as Control
	if header == null:
		return
	if header.get_index() != get_child_count() - 1:
		move_child(header, get_child_count() - 1)
```

```gdscript
############################################################
# BOTTOM NAVIGATION (autoload "BottomNavigation")
# One persistent bottom navigation bar shared by every scene
# that needs it. It lives on its own canvas layer above the
# scene content, so it never slides, never re-initialises and
# never flickers when change_scene_to_file() swaps the screens.
#
# When the current scene changes it tells the bar which scene is
# now showing: the bar shows/hides itself and glides its selector
# to the tab that owns that scene.
############################################################

const NAVIGATION_BAR_SCENE: PackedScene = preload(
	"res://scenes/bottom_navigation/NavigationBar.tscn"
)

# Above scene content (layer 0) but below the transition overlay.
const BAR_LAYER: int = 1

var bar: VisionNavigationBar


func _ready() -> void:
	layer = BAR_LAYER
	bar = NAVIGATION_BAR_SCENE.instantiate() as VisionNavigationBar
	add_child(bar)

	# Keep the bar in sync with the active scene, on launch and on every swap.
	get_tree().scene_changed.connect(_on_scene_changed)
	call_deferred("_on_scene_changed")


func _on_scene_changed() -> void:
	if bar == null or not is_instance_valid(bar):
		return
	var current: Node = get_tree().current_scene
	bar.apply_scene_path("" if current == null else current.scene_file_path)
```

## File: `res://autoload/ContentManager.gd`

```gdscript
extends Node
class_name ContentManager

# ============================================================
#  CONTENT MANAGER — autoload singleton ("Content")
#  Single gateway for the heavy media (audio + lesson images) that is
#  NOT shipped in the APK. It knows, for any logical `res://assets/...`
#  path, whether it is bundled or must come from user://content/.
#
#  Responsibilities:
#    * resolve/load audio & images from either location
#    * fetch the server manifest
#    * download per-lesson on demand, or everything ("download all")
#    * track what is already downloaded (user://content/index.json)
#
#  Offline-first: if a file is missing and cannot be fetched, callers get a
#  null stream/texture and degrade gracefully (e.g. TTS fallback for words).
# ============================================================

signal manifest_ready()
signal download_progress(done_count: int, total_count: int, done_bytes: int, total_bytes: int)
signal download_finished(success: bool)
signal lesson_ready(book: int, lesson: int)

const LOCAL_DIR := "user://content/"
const INDEX_PATH := "user://content/index.json"
const MANIFEST_PATH := "user://content/manifest.json"

var _manifest: Dictionary = {}
var _index: Dictionary = {}

# resolve() results cached by logical path so hot paths (per-word audio /
# image lookups in lesson lists) don't stat the filesystem every call.
# Cleared whenever a file lands on or leaves disk (_store_file,
# clear_downloads, validate_downloads).
var _resolve_cache: Dictionary = {}
# Manifest entries indexed by "book|lesson", rebuilt whenever the manifest
# changes, so _files_for_lesson() is a Dictionary lookup instead of a linear
# scan over the whole manifest.
var _lesson_files: Dictionary = {}

var _queue: Array = []
var _active: bool = false
var _failed: Array = []
var _auth_dead: bool = false
var _awaiting_token: bool = false

var _http: HTTPRequest
var _manifest_http: HTTPRequest

# Download batch progress counters.
var _dl_total_count: int = 0
var _dl_done_count: int = 0
var _dl_total_bytes: int = 0
var _dl_done_bytes: int = 0

var _pending_lessons: Array = []


func _ready() -> void:
	_load_index()
	_load_cached_manifest()

	_http = HTTPRequest.new()
	_http.timeout = 60.0
	_http.request_completed.connect(_on_download_completed)
	add_child(_http)

	_manifest_http = HTTPRequest.new()
	_manifest_http.timeout = 20.0
	_manifest_http.request_completed.connect(_on_manifest_completed)
	add_child(_manifest_http)

	var api := _api_node()
	if api != null and api.has_signal("token_refreshed"):
		api.token_refreshed.connect(_on_token_refreshed)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# RESOLUTION / LOADING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

## Returns a loadable path for a logical `res://assets/...` path, preferring
## the bundled copy, then the downloaded copy, else "" when missing.
func resolve(logical_path: String) -> String:
	if _resolve_cache.has(logical_path):
		return _resolve_cache[logical_path]
	var resolved := ""
	if FileAccess.file_exists(logical_path):
		resolved = logical_path
	else:
		var rel := _rel(logical_path)
		if rel != "":
			var local := _local_for(rel)
			if FileAccess.file_exists(local):
				resolved = local
	_resolve_cache[logical_path] = resolved
	return resolved


func has_asset(logical_path: String) -> bool:
	return resolve(logical_path) != ""


## Load an AudioStream from either the bundled or downloaded copy.
func load_audio(logical_path: String) -> AudioStream:
	var path := resolve(logical_path)
	if path == "":
		return null
	if path.begins_with("res://"):
		return load(path) as AudioStream
	match path.get_extension().to_lower():
		"mp3":
			return AudioStreamMP3.load_from_file(path)
		"ogg":
			return AudioStreamOggVorbis.load_from_file(path)
		"wav":
			return AudioStreamWAV.load_from_file(path)
	return null


## Load a Texture2D from either the bundled or downloaded copy.
func load_image(logical_path: String) -> Texture2D:
	var path := resolve(logical_path)
	if path == "":
		return null
	if path.begins_with("res://"):
		return load(path) as Texture2D
	var image := Image.load_from_file(path)
	if image == null:
		return null
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MANIFEST
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func get_manifest() -> Dictionary:
	return _manifest


func has_manifest() -> bool:
	return not _manifest.is_empty()


## Fetch the manifest from the server (requires a logged-in session).
func refresh_manifest() -> void:
	_ensure_logged_in(func(ok: bool) -> void:
		if not ok:
			# Guest / offline: nothing to fetch. Not an error — the app runs
			# from any bundled assets and fetches content once signed in.
			return
		var base := _api_base()
		if base == "":
			push_warning("Content: api_base_url not set.")
			return
		var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + _token()])
		var err := _manifest_http.request(base + "/content/manifest", headers)
		if err != OK:
			push_error("Content: manifest request failed (%d)" % err)
	)


func _on_manifest_completed(result: int, code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or code != 200:
		push_warning("Content: manifest fetch failed (result %d, HTTP %d)" % [result, code])
		return
	var text := body.get_string_from_utf8()
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(text)
	if not (parsed is Dictionary):
		push_error("Content: manifest is not a JSON object.")
		return
	_manifest = parsed
	_rebuild_lesson_index()
	var file := FileAccess.open(MANIFEST_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file != null:
		file.store_string(text)
		file.close()
	manifest_ready.emit()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DOWNLOADS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func is_lesson_ready(book: int, lesson: int) -> bool:
	for entry in _files_for_lesson(book, lesson):
		if not _entry_present(entry):
			return false
	return true


## Make sure every file for a lesson is present; download the missing ones.
func ensure_lesson(book: int, lesson: int) -> void:
	if not has_manifest():
		# Without a manifest we can't know what to fetch; try once and bail.
		refresh_manifest()
		return
	if is_lesson_ready(book, lesson):
		lesson_ready.emit(book, lesson)
		return
	if not _pending_lessons.has([book, lesson]):
		_pending_lessons.append([book, lesson])
	_reset_if_idle()
	for entry in _files_for_lesson(book, lesson):
		_enqueue(entry)
	_emit_progress()
	_pump()


## Queue every manifest file that isn't downloaded yet.
func download_all() -> void:
	if not has_manifest():
		refresh_manifest()
		return
	_reset_if_idle()
	for entry in _manifest.get("files", []):
		_enqueue(entry)
	_emit_progress()
	_pump()


func retry_failed() -> void:
	if _failed.is_empty():
		return
	_reset_if_idle()
	for entry in _failed:
		_enqueue(entry)
	_failed.clear()
	_emit_progress()
	_pump()


func is_downloading() -> bool:
	return _active or not _queue.is_empty()


func failed_downloads() -> Array:
	return _failed.duplicate()


## Cancel the current download batch: stops the in-flight request, clears the
## queue and progress, and returns to idle. Already-stored files are kept.
func cancel_downloads() -> void:
	if _http != null and _active:
		_http.cancel_request()
	_active = false
	_queue.clear()
	_pending_lessons.clear()
	_dl_total_count = 0
	_dl_done_count = 0
	_dl_total_bytes = 0
	_dl_done_bytes = 0
	_emit_progress()


## Per-file state: "bundled" | "downloaded" | "queued" | "failed" | "missing".
func file_status(rel: String) -> String:
	var bundled := "res://" + rel
	if FileAccess.file_exists(bundled):
		return "bundled"
	var local := _local_for(rel)
	if FileAccess.file_exists(local):
		return "downloaded"
	for entry in _queue:
		if str(entry.get("path", "")) == rel:
			return "queued"
	for entry in _failed:
		if str(entry.get("path", "")) == rel:
			return "failed"
	return "missing"


func _reset_if_idle() -> void:
	if not _active and _queue.is_empty() and _failed.is_empty():
		_dl_total_count = 0
		_dl_done_count = 0
		_dl_total_bytes = 0
		_dl_done_bytes = 0
		_auth_dead = false


func _enqueue(entry: Dictionary) -> void:
	if _entry_present(entry):
		return
	var rel := str(entry.get("path", ""))
	if rel == "":
		return
	for queued in _queue:
		if str(queued.get("path", "")) == rel:
			return
	_queue.append(entry)
	_dl_total_count += 1
	_dl_total_bytes += int(entry.get("size", 0))


func _pump() -> void:
	if _active or _auth_dead:
		return
	if _queue.is_empty():
		_on_queue_drained()
		return
	_active = true
	var entry: Dictionary = _queue[0]
	var url := _api_base() + str(entry.get("url", ""))
	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + _token()])
	var err := _http.request(url, headers)
	if err != OK:
		push_error("Content: download request failed (%d) for %s" % [err, url])
		_active = false
		_queue.pop_front()
		_failed.append(entry)
		call_deferred("_pump")


func _on_download_completed(result: int, code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	_active = false
	if _queue.is_empty():
		return
	var entry: Dictionary = _queue[0]

	if result == HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS and code == 200:
		if _store_file(entry, body):
			_queue.pop_front()
			_dl_done_count += 1
			_dl_done_bytes += int(entry.get("size", 0))
			_emit_progress()
		else:
			_queue.pop_front()
			_failed.append(entry)
		call_deferred("_pump")
		return

	if code == 401 and not _awaiting_token:
		var api := _api_node()
		if api != null:
			_awaiting_token = true
			api.refresh_tokens()
			return
	# Any other failure: skip this file, remember it, keep going.
	push_warning("Content: download failed (result %d, HTTP %d) for %s" % [result, code, entry.get("path", "")])
	_queue.pop_front()
	_failed.append(entry)
	call_deferred("_pump")


func _on_token_refreshed(success: bool) -> void:
	if not _awaiting_token:
		return
	_awaiting_token = false
	if success:
		call_deferred("_pump")
	else:
		# Session is dead — stop the whole batch rather than N failing requests.
		_auth_dead = true
		download_finished.emit(false)


func _on_queue_drained() -> void:
	_emit_progress()
	_check_pending_lessons()
	download_finished.emit(_failed.is_empty())


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# STORAGE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

func total_downloaded_bytes() -> int:
	var total := 0
	for info in _index.values():
		total += int(info.get("size", 0))
	return total


func clear_downloads() -> void:
	_index.clear()
	_resolve_cache.clear()
	_save_index()
	_remove_dir_recursive(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(LOCAL_DIR))


func _store_file(entry: Dictionary, bytes: PackedByteArray) -> bool:
	var rel := str(entry.get("path", ""))
	if rel == "":
		return false
	# Verify the payload against the manifest checksum BEFORE touching disk, so
	# a truncated/corrupt download is retried instead of poisoning the cache.
	var expected := str(entry.get("sha256", ""))
	if expected != "":
		var actual := _sha256(bytes)
		if actual.to_lower() != expected.to_lower():
			push_error("Content: checksum mismatch for %s (got %s, want %s) — not storing." % [rel, actual, expected])
			return false
	var local := _local_for(rel)
	var dir := local.get_base_dir()
	if not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(dir):
		var mk := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(dir)
		if mk != OK:
			push_error("Content: cannot create %s (%d)" % [dir, mk])
			return false
	var file := FileAccess.open(local, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_error("Content: cannot write %s" % local)
		return false
	file.store_buffer(bytes)
	file.close()
	_index[rel] = {"sha256": expected, "size": bytes.size()}
	_resolve_cache.clear()
	_save_index()
	return true


func _save_index() -> void:
	var file := FileAccess.open(INDEX_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_error("Content: cannot write index %s" % INDEX_PATH)
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(_index))
	file.close()


## SHA-256 of a byte buffer, hex-encoded lowercase. Used to verify downloads.
func _sha256(data: PackedByteArray) -> String:
	var ctx := HashingContext.new()
	ctx.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	ctx.update(data)
	return ctx.finish().hex_encode()


## Re-verify every cached file against the manifest checksum and re-queue the
## ones that rot on disk (power loss mid-write, storage corruption, ...).
## Returns the count of files that were re-queued.
func validate_downloads() -> int:
	if not has_manifest():
		return 0
	var bad_rels: Array = []
	for entry in _manifest.get("files", []):
		var expected := str(entry.get("sha256", ""))
		if expected == "":
			continue
		var rel := str(entry.get("path", ""))
		if rel == "":
			continue
		if not _index.has(rel):
			continue
		var local := _local_for(rel)
		if not FileAccess.file_exists(local):
			continue
		var f := FileAccess.open(local, FileAccess.READ)
		if f == null:
			continue
		var bytes := f.get_buffer(f.get_length())
		f.close()
		if _sha256(bytes).to_lower() != expected.to_lower():
			push_warning("Content: %s is corrupt on disk; re-queuing." % rel)
			bad_rels.append(entry)
			_index.erase(rel)
			_resolve_cache.clear()
	if not bad_rels.is_empty():
		_save_index()
		_reset_if_idle()
		for entry in bad_rels:
			_enqueue(entry)
		_pump()
	return bad_rels.size()


func _load_index() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(INDEX_PATH):
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(INDEX_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(file.get_as_text())
	file.close()
	if parsed is Dictionary:
		_index = parsed


func _load_cached_manifest() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(MANIFEST_PATH):
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(MANIFEST_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(file.get_as_text())
	file.close()
	if parsed is Dictionary:
		_manifest = parsed
		_rebuild_lesson_index()


func _remove_dir_recursive(abs_path: String) -> void:
	if not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(abs_path):
		return
	var dir := DirAccess.open(abs_path)
	if dir == null:
		return
	dir.list_dir_begin()
	var entry_name := dir.get_next()
	while entry_name != "":
		var full := abs_path.path_join(entry_name)
		if dir.current_is_dir():
			_remove_dir_recursive(full)
		else:
			DirAccess.remove_absolute(full)
		entry_name = dir.get_next()
	dir.list_dir_end()
	DirAccess.remove_absolute(abs_path)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# HELPERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

## Rebuilds the "book|lesson" -> entries index. Call whenever `_manifest` changes.
func _rebuild_lesson_index() -> void:
	_lesson_files.clear()
	for entry in _manifest.get("files", []):
		if not (entry is Dictionary):
			continue
		var key := "%d|%d" % [int(entry.get("book", -1)), int(entry.get("lesson", -1))]
		if not _lesson_files.has(key):
			_lesson_files[key] = []
		(_lesson_files[key] as Array).append(entry)


func _files_for_lesson(book: int, lesson: int) -> Array:
	var key := "%d|%d" % [book, lesson]
	if _lesson_files.has(key):
		return _lesson_files[key]
	return []


func _entry_present(entry: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var rel := str(entry.get("path", ""))
	if rel == "":
		return false
	return FileAccess.file_exists(_local_for(rel)) or FileAccess.file_exists("res://" + rel)


func _check_pending_lessons() -> void:
	var still: Array = []
	for pair in _pending_lessons:
		if is_lesson_ready(int(pair[0]), int(pair[1])):
			lesson_ready.emit(int(pair[0]), int(pair[1]))
		else:
			still.append(pair)
	_pending_lessons = still


func _emit_progress() -> void:
	download_progress.emit(_dl_done_count, _dl_total_count, _dl_done_bytes, _dl_total_bytes)


func _rel(logical_path: String) -> String:
	if logical_path.begins_with("res://"):
		return logical_path.substr(6)
	return logical_path


func _local_for(rel: String) -> String:
	return LOCAL_DIR + rel


func _api_base() -> String:
	var base := str(ProjectSettings.get_setting("vision_master/api_base_url", "")).strip_edges()
	if base.ends_with("/"):
		base = base.substr(0, base.length() - 1)
	return base


func _api_node() -> Node:
	return get_node_or_null("/root/API")


func _token() -> String:
	var api := _api_node()
	if api != null and api.has_method("get_access_token"):
		return str(api.get_access_token())
	return ""


func _ensure_logged_in(callback: Callable) -> void:
	var api := _api_node()
	if api == null or not api.has_method("is_logged_in"):
		callback.call(false)
		return
	if not api.is_logged_in():
		callback.call(false)
		return
	api.ensure_token(callback)
```

```gdscript
extends Node

## Cross-scene state for official daily challenges. The selected date is
## persisted as a canonical Gregorian key; no local date is calculated here.
static var selected_date: String = ""
static var selected_game: String = ""
static var current_attempt_id: String = ""
static var current_attempt_counted: bool = true
static var current_attempt_started_at: String = ""
static var current_public_content: Dictionary = {}
static var current_attempt_state: Dictionary = {}
static var current_attempt_status: String = ""

const STATE_PATH: String = "user://daily_challenge_state.cfg"

static func set_selected_date(date_key: String) -> void:
	selected_date = date_key
	var config: ConfigFile = ConfigFile.new()
	config.load(STATE_PATH)
	config.set_value("challenge", "selected_date", date_key)
	config.save(STATE_PATH)

static func load_selected_date() -> String:
	if selected_date != "":
		return selected_date
	var config: ConfigFile = ConfigFile.new()
	if config.load(STATE_PATH) == OK:
		selected_date = str(config.get_value("challenge", "selected_date", ""))
	return selected_date

static func begin_attempt(game_type: String, attempt_id: String, counted: bool, public_content: Dictionary, started_at: String = "", attempt_state: Dictionary = {}, attempt_status: String = "in_progress") -> void:
	selected_game = game_type
	current_attempt_id = attempt_id
	current_attempt_counted = counted
	current_attempt_started_at = started_at
	current_public_content = public_content.duplicate(true)
	current_attempt_state = attempt_state.duplicate(true)
	current_attempt_status = attempt_status

static func clear_attempt() -> void:
	current_attempt_id = ""
	selected_game = ""
	current_attempt_started_at = ""
	current_public_content.clear()
	current_attempt_state.clear()
	current_attempt_status = ""
	current_attempt_counted = true
```

```gdscript
## ============================================================
##  DESIGN TOKENS — the single source of truth for the app's visual language.
##
##  Everything visual in Vision Master resolves to a value in this file: the
##  palette, the corner-radius scale, border thickness, shadow levels, icon
##  sizes, the spacing scale, and a StyleBoxFlat factory for every component
##  (cards, five button states, inputs, dropdowns, toggles, sliders, progress
##  bars, toasts, modals, table rows and empty-state tiles).
##
##  WHY a separate module instead of scattering colours through scenes:
##  the app is code-generated UI — screens build their trees in GDScript and
##  read their colours from the theme. Keeping the whole visual language in one
##  place means a restyle is a change here, not a sweep through 49 scenes, and
##  it keeps the single supported appearance consistent by construction.
##
##  Consumers: ThemeService (palette + base Theme), MenuStyle (menu components),
##  ScrambledTheme / ExerciseTheme / GrammarTheme (gameplay modules).
##
##  SCALE NOTE: the design language was authored against a ~930px reference
##  panel, while this app renders a 1080x1920 portrait mobile viewport. Every
##  length below is therefore the reference token multiplied to app scale
##  (radius 4/8/12/18 -> 8/18/24/36, shadow 8/16/28, icon 14/18/22 -> 34/44/54)
##  so the proportions in the reference are preserved at app size.
## ============================================================

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- accents --
# The signature values as standalone consts. They exist so a SCREEN can name
# them in a `const` initialiser: indexing a const Dictionary is not a constant
# expression in GDScript, but referencing a const Color is. The palette below
# is built from these, so there is still exactly one place each colour lives.

## to white for an unknown role, so a missing key degrades to "invisible".

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  PALETTE ACCESS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Returns the sole supported palette. The argument remains for compatibility
## with existing style factories; its value no longer selects another palette.
static func palette(_dark: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
	return PALETTE_LIGHT


## Convenience: one role straight out of a palette.
static func color_of(dark: bool, role: String) -> Color:
	return palette(dark).get(role, Color.WHITE)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  LOW-LEVEL STYLEBOX HELPERS
#  Every factory below is built from these, so geometry is never restated.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## A filled, optionally bordered, optionally elevated rounded rect.
static func box(
		fill: Color,
		radius: int = RADIUS_MD,
		border_color: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
		border_width: int = 0,
		shadow_color: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
		shadow_size: int = 0,
		shadow_offset: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
	) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var s := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	s.bg_color = fill
	s.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	s.anti_aliasing = true
	if border_width > 0:
		s.set_border_width_all(border_width)
		s.border_color = border_color
	if shadow_size > 0:
		s.shadow_color = shadow_color
		s.shadow_size = shadow_size
		s.shadow_offset = shadow_offset
	return s


## Uniform inner padding, applied only to the sides actually given.
static func pad(s: StyleBoxFlat, x: int, y: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	s.content_margin_left = x
	s.content_margin_right = x
	s.content_margin_top = y
	s.content_margin_bottom = y
	return s


## Padding with different horizontal / vertical amounts on each side.
static func pad_box(s: StyleBoxFlat, left: int, top: int, right: int, bottom: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	s.content_margin_left = left
	s.content_margin_top = top
	s.content_margin_right = right
	s.content_margin_bottom = bottom
	return s


## A soft elevation shadow tinted by its own fill, so a blue card casts blue.
## `size` is accepted for call-site symmetry with the shadow factories but not
## read here: the caller sets shadow_size on the StyleBoxFlat itself, so the
## tint and the geometry stay independently tunable.
static func glow(tint: Color, strength: float, _size: int) -> Color:
	return Color(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, strength)


## Rounds only the top two corners — used by a modal's header band, which has to
## meet the square-shouldered body below it.
static func round_top(s: StyleBoxFlat, radius: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	s.corner_radius_top_left = radius
	s.corner_radius_top_right = radius
	s.corner_radius_bottom_left = 0
	s.corner_radius_bottom_right = 0
	return s


## Rounds only the bottom two corners — the modal body / page header mirror.
static func round_bottom(s: StyleBoxFlat, radius: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	s.corner_radius_top_left = 0
	s.corner_radius_top_right = 0
	s.corner_radius_bottom_left = radius
	s.corner_radius_bottom_right = radius
	return s


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  BUTTONS — the five states in the reference sheet.
#    Default : cream surface with a warm gold rim + gold outer glow
#    Hover   : vivid blue, brighter blue rim, blue glow
#    Pressed : deeper blue, tight shadow (reads as pushed IN)
#    Disabled: flat grey, no rim, no shadow, no glow
#    Focus   : a soft blue ring drawn around whatever state is showing
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## The resting button: cream paper, gold rim, warm glow. This is the reference
## sheet's "Default" state — the neutral / secondary action.
## The fill is OPAQUE on purpose: `gold_soft` carries an alpha, and lerping
## from it would leave the button translucent, letting the page show through.
static func button_default(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill: Color = Color("#EFE7D2")
	var rim: Color = PALETTE_LIGHT["gold_rim"]
	var gold: Color = PALETTE_LIGHT["gold"]
	var s := box(
		fill,
		RADIUS_PILL,
		rim,
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(gold, 0.24, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
		SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## The PRIMARY action — the modal's "Content" button and every "Continue" /
## "Check" / "Next" in the app. Flat accent blue with a bright rim + blue glow.
static func button_primary(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["accent"],
		RADIUS_PILL,
		p["accent_bright"],
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(p["accent"], 0.50, SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE),
		SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Primary hover: a shade brighter so it still reacts after being the resting
## style of a call-to-action.
static func button_primary_hover(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["accent_bright"],
		RADIUS_PILL,
		p["accent_bright"],
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(p["accent"], 0.65, SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE),
		SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Hover: the blue state. Fill lifts toward accent_bright.
static func button_hover(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["accent"],
		RADIUS_PILL,
		p["accent_bright"],
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(p["accent"], 0.55, SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE),
		SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Pressed: deeper blue and a tighter shadow so the button sinks.
static func button_pressed(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["accent_deep"],
		RADIUS_PILL,
		p["accent"],
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(p["accent_deep"], 0.50, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
		SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
		Vector2(0, 4)
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Disabled: contrast drops and the shadow is removed entirely.
static func button_disabled(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill := Color("#D8D3C7")
	var s := box(fill, RADIUS_PILL, Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 0)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Focus ring: a transparent body carrying only the blue outline, so it can be
## layered over any state without hiding it.
static func button_focus(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(Color(0, 0, 0, 0), RADIUS_PILL, p["accent_bright"], BORDER_PROMINENT)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Text colour for a button in a given state. The cream default needs dark ink;
## the blue hover/pressed states need white.
static func button_text_color(state: String, dark: bool = false) -> Color:
	var p := palette(dark)
	match state:
		"default":
			# The resting button is cream in BOTH themes, so its label is always
			# ink. Light briefly used `gold` here, which lands at barely 3.5:1 on
			# the cream fill — under the 4.5:1 target for body-sized text.
			return p["ink"]
		"disabled":
			return p["text_muted"]
		_:
			return p["on_accent"]


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CARDS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## The standard raised card: surface fill, hairline border, medium elevation.
static func card(_dark: bool = false, lifted: bool = false, flat: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
	var fill: Color = p["surface_alt"] if lifted else p["surface"]
	var s := box(fill, RADIUS_MD, p["border"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	if not flat:
		s.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
		s.shadow_size = SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE if lifted else SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE
		s.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 10 if lifted else 6)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_MD)


## The warm paper card — the cream tile in the reference, with a gold rim.
## Use for anything meant to feel "dealt on top of" the app.
static func card_paper(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill: Color = Color("#FFFDF6")
	var s := box(
		fill,
		RADIUS_MD,
		PALETTE_LIGHT["gold_rim"],
		BORDER_SUBTLE,
		Color(0, 0, 0, 0.12),
		SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2(0, 10)
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_MD)


## The blue-tinted card (the reference's first card) — an accent-identified tile.
static func card_accent(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill: Color = Color("#DCE8F8")
	var s := box(fill, RADIUS_MD, PALETTE_LIGHT["accent_soft"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	s.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
	s.shadow_size = SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE
	s.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 10)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_MD)


## Inset / sunken surface: inputs, empty-state tiles, unselected table rows.
## A StyleBoxFlat cannot draw a true inner shadow, so the "pressed into the
## plate" read comes from a fill darker than its parent plus a light top edge.
static func inset(dark: bool = false, radius: int = RADIUS_SM) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(p["surface_sunken"], radius, p["border"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	s.border_width_top = BORDER_STANDARD
	s.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.07)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## Focused input: the inset body plus the reference's always-visible soft ring.
static func input_focus(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["surface_sunken"],
		RADIUS_SM,
		p["accent"],
		BORDER_STANDARD,
		glow(p["accent"], 0.40, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
		SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CHIPS, PILLS & BADGES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Rounded square behind a card's icon / emoji, tinted by its identity colour.
static func icon_chip(accent_col: Color, radius: int = RADIUS_XS, _dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var a := 0.14
	var s := box(
		Color(accent_col.r, accent_col.g, accent_col.b, a),
		radius,
		Color(accent_col.r, accent_col.g, accent_col.b, 0.42),
		BORDER_SUBTLE
	)
	return s


## Fully rounded status pill (counts, levels, tags).
static func pill(accent_col: Color, _dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var a := 0.12
	var s := box(
		Color(accent_col.r, accent_col.g, accent_col.b, a),
		RADIUS_PILL,
		Color(accent_col.r, accent_col.g, accent_col.b, 0.45),
		BORDER_SUBTLE
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_SM, SPACE_XS)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TABLES (the reference's three row states)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

static func table_row(state: String, _dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	match state:
		"hover":
			var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
			var s := box(
				p["accent"],
				RADIUS_SM,
				p["accent_bright"],
				BORDER_SUBTLE,
				glow(p["accent"], 0.45, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
				SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
				Vector2.ZERO
			)
			return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)
		"selected":
			var q := PALETTE_LIGHT
			# Opaque gold-cream: lerping from `gold_soft` would inherit its
			# alpha and the row would blend into whatever sits behind it.
			var sel_fill: Color = Color("#F2E7C9")
			var g := box(
				sel_fill,
				RADIUS_SM,
				q["gold_rim"],
				BORDER_STANDARD,
				glow(q["gold"], 0.30, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
				SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
				Vector2.ZERO
			)
			return pad(g, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)
		_:
			return inset(false, RADIUS_SM)


## Type colour that stays legible on each row state.
static func table_row_text_color(state: String, _dark: bool = false) -> Color:
	var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
	if state == "hover":
		return p["on_accent"]
	if state == "selected":
		return p["gold"]
	return p["text"]


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  MODAL DIALOG — blue header band, cream body, deep diffuse shadow.
#  Emitted as a Dictionary so a caller can put `header` on the title bar and
#  `body` on the content panel without this module knowing the tree shape.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

static func modal(_dark: bool = false) -> Dictionary:
	var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
	var header := box(p["accent"], RADIUS_LG, p["accent_bright"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	round_top(header, RADIUS_LG)
	pad(header, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)

	# A single deep shadow belongs to the BODY: the header sits flush on top of
	# it, so giving both an elevation would double the darkening at the seam.
	var body_fill: Color = Color("#FFFDF6")
	var body := box(body_fill, RADIUS_LG, p["border"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	round_bottom(body, RADIUS_LG)
	pad(body, SPACE_LG, SPACE_LG)
	body.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.18)
	body.shadow_size = SHADOW_DEEP_SIZE
	body.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 16)

	return {"header": header, "body": body}


## Type colours for the modal, since its body is always a light surface.
static func modal_text_color(_dark: bool = false) -> Color:
	return Color("#2F2C26")


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TOAST — cream notification with a success tick, floating on a soft shadow.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

static func toast(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill: Color = Color("#FFFDF6")
	var s := box(
		fill,
		RADIUS_MD,
		PALETTE_LIGHT["gold_rim"],
		BORDER_SUBTLE,
		Color(0, 0, 0, 0.14),
		SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2(0, 10)
	)
	return pad(s, SPACE_MD, SPACE_SM)


## The circular tick badge inside a toast.
static func toast_badge(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return box(PALETTE_LIGHT["success"], RADIUS_PILL)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CONTROLS — toggle, slider, progress
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Toggle track: accent + glow when on, flat grey when off.
static func toggle_track(on: bool, _dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
	if on:
		var s := box(
			p["accent"],
			RADIUS_PILL,
			p["accent_bright"],
			BORDER_SUBTLE,
			glow(p["accent"], 0.45, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
			SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
			Vector2.ZERO
		)
		return s
	return box(Color("#CFC9BC"), RADIUS_PILL)


## Toggle knob: a cream disc that carries its own small shadow.
static func toggle_knob(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill: Color = Color("#FFFFFF")
	var s := box(
		fill,
		RADIUS_PILL,
		Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10),
		BORDER_SUBTLE,
		Color(0, 0, 0, 0.42),
		SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
		Vector2(0, 3)
	)
	return s


## Slider: a sunken track, an accent fill up to the current value, and a cream
## grabber matching the reference's discs.
static func slider_track(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return box(palette(dark)["surface_sunken"], RADIUS_PILL)


static func slider_fill(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return box(palette(dark)["accent"], RADIUS_PILL)


## A Slider's `grabber` is an ICON (Texture2D), NOT a StyleBox — Godot's
## Slider theme type exposes `slider` / `grabber_area` as styleboxes and
## `grabber` as a texture. So the reference's cream knob is drawn procedurally
## as a radial-gradient disc instead of shipping an image asset.
static func slider_grabber_texture(_dark: bool = false) -> Texture2D:
	var fill: Color = Color("#FFFFFF")
	var grad := Gradient.new()
	# Hold the fill out to 0.86 of the radius, then fall to fully transparent,
	# which gives a crisp disc rather than a fuzzy blob.
	grad.set_color(0, fill)
	grad.set_color(1, Color(fill.r, fill.g, fill.b, 0.0))
	grad.add_point(0.86, fill)
	var tex := GradientTexture2D.new()
	tex.gradient = grad
	tex.width = ICON_LG
	tex.height = ICON_LG
	tex.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL
	tex.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	tex.fill_to = Vector2(1.0, 0.5)
	return tex


## Progress bar: blue fill with the reference's glowing rounded cap, over a
## gold-tinted remainder track.
static func progress_fill(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(
		p["accent"],
		RADIUS_PILL,
		p["accent_bright"],
		BORDER_SUBTLE,
		glow(p["accent"], 0.50, SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE),
		SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE,
		Vector2.ZERO
	)
	return s


static func progress_track(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	# Opaque so the un-filled remainder reads as a real gold-tinted track
	# rather than the page showing through a translucent tint.
	var fill: Color = Color("#E9DFC0")
	return box(fill, RADIUS_PILL)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  EMPTY STATE — the inset tile with a rounded icon and centred muted copy.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

static func empty_tile(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := palette(dark)
	var s := box(p["surface_sunken"], RADIUS_MD, p["border"], BORDER_SUBTLE)
	s.content_margin_left = SPACE_LG
	s.content_margin_right = SPACE_LG
	s.content_margin_top = SPACE_XL
	s.content_margin_bottom = SPACE_XL
	return s


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CHROME — header bar & scrollbars
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Page header: rounded bottom shoulders, a gold underline and a soft drop.
static func header_bar(_dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var p := PALETTE_LIGHT
	var fill: Color = Color("#FFFDF6", 0.97)
	var s := box(fill, RADIUS_XL, p["border"], 0)
	round_bottom(s, RADIUS_LG)
	s.border_width_bottom = BORDER_PROMINENT
	s.border_color = p["gold_rim"]
	s.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.14)
	s.shadow_size = SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE
	s.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 8)
	return s


static func scrollbar_grabber(dark: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return box(palette(dark)["accent"], RADIUS_PILL)


static func scrollbar_track() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return box(Color(0, 0, 0, 0), RADIUS_PILL)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  VALIDATION — used by tests to guarantee the two palettes stay in lockstep.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Returns any missing roles from the sole supported Light palette.
static func missing_roles() -> Array:
	var missing: Array = []
	for role in PALETTE_ROLES:
		if not PALETTE_LIGHT.has(role):
			missing.append("light:" + role)
	return missing
```
