```gdscript
class_name HeaderBarStyler
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  HEADER BAR STYLER — the app-wide header bar engine.
##
##  Split out of ThemeService (which had grown to own the palette, the scene
##  walk AND the header engine). This collaborator owns exactly one thing:
##  given a Control in the scene that is a header bar, style it and lay its
##  items out in the app-wide order
##
##      [back][home]      title (centred)      [translation][audio][leitner]
##
##  Every screen wears the bar the main menu and the lesson menu wear: a 200 px
##  tall white surface with 35 px bottom shoulders, 60 px side padding and one
##  line of type in the middle. Every item is a SQUARE ICON BUTTON of the same
##  size, in the same slot on every screen, and it never scales or slides — the
##  back arrow sits in exactly the same place everywhere.
##
##  It is a pure function of its context: it never reaches for an autoload, so
##  it can be exercised in isolation. Call `set_context()` whenever the theme
##  mode changes.
##
##  Every colour and geometry value comes from DesignTokens / the shared
##  stylebox and texture resources — nothing visual is defined here.
## ============================================================

const STYLEBOX_DIR := "res://resources/styleboxes/"

## The one surface every bar paints — the same resource the scene headers
## reference in their .tscn, so the editor preview and the runtime look cannot
## drift apart.
const BAR_STYLEBOX_PATH := "res://scenes/shared/HeaderBar.tres"

const HEADER_BAR_NAMES := ["HeaderBar", "TopBar", "TopHeader", "TitleBar"]
## Height of the bar itself, in pixels — the main menu's header, which every
## screen in the app now follows.
const BAR_HEIGHT := 200.0
## Radius of the bar's bottom shoulders. Mirrors HeaderBar.tres; asserted by
## the regression test so the resource cannot silently lose it.
const BAR_RADIUS := 35
## Distance from the bar's left/right edge to the first item.
const PAD_X := 60.0
## Distance from the bar's top/bottom edge to the row (kept symmetric so the
## items are exactly centred vertically).
const PAD_Y := 24.0
## Gap between two items in the header row.
const ITEM_GAP := 16.0
## Names of the nodes the row layout rebuilds on every pass.
const LEADING_NAME := "HeaderLeading"
const TRAILING_NAME := "HeaderTrailing"
const FLEX_NAME := "HeaderFlex"

## Square size every header item is pinned to, so the row reads identically in
## every scene no matter which buttons that scene happens to show.
const BUTTON_SIZE := 144.0
## Longest side the icon inside a header button may draw at. The source art is
## a 200 px canvas whose glyph fills ~65 % of it, so 72 px draws a ~50 px icon
## inside the 96 px button.
const ICON_SIZE := 112
## One type ramp for every header title, in pixels.
const TITLE_FONT_SIZE := 40

## What each icon means, so an icon-only bar stays discoverable (hover / long
## press tooltip). Only the recognised roles get one.
const TOOLTIPS := {
	"back":        "بازگشت",
	"audio":       "پخش صدا",
	"leitner":     "جعبه لایتنر",
	"translation": "نمایش ترجمه",
}

## Canonical slot order. A button is placed by its role, not by where the scene
## happened to author it, so "audio" is always the second item from the right
## edge — even in a screen that used to put it on the left.
const LEADING_ORDER := ["back"]
const TRAILING_ORDER := ["translation", "audio", "leitner"]

## Meta key UiMotion.wire_microinteractions() checks before it wires a hover /
## press scale. Header buttons set it so an item can never grow, shrink or
## drift out of its slot — it stays put, at its one size.
const MOTION_WIRED_META := "ui_motion_wired"

## Canonical icons per recognised header button. Keys are produced by
## `_button_kind()` from the button's own name.
const ICONS := {
	"back":        "res://ui/images/Back.png",
	"audio":       "res://ui/images/audio_play.png",
	"leitner":     "res://ui/images/Leitner.png",
	"translation": "res://ui/images/Translate.png",
}

var _dark: bool = false
var _palette: Dictionary = {}


## Pushes the active theme context in. Must be called before any styling, and
## again on every Dark / Light switch.
func set_context(dark: bool, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	_dark = dark
	_palette = palette


func _color(role: String) -> Color:
	return _palette.get(role, Color.WHITE)


func _sb(file_base: String) -> StyleBox:
	var suffix := "light"
	return load(STYLEBOX_DIR + "%s_%s.tres" % [file_base, suffix])


## Mode-independent stylebox — a transparent body is the same in both themes.
func _sb_plain(file_base: String) -> StyleBox:
	return load(STYLEBOX_DIR + "%s.tres" % file_base)


## True when `node` is a bar the app paints as a header. Scenes name their bar
## HeaderBar (a few older ones say TopBar / TitleBar); the watcher in
## ThemeService only ever hands us nodes that answer true.
static func is_header_bar(node: Node) -> bool:
	if node == null or not (node is Control):
		return false
	return String((node as Node).name) in HEADER_BAR_NAMES


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ENTRY POINT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

func style_header(header: Node) -> void:
	if not is_header_bar(header) or not (header as Node).is_inside_tree():
		return

	var row: BoxContainer = find_row(header)
	var inner: MarginContainer = inner_margin(header, row)

	if not _has_header_buttons(header):
		# A title-only hero bar (the main menu and the lesson menu). It already
		# wears the canonical surface and its scene owns the composition — the
		# menus stack a spacer above the label — so only the bar body is pinned.
		# Rebuilding this row would stack the clusters vertically in that VBox.
		if header is PanelContainer or header is Panel:
			header.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _bar_stylebox(inner == null))
		normalize_geometry(header, null)
		return

	# Style the items first: the layout below measures them, so every button
	# must already carry its final (uniform) size when the row is rebuilt.
	for item: Node in _items(header):
		if item is BaseButton:
			_style_button(item as Button)
		elif item is Label:
			_style_label(item as Label)

	# Then the bar itself: one surface, one height, whatever the scene authored.
	if header is PanelContainer or header is Panel:
		header.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _bar_stylebox(inner == null))

	normalize_geometry(header, inner)
	layout_row(row)


## True when the bar carries at least one button, i.e. it is a toolbar rather
## than a title-only hero bar.
func _has_header_buttons(header: Node) -> bool:
	for item: Node in _items(header):
		if item is BaseButton:
			return true
	return false


## Every Button / Label on the bar. Scenes nest them in a row, a margin box or
## a spacer, so the search is a plain subtree walk.
func _items(header: Node) -> Array[Node]:
	var out: Array[Node] = []
	var stack: Array[Node] = [header]
	while not stack.is_empty():
		var node: Node = stack.pop_back()
		if node != header and (node is Button or node is Label):
			out.append(node)
			continue
		for child: Node in node.get_children():
			stack.push_back(child)
	return out


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  GEOMETRY
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## The header's content row: the shallowest BoxContainer under `header` that
## directly holds header items (a button or a label).
static func find_row(header: Node) -> BoxContainer:
	if header == null:
		return null
	for child in header.get_children():
		if child is BoxContainer:
			for item in child.get_children():
				if item is BaseButton or item is Label:
					return child as BoxContainer
		var deeper := find_row(child)
		if deeper != null:
			return deeper
	return null


## The MarginContainer sitting between the bar and its row. The menu screens
## build one, the .tscn lesson screens do not. Null when there is none.
static func inner_margin(header: Node, row: Node) -> MarginContainer:
	if header == null or row == null:
		return null
	var found: MarginContainer = null
	var node := row.get_parent()
	while node != null and node != header:
		if node is MarginContainer:
			found = node as MarginContainer
		node = node.get_parent()
	return found


## Pins the bar to the canonical height and makes exactly one element own the
## padding, so the first item always sits PAD_X from the left edge and the row
## is vertically centred in the bar.
static func normalize_geometry(header: Node, inner: MarginContainer) -> void:
	var bar := header as Control
	if bar == null:
		return
	if bar.get_parent() is Container:
		# Built inside a layout (grammar screens): the flow owns the width,
		# so only the height is pinned.
		bar.custom_minimum_size.y = BAR_HEIGHT
	else:
		bar.anchor_left = 0.0
		bar.anchor_top = 0.0
		bar.anchor_right = 1.0
		bar.anchor_bottom = 0.0
		bar.offset_left = 0.0
		bar.offset_top = 0.0
		bar.offset_right = 0.0
		bar.offset_bottom = BAR_HEIGHT
		bar.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
		bar.grow_vertical = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_END
	if inner != null:
		inner.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", int(PAD_X))
		inner.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", int(PAD_X))
		inner.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", int(PAD_Y))
		inner.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", int(PAD_Y))


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ROW LAYOUT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Rebuilds a header row into the app-wide order. Both sides get the SAME
## fixed width, so the title stays exactly centred on the bar no matter which
## side buttons a scene hides or shows later.
static func layout_row(row: BoxContainer) -> void:
	if row == null:
		return
	_unwrap_row(row)
	row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(ITEM_GAP))
	# Scenes author this row either shrink-centred (the .tscn lesson screens)
	# or expanding (the menu screens); pin it so the row always spans the bar
	# and the left edge is the same pixel column everywhere.
	row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_FILL
	row.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_FILL

	var back_group: Array[Node] = []
	var leading: Array[Node] = []
	var trailing: Array[Node] = []
	var title: Node = null
	for child in row.get_children():
		if _is_spacer_placeholder(child):
			# Placeholder Controls some scenes use to fake spacing — the row
			# below spaces itself, so they are dropped.
			(child as Control).visible = false
			continue
		var kind := _button_kind(child) if child is BaseButton else ""
		if kind == "back":
			back_group.append(child)
		elif kind == "home":
			leading.append(child)
		elif kind == "translation" or kind == "audio" or kind == "leitner":
			trailing.append(child)
		elif title == null and _is_title(child):
			title = child
		elif title == null:
			leading.append(child)
		else:
			trailing.append(child)

	# The back button is always the first item on the left, whatever order the
	# scene authored its header in.
	var left: Array[Node] = []
	for b in back_group:
		left.append(b)
	for l in leading:
		left.append(l)
	leading = _sorted_by_role(left, LEADING_ORDER)
	trailing = _sorted_by_role(trailing, TRAILING_ORDER)

	if title == null:
		# Nothing to centre: pack the leading items left, the rest right.
		for child in leading:
			_detach(child)
			row.add_child(child)
		if not leading.is_empty() and not trailing.is_empty():
			var flex := Control.new()
			flex.name = FLEX_NAME
			flex.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			row.add_child(flex)
		for child in trailing:
			_detach(child)
			row.add_child(child)
		return

	var side := maxf(_side_width(leading), _side_width(trailing))
	var lead_wrap := _make_side(leading, LEADING_NAME, BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN, side)
	var trail_wrap := _make_side(trailing, TRAILING_NAME, BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END, side)
	_center_title(title)
	row.add_child(lead_wrap)
	_detach(title)
	row.add_child(title)
	row.add_child(trail_wrap)
	# Pin the order explicitly: any dropped placeholder is left behind the
	# canonical three so the row reads the same in every scene.
	row.move_child(lead_wrap, 0)
	row.move_child(title, 1)
	row.move_child(trail_wrap, 2)


## Stable sort by a role table. An unknown role sorts after every known one, so
## two unrecognised buttons keep the order their scene authored.
static func _sorted_by_role(items: Array[Node], order: Array) -> Array[Node]:
	var out: Array[Node] = []
	for item: Node in items:
		var slot := _slot_of(item, order)
		var at := out.size()
		for i: int in range(out.size()):
			if slot < _slot_of(out[i], order):
				at = i
				break
		out.insert(at, item)
	return out


static func _slot_of(node: Node, order: Array) -> int:
	var slot := order.find(_button_kind(node))
	return slot if slot >= 0 else order.size()


static func _make_side(items: Array[Node], wrap_name: String, align: BoxContainer.AlignmentMode, side: float) -> HBoxContainer:
	var side_wrap := HBoxContainer.new()
	side_wrap.name = wrap_name
	side_wrap.alignment = align
	side_wrap.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_FILL
	side_wrap.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(ITEM_GAP))
	side_wrap.custom_minimum_size.x = side
	for item in items:
		_detach(item)
		side_wrap.add_child(item)
	return side_wrap


## A node can only be re-parented after it has been detached.
static func _detach(node: Node) -> void:
	var parent := node.get_parent()
	if parent != null:
		parent.remove_child(node)


static func _center_title(title: Node) -> void:
	if title is Label:
		var direct := title as Label
		direct.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		direct.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		direct.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		direct.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		return
	var el := title as Control
	if el == null:
		return
	el.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	el.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	var nested := _first_label(el)
	if nested == null:
		return
	nested.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	nested.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	nested.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_FILL
	if not (el is Container):
		# A plain Control (title + spacer) has no minimum size of its own, so
		# give it the label's so the centred slot keeps the right width.
		el.custom_minimum_size.x = maxf(el.custom_minimum_size.x, nested.get_combined_minimum_size().x)


## Moves the wrappers built by a previous pass back into the row so the next
## pass classifies again from scratch (theme switches re-apply the header).
static func _unwrap_row(row: BoxContainer) -> void:
	for child in row.get_children():
		if child.name != LEADING_NAME and child.name != TRAILING_NAME:
			continue
		var side_wrap := child as HBoxContainer
		if side_wrap == null:
			continue
		for item in side_wrap.get_children():
			side_wrap.remove_child(item)
			row.add_child(item)
		row.remove_child(side_wrap)
		side_wrap.queue_free()
	for child in row.get_children():
		if child.name == FLEX_NAME:
			row.remove_child(child)
			child.queue_free()


static func _side_width(items: Array[Node]) -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for item in items:
		var c := item as Control
		if c != null:
			total += c.get_combined_minimum_size().x
	if items.size() > 1:
		total += ITEM_GAP * float(items.size() - 1)
	return total


## A spacer Control (not a button or label) with no children of its own.
static func _is_spacer_placeholder(node: Node) -> bool:
	if node is BaseButton or node is Label:
		return false
	var c := node as Control
	return c != null and c.get_child_count() == 0


## The title is the row's text: a Label, or the container/spacer that holds it.
static func _is_title(node: Node) -> bool:
	if node is Label:
		return true
	var c := node as Control
	if c == null or c.get_child_count() == 0:
		return false
	if node is BaseButton:
		return false
	return _first_label(node) != null and not _has_button(node)


static func _first_label(node: Node) -> Label:
	for child in node.get_children():
		if child is Label:
			return child as Label
		var deeper := _first_label(child)
		if deeper != null:
			return deeper
	return null


static func _has_button(node: Node) -> bool:
	for child in node.get_children():
		if child is BaseButton:
			return true
		if _has_button(child):
			return true
	return false


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ITEM STYLING
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## One bar look for the whole app: white, square top shoulders (it meets the
## screen edge), rounded bottom. `owns_padding` is false when a MarginContainer
## already supplies the 60 px side padding — the two must never stack up.
func _bar_stylebox(owns_padding: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var bar := (load(BAR_STYLEBOX_PATH) as StyleBoxFlat).duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	bar.set_border_width_all(0)
	bar.corner_radius_top_left = 0
	bar.corner_radius_top_right = 0
	bar.corner_radius_bottom_left = BAR_RADIUS
	bar.corner_radius_bottom_right = BAR_RADIUS
	bar.content_margin_left = PAD_X if owns_padding else 0.0
	bar.content_margin_right = PAD_X if owns_padding else 0.0
	bar.content_margin_top = PAD_Y if owns_padding else 0.0
	bar.content_margin_bottom = PAD_Y if owns_padding else 0.0
	return bar


## Which canonical header role a button plays, inferred from its node name.
static func _button_kind(btn: Node) -> String:
	var n := String(btn.name).to_lower()
	if n.contains("back"):
		return "back"
	if n.contains("home") or n.contains("menu"):
		return "home"
	if n.contains("translation") or n.contains("toggle"):
		return "translation"
	if n.contains("leitner"):
		return "leitner"
	if n.contains("audio"):
		return "audio"
	return ""


## Turns any header button into the app's square icon button: no text, one
## size, one slot. An unknown button keeps whatever icon its scene gave it.
func _style_button(btn: Button) -> void:
	var kind := _button_kind(btn)
	btn.text = ""
	btn.flat = true
	btn.expand_icon = true
	btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	btn.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(BUTTON_SIZE, BUTTON_SIZE)
	btn.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_width", ICON_SIZE)
	btn.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_height", ICON_SIZE)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sb_plain("nav_button_normal"))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sb("nav_button_hover"))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _sb("nav_button_pressed"))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _sb("nav_button_focus"))
	# Still and one size: no hover lift, no press squash, no drift.
	btn.scale = Vector2.ONE
	btn.set_meta(MOTION_WIRED_META, true)
	if kind == "home":
		# Remove the home button from all header bars
		btn.visible = false
		return
	if ICONS.has(kind):
		btn.icon = load(ICONS[kind])
	if TOOLTIPS.has(kind):
		btn.tooltip_text = TOOLTIPS[kind]


## Paints the translation toggle so its on/off state is obvious at a glance.
func set_translation_toggle_state(btn: Button, active: bool) -> void:
	if btn == null:
		return
	var accent := _color("accent")
	if active:
		btn.modulate = accent.lightened(0.35) if _dark else accent
	else:
		btn.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 1)


func _style_label(label: Label) -> void:
	_apply_title_style(label, _color("accent"))


## Re-applies the canonical header title look to a label. Screens call this from
## their `_apply_theme()` so a live re-theme cannot repaint the bar's title with
## a page colour.
static func style_title(label: Label) -> void:
	if label == null:
		return
	_apply_title_style(label, DesignTokens.ACCENT)


## One type ramp for the words on the bar: Vazir for Persian, Jakarta for
## Latin, 40 px, in the accent colour, centred on the bar.
static func _apply_title_style(label: Label, accent: Color) -> void:
	label.label_settings = null
	var font := _title_font(label.text)
	if font != null:
		label.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", TITLE_FONT_SIZE)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	label.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS


## Fonts the bar title can be set in. Loaded straight from res:// rather than
## through MenuStyle, so the engine keeps no autoload in its dependency graph.
const FONT_VAZIR := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_LATIN := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"


static func _title_font(text: String) -> Font:
	return load(FONT_VAZIR if _has_persian(text) else FONT_LATIN) as Font


static func _has_persian(text: String) -> bool:
	for i: int in text.length():
		var code := text.unicode_at(i)
		if code >= 0x0600 and code <= 0x06FF:
			return true
	return false
```

```gdscript
const ENTER_SCALE      := 1.04    # new screen arrives slightly big, settles to 1

func _begin_preload(scene_path: String) -> void:

# between two full-screen artworks.

## covers (a fade covers the swap with black, a slide does not).

			_pending_scene = scene_path
		return

	_fade_busy = true
	var target := scene_path
	# True once the overlay is fully opaque. A chained swap runs while the
	# screen is still black, so its fade-out must not reset the overlay to
	# transparent first — that would flash the outgoing screen for a frame.
	var black := false

	while true:
		_active_scene = target
		# Load the destination on a worker thread while the fade-out
		# animation covers it, so the swap below never stalls a frame.
		_begin_preload(target)
		await _fade_out(black)
		# 2. Swap the scene while nothing is visible.
		var packed: PackedScene = await _threaded_get(target)
		if packed != null:
			get_tree().change_scene_to_packed(packed)
		else:
			get_tree().change_scene_to_file(target)
		# 3. Give the new scene two frames to finish layout before revealing.
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await get_tree().process_frame
		black = true

		# The new screen may already have queued its own navigation (the
		# Saved Words pass-through above). Chain straight into it while the
		# screen is still black instead of revealing a screen nobody wants.
		if _pending_scene != "" and _pending_scene != target:
			target = _pending_scene
			_pending_scene = ""
			continue

		_pending_scene = ""
		# 4. Fade back in.
		await _fade_in()
		black = false
		# A request that arrived during the fade-in still needs a cycle of
		# its own; anything else (including a repeat of this target) is done.
		if _pending_scene == "" or _pending_scene == target:
			_pending_scene = ""
			break
		target = _pending_scene
		_pending_scene = ""

	_active_scene = ""
	_fade_busy = false


## Fades the overlay to opaque. `already_black` is set when a chained swap
## starts while the overlay is already opaque: the overlay stays black and
## only the transparent reset is skipped, so the outgoing screen never flashes.
func _fade_out(already_black: bool = false) -> void:
	color_rect.visible = true
	if not already_black:
		color_rect.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)   # start fully transparent
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(color_rect, "color:a", 1.0, fade_duration)
	await tween.finished


func _fade_in() -> void:
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(color_rect, "color:a", 0.0, fade_duration)
	await tween.finished
	color_rect.visible = false             # hide so it never eats touches


############################################################
# TAB PUSH — quick horizontal transition between bottom tabs.
# FORWARD moves the old screen LEFT; BACK moves it RIGHT.
# Unlike the hierarchical slide, this is a direct push with no scaling.
############################################################
func tab_change_scene(scene_path: String, direction: Slide) -> void:
	if scene_path.is_empty() or _tab_change_busy or _fade_busy or _slide_busy:
		return
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(scene_path):
		push_error("tab_change_scene: can't load '%s'." % scene_path)
		return
	_tab_change_busy = true
	tab_transition_started.emit()
	_lock_navigation_bars()
	# Kick the destination load off on a worker thread immediately, so the
	# outgoing slide animation runs during the load instead of the tap
	# frame stalling on a synchronous load.
	_begin_preload(scene_path)
	var scene_tree: SceneTree = get_tree()
	var travel: float = maxf(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x, 1.0)
	var exit_offset: float = -travel if direction == Slide.FORWARD else travel
	var old_scene: Node = scene_tree.current_scene
	var old_nodes: Array = _slidable_nodes(old_scene)

	# Only scene content participates; the shared background and the persistent
	# bottom navigation (its own canvas layer) remain perfectly stationary.
	if not old_nodes.is_empty():
		var outgoing_tween: Tween = _create_tab_slide_tween(
			old_nodes, exit_offset, false
		)
		await outgoing_tween.finished

	# The worker-thread load started above has had the whole exit animation
	# to finish; pick it up (or fall back to the synchronous path).
	# Hold the outgoing artwork across the swap: backgrounds do not slide, so
	# it is still the backdrop, and the swap's empty frame would show the
	# flat fill instead of it.
	hold_background(_scene_background(old_scene))
	var packed: PackedScene = await _threaded_get(scene_path)
	var error_code: int = OK
	if packed != null:
		error_code = scene_tree.change_scene_to_packed(packed)
	else:
		error_code = scene_tree.change_scene_to_file(scene_path)
	if error_code != OK:
		release_background()
		push_error(
			"tab_change_scene: can't load '%s' (%s)."
			% [scene_path, error_string(error_code)]
		)
		if not old_nodes.is_empty():
			var restore_tween: Tween = _create_tab_slide_tween(
				old_nodes, -exit_offset, true
			)
			await restore_tween.finished
		_finish_tab_transition(false)
		return

	# The incoming screen is in the tree now; drop the still once it has drawn
	# its own background on top of it.
	release_background()

	# Change scenes through a deferred call. Once the native swap emits
	# scene_changed, park the incoming content before the next rendered frame.
	await scene_tree.scene_changed
	var incoming_scene: Node = scene_tree.current_scene
	if incoming_scene == null:
		push_error("tab_change_scene: the new current scene is unavailable.")
		_finish_tab_transition(false)
		return

	var incoming_nodes: Array = _slidable_nodes(incoming_scene)
	for incoming_node: Node in incoming_nodes:
		_shift_tab_node_x(incoming_node, -exit_offset)

	if not incoming_nodes.is_empty():
		var incoming_tween: Tween = _create_tab_slide_tween(
			incoming_nodes, exit_offset, true
		)
		await incoming_tween.finished

	_finish_tab_transition(true)


func _create_tab_slide_tween(
	nodes: Array,
	horizontal_offset: float,
	entering: bool
) -> Tween:
	var movement_tween: Tween = create_tween()
	movement_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	movement_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT if entering else Tween.EASE_IN)
	for node: Node in nodes:
		if not is_instance_valid(node):
			continue
		if node is Control:
			var control_node: Control = node as Control
			var target_left: float = control_node.offset_left + horizontal_offset
			var target_right: float = control_node.offset_right + horizontal_offset
			movement_tween.parallel().tween_property(
				control_node, "offset_left", target_left, TAB_SLIDE_TIME
			)
			movement_tween.parallel().tween_property(
				control_node, "offset_right", target_right, TAB_SLIDE_TIME
			)
		elif node is Node2D:
			var node_2d: Node2D = node as Node2D
			movement_tween.parallel().tween_property(
				node_2d, "position:x", node_2d.position.x + horizontal_offset, TAB_SLIDE_TIME
			)
	return movement_tween


func _shift_tab_node_x(node: Node, offset_x: float) -> void:
	if node is Control:
		var control_node: Control = node as Control
		control_node.offset_left += offset_x
		control_node.offset_right += offset_x
	elif node is Node2D:
		var node_2d: Node2D = node as Node2D
		node_2d.position.x += offset_x


func _finish_tab_transition(success: bool) -> void:
	_tab_change_busy = false
	if color_rect != null:
		color_rect.visible = false
	# Unlocks the persistent bottom navigation (see _unlock_navigation_bars).
	tab_transition_finished.emit(success)


############################################################
# SLIDE — the menu-flow transition.
# FORWARD: old content exits LEFT,  new content enters from RIGHT
# BACK:    old content exits RIGHT, new content enters from LEFT
#
# Flash-free by design: the incoming screen is parked off-screen
# in the SAME frame it is swapped in (before anything renders),
# layout is then allowed to settle while it is invisible, and
# only then does it slide home.
############################################################
############################################################
# INSTANT — threaded but transition-free scene swap.
# Legacy call sites used change_scene_to_file() directly, which loads AND
# instantiates the scene synchronously on the tap frame (a visible hitch).
# change_scene_now() starts the load on a worker thread immediately and
# swaps as soon as the packed scene is ready, with no visual transition —
# identical behaviour minus the stall. Returns false only when the scene
# could not be loaded at all.
############################################################
func change_scene_now(scene_path: String) -> bool:
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(scene_path):
		push_error("change_scene_now: scene not found — " + scene_path)
		return false
	_begin_preload(scene_path)
	var packed: PackedScene = await _threaded_get(scene_path)
	if packed != null:
		get_tree().change_scene_to_packed(packed)
		return true
	# Worker path failed (rare): fall back to the direct call so the tap
	# still goes somewhere instead of dead-ending the user.
	var err := get_tree().change_scene_to_file(scene_path)
	if err != OK:
		push_error("change_scene_now: couldn't open '%s' (%s)."
			% [scene_path, error_string(err)])
		return false
	return true


func slide_change_scene(scene_path: String, direction: Slide) -> void:
	# Ignore any tap that arrives while a slide is already running.
	if _slide_busy:
		return
	_slide_busy = true
	# Start loading the destination on a worker thread right away: the whole
	# Phase-1 exit animation then runs concurrently with the load instead of
	# the load stalling the Phase-2 swap.
	_begin_preload(scene_path)

	# Total horizontal distance: full screen width + margin for shadows.
	var travel := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x + SLIDE_MARGIN
	# Negative = move left (forward), positive = move right (back).
	var exit_offset := -travel if direction == Slide.FORWARD else travel

	# --- Phase 1: push the current screen out. ---
	var old_nodes := _slidable_nodes(get_tree().current_scene)
	if old_nodes.size() > 0:
		# Centre pivots so the exit shrink reads as "pushed backwards".
		# Sizes are valid here — this scene has been live for a while.
		for n in old_nodes:
			if n is Control:
				n.pivot_offset = n.size / 2.0

		var tw_out := create_tween()
		# Ease-in: accelerate off-screen so the corners visibly sweep out.
		tw_out.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
		for n in old_nodes:
			# Every node travels the same delta — the screen moves as one.
			tw_out.parallel().tween_property(
				n, "position:x", n.position.x + exit_offset, SLIDE_EXIT_TIME)
			# Slight shrink while leaving (Controls only — they have real
			# sizes to centre on; Node2D backgrounds just slide).
			if n is Control:
				tw_out.parallel().tween_property(
					n, "scale", Vector2(EXIT_SCALE, EXIT_SCALE), SLIDE_EXIT_TIME)
		await tw_out.finished

	# --- Phase 2: swap scenes while the old content is off-screen. ---
	# The backgrounds never slide, so the outgoing artwork is still the whole
	# backdrop. Hold it on the bridge across the swap: the frame(s) in which
	# the tree has no current scene would otherwise show the flat fill.
	hold_background(_scene_background(get_tree().current_scene))
	var packed: PackedScene = await _threaded_get(scene_path)
	var err := OK
	if packed != null:
		get_tree().change_scene_to_packed(packed)
	else:
		err = get_tree().change_scene_to_file(scene_path)
	if err != OK:
		release_background()
		# Scene failed to load — slide the old screen back home and bail.
		push_error("slide_change_scene: can't load " + scene_path)
		var tw_back := create_tween()
		tw_back.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUINT).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		for n in old_nodes:
			tw_back.parallel().tween_property(
				n, "position:x", n.position.x - exit_offset, SLIDE_ENTER_TIME)
			if n is Control:
				tw_back.parallel().tween_property(n, "scale", Vector2.ONE, SLIDE_ENTER_TIME)
		await tw_back.finished
		_slide_busy = false
		return

	# The incoming screen is in the tree now; drop the still once it has drawn
	# its own background on top of it.
	release_background()

	# --- Phase 3: park the new content off-screen IMMEDIATELY. ---
	# No await before this! change_scene_to_file() returns in the same
	# frame, before rendering — so the incoming screen never gets a
	# chance to flash at its resting position. (This is what fixes the
	# "buttons visible for a millisecond" flicker, in both directions.)
	var new_nodes := _slidable_nodes(get_tree().current_scene)
	for n in new_nodes:
		# Push each node to the entering side (opposite of the exit).
		n.position.x -= exit_offset

	# Let the scene finish layout while it is safely invisible.
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame

	# --- Phase 4: slide the new screen home. ---
	if new_nodes.size() > 0:
		var tw_in := create_tween()
		# Ease-out: arrive fast, settle gently.
		tw_in.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUINT).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		for n in new_nodes:
			# Resting x is read AFTER layout (current x + the offset we
			# applied), so container/anchor settling can't desync it.
			tw_in.parallel().tween_property(
				n, "position:x", n.position.x + exit_offset, SLIDE_ENTER_TIME)
			# Sizes are valid now, so centre pivots are safe; arrive
			# slightly oversized and settle to the exact size.
			if n is Control:
				n.pivot_offset = n.size / 2.0
				n.scale = Vector2(ENTER_SCALE, ENTER_SCALE)
				tw_in.parallel().tween_property(
					n, "scale", Vector2.ONE, SLIDE_ENTER_TIME)
		await tw_in.finished

	# Transition fully done — accept new navigation taps.
	_slide_busy = false


## Returns every root child that should participate in the slide.
## Root-level scene content slides as a unit. Persistent overlays and the
## solid app background live on separate canvas layers and remain stationary.
## CanvasLayers are skipped: they are independent overlays.
## The bottom navigation bar is persistent chrome: it must stay
## perfectly still while the scene content pushes past it, so it is
## skipped too (its selection is carried across the swap explicitly).
func _slidable_nodes(root: Node) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	if root == null:
		return out
	for child in root.get_children():
		# Overlays/HUDs on their own canvas stay put.
		if child is CanvasLayer:
			continue
		# The bottom navigation bar never moves during a transition.
		if child is VisionNavigationBar:
			continue
		# Background images stay fixed so the screen never shows a blank
		# clear color while swapping scenes (avoids the flash between
		# blur and unblur backgrounds).
		if child.name.contains("Background"):
			continue
		# Only nodes with a position property can be tweened this way.
		if child is Control or child is Node2D:
			out.append(child)
	return out
```

## File: `res://scenes/about_me/about_me.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
## ============================================================
##  ABOUT ME — a polished developer/author page.
##  Shown via the side-menu «درباره من» entry (fade transition).
##  Uses the persistent bottom navigation for scene changes.
## ============================================================

const DEV_EMAIL := "mrsaei@example.com"   # TODO: replace with your real contact
const DEV_INSTAGRAM := "@mrsaei"           # TODO: replace with your real handle

# --- Node references (match AboutMe.tscn) ---
@onready var bg: ColorRect = $Bg
@onready var email_button: Button = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/ContactCard/VBox/EmailRow
@onready var instagram_button: Button = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/ContactCard/VBox/InstagramRow
@onready var version_value: Label = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/Footer/VersionValue


func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()
	version_value.text = "نسخه " + _app_version()
	email_button.pressed.connect(_on_email_pressed)
	instagram_button.pressed.connect(_on_instagram_pressed)
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  THEME AWARENESS — restyle this page for Dark / Light
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	_theme_walk(self)

func _theme_walk(node: Node) -> void:
	# The bottom NavigationBar owns its own bespoke styling — leave it alone.
	if node.name == "NavigationBar":
		return
	# The app-wide header bar paints its own surface and type ramp; the card
	# style below must never repaint it.
	if node.name == "HeaderBar":
		return
	if node is ColorRect and node.name == "Bg":
		bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	elif node is PanelContainer and node.name != "Avatar":
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(26)
		style.content_margin_left = 44.0
		style.content_margin_top = 38.0
		style.content_margin_right = 44.0
		style.content_margin_bottom = 38.0
		if Global.theme_is_dark():
			style.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.06)
			style.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10)
		else:
			style.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85)
			style.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	elif node is Label:
		_theme_label(node)
	elif node is Button:
		node.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	for child in node.get_children():
		_theme_walk(child)


func _theme_label(label: Label) -> void:
	var n: String = label.name
	if n.ends_with("Title"):
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	elif n in ["Subtitle", "ContactHint", "VersionValue", "CreditLabel"]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	elif n == "Role":
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	else:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))


func _on_instagram_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(DEV_INSTAGRAM)
	_show_toast("اینستاگرام کپی شد ✓")


func _app_version() -> String:
	var v: Variant = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/version", "")
	return str(v) if not str(v).is_empty() else "1.0.0"


func _on_email_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(DEV_EMAIL)
	_show_toast("ایمیل کپی شد ✓")


# small confirmation banner (same style as the Settings toast)
func _show_toast(text: String) -> void:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.15, 0.97)
	style.border_width_left = 3
	style.border_width_top = 3
	style.border_width_right = 3
	style.border_width_bottom = 3
	style.border_color = Color(0.760784, 0.611765, 1)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(24)
	style.content_margin_left = 48
	style.content_margin_top = 24
	style.content_margin_right = 48
	style.content_margin_bottom = 24
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 8)
	panel.add_child(label)

	add_child(panel)
	panel.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	panel.position.y -= 150
	panel.pivot_offset = panel.size / 2.0
	panel.scale = Vector2(0.82, 0.82)
	panel.modulate.a = 0.0

	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(panel, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.32) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_interval(1.3)
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.4)
	tw.tween_callback(panel.queue_free)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  NAVIGATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")
```

## File: `res://scenes/auth/auth.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
#  AUTH — phone + OTP sign-in.
#  Step 1: enter the phone number  →  API.request_otp()
#  Step 2: enter the SMS code      →  API.verify_otp()
#  The UI is built in code (like Purchase) so the scene file stays tiny and
#  the whole screen re-themes with the app's Dark / Light palette.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_SETTINGS  := "res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn"

const COLOR_ACCENT := DesignTokens.ACCENT
const COLOR_OK     := Color("#10B981")
const COLOR_ERR    := Color("#EF4444")

@onready var _phone_edit: LineEdit = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/PhoneStep/PhoneEdit
@onready var _code_edit: LineEdit = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CodeStep/CodeEdit
@onready var _status_label: Label = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/StatusLabel
@onready var _send_button: Button = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/PhoneStep/SendButton
@onready var _verify_button: Button = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CodeStep/VerifyButton
@onready var _resend_button: Button = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CodeStep/ResendButton
@onready var _change_button: Button = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CodeStep/ChangeButton
@onready var _phone_step: VBoxContainer = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/PhoneStep
@onready var _code_step: VBoxContainer = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CodeStep

var _phone: String = ""
var _resend_cooldown: float = 0.0
var _busy: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()
	_build_ui()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	set_process(true)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _resend_cooldown > 0.0:
		_resend_cooldown = maxf(0.0, _resend_cooldown - delta)
		if _resend_button != null and _resend_button.visible:
			_resend_button.disabled = _resend_cooldown > 0.0
			_resend_button.text = "ارسال دوباره کد (%d)" % int(ceil(_resend_cooldown))
			_resend_button.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits(_resend_button.text)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  UI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _build_ui() -> void:
	_phone_edit.placeholder_text = "۰۹۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹"
	_phone_edit.virtual_keyboard_type = LineEdit.KEYBOARD_TYPE_PHONE
	_phone_edit.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_phone_edit.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	_phone_edit.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	_code_edit.virtual_keyboard_type = LineEdit.KEYBOARD_TYPE_NUMBER
	_code_edit.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_code_edit.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	_code_edit.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 46)
	_send_button.pressed.connect(_on_send_pressed)
	_verify_button.pressed.connect(_on_verify_pressed)
	_resend_button.pressed.connect(_on_resend_pressed)
	_change_button.pressed.connect(_on_change_number_pressed)
	_resend_button.visible = false
	_status_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	_status_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	var phone_hint: Label = _phone_step.get_node("PhoneHint") as Label
	phone_hint.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	phone_hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	var code_hint: Label = _code_step.get_node("CodeHint") as Label
	code_hint.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	code_hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	_apply_button_layout(_send_button, 36, true)
	_apply_button_layout(_verify_button, 36, true)
	_apply_button_layout(_resend_button, 32, false)
	_apply_button_layout(_change_button, 32, false)
	var side_menu: Node = get_node_or_null("SideMenu")
	if side_menu != null and side_menu.has_method("set_hamburger_button"):
		var hamburger: Button = get_node_or_null("HamburgerButton") as Button
		if hamburger != null:
			side_menu.set_hamburger_button(hamburger)
			hamburger.pressed.connect(side_menu.toggle)
			MenuStyle.style_button(hamburger, "secondary")
			MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(hamburger)


func _apply_button_layout(button: Button, font_size: int, primary: bool) -> void:
	button.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	if primary:
		button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
		button.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
		button.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color.WHITE)
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
		style.bg_color = COLOR_ACCENT
		style.set_content_margin_all(18)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", style)
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(button)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  THEME
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var bg: ColorRect = $Background
	bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

	var card: PanelContainer = $CenterContainer/AuthCard
	if card != null:
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
		style.content_margin_left = 48
		style.content_margin_right = 48
		style.content_margin_top = 56
		style.content_margin_bottom = 56
		style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("border")
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var heading: Label = $CenterContainer/AuthCard/CardMargin/VBoxContainer/CardHeading
	if heading != null:
		heading.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))

	if _status_label != null:
		_status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))



func _set_status(message: String, color: Color) -> void:
	if _status_label == null:
		return
	_status_label.text = message
	_status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  FLOW
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_send_pressed() -> void:
	if _busy:
		return
	var phone := _phone_edit.text.strip_edges()
	if phone.length() < 10:
		_set_status("شماره موبایل معتبر وارد کنید.", COLOR_ERR)
		return
	_phone = phone
	_busy = true
	_send_button.disabled = true
	_set_status("در حال ارسال کد…", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	API.request_otp(phone, _on_otp_requested)


func _on_otp_requested(ok: bool, error: String, retry_after: int) -> void:
	_busy = false
	_send_button.disabled = false
	if not ok:
		_set_status(_error_message(error, retry_after), COLOR_ERR)
		return
	_phone_step.visible = false
	_code_step.visible = true
	_code_edit.text = ""
	_code_edit.grab_focus()
	_start_resend_cooldown(60.0)
	_set_status("کد تأیید پیامک شد.", COLOR_OK)


func _on_verify_pressed() -> void:
	if _busy:
		return
	var code := _code_edit.text.strip_edges()
	if code.length() < 4:
		_set_status("کد را کامل وارد کنید.", COLOR_ERR)
		return
	_busy = true
	_verify_button.disabled = true
	_set_status("در حال بررسی کد…", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	API.verify_otp(_phone, code, _on_otp_verified)


func _on_otp_verified(ok: bool, error: String) -> void:
	_busy = false
	_verify_button.disabled = false
	if not ok:
		_set_status(_error_message(error, 0), COLOR_ERR)
		return
	_set_status("خوش آمدید! پیشرفت شما همگام‌سازی می‌شود…", COLOR_OK)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.6).timeout
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_SETTINGS)


func _on_resend_pressed() -> void:
	if _busy or _resend_cooldown > 0.0:
		return
	_busy = true
	_resend_button.disabled = true
	API.request_otp(_phone, func(ok: bool, error: String, retry_after: int) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if ok:
			_start_resend_cooldown(60.0)
			_set_status("کد جدید پیامک شد.", COLOR_OK)
		else:
			_resend_button.disabled = false
			_set_status(_error_message(error, retry_after), COLOR_ERR))


func _on_change_number_pressed() -> void:
	_code_step.visible = false
	_phone_step.visible = true
	_resend_cooldown = 0.0
	_set_status("", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))


func _start_resend_cooldown(seconds: float) -> void:
	_resend_cooldown = seconds
	_resend_button.visible = true


func _error_message(error: String, retry_after: int) -> String:
	match error:
		"invalid_phone", "invalid_input":
			return "شماره موبایل معتبر نیست."
		"too_many_requests":
			return "لطفاً %d ثانیه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید." % retry_after
		"sms_failed":
			return "ارسال پیامک ناموفق بود. دوباره تلاش کنید."
		"no_code":
			return "کدی برای این شماره ارسال نشده است."
		"expired":
			return "کد منقضی شده است. کد جدید بگیرید."
		"too_many_attempts":
			return "تلاش‌های بیش از حد. کد جدید بگیرید."
		"invalid_code":
			return "کد وارد‌شده صحیح نیست."
		"no_base_url":
			return "اتصال به سرور تنظیم نشده است."
		_:
			return "خطا در ارتباط با سرور. دوباره تلاش کنید."


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  NAVIGATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")
```

## File: `res://scenes/book_menu/book_card.gd`

```gdscript
extends Control
class_name BookCard

signal swipe_committed(card: BookCard, direction: int)
signal swipe_cancelled(card: BookCard)
signal card_pressed(card: BookCard)

const ROUNDED_CORNER_SHADER: Shader = preload(
	"res://scenes/book_menu/book_card_rounded.gdshader"
)

const BOOK_TAB_COLORS: Array[Color] = [
	Color("#174982"), # Vision 1: deep cosmic blue
	Color("#08745c"), # Vision 2: lush green
	Color("#a84427")  # Vision 3: warm sunset orange
]
const BOOK_TAB_TEXT_COLOR: Color = Color("#fff4dc")
const BOOK_GRADE_NAMES: Array[String] = ["دهم", "یازدهم", "دوازدهم"]

@export var book_id: int = 0
@export var corner_radius: float = 25.0

@onready var card_background: TextureRect = $Content/ContentPanel/CardBackground
@onready var book_title: Label = $Content/ContentPanel/MarginContainer/BookTitle
@onready var book_number: Label = $Content/ContentPanel/MarginContainer/BookNumber
@onready var book_tab: PanelContainer = $BookTab
@onready var tab_label: Label = $BookTab/TabLabel

var input_enabled: bool = false
var is_dragging: bool = false
var start_position: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var drag_distance_x: float = 0.0
var has_dragged: bool = false

# Buffered content – applied on _ready or on set_book_content().
var _pending_title: String = ""
var _pending_background: Texture2D = null
var _background_shader_mat: ShaderMaterial = null


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================

func set_book_content(
	id: int,
	title: String,
	background_texture: Texture2D
) -> void:
	book_id = id
	_pending_title = title
	_pending_background = background_texture
	_apply_content()


func set_card_background(texture: Texture2D) -> void:
	_pending_background = texture
	if is_node_ready():
		card_background.texture = texture


func _apply_content() -> void:
	if not is_node_ready():
		return

	book_title.text = _pending_title
	tab_label.text = _pending_title
	var grade_index: int = clampi(book_id, 0, BOOK_GRADE_NAMES.size() - 1)
	book_number.text = BOOK_GRADE_NAMES[grade_index]
	_apply_book_tab_theme()

	if _pending_background != null:
		card_background.texture = _pending_background


func _apply_book_tab_theme() -> void:
	var color_index: int = clampi(book_id, 0, BOOK_TAB_COLORS.size() - 1)
	var tab_style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	tab_style.bg_color = BOOK_TAB_COLORS[color_index]
	tab_style.corner_radius_top_right = 25
	tab_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 25
	book_tab.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", tab_style)
	tab_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", BOOK_TAB_TEXT_COLOR)


# ============================================================
# INPUT
# ============================================================

func set_input_enabled(enabled: bool) -> void:
	input_enabled = enabled
	mouse_filter = (
		Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
		if enabled
		else Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	)


func _ready() -> void:
	# The card itself owns pointer input. Visual descendants (labels, panels,
	# and texture rects) must not stop GUI events before they bubble to it.
	for child_node: Node in find_children("*", "Control", true, false):
		var child_control: Control = child_node as Control
		child_control.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_setup_background_shader()
	_apply_content()


# ============================================================
# ROUNDED BACKGROUND (top-left + bottom-left only)
# ============================================================

func _setup_background_shader() -> void:
	_background_shader_mat = ShaderMaterial.new()
	_background_shader_mat.shader = ROUNDED_CORNER_SHADER
	_background_shader_mat.set_shader_parameter(
		"corner_radius", corner_radius
	)
	card_background.material = _background_shader_mat

	_update_shader_size()
	card_background.resized.connect(_update_shader_size)


func _update_shader_size() -> void:
	if _background_shader_mat == null:
		return
	_background_shader_mat.set_shader_parameter(
		"rect_size", card_background.size
	)


# ============================================================
# INPUT HANDLING
# ============================================================

func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not input_enabled:
		return

	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		var mouse_event: InputEventMouseButton = event as InputEventMouseButton
		if mouse_event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and mouse_event.pressed:
			_begin_drag()
			accept_event()

	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		var touch_event: InputEventScreenTouch = event as InputEventScreenTouch
		if touch_event.pressed:
			_begin_drag()
		accept_event()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not is_dragging:
		return

	if event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		var motion_event: InputEventMouseMotion = event as InputEventMouseMotion
		_update_drag(motion_event.relative.x)
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag:
		var drag_event: InputEventScreenDrag = event as InputEventScreenDrag
		_update_drag(drag_event.relative.x)
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton:
		var mouse_event: InputEventMouseButton = event as InputEventMouseButton
		if mouse_event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not mouse_event.pressed:
			_finish_drag()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		var touch_event: InputEventScreenTouch = event as InputEventScreenTouch
		if not touch_event.pressed:
			_finish_drag()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()


func _begin_drag() -> void:
	if is_dragging:
		return

	is_dragging = true
	has_dragged = false
	drag_distance_x = 0.0
	start_position = position


func _update_drag(delta_x: float) -> void:
	drag_distance_x += delta_x

	if absf(drag_distance_x) > 8.0:
		has_dragged = true

	position.x = start_position.x + drag_distance_x


func _finish_drag() -> void:
	if not is_dragging:
		return

	is_dragging = false

	if not has_dragged:
		position = start_position
		card_pressed.emit(self)
		return

	var threshold: float = size.x * 0.15

	if absf(drag_distance_x) >= threshold:
		swipe_committed.emit(
			self,
			1 if drag_distance_x > 0.0 else -1
		)
	else:
		swipe_cancelled.emit(self)
```

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

############################################################
# BOOK MENU — modern, friendly lesson picker.

############################################################

const SCENE_MAIN_MENU   := "res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn"
const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

# Persian + English lesson titles per book.
const LESSON_DATA := {
	1: [
		"Saving Nature",
		"Wonders of Creation",
		"The Value of Knowledge",
		"Traveling the World",
	],
	2: [
		"Understanding People",
		"A Healthy Lifestyle",
		"Art and Culture",
	],
	3: [
		"Sense of Appreciation",
		"Look It Up!",
		"Renewable Energy",
	],
}

const BOOK_COLORS := {
	1: Color("#3B82F6"),   # Vision 1 — solid light blue
	2: Color("#22C55E"),   # Vision 2 — solid green
	3: Color("#EF4444"),   # Vision 3 — solid red
}

const PERSIAN_DIGITS := ["۱", "۲", "۳", "۴", "۵", "۶", "۷", "۸", "۹"]

var _navigating: bool = false
var _book: int = 1
var _accent: Color = Color("#3B82F6")

# Built UI state.
var _scroll: ScrollContainer = null
var _col: VBoxContainer = null
var _title_label: Label = null
var _count_badge: Label = null
var _card_buttons: Array[Button] = []


func _ready() -> void:
	_book = Global.current_book
	_accent = BOOK_COLORS.get(_book, Color("#2563EB"))

	_build_ui()

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()

	# Gentle entrance.
	_scroll.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(_scroll, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.30) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _build_ui() -> void:
	# The persistent bottom navigation replaces this screen's header and back control.
	# ---- Scrollable content above persistent navigation ----
	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	_scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_scroll.offset_top = 0.0
	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	_scroll.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	add_child(_scroll)

	var outer := MarginContainer.new()
	outer.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	outer.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	outer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 40)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 40)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 32)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 176)
	_scroll.add_child(outer)

	_col = VBoxContainer.new()
	_col.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	outer.add_child(_col)

	var hero := Label.new()
	hero.text = "یک درس را انتخاب کنید 👇"
	hero.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	hero.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	hero.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text_dim())
	hero.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	hero.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 72)
	_col.add_child(hero)

	var lessons: Array = LESSON_DATA.get(_book, [])
	for i in lessons.size():
		var lesson_title: String = lessons[i]
		var digit: String = PERSIAN_DIGITS[i] if i < PERSIAN_DIGITS.size() else str(i + 1)
		var card: Button = MenuStyle.make_card(
			"درس %s" % digit,
			lesson_title,
			digit,
			_accent,
			150,
			"",
			true
		)
		card.pressed.connect(_on_lesson_pressed.bind(i + 1))
		MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(card)
		_col.add_child(card)
		_card_buttons.append(card)

	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
	_col.add_child(spacer)

	_col.add_child(MenuStyle.make_tip_card("هر روز کمی یاد بگیر — موفق باشی ✨", "💡"))


############################################################
# THEME
############################################################
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	if _title_label:
		_title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _accent)
	if _count_badge:
		_count_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", MenuStyle.icon_chip(_accent, 26))
		_count_badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.pill_text(_accent))
	# Cards (flat — no elevation).
	for btn in _card_buttons:
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", MenuStyle.card_style(_accent, 26, false, true))
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", MenuStyle.card_hover_style(_accent, 26, true))
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", MenuStyle.card_pressed_style(_accent, 26, true))
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", MenuStyle.card_hover_style(_accent, 26, true))
		var tl: Label = btn.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/TitleLabel") as Label
		if tl:
			tl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
		var sl: Label = btn.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/SubLabel") as Label
		if sl:
			sl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
		# Rebuild hover/press via a fresh wired pass is unnecessary — the
		# micro-interactions tween scale only, so styleboxes are enough.


############################################################
# NAVIGATION
############################################################
func _on_lesson_pressed(lesson_number: int) -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.current_lesson = lesson_number
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.10).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU, TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.10).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(SCENE_MAIN_MENU, TransitionManager.Slide.BACK)
```

## File: `res://scenes/book_menu/book_selection.gd`

```gdscript
extends Control


# ============================================================
# SCENES
# ============================================================

const BOOK_CARD_SCENE: PackedScene = preload(
	"res://scenes/book_menu/BookCard.tscn"
)

const BOOK_CONTENTS_SCENE: PackedScene = preload(
	"res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"
)


# ============================================================
# BOOK DATA
# ============================================================

const BOOK_TITLES: Array[String] = [
	"ویژن ۱",
	"ویژن ۲",
	"ویژن ۳"
]

const BOOK_COVERS: Array[Texture2D] = [
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision1.png"),
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision2.png"),
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision3.png")
]

const BOOK_BLURRED_BACKGROUNDS: Array[Texture2D] = [
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision1_blur.png"),
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision2_blur.png"),
	preload("res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision3_blur.png")
]


# ============================================================
# ANIMATION SETTINGS
# ============================================================

const STACK_X_OFFSET: float = 60.0
const STACK_Y_OFFSET: float = 5.0

const SWIPE_DURATION: float = 0.28
const STACK_DURATION: float = 0.36
const BACKGROUND_DURATION: float = 0.50
const OPEN_DURATION: float = 0.30

const NAV_HEIGHT: float = 150.0
const TOP_SPACE: float = 80.0
const SCREEN_MARGIN: float = 16.0


# ============================================================
# SCENE REFERENCES
# ============================================================

@onready var background_a: TextureRect = $BackgroundA
@onready var background_b: TextureRect = $BackgroundB
@onready var card_stack: Control = $CardStack


# ============================================================
# STATE
# ============================================================

var cards: Array[BookCard] = []
var book_order: Array[int] = [0, 1, 2]

var is_animating: bool = false
var is_opening: bool = false

var background_tween: Tween

# Flickering drag hint (created at runtime, no scene edits needed).
var drag_hint_label: Label = null
var drag_hint_tween: Tween = null


# ============================================================
# INITIALIZATION
# ============================================================

func _ready() -> void:
	_configure_backgrounds()
	$SelectionPrompt.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	var selected_id: int = clampi(
		BookSession.selected_book_id,
		0,
		2
	)

	book_order = [
		selected_id,
		(selected_id + 1) % 3,
		(selected_id + 2) % 3
	]

	_create_cards()
	_create_drag_hint()

	if cards.size() != 3:
		push_error("BookSelection: Failed to create all three cards.")
		return

	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_layout_cards)

	_layout_cards()
	_update_card_input()
	_update_drag_hint_visibility()

	_show_background(book_order[0], false)


# ============================================================
# BACKGROUND SETUP
# ============================================================

func _configure_backgrounds() -> void:
	for bg in [background_a, background_b]:
		bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(
			Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT
		)

		bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		bg.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		bg.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED

	background_a.modulate.a = 1.0
	background_b.modulate.a = 0.0


# ============================================================
# CREATE THE MANUALLY DESIGNED CARDS
# ============================================================

func _create_cards() -> void:
	for book_id in range(3):
		var card := BOOK_CARD_SCENE.instantiate() as BookCard

		if card == null:
			push_error(
				"BookSelection: BookCard.tscn must use BookCard.gd."
			)
			return

		card.book_id = book_id

		card_stack.add_child(card)

		# Feed the per-book data so the labels reflect the book
		# that the card is currently showing.
		card.set_book_content(
			book_id,
			BOOK_TITLES[book_id],
			BOOK_COVERS[book_id]
		)

		card.swipe_committed.connect(_on_swipe_committed)
		card.swipe_cancelled.connect(_on_swipe_cancelled)
		card.card_pressed.connect(_on_card_pressed)

		cards.append(card)


# ============================================================
# DRAG HINT  ("کارت را بکشید")
# ============================================================

func _create_drag_hint() -> void:
	drag_hint_label = Label.new()
	drag_hint_label.text = "کارت را بکشید"

	drag_hint_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	drag_hint_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	drag_hint_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	drag_hint_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	drag_hint_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	drag_hint_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.92)
	)
	drag_hint_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_shadow_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.75)
	)
	drag_hint_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_x", 1)
	drag_hint_label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 2)

	# Draw above the card stack so it is always readable.
	add_child(drag_hint_label)
	move_child(drag_hint_label, get_child_count() - 1)

	_start_drag_hint_flicker()


func _start_drag_hint_flicker() -> void:
	if drag_hint_label == null:
		return

	if drag_hint_tween != null and drag_hint_tween.is_valid():
		drag_hint_tween.kill()

	drag_hint_label.modulate.a = 1.0

	drag_hint_tween = create_tween().set_loops()
	drag_hint_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
	drag_hint_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)

	drag_hint_tween.tween_property(
		drag_hint_label, "modulate:a", 0.15, 0.75
	)
	drag_hint_tween.tween_property(
		drag_hint_label, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.75
	)


func _update_drag_hint_position() -> void:
	if drag_hint_label == null or cards.is_empty():
		return

	var top_card: BookCard = cards[book_order[0]]

	# Account for the scale/pivot so the label sits visually
	# just below the top card.
	var visual_pos: Vector2 = (
		top_card.position
		+ top_card.pivot_offset
		- top_card.pivot_offset * top_card.scale
	)
	var visual_size: Vector2 = top_card.size * top_card.scale

	drag_hint_label.position = Vector2(
		visual_pos.x,
		visual_pos.y + visual_size.y + 12.0
	)
	drag_hint_label.size = Vector2(visual_size.x, 40.0)


func _update_drag_hint_visibility() -> void:
	if drag_hint_label == null:
		return

	var should_show: bool = not is_animating and not is_opening

	drag_hint_label.visible = should_show

	if should_show:
		if drag_hint_tween == null or not drag_hint_tween.is_valid():
			_start_drag_hint_flicker()
		elif not drag_hint_tween.is_running():
			_start_drag_hint_flicker()


# ============================================================
# RESPONSIVE CARD POSITIONING
# ============================================================

func _get_card_base_scale() -> float:
	if cards.is_empty():
		return 1.0

	var viewport_size: Vector2 = get_viewport_rect().size
	var card_size: Vector2 = cards[0].size

	if card_size.x <= 0.0 or card_size.y <= 0.0:
		return 1.0

	var available_width: float = maxf(
		1.0,
		viewport_size.x
			- SCREEN_MARGIN * 2.0
			- STACK_X_OFFSET * 2.0
	)

	var available_height: float = maxf(
		1.0,
		viewport_size.y - NAV_HEIGHT - TOP_SPACE
	)

	var width_scale: float = available_width / card_size.x
	var height_scale: float = available_height / card_size.y

	return minf(1.0, minf(width_scale, height_scale))


func _get_stack_base_position() -> Vector2:
	var viewport_size: Vector2 = get_viewport_rect().size
	var card_size: Vector2 = cards[0].size

	var base_x: float = (
		viewport_size.x - card_size.x
	) * 0.5 - STACK_X_OFFSET

	var available_height: float = (
		viewport_size.y - NAV_HEIGHT - TOP_SPACE
	)

	var base_y: float = TOP_SPACE + (
		available_height - card_size.y
	) * 0.5 - STACK_Y_OFFSET

	return Vector2(base_x, base_y)


func _layout_cards() -> void:
	if cards.size() != 3:
		return

	var card_size: Vector2 = cards[0].size

	if card_size.x <= 0.0 or card_size.y <= 0.0:
		push_error(
			"Set the BookCard root's actual Size in the Inspector."
		)
		return

	var base_position: Vector2 = _get_stack_base_position()
	var base_scale: float = _get_card_base_scale()

	for depth in range(book_order.size()):
		var book_id: int = book_order[depth]
		var card: BookCard = cards[book_id]

		card.pivot_offset = card.size * 0.5

		card.position = base_position + Vector2(
			depth * STACK_X_OFFSET,
			depth * STACK_Y_OFFSET
		)

		card.scale = Vector2.ONE * (
			base_scale * (1.0 - depth * 0.035)
		)

		card.rotation = 0.0
		card.z_index = 10 - depth

	_update_card_input()
	_update_drag_hint_position()


# ============================================================
# INPUT MANAGEMENT
# ============================================================

func _update_card_input() -> void:
	for depth in range(book_order.size()):
		var book_id: int = book_order[depth]

		cards[book_id].set_input_enabled(
			depth == 0
			and not is_animating
			and not is_opening
		)


# ============================================================
# SWIPE A CARD AWAY
# ============================================================

func _on_swipe_committed(
	card: BookCard,
	direction: int
) -> void:
	if is_animating or is_opening:
		return

	if book_order[0] != card.book_id:
		return

	is_animating = true
	_update_card_input()
	_update_drag_hint_visibility()

	# Start the background crossfade as the swipe begins, not after the
	# outgoing card has left the screen. This keeps both transitions in sync.
	var next_book_id: int = book_order[1]
	_show_background(next_book_id, true)

	var viewport_width: float = get_viewport_rect().size.x

	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_parallel(true)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)

	tween.tween_property(
		card,
		"position:x",
		card.position.x + direction * viewport_width * 1.25,
		SWIPE_DURATION
	)

	tween.tween_property(
		card,
		"rotation",
		direction * 0.18,
		SWIPE_DURATION
	)

	tween.tween_property(
		card,
		"scale",
		card.scale * 0.90,
		SWIPE_DURATION
	)

	await tween.finished

	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	var previous_front: int = book_order.pop_front()
	book_order.append(previous_front)

	await _animate_stack()

	if background_tween != null and background_tween.is_running():
		await background_tween.finished

	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	is_animating = false
	_update_card_input()
	_update_drag_hint_position()
	_update_drag_hint_visibility()


# ============================================================
# CANCEL A SHORT DRAG
# ============================================================

func _on_swipe_cancelled(card: BookCard) -> void:
	if is_animating or is_opening:
		return

	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_parallel(true)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

	tween.tween_property(
		card,
		"position",
		card.start_position,
		0.25
	)

	tween.tween_property(
		card,
		"rotation",
		0.0,
		0.25
	)


# ============================================================
# RESTACK CARDS SMOOTHLY
# ============================================================

func _animate_stack() -> void:
	var base_position: Vector2 = _get_stack_base_position()
	var base_scale: float = _get_card_base_scale()

	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_parallel(true)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

	for depth in range(book_order.size()):
		var book_id: int = book_order[depth]
		var card: BookCard = cards[book_id]

		card.z_index = 10 - depth

		var target_position: Vector2 = base_position + Vector2(
			depth * STACK_X_OFFSET,
			depth * STACK_Y_OFFSET
		)

		var target_scale: Vector2 = Vector2.ONE * (
			base_scale * (1.0 - depth * 0.035)
		)

		tween.tween_property(
			card,
			"position",
			target_position,
			STACK_DURATION
		)

		tween.tween_property(
			card,
			"scale",
			target_scale,
			STACK_DURATION
		)

		tween.tween_property(
			card,
			"rotation",
			0.0,
			STACK_DURATION
		)

	await tween.finished


# ============================================================
# SMOOTH FULL-SCREEN BACKGROUND CROSSFADE
# ============================================================

func _show_background(
	book_id: int,
	animate: bool
) -> void:
	if background_tween != null and background_tween.is_running():
		background_tween.kill()

	book_id = clampi(book_id, 0, 2)

	background_b.texture = BOOK_BLURRED_BACKGROUNDS[book_id]
	background_b.modulate.a = 0.0

	if not animate:
		background_a.texture = BOOK_BLURRED_BACKGROUNDS[book_id]
		background_a.modulate.a = 1.0
		background_b.modulate.a = 0.0
		return

	background_tween = create_tween()
	background_tween.set_parallel(true)
	background_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
	background_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)

	# Crossfade both layers together. Fading only the incoming layer over the
	# old one makes the change feel abrupt when the covers differ strongly.
	background_tween.tween_property(
		background_b,
		"modulate:a",
		1.0,
		BACKGROUND_DURATION
	)
	background_tween.tween_property(
		background_a,
		"modulate:a",
		0.0,
		BACKGROUND_DURATION
	)

	await background_tween.finished

	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	var previous_background: TextureRect = background_a
	background_a = background_b
	background_b = previous_background

	background_a.modulate.a = 1.0
	background_b.modulate.a = 0.0


# ============================================================
# OPEN THE SELECTED BOOK
# ============================================================

func _on_card_pressed(card: BookCard) -> void:
	if is_animating or is_opening:
		return

	if book_order[0] != card.book_id:
		return

	is_opening = true
	is_animating = true
	_update_card_input()
	_update_drag_hint_visibility()

	BookSession.selected_book_id = card.book_id

	Global.current_book = card.book_id + 1
	Global.current_lesson = 1

	var viewport_width: float = get_viewport_rect().size.x

	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_parallel(true)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)

	for depth in range(book_order.size()):
		var book_id: int = book_order[depth]
		var current_card: BookCard = cards[book_id]

		var direction: float = (
			-1.0 if depth % 2 == 0 else 1.0
		)

		var duration: float = (
			OPEN_DURATION + float(depth) * 0.06
		)

		tween.tween_property(
			current_card,
			"position:x",
			current_card.position.x
				+ direction * viewport_width * 1.2,
			duration
		)

		tween.tween_property(
			current_card,
			"modulate:a",
			0.0,
			duration
		)

	await tween.finished

	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	# Hand the screen over while the blurred cover stays exactly where it is.
	# The unblur belongs to the lesson menu: it opens on this same still and
	# sharpens it while its own content fades in. Doing the unblur here as well
	# would go blur -> sharp -> (rebuild) -> sharp-with-no-content, which is the
	# "splash of an empty screen" this replaces.
	TransitionManager.handover_scene(
		BOOK_CONTENTS_SCENE, BOOK_BLURRED_BACKGROUNDS[card.book_id]
	)
```
