	"res://scenes/saved_words/SavedWords.tscn",
	"res://scenes/auth/Auth.tscn",
	"res://scenes/purchase/Purchase.tscn",
	"res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn",
	"res://scenes/about_me/AboutMe.tscn"
]

@export_range(0, 5, 1) var initial_index: int = 0
@export var auto_navigate: bool = true

@export var navigation_color: Color = Color.WHITE
@export var selector_color: Color = Color.WHITE
@export var label_color: Color = Color("#30343B")

@onready var bar_background: ColorRect = $BarBackground
@onready var items: HBoxContainer = $MarginContainer/Items
@onready var selector: Control = $Selector
@onready var circle: Panel = $Selector/Circle
@onready var active_icon: TextureRect = $Selector/ActiveIcon
@onready var menu_panel: Panel = get_node_or_null("MenuPanel") as Panel
@onready var menu_items_container: VBoxContainer = get_node_or_null("MenuPanel/MenuItems") as VBoxContainer

var current_index: int = 0
static var _last_primary_index: int = 0
var is_initialized: bool = false
var menu_panel_open: bool = false
var _is_navigating: bool = false
var normal_icons: Array[TextureRect] = []
var labels: Array[Label] = []
var label_rest_positions: Array[Vector2] = []
var label_tweens: Array[Tween] = []
var icon_visibility_tweens: Array[Tween] = []
var icon_is_clear: Array[bool] = []
var icon_rest_positions: Array[Vector2] = []
var menu_sub_items: Array[Control] = []
var menu_item_highlights: Array[Panel] = []
var active_menu_index: int = -1

var selector_tween: Tween
var icon_tween: Tween
var scale_tween: Tween
var menu_panel_tween: Tween
var selector_start_position: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

# Scene path requested before _ready() finished laying the bar out.
var _pending_scene_path: String = ""


func _ready() -> void:
	# Persistent chrome: this bar is built ONCE by the BottomNavigation autoload
	# and lives for the whole session. It is never re-instantiated on a scene
	# swap, so it cannot flicker, re-layout, or teleport its selector when the
	# screens change under it.
	if not is_in_group("bottom_navigation"):
		add_to_group("bottom_navigation")

	# Transparent until laid out, but still "visible" so the containers size
	# their children correctly (hiding a Control freezes its layout pass, which
	# would make the item rest positions capture as zero).
	modulate.a = 0.0
	set_process(false)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS

	bar_background.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	items.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	selector.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	_configure_selector()
	_configure_items()
	_configure_menu_panel()

	resized.connect(_on_resized)

	# Wait for container layout to settle before saving the authored positions.
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	move_to_front()
	_refresh_layout()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	_capture_item_rest_positions()

	current_index = clampi(initial_index, 0, ITEM_COUNT - 2)
	_last_primary_index = current_index
	_set_selector_position(current_index, false)
	_position_menu_panel()
	_set_label_position(current_index, true)
	_set_initial_icon_visibility()
	_set_active_icon(current_index)
	_set_item_appearance(current_index, false)
	is_initialized = true
	_update_cutout_shader()
	_update_icons_covered_by_cutout()
	modulate.a = 1.0

	# A scene may have been announced while we were still laying out.
	if _pending_scene_path != "":
		var pending_path: String = _pending_scene_path
		_pending_scene_path = ""
		apply_scene_path(pending_path)


## Called by the BottomNavigation autoload whenever the current scene changes.
## Shows/hides the bar and animates the selector to the tab that owns the new
## scene. Safe to call before _ready() has finished: the request is parked.
func apply_scene_path(scene_path: String) -> void:
	if not is_initialized:
		_pending_scene_path = scene_path
		return

	var show_bar: bool = BAR_SCENES.has(scene_path)
	visible = show_bar
	set_process(show_bar)
	_set_menu_panel_open(false, false)

	if not show_bar:
		return

	var detected_menu_index: int = _detect_menu_scene_index(scene_path)
	if detected_menu_index >= 0:
		# Menu destinations use a direct scene swap rather than the tab
		# transition manager, so unlock navigation once their scene is active.
		_is_navigating = false

	var detected_index: int = _detect_scene_index(scene_path)
	if detected_index >= 0 and detected_index < ITEM_COUNT - 1:
		_set_primary_index(detected_index, true)
	elif detected_menu_index >= 0:
		# Menu destinations select the Menu tab itself; remember the last primary
		# tab separately so returning to the app tabs does not lose its selection.
		_set_primary_index(ITEM_COUNT - 1, true)

	_set_active_menu_destination(detected_menu_index)


## Moves the selector to a navigation item. Only primary tabs update the saved
## primary selection; the Menu tab can be selected for side-menu destinations.
func _set_primary_index(index: int, animate: bool) -> void:
	index = clampi(index, 0, ITEM_COUNT - 1)
	if index < ITEM_COUNT - 1:
		_last_primary_index = index
	if index == current_index:
		return
	if not is_initialized:
		current_index = index
		return

	var previous_index: int = current_index
	current_index = index
	active_icon.visible = false

	if animate:
		_animate_label(previous_index, false)
		_animate_label(index, true)
		_animate_selector(index)
	else:
		_set_label_position(previous_index, false)
		_set_label_position(index, true)
		_set_selector_position(index, false)
		_set_active_icon(index)
		_set_initial_icon_visibility()

	_set_item_appearance(index, false)


func _detect_scene_index(scene_path: String) -> int:
	if scene_path == "":
		return -1
	if scene_path.ends_with("MainMenu.tscn"):
		return 0
	if (
		scene_path.ends_with("BookSelection.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("BookMenu.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("BookMenu_backup.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("LessonMenu.tscn")
	):
		return 1
	if scene_path.contains("/word_game/"):
		return 2
	if scene_path.contains("/exam/"):
		return 3
	if (
		scene_path.ends_with("FlashcardHub.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("SavedWords.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("WordReview.tscn")
	):
		return 4
	if (
		scene_path.ends_with("Auth.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("Purchase.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("Settings.tscn")
		or scene_path.ends_with("AboutMe.tscn")
	):
		return 5
	return -1


func _detect_menu_scene_index(scene_path: String) -> int:
	return MENU_SUB_SCENES.find(scene_path)


func _set_active_menu_destination(menu_index: int) -> void:
	active_menu_index = menu_index
	for index: int in range(menu_item_highlights.size()):
		var highlight: Panel = menu_item_highlights[index]
		highlight.visible = index == active_menu_index


func _current_scene_path() -> String:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return ""
	var current_scene: Node = get_tree().current_scene
	if current_scene != null and current_scene != self and current_scene.scene_file_path != "":
		return current_scene.scene_file_path
	if owner != null and owner != self and owner.scene_file_path != "":
		return owner.scene_file_path
	var p: Node = get_parent()
	if p != null and p.scene_file_path != "":
		return p.scene_file_path
	return ""


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_update_cutout_shader()
	_update_icons_covered_by_cutout()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not visible:
		return
	if not menu_panel_open or menu_panel == null or not menu_panel.visible:
		return

	var pressed: bool = false
	var pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and event.pressed:
			pressed = true
			pos = event.position
	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if event.pressed:
			pressed = true
			pos = event.position

	if not pressed:
		return

	for sub_idx: int in range(menu_sub_items.size()):
		var sub_item: Control = menu_sub_items[sub_idx]
		if sub_item.get_global_rect().has_point(pos):
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			_on_menu_sub_item_activated(sub_idx)
			return

	if menu_panel.get_global_rect().has_point(pos):
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
		return

	if items.get_child_count() == ITEM_COUNT:
		var menu_btn: Control = items.get_child(ITEM_COUNT - 1) as Control
		if menu_btn != null and menu_btn.get_global_rect().has_point(pos):
			return

	_set_menu_panel_open(false, true)


func _update_icons_covered_by_cutout() -> void:
	if normal_icons.size() != ITEM_COUNT or not is_initialized:
		return
	if not is_node_ready() or not visible:
		return
	var cutout_center_global: Vector2 = (
		bar_background.get_global_transform()
		* Vector2(
			selector.position.x + selector.pivot_offset.x,
			0.0
		)
	)
	for i in range(ITEM_COUNT):
		var normal_icon: TextureRect = normal_icons[i]
		var icon_center_global: Vector2 = (
			normal_icon.get_global_transform()
			* (normal_icon.size * 0.5)
		)
		var distance_to_cutout: float = cutout_center_global.distance_to(
			icon_center_global
		)
		var is_tapped_icon: bool = i == current_index
		var cutout_touches_icon: bool = (
			distance_to_cutout <= CUTOUT_RADIUS + NORMAL_ICON_TOUCH_RADIUS
		)
		if is_tapped_icon:
			if not icon_is_clear[i]:
				_set_icon_clear_state(i, true, true)
		elif cutout_touches_icon:
			if not icon_is_clear[i]:
				_set_icon_clear_state(i, true, false)
		elif icon_is_clear[i]:
			_set_icon_clear_state(i, false, false)


func _set_initial_icon_clear_state(index: int, should_lift: bool) -> void:
	var icon: TextureRect = normal_icons[index]
	icon_is_clear[index] = true
	icon.modulate.a = 0.0
	icon.visible = false
	if should_lift:
		icon.position = icon_rest_positions[index] + Vector2.UP * ICON_LIFT_DISTANCE


func _set_icon_clear_state(
	index: int,
	should_clear: bool,
	should_lift: bool
) -> void:
	var icon: TextureRect = normal_icons[index]
	var target_alpha: float = 0.0 if should_clear else 1.0
	var rest_position: Vector2 = icon_rest_positions[index]
	var target_position: Vector2 = rest_position
	if should_lift:
		target_position += Vector2.UP * ICON_LIFT_DISTANCE

	if (
		icon_is_clear[index] == should_clear
		and icon.modulate.a == target_alpha
		and icon.position.is_equal_approx(target_position)
	):
		return

	icon_is_clear[index] = should_clear
	var previous_tween: Tween = icon_visibility_tweens[index]
	if previous_tween and previous_tween.is_running():
		previous_tween.kill()

	icon.visible = true
	icon_visibility_tweens[index] = create_tween()
	icon_visibility_tweens[index].set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	icon_visibility_tweens[index].set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	icon_visibility_tweens[index].tween_property(
		icon,
		"modulate:a",
		target_alpha,
		ICON_CLEAR_FADE_DURATION
	)
	icon_visibility_tweens[index].parallel().tween_property(
		icon,
		"position",
		target_position,
		ICON_CLEAR_FADE_DURATION
	)
	if should_clear:
		icon_visibility_tweens[index].tween_callback(
			func() -> void:
				if icon_is_clear[index]:
					icon.visible = false
		)
	else:
		icon_visibility_tweens[index].tween_callback(
			func() -> void:
				if not icon_is_clear[index]:
					icon.visible = true
		)


func _update_cutout_shader() -> void:
	var shader_material := bar_background.material as ShaderMaterial
	if shader_material == null:
		return

	var selector_center_global: Vector2 = (
		selector.get_global_transform() * selector.pivot_offset
	)
	var bar_top_global: Vector2 = get_global_transform() * Vector2.ZERO
	var cutout_center_in_background: Vector2 = (
		bar_background.get_global_transform().affine_inverse()
		* Vector2(selector_center_global.x, bar_top_global.y)
	)
	shader_material.set_shader_parameter(
		"cutout_center",
		cutout_center_in_background
	)
	# Keep the shader cutout steady while only the white selector disc animates.
	shader_material.set_shader_parameter("cutout_radius", CUTOUT_RADIUS)
	shader_material.set_shader_parameter("bar_size", bar_background.size)


func _configure_selector() -> void:
	selector.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	selector.size = Vector2(SELECTOR_SIZE, SELECTOR_SIZE)
	selector.pivot_offset = Vector2(
		SELECTOR_SIZE * 0.5,
		SELECTOR_SIZE * 0.5
	)

	circle.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	circle.anchor_left = 0.5
	circle.anchor_top = 0.5
	circle.anchor_right = 0.5
	circle.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	circle.offset_left = -(SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0) * 0.5
	circle.offset_top = -(SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0) * 0.5
	circle.offset_right = (SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0) * 0.5
	circle.offset_bottom = (SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0) * 0.5
	circle.size = Vector2(SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0, SELECTOR_SIZE - 18.0)
	circle.pivot_offset = circle.size * 0.5

	# Plain white disc: no border, no inner line, no shadow.
	var circle_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	circle_style.bg_color = Color.WHITE
	# Explicitly override every outline/shadow property; StyleBoxFlat defaults
	# carry a gray border color that can show as a dark rim with antialiasing.
	circle_style.set_corner_radius_all(999)
	circle_style.set_border_width_all(0)
	circle_style.border_color = Color.WHITE
	circle_style.shadow_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)
	circle_style.shadow_size = 0

	circle.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", circle_style)

	active_icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	active_icon.anchor_left = 0.5
	active_icon.anchor_top = 0.5
	active_icon.anchor_right = 0.5
	active_icon.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	active_icon.offset_left = -ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE * 0.5
	active_icon.offset_top = -ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE * 0.5
	active_icon.offset_right = ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE * 0.5
	active_icon.offset_bottom = ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE * 0.5
	active_icon.size = Vector2(ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE, ACTIVE_ICON_SIZE)
	active_icon.pivot_offset = active_icon.size * 0.5


func _configure_menu_panel() -> void:
	if menu_panel == null or menu_items_container == null:
		return

	menu_panel.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	menu_panel.size = Vector2(MENU_PANEL_WIDTH, MENU_PANEL_HEIGHT)
	menu_panel.pivot_offset = Vector2(MENU_PANEL_WIDTH * 0.5, MENU_PANEL_HEIGHT)
	menu_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP

	var panel_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	panel_style.bg_color = Color.WHITE
	panel_style.set_corner_radius_all(33)
	panel_style.set_border_width_all(0)
	panel_style.border_color = Color.WHITE
	panel_style.shadow_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.14)
	panel_style.shadow_size = 14
	panel_style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 4.0)
	menu_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", panel_style)

	menu_sub_items.clear()
	menu_item_highlights.clear()
	var count: int = mini(menu_items_container.get_child_count(), MENU_ITEM_COUNT)
	for i: int in range(count):
		var sub_item := menu_items_container.get_child(i) as Control
		if sub_item == null:
			continue
		sub_item.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
		sub_item.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND

		var highlight: Panel = Panel.new()
		highlight.name = "ActiveHighlight"
		highlight.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
		highlight.offset_left = -20.0
		highlight.offset_top = -20.0
		highlight.offset_right = 20.0
		highlight.offset_bottom = 20.0
		highlight.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		highlight.visible = false
		var highlight_style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new()
		highlight_style.bg_color = Color("#E7F2FF")
		highlight_style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
		highlight_style.set_border_width_all(0)
		highlight.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", highlight_style)
		sub_item.add_child(highlight)
		sub_item.move_child(highlight, 0)
		menu_item_highlights.append(highlight)

		var icon_node := sub_item.get_node_or_null("Icon") as TextureRect
		if icon_node != null:
			icon_node.texture = MENU_SUB_ICONS[i]
			icon_node.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		if not sub_item.gui_input.is_connected(_on_menu_sub_item_gui_input):
			sub_item.gui_input.connect(_on_menu_sub_item_gui_input.bind(i))
		menu_sub_items.append(sub_item)

	_set_active_menu_destination(active_menu_index)
	menu_panel_open = false
	menu_panel.visible = false
	menu_panel.modulate.a = 0.0


func _get_menu_panel_position() -> Vector2:
	if items.get_child_count() < ITEM_COUNT:
		return Vector2(size.x - MENU_PANEL_WIDTH - 16.0, -MENU_PANEL_HEIGHT - MENU_PANEL_BOTTOM_GAP)
	var menu_item := items.get_child(ITEM_COUNT - 1) as Control
	var item_center_global: Vector2 = (
		menu_item.get_global_transform() * (menu_item.size * 0.5)
	)
	var item_center_local: Vector2 = (
		get_global_transform().affine_inverse() * item_center_global
	)
	return Vector2(
		item_center_local.x - MENU_PANEL_WIDTH * 0.5,
		-MENU_PANEL_HEIGHT - MENU_PANEL_BOTTOM_GAP
	)


func _position_menu_panel() -> void:
	if menu_panel == null:
		return
	menu_panel.position = _get_menu_panel_position()


func _set_menu_panel_open(open: bool, animate: bool) -> void:
	if menu_panel == null:
		return
	menu_panel_open = open
	var target_pos: Vector2 = _get_menu_panel_position()

	if menu_panel_tween and menu_panel_tween.is_running():
		menu_panel_tween.kill()

	menu_panel.pivot_offset = Vector2(MENU_PANEL_WIDTH * 0.5, MENU_PANEL_HEIGHT)

	if not animate:
		menu_panel.visible = open
		menu_panel.position = target_pos
		menu_panel.scale = Vector2.ONE if open else Vector2(0.85, 0.85)
		menu_panel.modulate.a = 1.0 if open else 0.0
		return

	if open:
		menu_panel.visible = true
		menu_panel.position = target_pos + Vector2(0.0, 16.0)
		menu_panel.scale = Vector2(0.85, 0.85)
		menu_panel.modulate.a = 0.0

		menu_panel_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
		menu_panel_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
		menu_panel_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "position", target_pos, 0.24)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.24)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)
	else:
		menu_panel_tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
		menu_panel_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
		menu_panel_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(
			menu_panel,
			"position",
			target_pos + Vector2(0.0, 12.0),
			0.16
		)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(
			menu_panel,
			"scale",
			Vector2(0.85, 0.85),
			0.16
		)
		menu_panel_tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.16)
		menu_panel_tween.chain().tween_callback(
			func() -> void:
				if not menu_panel_open and menu_panel != null:
					menu_panel.visible = false
		)


func _on_menu_sub_item_gui_input(event: InputEvent, sub_index: int) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and event.pressed:
			accept_event()
			_on_menu_sub_item_activated(sub_index)
	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if event.pressed:
			accept_event()
			_on_menu_sub_item_activated(sub_index)


func _on_menu_sub_item_activated(sub_index: int) -> void:
	if sub_index < 0 or sub_index >= MENU_SUB_SCENES.size():
		return
	_set_menu_panel_open(false, true)
	menu_item_selected.emit(sub_index)
	if not auto_navigate:
		return
	var target_scene: String = MENU_SUB_SCENES[sub_index]
	_navigate_to_scene(target_scene, TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD)


func _configure_items() -> void:
	items.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)

	if items.get_child_count() != ITEM_COUNT:
		push_error(
			"NavigationBar requires exactly six children under Items."
		)
		return

	normal_icons.clear()
	labels.clear()
	label_rest_positions.clear()
	label_tweens.clear()
	icon_visibility_tweens.clear()
	icon_is_clear.clear()
	icon_rest_positions.clear()

	for i in range(ITEM_COUNT):
		var item := items.get_child(i) as Control

		item.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		item.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		item.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
		item.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND

		var normal_icon := item.get_node("ActiveIcon") as TextureRect
		var label := item.get_node("Label") as Label

		normal_icon.texture = NORMAL_ICONS[i]
		normal_icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		normal_icon.visible = true
		normal_icon.modulate.a = 1.0
		normal_icons.append(normal_icon)
		icon_visibility_tweens.append(null)
		icon_is_clear.append(false)
		icon_rest_positions.append(Vector2.ZERO)
		normal_icon.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
		normal_icon.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(NORMAL_ICON_SIZE, NORMAL_ICON_SIZE)
		normal_icon.size = Vector2(NORMAL_ICON_SIZE, NORMAL_ICON_SIZE)
		normal_icon.position = Vector2.ZERO

		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", label_color)
		label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
		if label.label_settings != null:
			label.label_settings.font_color = label_color
		label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
		label.size = Vector2(item.size.x, 36.0)
		label.position = Vector2(0.0, 0.0)
		label.offset_left = 0.0
		label.offset_right = item.size.x
		label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		labels.append(label)
		label_rest_positions.append(Vector2.ZERO)
		label_tweens.append(null)

		if not item.gui_input.is_connected(_on_item_gui_input):
			item.gui_input.connect(_on_item_gui_input.bind(i))


func _on_item_gui_input(
	event: InputEvent,
	index: int
) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and event.pressed:
			accept_event()
			select_item(index)

	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		if event.pressed:
			accept_event()
			select_item(index)


func _capture_item_rest_positions() -> void:
	for index in range(ITEM_COUNT):
		var item: Control = items.get_child(index)
		var icon: TextureRect = normal_icons[index]
		var label: Label = labels[index]
		icon_rest_positions[index] = Vector2(
			(item.size.x - icon.size.x) * 0.5,
			0.0
		)
		label_rest_positions[index] = Vector2(
			(item.size.x - label.size.x) * 0.5,
			item.size.y - label.size.y - 5.0
		)
		icon.position = icon_rest_positions[index]
		label.position = label_rest_positions[index]


func _set_initial_icon_visibility() -> void:
	for index in range(ITEM_COUNT):
		var icon: TextureRect = normal_icons[index]
		var is_selected: bool = index == current_index
		icon_is_clear[index] = is_selected
		icon.modulate.a = 1.0
		icon.visible = not is_selected
		icon.position = icon_rest_positions[index]


func _set_label_position(index: int, selected: bool) -> void:
	var label: Label = labels[index]
	label.position = label_rest_positions[index]
	if selected:
		label.position.y += SELECTED_LABEL_DROP


func _animate_label(index: int, selected: bool) -> void:
	var label: Label = labels[index]
	var previous_tween: Tween = label_tweens[index]
	if previous_tween and previous_tween.is_running():
		previous_tween.kill()

	var target_position: Vector2 = label_rest_positions[index]
	if selected:
		target_position.y += SELECTED_LABEL_DROP

	label_tweens[index] = create_tween()
	label_tweens[index].set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	label_tweens[index].set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	label_tweens[index].tween_property(
		label,
		"position",
		target_position,
		MOVE_DURATION
	)


func select_item(index: int) -> void:
	if index < 0 or index >= ITEM_COUNT:
		return
	if not visible or _is_navigating:
		return

	# "منو" toggles the popup without becoming a selected destination.
	if index == ITEM_COUNT - 1:
		_set_menu_panel_open(not menu_panel_open, true)
		item_selected.emit(index)
		return

	# Any other item (0..4) closes the menu popup panel if it was open.
	if menu_panel_open:
		_set_menu_panel_open(false, true)

	if index == current_index:
		if auto_navigate and index < ITEM_SCENES.size() and ITEM_SCENES[index] != "":
			_navigate_to_scene(
				ITEM_SCENES[index],
				TransitionManager.Slide.BACK
			)
		return

	var previous_index: int = current_index
	current_index = index
	_last_primary_index = index
	active_icon.visible = false
	_animate_label(previous_index, false)
	_animate_label(index, true)

	_animate_selector(index)

	item_selected.emit(index)

	if auto_navigate and index < ITEM_SCENES.size() and ITEM_SCENES[index] != "":
		_navigate_to_scene(
			ITEM_SCENES[index],
			TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD
			if index > previous_index
			else TransitionManager.Slide.BACK
		)


func _navigate_to_scene(
	target_scene: String,
	tab_direction: int = TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD
) -> void:
	if target_scene == "" or _is_navigating:
		return
	var current_path: String = _current_scene_path()
	if current_path == target_scene:
		return

	_is_navigating = true
	Sfx.click()

	# Side-menu destinations are layered screens rather than peer tabs. Route
	# those directly; only primary tabs use a quick horizontal push.
	if _target_primary_index(target_scene) >= ITEM_SCENES.size() - 1:
		# Layered screens swap with no transition; the load now runs on a
		# worker thread (change_scene_now) so the tap frame doesn't hitch on
		# a synchronous load. apply_scene_path() unlocks the bar once the
		# destination is active, same as before — only a hard load failure
		# re-opens it here.
		var opened: bool = await TransitionManager.change_scene_now(target_scene)
		if not opened:
			_is_navigating = false
		return

	if TransitionManager._tab_change_busy or TransitionManager._fade_busy or TransitionManager._slide_busy:
		_is_navigating = false
		return

	if not is_in_group("bottom_navigation"):
		add_to_group("bottom_navigation")
	_is_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.tab_change_scene(target_scene, tab_direction)


func set_navigation_busy(busy: bool) -> void:
	_is_navigating = busy


func _target_primary_index(target_scene: String) -> int:
	for index: int in range(ITEM_SCENES.size() - 1):
		if ITEM_SCENES[index] == target_scene:
			return index
	return ITEM_SCENES.size() - 1


func _animate_selector(index: int) -> void:
	if selector_tween and selector_tween.is_running():
		selector_tween.kill()

	if scale_tween and scale_tween.is_running():
		scale_tween.kill()

	selector_start_position = selector.position
	var target_position: Vector2 = _get_selector_position(index)
	var travel_distance: float = absf(target_position.x - selector_start_position.x)
	var arc_height: float = minf(TRAVEL_ARC_HEIGHT, travel_distance * 0.08)

	selector_tween = create_tween()
	selector_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	selector_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	selector_tween.tween_method(
		_update_selector_travel.bind(target_position, arc_height),
		0.0,
		1.0,
		MOVE_DURATION
	)
	selector_tween.tween_callback(_on_selector_arrived.bind(index))

	# Squash the circle only; keep the active icon and selector transform steady.
	circle.scale = Vector2.ONE
	scale_tween = create_tween()
	scale_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	scale_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	scale_tween.tween_property(
		circle,
		"scale",
		Vector2(1.12, 0.90),
		MOVE_DURATION * 0.32
	)
	scale_tween.tween_property(
		circle,
		"scale",
		Vector2(0.94, 1.08),
		MOVE_DURATION * 0.24
	)
	scale_tween.tween_property(
		circle,
		"scale",
		Vector2.ONE,
		MOVE_DURATION * 0.44
	)


func _update_selector_travel(
	progress: float,
	target_position: Vector2,
	arc_height: float
) -> void:
	var travel_position: Vector2 = selector_start_position.lerp(
		target_position,
		progress
	)
	travel_position.y -= sin(progress * PI) * arc_height
	selector.position = travel_position


func _on_selector_arrived(index: int) -> void:
	_animate_active_icon(index)
	_set_item_appearance(index, true)


func _animate_active_icon(index: int) -> void:
	if icon_tween and icon_tween.is_running():
		icon_tween.kill()

	active_icon.texture = ACTIVE_ICONS[index]
	active_icon.modulate.a = 0.0
	active_icon.visible = true

	icon_tween = create_tween()
	icon_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	icon_tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	icon_tween.tween_property(
		active_icon,
		"modulate:a",
		1.0,
		ICON_FADE_IN
	)


func _set_active_icon(index: int) -> void:
	active_icon.texture = ACTIVE_ICONS[index]
	active_icon.modulate = Color.WHITE


func _set_item_appearance(
	_selected_index: int,
	_animate: bool
) -> void:
	for normal_icon: TextureRect in normal_icons:
		normal_icon.modulate.a = 1.0


func _get_selector_position(index: int) -> Vector2:
	var item := items.get_child(index) as Control
	var item_center_global: Vector2 = (
		item.get_global_transform() * (item.size * 0.5)
	)
	var selector_parent: Control = selector.get_parent_control()
	var item_center_in_selector_parent: Vector2 = (
		selector_parent.get_global_transform().affine_inverse()
		* item_center_global
	)

	# Center horizontally on the item slot, and pin the vertical center to the
	# top edge of the navigation bar (y = 0 in the selector's own parent space),
	# so the disc straddles the bar and sits in a semicircular notch.
	return Vector2(
		item_center_in_selector_parent.x - selector.pivot_offset.x,
		-selector.pivot_offset.y
	)


func _set_selector_position(
	index: int,
	animate: bool
) -> void:
	var target_position := _get_selector_position(index)

	if animate:
		_animate_selector(index)
	else:
		selector.position = target_position
		selector.scale = Vector2.ONE
		circle.scale = Vector2.ONE


func _refresh_layout() -> void:
	bar_background.color = navigation_color

	var background_shader_material := bar_background.material as ShaderMaterial

	if background_shader_material:
		background_shader_material.set_shader_parameter("bar_color", navigation_color)
		background_shader_material.set_shader_parameter("bar_size", bar_background.size)

	var style := circle.get_theme_stylebox("panel") as StyleBoxFlat

	if style:
		var updated_style := style.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
		updated_style.bg_color = Color.WHITE
		updated_style.set_border_width_all(0)
		updated_style.border_color = Color.WHITE
		updated_style.shadow_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0)
		updated_style.shadow_size = 0
		circle.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", updated_style)


func _on_resized() -> void:
	call_deferred("_refresh_after_resize")


func _refresh_after_resize() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_refresh_layout()

	if items.get_child_count() == ITEM_COUNT and normal_icons.size() == ITEM_COUNT:
		_capture_item_rest_positions()
		_set_label_position(current_index, true)
		_set_initial_icon_visibility()
		_set_selector_position(current_index, false)
		_position_menu_panel()

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# CONVERSATION SCENE — PageView Edition
# Two swipeable pages: Conversation / Oral Practice
# ============================================================
const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

# Vibrant accent colors for the left border & speaker labels
const SPEAKER_COLORS := [
	Color("#22D3EE"),  # Cyan
	Color("#EC4899"),  # Pink/Magenta
	Color("#FBBF24"),  # Amber/Gold
	Color("#34D399")   # Emerald
]

# Dark, harmonious card backgrounds (tinted to match the navy theme)
const SPEAKER_BG_COLORS := [
	Color("#1a2f5c"),  # Deep blue
	Color("#2d1f4e"),  # Deep purple
	Color("#2d2a1f"),  # Deep amber-brown
	Color("#1a2d2a")   # Deep teal
]

# ---------- Font configuration ----------
const FONT_JAKARTA_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_JAKARTA_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_JAKARTA_ITALIC_PATH  := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Italic.ttf"
const FONT_JAKARTA_MEDIUM_PATH  := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Medium.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN            := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_italic: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

# ---------- Node References ----------
@onready var background: ColorRect            = $Background
@onready var header_bar: Control              = $HeaderBar
@onready var back_button: Button              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var audio_button: Button             = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/AudioButton
@onready var translation_toggle: Button       = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/TranslationToggleButton
@onready var audio_panel: PanelContainer      = $AudioPanel
@onready var page_view: PageView              = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView

# ---------- Dynamically Created Nodes ----------
var conversation_image: TextureRect
var intro_label: RichTextLabel
var lines_container: VBoxContainer
var exercises_container: VBoxContainer
var intro_translation_label: Label = null
var _page_bg_style: StyleBoxFlat

# Collapsing image state
const HERO_MAX_HEIGHT := 800.0
var _hero_collapse_progress: float = 0.0

# ---------- State Variables ----------
const SEEK_STEP: float = 10.0
var is_dragging_slider: bool = false
var word_regex := RegEx.new()
var line_rtls: Array = []
var current_word_data: Dictionary = {}
var current_highlighted_word: String = ""
var all_sentences_sync: Array = []
var intro_sentences_data: Array = []
var _last_active_sentence: Dictionary = {}
var _sync_index: int = 0
var _touch_start_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _is_drag_scrolling: bool = false
var dict_popup: DictionaryPopup
var show_translation: bool = false
var current_book: int = 0
var current_lesson: int = 0
var current_data: Dictionary = {}

# ============================================================
# READY — Build the two pages
# ============================================================
func _ready() -> void:
	page_view.add_swipe_blocker(audio_panel)
	page_view.add_swipe_blocker(header_bar)
	
	var apostrophes := "'%s%s" % [char(0x2018), char(0x2019)]
	word_regex.compile("\\b([a-zA-Z]+(?:[%s-][a-zA-Z]+)*)\\b" % apostrophes)
	dict_popup = DictionaryPopup.new()
	add_child(dict_popup)
	dict_popup.popup_closed.connect(_on_popup_closed)
	
	audio_button.pivot_offset = audio_button.size / 2.0
	back_button.pivot_offset = back_button.size / 2.0
	
	_load_fonts()
	if font_bold: header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	
	# General Connections
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	audio_button.pressed.connect(_on_audio_pressed)
	translation_toggle.pressed.connect(_on_translation_toggle_pressed)
	
	# Audio Panel Connections
	audio_panel.playback_updated.connect(_update_audio_sync)
	audio_panel.audio_closed.connect(_on_audio_stopped)
	audio_panel.audio_finished.connect(_on_audio_stopped)
	
	current_book = Global.current_book
	current_lesson = Global.current_lesson
	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nمکالمه" % [current_lesson])
	# Fetch this lesson's media (conversation/reading audio + images) if missing.
	Content.ensure_lesson(current_book, current_lesson)
	current_data = Global.load_conversation(current_book, current_lesson)
	
	# ---- Build the two pages ----
	_build_conversation_page()
	_build_oral_page()
	
	# Theme-aware styling + live re-theme on toggle.
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	_apply_theme()
	
	if current_data.is_empty():
		intro_label.text = "Conversation not available yet."
		return
		
	var lesson_data := Global.load_category("conversation_oral", Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson)
	for exercise in lesson_data.get("exercises", []):
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		exercises_container.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)
		engine.exercise_checked.connect(_on_exercise_checked)
		
	_build_conversation(current_book, current_lesson, current_data)
	_update_toggle_button_text()

# ============================================================
# PAGE BUILDERS
# ============================================================
func _build_conversation_page() -> void:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	
	# Tint the page background to match the current theme
	var page_bg := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	page_bg.bg_color = _page_bg()
	_page_bg_style = page_bg
	page.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", page_bg)

	# Conversation Image
	conversation_image = TextureRect.new()
	conversation_image.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	conversation_image.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	conversation_image.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	conversation_image.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, HERO_MAX_HEIGHT)
	conversation_image.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	page.add_child(conversation_image)

	# Intro Label
	intro_label = RichTextLabel.new()
	intro_label.bbcode_enabled = true
	intro_label.scroll_active = false
	intro_label.fit_content = true
	intro_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	intro_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	intro_label.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 48)
	intro_label.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _text_color())  # Readable body text
	if font_regular:
		intro_label.add_theme_font_override("normal_font", font_regular)
	page.add_child(intro_label)

	# Lines Container
	lines_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	lines_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	page.add_child(lines_container)

	# Spacer for Audio Panel
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 200)
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	page.add_child(spacer)

	page_view.add_page("conversation", "مکالمه", "💬", page)

func _build_oral_page() -> void:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	
	# Exercises Container
	exercises_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	exercises_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	page.add_child(exercises_container)

	var spacer := Control.new()

	page_view.add_page("oral", "تمرین شفاهی", "🗣️", page)

# ============================================================
# INPUT & SCROLL TRACKING
# ============================================================
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	super._input(event)
	if event is InputEventScreenTouch or (event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT):
		if event.pressed:
			_touch_start_pos = event.position
			_is_drag_scrolling = false
		else:
			if _touch_start_pos.distance_to(event.position) > 15.0:
				_is_drag_scrolling = true
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
			_update_hero_collapse(-60.0)
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
			_update_hero_collapse(60.0)
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag or (event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)):
		if _touch_start_pos.distance_to(event.position) > 15.0:
			_is_drag_scrolling = true
			_update_hero_collapse(event.relative.y)

func _update_hero_collapse(scroll_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(conversation_image) or not conversation_image.visible:
		return
	
	var delta_progress := -scroll_delta / HERO_MAX_HEIGHT
	_hero_collapse_progress = clampf(_hero_collapse_progress + delta_progress, 0.0, 1.0)
	
	var current_h := lerpf(HERO_MAX_HEIGHT, 0.0, _hero_collapse_progress)
	conversation_image.custom_minimum_size.y = current_h
	conversation_image.modulate.a = 1.0 - (_hero_collapse_progress * 0.85)

func _load_fonts() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_JAKARTA_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold = load(FONT_JAKARTA_BOLD_PATH)
	font_italic = load(FONT_JAKARTA_ITALIC_PATH)
	font_farsi = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)


# ============================================================
# THEME-AWARE STYLING
# ============================================================

func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	if background != null:
		background.color = _page_bg()

	if _page_bg_style != null:
		_page_bg_style.bg_color = _page_bg()

	if intro_label != null:
		intro_label.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _text_color())

	if intro_translation_label != null and is_instance_valid(intro_translation_label):
		intro_translation_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text_muted())

	for item in line_rtls:
		var rtl: RichTextLabel = item.get("rtl")
		if rtl != null:
			rtl.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _text_color())
		var tl: Label = item.get("translation_label")
		if tl != null:
			tl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text_muted())

	# Rebuild the clickable/highlighted BBCode so highlight colors match.
	if not current_data.is_empty() and intro_label != null:
		_refresh_all_text()


# ---------- Theme-aware color helpers ----------
# All colors resolve through Global (the single theme source).
func _page_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

func _text_color() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("text")

func _text_muted() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")

func _speaker_bg(idx: int) -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return SPEAKER_BG_COLORS[idx]
	return Global.get_theme_color("surface").lerp(SPEAKER_COLORS[idx], 0.08)

func _highlight_bg_color() -> String:
	# Read-along sentence highlight. Dark theme gets a fully opaque bright
	# amber so it stands out against the dark card; light theme keeps the
	# softer translucent tint, which already reads well.
	return "#fbbf24" if Global.theme_is_dark() else "#fbbf2480"

func _highlight_text_color() -> String:
	# Dark text reads best on the bright amber highlight in both themes
	# (white text on dim amber is what made dark mode barely visible).
	return "#111111"

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING & AUDIO SYNC LOGIC
# ============================================================
func _build_conversation(book: int, lesson: int, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	all_sentences_sync.clear()
	_sync_index = 0
	_hero_collapse_progress = 0.0
	var image_path := "res://assets/images/%s" % data.get("image", "")
	var lesson_texture: Texture2D = Content.load_image(image_path)
	if lesson_texture != null:
		conversation_image.texture = lesson_texture
		conversation_image.visible = true
		conversation_image.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, HERO_MAX_HEIGHT)
		conversation_image.modulate.a = 1.0
	else:
		conversation_image.visible = false
		conversation_image.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 0) # Hidden until downloaded
		
	# --- Intro with translation ---
	var intro_data: Dictionary = data.get("intro", {})
	intro_sentences_data = intro_data.get("sentences", [])
	var intro_text: String = ""
	var intro_fa: String = ""
	
	for i in range(intro_sentences_data.size()):
		var sentence = intro_sentences_data[i]
		intro_text += sentence.get("en", "") + " "
		intro_fa += sentence.get("fa", "") + " "
		if sentence.has("start") and sentence.has("end"):
			all_sentences_sync.append({
				"type": "intro", "block_idx": -1, "sentence_idx": i,
				"start": sentence.get("start", 0.0), "end": sentence.get("end", 0.0)
			})
	
	# --- FIX: Make intro text clickable ---
	intro_label.meta_underlined = false
	intro_label.text = _format_clickable_text(intro_text.strip_edges(), "")
	intro_label.meta_clicked.connect(func(meta): _on_word_clicked(meta, intro_label, intro_text.strip_edges()))
	intro_label.set_meta("translation", intro_fa.strip_edges())
	_create_intro_translation_label(intro_fa.strip_edges())
	
	_build_lines(data.get("lines", []))
	
	var audio_value: String = data.get("audio", "")
	var audio_path: String = Global.resolve_audio_path(book, lesson, audio_value, "reading.mp3")
	set_meta("audio_path", audio_path)


func _build_lines(lines: Array) -> void:
	for child in lines_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	line_rtls.clear()
	
	var speaker_map: Dictionary = {}
	var color_counter: int = 0
	for line in lines:
		var speaker: String = line.get("speaker", "")
		if speaker != "" and not speaker_map.has(speaker):
			speaker_map[speaker] = color_counter % SPEAKER_COLORS.size()
			color_counter += 1
			
	for line in lines:
		var speaker: String = line.get("speaker", "")
		var sentences: Array = line.get("sentences", [])
		var text: String = ""
		var translation: String = ""
		var block_idx = line_rtls.size()
		
		for i in range(sentences.size()):
			var sentence = sentences[i]
			text += sentence.get("en", "") + " "
			translation += sentence.get("fa", "") + " "
			if sentence.has("start") and sentence.has("end"):
				all_sentences_sync.append({
					"type": "line", "block_idx": block_idx, "sentence_idx": i,
					"start": sentence.get("start", 0.0), "end": sentence.get("end", 0.0)
				})
				
		text = text.strip_edges()
		translation = translation.strip_edges()
		var color_idx: int = speaker_map.get(speaker, 0)
		lines_container.add_child(_make_line_card(speaker, text, translation, color_idx, sentences))

func _make_line_card(speaker: String, text: String, translation: String, color_idx: int, sentences: Array) -> PanelContainer:
	var accent_color: Color = SPEAKER_COLORS[color_idx]
	var bg_color: Color     = SPEAKER_BG_COLORS[color_idx]

	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS

	# --- Modern card style with shadow & rounded corners ---
	var card_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	card_style.bg_color = _speaker_bg(color_idx)
	card_style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	card_style.border_width_left = 5
	card_style.border_color = accent_color
	card_style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	card_style.shadow_size = 10
	card_style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 6)
	card_style.content_margin_left   = 28
	card_style.content_margin_right  = 28
	card_style.content_margin_top    = 22
	card_style.content_margin_bottom = 22
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", card_style)

	var inner := VBoxContainer.new()
	inner.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	inner.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS

	# --- Speaker label (vibrant accent color) ---
	var speaker_label := Label.new()
	speaker_label.text = speaker.to_upper()
	speaker_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	speaker_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent_color)
	if font_bold:
		speaker_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	# --- Main text (light color for visibility on dark card) ---
	var text_label := RichTextLabel.new()
	text_label.meta_underlined = false
	text_label.bbcode_enabled = true
	text_label.fit_content = true
	text_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	text_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	text_label.scroll_active = false
	text_label.selection_enabled = false
	text_label.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 48)
	text_label.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _text_color())  # Readable body text
	text_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	if font_regular:
		text_label.add_theme_font_override("normal_font", font_regular)
	if font_bold:
		text_label.add_theme_font_override("bold_font", font_bold)
	
	text_label.text = _format_clickable_text(text, "")
	text_label.meta_clicked.connect(func(meta): _on_word_clicked(meta, text_label, text))

	# --- Translation label (muted light for hierarchy) ---
	var translation_label := Label.new()
	translation_label.text = translation
	translation_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	translation_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	translation_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text_muted())  # Muted text
	translation_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	translation_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	translation_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	if font_farsi:
		translation_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	translation_label.visible = show_translation

	inner.add_child(speaker_label)
	inner.add_child(text_label)
	inner.add_child(translation_label)
	card.add_child(inner)

	line_rtls.append({
		"rtl": text_label, 
		"text": text, 
		"sentences": sentences,
		"translation": translation, 
		"translation_label": translation_label
	})
	
	return card

func _update_audio_sync(current_time: float) -> void:
	var active_sentence: Dictionary = _find_active_sentence(current_time)
	if not _is_same_sentence(active_sentence, _last_active_sentence):
		_last_active_sentence = active_sentence
		_refresh_all_text()


## Time-ordered sentence lookup with a forward-advancing cursor (O(1) per
## frame on forward playback) instead of scanning the whole array every frame.
func _find_active_sentence(current_time: float) -> Dictionary:
	var arr: Array = all_sentences_sync
	if arr.is_empty():
		_sync_index = 0
		return {}
	if _sync_index >= arr.size():
		_sync_index = arr.size() - 1
	if current_time < float(arr[_sync_index].get("start", 0.0)):
		_sync_index = 0 # backward seek — restart the scan
	while _sync_index < arr.size() \
			and current_time > float(arr[_sync_index].get("end", 0.0)):
		_sync_index += 1
	if _sync_index >= arr.size():
		_sync_index = arr.size() - 1
		return {}
	var s: Dictionary = arr[_sync_index]
	if current_time >= float(s.get("start", 0.0)) \
			and current_time <= float(s.get("end", 0.0)):
		return s
	return {}

func _is_same_sentence(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if a.is_empty() and b.is_empty(): return true
	if a.is_empty() or b.is_empty(): return false
	return a["type"] == b["type"] and a["block_idx"] == b["block_idx"] and a["sentence_idx"] == b["sentence_idx"]

func _refresh_all_text() -> void:
	# 1. Update Intro with clickable words and highlight
	var new_intro_bbcode := ""
	for i in range(intro_sentences_data.size()):
		var s = intro_sentences_data[i]
		var en_text = s.get("en", "")
		var clickable_sentence = _format_clickable_text(en_text, current_highlighted_word)
		
		if _last_active_sentence.has("type") and _last_active_sentence["type"] == "intro" and _last_active_sentence["sentence_idx"] == i:
			new_intro_bbcode += "[bgcolor=%s][color=%s]" % [_highlight_bg_color(), _highlight_text_color()] + clickable_sentence + "[/color][/bgcolor] "
		else:
			new_intro_bbcode += clickable_sentence + " "
			
	if intro_label != null:
		intro_label.text = new_intro_bbcode.strip_edges()

	# 2. Update Lines
	for block_idx in range(line_rtls.size()):
		var block = line_rtls[block_idx]
		var rtl: RichTextLabel = block["rtl"]
		var sentences: Array = block["sentences"]
		var new_bbcode := ""
		
		for s_idx in range(sentences.size()):
			var s = sentences[s_idx]
			var en_text = s.get("en", "")
			var clickable_sentence = _format_clickable_text(en_text, current_highlighted_word)
			
			if _last_active_sentence.has("type") and _last_active_sentence["type"] == "line" and _last_active_sentence["block_idx"] == block_idx and _last_active_sentence["sentence_idx"] == s_idx:
				new_bbcode += "[bgcolor=%s][color=%s]" % [_highlight_bg_color(), _highlight_text_color()] + clickable_sentence + "[/color][/bgcolor] "
			else:
				new_bbcode += clickable_sentence + " "
				
		rtl.text = new_bbcode.strip_edges()

# ============================================================
# DICTIONARY POPUP & TRANSLATION TOGGLES
# ============================================================
func _format_clickable_text(base_text: String, highlight_word: String) -> String:
	var out := ""
	var last_end := 0

	var normalized_highlight := ""
	if highlight_word != "":
		normalized_highlight = _normalize_word(highlight_word)

	for m in word_regex.search_all(base_text):
		var start: int = m.get_start()
		var end: int = m.get_end()
		var word: String = base_text.substr(start, end - start)

		# Add any spaces/punctuation before this word.
		out += base_text.substr(last_end, start - last_end)

		# Meta must be safe for BBCode attributes.
		var safe_meta := _encode_word_meta(word)

		if normalized_highlight != "" and _normalize_word(word) == normalized_highlight:
			out += "[bgcolor=#fbbf24][color=#000000][url=%s]%s[/url][/color][/bgcolor]" % [
				safe_meta, word
			]
		else:
			out += "[url=%s]%s[/url]" % [
				safe_meta, word
			]

		last_end = end

	# Add anything after the last matched word.
	out += base_text.substr(last_end)

	return out

func _normalize_word(word: String) -> String:
	var normalized := word

	# Convert common apostrophe-like characters to a normal ASCII apostrophe.
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x2018), "'")  # ‘
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x2019), "'")  # ’
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x00B4), "'")  # ´
	normalized = normalized.replace("`", "'")

	return normalized.to_lower()


func _encode_word_meta(word: String) -> String:
	# Make the meta safe for RichTextLabel BBCode.
	# Do not put raw apostrophes inside [url=...].
	return _normalize_word(word).replace("'", "%27")

func _on_word_clicked(meta: Variant, _clicked_rtl: RichTextLabel, _original_text: String) -> void:
	if _is_drag_scrolling:
		return

	var clicked_string := str(meta).replace("%27", "'")
	clicked_string = _normalize_word(clicked_string)

	var def := Global.get_word_definition_from_current_lesson(clicked_string)
	if def.is_empty():
		return

	current_word_data = def
	current_highlighted_word = clicked_string

	_refresh_all_text()
	dict_popup.show_word(def)

func _on_popup_closed() -> void:
	current_highlighted_word = ""
	_refresh_all_text()

func _update_toggle_button_text() -> void:
	Global.set_translation_toggle_state(translation_toggle, show_translation)

func _on_translation_toggle_pressed() -> void:
	show_translation = !show_translation
	_update_toggle_button_text()
	for item in line_rtls:
		if item.has("translation_label") and item["translation_label"] != null:
			item["translation_label"].visible = show_translation
			
	var intro_translation = intro_label.get_meta("translation", "")
	if intro_translation != "":
		_toggle_intro_translation(intro_translation)

func _create_intro_translation_label(translation: String) -> void:
	_remove_intro_translation_label()
	if translation == "": return
	
	intro_translation_label = Label.new()
	intro_translation_label.text = translation
	intro_translation_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	intro_translation_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	intro_translation_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text_muted())
	intro_translation_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	intro_translation_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	intro_translation_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	if font_farsi: intro_translation_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	intro_translation_label.visible = show_translation
	
	var parent = intro_label.get_parent()
	if parent == null: return
	
	var index = 0
	for i in range(parent.get_child_count()):
		if parent.get_child(i) == intro_label:
			index = i + 1
			break
			
	parent.add_child(intro_translation_label)
	parent.move_child(intro_translation_label, index)

func _toggle_intro_translation(translation: String) -> void:
	if intro_translation_label == null or not is_instance_valid(intro_translation_label):
		_create_intro_translation_label(translation)
		return
	intro_translation_label.visible = show_translation

func _remove_intro_translation_label() -> void:
	if intro_translation_label != null and is_instance_valid(intro_translation_label):
		intro_translation_label.queue_free()
		intro_translation_label = null

# ============================================================
# AUDIO & NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_audio_pressed() -> void:
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(audio_button, "scale", Vector2(0.93, 0.93), 0.08).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(audio_button, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	if not audio_panel.is_playing():
		var path: String = get_meta("audio_path", "")
		audio_panel.load_and_play(path)

func _on_audio_stopped() -> void:
	_last_active_sentence = {}
	_sync_index = 0
	_refresh_all_text()

func _on_exercise_checked(exercise_id: String, correct: int, total: int) -> void:
	print("%s → %d/%d" % [exercise_id, correct, total])

func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	_remove_intro_translation_label()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")

func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	_remove_intro_translation_label()
	var tween = create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(back_button, "scale", Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)

func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if dict_popup != null and dict_popup.is_open():
		dict_popup._hide_popup()
	else:
		_on_back_button_pressed()
```

#### API Status Demo - demonstrates server-dependent features
### Shows whether the API is configured and logged in, and responds to auth signals

@api
@class_name ApiStatusDemo

var _api: ApiClient = null
var _is_configured: bool = false
var _is_logged_in: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	_api = /root/API
	_is_configured = _api.is_configured()
	_is_logged_in = _api.is_logged_in()
	_update_labels()
	
	# Connect to signals
	_api.logged_in.connect(_on_logged_in)
	_api.logged_out.connect(_on_logged_out)
	_api.token_refreshed.connect(_on_token_refreshed)

func _on_logged_in(user: Dictionary) -> void:

	_update_labels()
	print("[ApiStatusDemo] Logged in: %s" % user)

func _on_logged_out() -> void:
	_is_logged_in = false
	_update_labels()
	print("[ApiStatusDemo] Logged out")

func _on_token_refreshed(success: bool) -> void:
	_update_labels()
	print("[ApiStatusDemo] Token refreshed: %s" % success)

func _update_labels() -> void:
	var config_text: String = _is_configured and "Configured" or "Not Configured"
	var login_text: String = _is_logged_in and "Logged In" or "Not Logged In"
	$._configured_label.text = "API Configured: %s" % config_text
	$._login_button.visible = not _is_logged_in
	$._logout_button.visible = _is_logged_in
	$._status_label.text = "Status: %s %s" % [config_text, login_text]
	$._refresh_label.visible = _is_logged_in and not _is_configured

# UI buttons
func _on_logout_pressed() -> void:
	_api.logout()

func _on_refresh_pressed() -> void:
	_api.refresh_tokens()

## File: `res://scenes/exam/exam_data.gd`

```gdscript
class_name ExamData
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  EXAM DATA — plain data-access helper for the "امتحانات نهایی"
##  (Final Exams) feature.
##
##  The content lives in JSON files:
##    res://data/final_exams/manifest.json   → years + exam index
##    res://data/final_exams/<id>.json       → one exam (blocks)
##
##  This class only reads and validates that data. It owns no
##  nodes and no presentation, so the year-picker, exam-list and
##  exam-runner scenes can share a single, consistent loader.
## ============================================================

const MANIFEST_PATH: String = "res://data/final_exams/manifest.json"


## Reads and parses the exam manifest. Returns {} on any failure.
static func load_manifest() -> Dictionary:
	return _read_json(MANIFEST_PATH)


## Reads and parses one exam file by its res:// path. Returns {} on failure.
static func load_exam(exam_path: String) -> Dictionary:
	return _read_json(exam_path)


## Returns the list of years from the manifest (each a Dictionary).
static func years() -> Array:
	return load_manifest().get("years", [])


## Returns a single year Dictionary by its id (e.g. "12"), or {} if absent.
static func year_by_id(year_id: String) -> Dictionary:
	for year in years():
		if str(year.get("id", "")) == year_id:
			return year
	return {}


## Returns the exams of a year, sorted newest-to-oldest by date_key.
static func exams_for_year(year_id: String) -> Array:
	var exams: Array = year_by_id(year_id).get("exams", []).duplicate()
	exams.sort_custom(func(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
		return int(a.get("date_key", 0)) > int(b.get("date_key", 0)))
	return exams


## Reads a JSON file into a Dictionary; logs and returns {} on error.
static func _read_json(path: String) -> Dictionary:
	# An empty path is "no exam selected" (the scene opened directly or a stale
	# deep link) — a benign, expected state, so it degrades to {} without the
	# noisy error a genuinely missing file deserves.
	if path.is_empty():
		return {}
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		push_error("ExamData: file not found: " + path)
		return {}
	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		push_error("ExamData: cannot open: " + path)
		return {}
	var text: String = file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK:
		push_error("ExamData: JSON parse error in %s: %s" % [path, json.get_error_message()])
		return {}
	var data: Variant = json.data
	if data is Dictionary:
		return data
	push_error("ExamData: expected a JSON object in " + path)
	return {}
```

## File: `res://scenes/exam/final_exam.gd`

```gdscript
class_name FinalExam
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
## ============================================================
##  FINAL EXAM — اجرای یک امتحان نهایی
##
##  Renders one exam JSON (loaded from the path passed via the
##  AppRouter arg "exam_json") with the shared ExerciseEngine,
##  exactly like the grammar exam: per-item Check buttons are
##  hidden and a single global "بررسی پاسخ‌ها" button grades
##  everything at once.
##
##  SCORING (/40)
##  -------------
##  Every gradable block carries a "points" weight (its official
##  mark). A block's contribution is
##      points * (correct_items / total_items)
##  The raw earned total is scaled so the exam is out of 40:
##      score = round(40 * earned / gradable_points)
##  Blocks that cannot be auto-graded (writing paragraphs /
##  open-ended items) carry points 0 and are shown for practice
##  only, so they never affect the auto-score.
## ============================================================

const SCORE_MAX: float = 40.0

var _navigating: bool = false
var _exam: Dictionary = {}
var _engines: Array = []                 # gradable ExerciseEngine instances
var _points_by_id: Dictionary = {}       # exercise_id -> points weight
var _results: Dictionary = {}            # exercise_id -> {correct, total}
var _check_btn: Button = null
var _score_overlay: Control = null
var _audio_panel: PanelContainer = null
var _audio_button: Button = null
var _audio_path: String = ""
var _page_view: PageView = null


func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	_exam = ExamData.load_exam(str(AppRouter.get_arg("exam_json", "")))
	_build_ui()


func _build_ui() -> void:
	var root_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	root_margin.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root_margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	# The app-wide header bar is authored in FinalExam.tscn and floats above the
	# page, so the content starts below it instead of underneath it.
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", HeaderBarStyler.BAR_HEIGHT + GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	add_child(root_margin)

	# Lift the authored bar back above the page: root_margin stops mouse input
	# across the whole screen, which would otherwise swallow the bar's taps.
	wire_header_bar(str(_exam.get("title_fa", AppRouter.get_arg("title_fa", "امتحان نهایی"))))

	var main: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	main.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	root_margin.add_child(main)

	var page_host: Control = Control.new()
	page_host.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	page_host.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_child(page_host)

	_page_view = PageView.new()
	_page_view.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_page_view.tab_font_size = 26
	_page_view.tab_font_min = 18
	page_host.add_child(_page_view)

	var blocks: Array = _exam.get("blocks", [])
	if blocks.is_empty():
		var empty_page: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		_show_empty_message(empty_page)
		_page_view.add_page("empty", "آزمون", "📄", empty_page)
		return

	_build_exam_pages(blocks)


func _build_audio_button(content: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	if _audio_path.is_empty():
		return
	_audio_button = Button.new()
	_audio_button.text = "▶  Play Audio"
	_audio_button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 96)
	_audio_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(_audio_button)
	_audio_button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	_audio_button.pressed.connect(_on_audio_pressed)
	content.add_child(_audio_button)

	var packed_audio: PackedScene = load("res://scenes/shared/AudioPanel.tscn") as PackedScene
	if packed_audio == null:
		push_error("FinalExam: AudioPanel scene could not be loaded")
		_audio_button.disabled = true
		return
	_audio_panel = packed_audio.instantiate() as PanelContainer
	if _audio_panel == null:
		_audio_button.disabled = true
		return
	add_child(_audio_panel)
	_page_view.add_swipe_blocker(_audio_panel)
	_audio_panel.audio_closed.connect(_on_audio_closed)
	_audio_panel.audio_finished.connect(_on_audio_closed)


func _on_audio_pressed() -> void:
	if _audio_panel == null or _audio_path.is_empty():
		return
	_audio_panel.load_and_play(_audio_path)
	_audio_button.text = "⏸  Pause Audio"


func _on_audio_closed() -> void:
	if _audio_button != null and is_instance_valid(_audio_button):
		_audio_button.text = "▶  Play Audio"


func _build_exam_pages(blocks: Array) -> void:
	var sections: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var current: Dictionary = {"title": "آزمون", "blocks": []}
	for block_value in blocks:
		var block: Dictionary = block_value as Dictionary
		if str(block.get("type", "")) == "h4":
			if not (current["blocks"] as Array).is_empty():
				sections.append(current)
			current = {"title": str(block.get("text", "بخش")), "blocks": []}
		else:
			(current["blocks"] as Array).append(block)
	if not (current["blocks"] as Array).is_empty():
		sections.append(current)

	for index in sections.size():
		var section: Dictionary = sections[index]
		var content: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", GrammarTheme.SPACING_LG)
		var section_title: String = _english_section_title(str(section["title"]))
		if section_title == "Listening":
			_audio_path = _find_section_audio(section["blocks"] as Array)
			_build_audio_button(content)
		for block_value in section["blocks"] as Array:
			var block: Dictionary = block_value as Dictionary
			var engine: ExerciseEngine = ExerciseEngine.new()
			engine.hide_footer_buttons = true
			engine.audio_allow_any_type = false
			content.add_child(engine)
			var engine_block: Dictionary = block.duplicate(true)
			engine_block["show_audio"] = false
			engine.build(engine_block)
			var points: float = float(block.get("points", 0))
			if points > 0.0:
				var ex_id: String = str(block.get("exercise_id", ""))
				if not ex_id.is_empty():
					_points_by_id[ex_id] = points
					engine.exercise_checked.connect(_on_exercise_checked)
					_engines.append(engine)
		if index == sections.size() - 1 and not _engines.is_empty():
			var spacer: Control = Control.new()
			spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
			content.add_child(spacer)
			_check_btn = Button.new()
			_check_btn.text = "بررسی پاسخ‌ها"
			_check_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 112)
			_check_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(_check_btn)
			_check_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres"))
			_check_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres"))
			_check_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Hovered.tres"))
			_check_btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 46)
			_check_btn.pressed.connect(_on_check_pressed)
			content.add_child(_check_btn)
		_page_view.add_page("section_%d" % index, section_title, "", content)


func _english_section_title(source: String) -> String:
	var text: String = source.split("—", true, 1)[0].strip_edges()
	if text.is_empty():
		return "Section"
	return text


func _find_section_audio(blocks: Array) -> String:
	for block_value in blocks:
		var block: Dictionary = block_value as Dictionary
		var path: String = str(block.get("audio", ""))
		if not path.is_empty():
			return path
	return ""


func _add_section_header(content: VBoxContainer, block: Dictionary) -> void:
	var header: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(header, str(block.get("text", "")))
	header.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	header.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var bold: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	if bold != null:
		header.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.accent_color())
	content.add_child(header)


func _show_empty_message(content: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var empty: Label = Label.new()
	empty.text = "📄\nاطلاعات این آزمون یافت نشد."
	empty.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	empty.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	empty.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	content.add_child(empty)


# ============================================================
# GRADING
# ============================================================
func _on_exercise_checked(exercise_id: String, correct: int, total: int) -> void:
	_results[exercise_id] = {"correct": correct, "total": total}


func _on_check_pressed() -> void:
	if _engines.is_empty():
		return
	_results.clear()
	for engine in _engines:
		engine.grade_all()
	_check_btn.disabled = true
	_check_btn.text = "پاسخ‌ها بررسی شد ✓"

	var earned: float = 0.0
	var gradable: float = 0.0
	for ex_id in _points_by_id.keys():
		var points: float = float(_points_by_id[ex_id])
		gradable += points
		if _results.has(ex_id):
			var res: Dictionary = _results[ex_id]
			var total: int = int(res.get("total", 0))
			var correct: int = int(res.get("correct", 0))
			if total > 0:
				earned += points * (float(correct) / float(total))

	var score: float = 0.0
	if gradable > 0.0:
		score = SCORE_MAX * earned / gradable
	_show_score_popup(snappedf(score, 0.25))


func _show_score_popup(score: float) -> void:
	if _score_overlay != null and is_instance_valid(_score_overlay):
		_score_overlay.queue_free()
	_score_overlay = Control.new()
	_score_overlay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	add_child(_score_overlay)

	var dim: ColorRect = ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.6)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.add_child(dim)

	var center: CenterContainer = CenterContainer.new()
	center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.add_child(center)

	var card: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = GrammarTheme.card_style()
	style.set_content_margin_all(GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(580, 500)
	center.add_child(card)

	var vb: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	card.add_child(vb)

	var icon: Label = Label.new()
	icon.text = "🎓"
	icon.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 84)
	vb.add_child(icon)

	var head: Label = Label.new()
	head.text = "نمرهٔ شما"
	head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var bold: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	if bold != null:
		head.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	vb.add_child(head)

	var score_label: Label = Label.new()
	score_label.text = _format_number(score) + " / ۴۰"
	score_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if bold != null:
		score_label.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	score_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 96)
	score_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.success_color() if score >= SCORE_MAX / 2.0 else GrammarTheme.error_color()
	)
	vb.add_child(score_label)

	var note: Label = Label.new()
	if score >= SCORE_MAX * 0.8:
		note.text = "عالی! 👏"
	elif score >= SCORE_MAX * 0.5:
		note.text = "خوب بود، ادامه بده! 💪"
	else:
		note.text = "دوباره تمرین کن تا بهتر شوی! 📚"
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if bold != null:
		note.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	vb.add_child(note)

	var close_btn: Button = Button.new()
	close_btn.text = "بستن"
	close_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, GrammarTheme.BUTTON_HEIGHT)
	close_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	close_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres"))
	close_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres"))
	close_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Hovered.tres"))
	GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(close_btn)
	close_btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		if _score_overlay != null and is_instance_valid(_score_overlay):
			_score_overlay.queue_free()
			_score_overlay = null)
	vb.add_child(close_btn)


# Formats a float score: whole numbers without decimals, else one decimal.
func _format_number(value: float) -> String:
	if is_equal_approx(value, roundf(value)):
		return str(int(roundf(value)))
	return "%.1f" % value


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	AppRouter.back("final_exam_list", {"year": _year_id()})


func _year_id() -> String:
	var id: String = str(_exam.get("id", ""))
	# Exam ids look like "12_khordad_1404"; the leading token is the grade.
	var parts: PackedStringArray = id.split("_")
	if parts.size() > 0:
		return parts[0]
	return "12"


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()
```

```gdscript
class_name FinalExamList
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
## ============================================================
##  FINAL EXAM LIST — فهرست امتحانات یک پایه
##
##  Shows the exams of one grade (passed via AppRouter arg
##  "year", e.g. "12") as a chronological list of cards, read
##  from res://data/final_exams/manifest.json. Picking an exam
##  pushes the exam runner with the exam's JSON path.
## ============================================================

const CARD_ACCENT: Color = Color("#D97706")

var _navigating: bool = false
var _year_id: String = ""

@onready var _dynamic_content: VBoxContainer = $RootMargin/MainColumn/ContentMargin/ContentScroll/Content/DynamicContent
@onready var _empty_message: Label = $RootMargin/MainColumn/ContentMargin/ContentScroll/Content/EmptyMessage

func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	_year_id = str(AppRouter.get_arg("year", "12"))
	wire_header_bar(_header_title())
	_build_ui()


## The bar reads "امتحانات نهایی · <پایه>" so the chosen grade stays visible.
func _header_title() -> String:
	var year: Dictionary = ExamData.year_by_id(_year_id)
	var year_title: String = str(year.get("title_fa", "")).strip_edges()
	if year_title.is_empty():
		return "امتحانات نهایی"
	return "امتحانات نهایی · " + year_title


func _build_ui() -> void:
	var _yellow_normal: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres")
	var _yellow_hovered: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Hovered.tres")
	var _blue_normal: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Blue_Normal.tres")
	var _blue_hovered: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Blue_Hovered.tres")
	var title_blue_settings: LabelSettings = load("res://ui/fonts/Fa_Button_Title_Blue.tres")
	var info_blue_settings: LabelSettings = load("res://ui/fonts/Fa_Button_Info_Blue.tres")
	var exams: Array = ExamData.exams_for_year(_year_id)
	if exams.is_empty():
		_empty_message.visible = true
		return

	for exam in exams:
		var title: String = str(exam.get("title_fa", ""))
		var date_fa: String = str(exam.get("date_fa", ""))
		var exam_json: String = str(exam.get("json", ""))
		var card: Button = MenuStyle.make_card(title, "تاریخ آزمون · " + date_fa, "📄", CARD_ACCENT, 168)
		if _year_id == "11":
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _blue_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _blue_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _blue_hovered)
		elif _year_id == "12":
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _yellow_hovered)
		else:
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _yellow_hovered)

		if _year_id == "11" or _year_id == "12":
			var title_lbl: Label = card.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/TitleLabel") as Label
			if title_lbl != null:
				title_lbl.label_settings = title_blue_settings
			var sub_lbl: Label = card.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/SubLabel") as Label
			if sub_lbl != null:
				sub_lbl.label_settings = info_blue_settings
		card.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _open_exam(exam_json, title))
		MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(card)
		var card_inset: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
		card_inset.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 14)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 14)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 4)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 4)
		card_inset.add_child(card)
		_dynamic_content.add_child(card_inset)

	var spacer: Control = Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 24)
	_dynamic_content.add_child(spacer)


func _open_exam(exam_json: String, title: String) -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Sfx.click()
	AppRouter.push("final_exam", {"exam_json": exam_json, "title_fa": title})


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	AppRouter.back("final_exams")
```

class_name FinalExams

## ============================================================

##  from res://data/final_exams/manifest.json. Picking a grade pushes the exam list for that year.
## ============================================================

const SCENE_MAIN_MENU: String = "res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn"
const CARD_ACCENTS: Array[Color] = [Color("#2563EB"), Color("#D97706")]
