```gdscript
@onready var _subtitle: Label = $RootMargin/MainColumn/ContentMargin/ContentScroll/Content/Subtitle
@onready var _dynamic_content: VBoxContainer = $RootMargin/MainColumn/ContentMargin/ContentScroll/Content/DynamicContent
@onready var _empty_message: Label = $RootMargin/MainColumn/ContentMargin/ContentScroll/Content/EmptyMessage


func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	wire_header_bar()
	_build_ui()


func _build_ui() -> void:
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(_subtitle, "پایه خود را انتخاب کنید")
	var _yellow_normal: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Normal.tres")
	var _yellow_hovered: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Yellow_Hovered.tres")
	var _blue_normal: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Blue_Normal.tres")
	var _blue_hovered: StyleBoxFlat = load("res://ui/Styles/buttons/Blue_Hovered.tres")
	_subtitle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	_subtitle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())

	var years: Array = ExamData.years()
	if years.is_empty():
		_empty_message.visible = true
		return

	for i in years.size():
		var year: Dictionary = years[i]
		var accent: Color = CARD_ACCENTS[i % CARD_ACCENTS.size()]
		var exam_count: int = year.get("exams", []).size()
		var card: Button = MenuStyle.make_card(
			str(year.get("title_fa", "")),
			"%s · %d آزمون" % [str(year.get("subtitle_fa", "")), exam_count],
			"🎓",
			accent,
			190
		)
		var year_id: String = str(year.get("id", ""))
		if year_id == "11":
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _blue_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _blue_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _blue_hovered)
		elif year_id == "12":
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _yellow_hovered)
		else:
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _yellow_normal)
			card.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _yellow_hovered)

		if year_id == "11" or year_id == "12":
			var title_lbl: Label = card.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/TitleLabel") as Label
			if title_lbl != null:
				title_lbl.label_settings = load("res://ui/fonts/Fa_Button_Title_Blue.tres")
			var sub_lbl: Label = card.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/SubLabel") as Label
			if sub_lbl != null:
				sub_lbl.label_settings = load("res://ui/fonts/Fa_Button_Info_Blue.tres")
		card.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _open_year(year_id))
		MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(card)
		var card_inset: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
		card_inset.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 14)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 14)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 4)
		card_inset.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 4)
		card_inset.add_child(card)
		_dynamic_content.add_child(card_inset)

	var spacer: Control = Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 24)
	_dynamic_content.add_child(spacer)


func _open_year(year_id: String) -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Sfx.click()
	AppRouter.push("final_exam_list", {"year": year_id})


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(SCENE_MAIN_MENU, TransitionManager.Slide.BACK)
```

```gdscript
class_name FeedbackPopup

signal skip_pressed

	explanation_label = Label.new()
	explanation_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	explanation_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	explanation_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SIZE)
	explanation_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	layout.add_child(explanation_label)

	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 6)
	layout.add_child(spacer)

	var button_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	button_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	layout.add_child(button_row)

	continue_button = GrammarButton.new()
	continue_button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.PRIMARY
	continue_button.text = "ادامه"
	continue_button.min_height = 112
	continue_button.font_size = 46
	continue_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	continue_button.pressed.connect(_on_continue_pressed)

	skip_button = GrammarButton.new()

	skip_button.text = "پرش به سوال بعدی"
	skip_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	skip_button.visible = false
	skip_button.pressed.connect(_on_skip_pressed)

func show_correct(explanation: String) -> void:

	skip_button.visible = false
	title_label.text = "🌟 عالی بود!"
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.success_color())

	style.border_color = GrammarTheme.success_color()
	style.set_border_width_all(3)

func show_wrong(_explanation: String) -> void:

	skip_button.visible = false
	title_label.text = "💡 نزدیک بود!"
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.warning_color())
	var style := GrammarTheme.card_style()
	style.border_color = GrammarTheme.warning_color()
	style.set_border_width_all(3)
	_card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(
		explanation_label,
		"اشکالی نداره، دوباره امتحان کن!\nمی‌تونی از چراغ راهنما کمک بگیری."
	)
	continue_button.text = "دوباره امتحان کن"
	Sfx.wrong()
	_show_popup()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if _card != null:
		GrammarTheme.style_card(_card)
	if explanation_label != null:
		explanation_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


func _show_popup() -> void:
	show()
	GrammarAnimation.pop(_card)


func hide_popup() -> void:
	GrammarAnimation.disappear(_card)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.18).timeout
	hide()


func show_skip_button() -> void:
	if skip_button != null:
		skip_button.visible = true


func _on_continue_pressed() -> void:
	continue_pressed.emit()
	hide()


func _on_skip_pressed() -> void:
	skip_pressed.emit()
	hide()
```

```gdscript
class_name GrammarButton
extends Button


enum ButtonVariant {
	PRIMARY,
	SECONDARY
}


@export var variant: ButtonVariant = ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
# Minimum button height. Defaults to the theme button height; compact
# chip buttons (e.g. unscramble word slots) set a smaller value.
@export var min_height: int = GrammarTheme.BUTTON_HEIGHT
# Optional larger font size override. 0 (default) uses the theme button
# font size set by the applied style; any positive value wins over it.
@export var font_size: int = 0
@export var enable_press_animation := true
# When false, no click sound plays on press. Used for answer-choice
# buttons so the ONLY sound after answering is the feedback sound.
@export var play_click_sound := true
# When true, the hover and pressed styles are the same as the normal
# style. Used on answer-choice buttons so neither a cursor parked over
# an option nor a stuck "pressed" state (e.g. the option under the
# cursor when the continue button closes the feedback popup) makes it
# look like it was already selected/blacked-out.
@export var neutral_states := false
# When true, the button never clips or trims its text (used by compact
# word chips so no letter is ever removed). Applied in _apply_theme so
# it is not overwritten by the default clipping.
@export var no_clip := false


func _ready() -> void:

	# Enforce a minimum button height, but never clobber an explicit
	# width already set by the caller (e.g. exercise options that
	# want a shared fixed width and SHRINK_CENTER alignment).
	if custom_minimum_size.y < min_height:
		custom_minimum_size.y = min_height

	_apply_theme()

	# Keep the scale pivot at the center so press/hover animations
	# grow from the button's middle instead of its top-left corner.
	pivot_offset = size * 0.5

	Global.on_theme_changed(
		_on_theme_changed
	)

	pressed.connect(
		func() -> void:
			if play_click_sound:
				Sfx.click()
	)

	button_down.connect(
		_on_button_down
	)

	focus_entered.connect(
		_on_focus_entered
	)

	mouse_entered.connect(
		_on_mouse_entered
	)


func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_RESIZED:
		pivot_offset = size * 0.5


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	# Stop following live theme changes so a freed button never leaks a
	# callback on the Global.theme_changed signal (it persists for the whole
	# app session and would otherwise keep calling into a freed object).
	if is_instance_valid(Global) and Global.theme_changed.is_connected(_on_theme_changed):
		Global.theme_changed.disconnect(_on_theme_changed)


func _apply_theme() -> void:

	if variant == ButtonVariant.PRIMARY:

		GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(
			self
		)

	else:

		GrammarTheme.style_secondary_button(
			self
		)

	# A positive font_size export overrides the theme default (so larger
	# action buttons like "بررسی" keep their size after theme changes).
	if font_size > 0:
		add_theme_font_size_override(
			"font_size",
			font_size
		)

	if neutral_states:
		add_theme_stylebox_override(
			"hover",
			get_theme_stylebox("normal")
		)

		add_theme_stylebox_override(
			"pressed",
			get_theme_stylebox("normal")
		)

	if no_clip:
		text_overrun_behavior = (
			TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING
		)

		clip_text = false
	else:
		text_overrun_behavior = (
			TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
		)

		clip_text = true


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:

	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	# Re-apply the base theme styling for the current mode. Transient
	# correct/wrong/selected overrides are re-applied by their callers
	# the next time they are triggered.
	_apply_theme()


func _on_button_down() -> void:

	if enable_press_animation:
		GrammarAnimation.press(
			self
		)


func _on_focus_entered() -> void:

	GrammarAnimation.small_pop(
		self
	)


func _on_mouse_entered() -> void:

	if not disabled:
		GrammarAnimation.small_pop(
			self
		)


func set_correct_state() -> void:

	disabled = true

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"disabled",
		GrammarTheme.success_button()
	)

	add_theme_color_override(
		"font_disabled_color",
		GrammarTheme.success_color()
	)

	GrammarAnimation.correct(
		self
	)


func set_wrong_state() -> void:

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"normal",
		GrammarTheme.error_button()
	)

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"hover",
		GrammarTheme.error_button()
	)

	add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.error_color()
	)

	# A wrong option is left interactive so the learner can re-pick, but if a
	# caller disables it (e.g. after a second attempt) the text must stay the
	# error red rather than snapping back to the default disabled gray.
	add_theme_color_override(
		"font_disabled_color",
		GrammarTheme.error_color()
	)

	GrammarAnimation.wrong(
		self
	)


func reset_state() -> void:

	_apply_theme()

	disabled = false


# Highlights a button as currently picked (used by Matching so the
# player can see which part has been chosen).
func set_selected_state() -> void:

	var style := GrammarTheme.selected_button()

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"normal",
		style
	)

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"hover",
		style
	)

	add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"pressed",
		style
	)

	add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.accent_font_color()
	)

	add_theme_color_override(
		"font_hover_color",
		GrammarTheme.accent_font_color()
	)


func clear_selected_state() -> void:

	remove_theme_stylebox_override(
		"normal"
	)

	remove_theme_stylebox_override(
		"hover"
	)

	remove_theme_stylebox_override(
		"pressed"
	)

	remove_theme_color_override(
		"font_color"
	)

	remove_theme_color_override(
		"font_hover_color"
	)

	_apply_theme()
```

## File: `res://scenes/grammar/components/GrammarHint.gd`

```gdscript
class_name GrammarHint
extends Control
# ============================================================
#  GRAMMAR HINT — a big, friendly light-bulb hint affordance.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
#  * A large 💡 button that sits near the bottom-centre of the
#    lesson's content card.
#  * When the learner gets an answer wrong, GrammarLesson calls
#    flash() to draw attention with expanding rings (heartbeat
#    pulse) radiating from behind the bulb.
#  * Tapping the bulb emits hint_requested; the caller fills the
#    hint text and calls show_bubble() to reveal a bright,
#    friendly bubble (a different message system from the modal
#    FeedbackPopup).
# ============================================================

signal hint_requested

const PULSE_PERIOD := 1.2
const RING_COLOR := Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.3, 0.5)

var _bulb: Button
var _bubble: PanelContainer
var _bubble_label: Label
var _bubble_margin: MarginContainer

var _pulse := 0.0
var _time := 0.0
var _pulsing := false


func _ready() -> void:
	# The overlay spans the bottom of the card, right over the answer
	# buttons. Keep it fully click-through (IGNORE on every container)
	# so it never blocks the exercise buttons underneath; only the bulb
	# Button itself captures presses.
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_build_ui()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(
		_on_theme_changed
	)
	set_process(true)


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(Global) and Global.theme_changed.is_connected(_on_theme_changed):
		Global.theme_changed.disconnect(_on_theme_changed)


func _build_ui() -> void:
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	vbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(vbox)

	# Push the bubble + bulb down to the bottom so they sit near the
	# bottom edge of the card.
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	vbox.add_child(spacer)

	_bubble = PanelContainer.new()
	_bubble.visible = false
	_bubble.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_bubble.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	vbox.add_child(_bubble)

	_bubble_margin = MarginContainer.new()
	_bubble_margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_bubble_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 20)
	_bubble_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 20)
	_bubble_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 14)
	_bubble_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 14)
	_bubble.add_child(_bubble_margin)

	_bubble_label = Label.new()
	_bubble_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_bubble_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_bubble_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_bubble_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(320, 0)
	_bubble_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SMALL_SIZE)
	_bubble_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular())
	_bubble_margin.add_child(_bubble_label)

	# The bulb itself: a big transparent emoji button. STOP so its own
	# presses are captured (it is the only interactive part of the hint).
	_bulb = Button.new()
	_bulb.text = "💡"
	_bulb.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(96, 96)
	_bulb.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	_bulb.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_bulb.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	_bulb.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 58)
	var flat := StyleBoxEmpty.new()
	_bulb.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", flat)
	_bulb.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", flat)
	_bulb.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", flat)
	_bulb.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", flat)
	_bulb.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", flat)
	_bulb.pressed.connect(func() -> void: hint_requested.emit())
	vbox.add_child(_bulb)


# Theme --------------------------------------------------------

func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if _bubble == null or _bubble_label == null:
		return
	# The hint bubble is an intentionally bright, friendly light-bulb
	# callout. In dark mode it uses the warm warning gold; in light mode
	# a bright warm yellow keeps the same friendly look. Dark text reads
	# well on both fills.
	var is_dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
	var fill: Color = GrammarTheme.warning_color() if is_dark else Global.get_theme_color("warning_soft")
	var border: Color = Global.get_theme_color("warning")
	_bubble.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"panel",
		GrammarTheme.rounded_box(fill, 20, border, 2)
	)
	_bubble_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		Color(0.09, 0.09, 0.12)
	)


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


# Public API ---------------------------------------------------

func set_hint(text: String) -> void:
	if _bubble_label != null:
		_bubble_label.text = GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(text)
		_bubble_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL


func show_bubble() -> void:
	if _bubble == null:
		return
	_bubble.visible = true
	_bubble.modulate.a = 0.0
	_bubble.pivot_offset = _bubble.size * 0.5
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(_bubble, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(_bubble, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.3)


func hide_bubble() -> void:
	if _bubble != null:
		_bubble.visible = false
		_bubble.scale = Vector2.ONE
		_bubble.modulate.a = 1.0


func toggle_bubble() -> void:
	if _bubble != null and _bubble.visible:
		hide_bubble()
	else:
		show_bubble()


# Start / stop the expanding-ring pulse used to attract attention
# after a wrong answer.
func flash() -> void:
	_pulsing = true
	_time = 0.0
	queue_redraw()


func stop_flash() -> void:
	_pulsing = false
	queue_redraw()


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if _pulsing:
		_time += delta
		_pulse = fmod(_time / PULSE_PERIOD, 1.0)
		queue_redraw()


func _draw() -> void:
	if not _pulsing or _bulb == null:
		return

	var center: Vector2 = _bulb.position + _bulb.size * 0.5
	var max_radius := 78.0
	var rings := 3

	for i in rings:
		var t := fmod(_pulse + float(i) / float(rings), 1.0)
		var radius := 14.0 + t * (max_radius - 14.0)
		var alpha := (1.0 - t) * 0.45
		draw_arc(center, radius, 0.0, TAU, 48, Color(RING_COLOR.r, RING_COLOR.g, RING_COLOR.b, alpha), 4.0)
```

```gdscript
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if _card != null:
		GrammarTheme.style_card(_card)
	if title_label != null:
		title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	if reward_label != null:
		reward_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.xp_color())
	if rank_badge_panel != null:
		rank_badge_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", GrammarTheme.info_card_style())


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


func show_reward(title: String, awarded_xp: int, next_text: String = "ادامه", show_back: bool = false, bonus_xp: int = 0) -> void:
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(title_label, title)
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(next_button, next_text)
	back_button.visible = show_back

	if bonus_xp > 0:
		bonus_label.visible = true
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(bonus_label, "🔥 +%d XP پاداش پاسخ بدون اشتباه!" % bonus_xp)
	else:
		bonus_label.visible = false

	# Update Mastery Bar & Rank inside Popup
	var mastery := GrammarData.get_mastery_status(Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson)
	var rank_str := "%s سطح تسلط: %s  (⭐ %d / %d XP)" % [
		mastery["rank_icon"],
		mastery["rank_title_fa"],
		mastery["current_xp"],
		mastery["base_max_xp"]
	]
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(rank_label, rank_str)
	rank_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", mastery["rank_color"])
	mastery_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", GrammarTheme.rounded_box(mastery["rank_color"], 8))
	mastery_bar.value = 0.0

	show()
	GrammarAnimation.pop(_card)
	GrammarAnimation.spawn_confetti(self, 80 if awarded_xp > 0 else 35)

	# Animate the XP counter and mastery bar
	var t := create_tween()
	t.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	t.tween_property(mastery_bar, "value", mastery["progress_ratio"] * 100.0, 0.75)

	if awarded_xp > 0:
		emoji_label.text = "🏆" if mastery["progress_ratio"] >= 1.0 else "🎉"
		Sfx.reward()
		t.parallel().tween_method(
			func(val: int) -> void: reward_label.text = "⭐ +%d XP" % val,
			0,
			awarded_xp,
			0.65
		)
	else:
		emoji_label.text = "✅"
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(reward_label, "⭐ مرور مجدد (امتیاز قبلاً دریافت شده)")


func _on_next() -> void:
	hide()
	next_requested.emit()


func _on_back() -> void:
	hide()
	back_requested.emit()
```

```gdscript
class_name FillBlankExercise
extends GrammarExercise


var prompt_label: Label
var input: LineEdit
var submit_button: GrammarButton


func setup(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	super.setup(data)

	_build_ui()
	_show_item()


func _build_ui() -> void:
	for child in get_children():
		child.queue_free()

	var container := VBoxContainer.new()

	container.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(
		Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT
	)

		)
	))
	title.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL

	title.horizontal_alignment = (
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	)

	title.autowrap_mode = (
		TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	)

	title.add_theme_font_size_override(
		"font_size",
		GrammarTheme.BODY_SIZE
	)

	title.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color()
	)

	container.add_child(title)

	prompt_label = Label.new()

	prompt_label.horizontal_alignment = (
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	)

	prompt_label.vertical_alignment = (
		VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	)

	prompt_label.autowrap_mode = (
		TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	)

	prompt_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(
		0,
		140
	)

	prompt_label.add_theme_font_size_override(
		"font_size",
		GrammarTheme.HEADING_SIZE
	)

	prompt_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.text_color()
	)

	container.add_child(prompt_label)

	input = LineEdit.new()

	input.placeholder_text = (
		"پاسخ خود را بنویس..."
	)

	input.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(
		600,
		70
	)

	# Keep it a centered 1000-wide box instead of stretching edge-to-edge.
	input.size_flags_horizontal = (
		Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	)

	input.alignment = (
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	)

	input.add_theme_font_size_override(
		"font_size",
		GrammarTheme.BODY_LARGE_SIZE
	)

	container.add_child(input)

	submit_button = GrammarButton.new()

	submit_button.variant = (
		GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.PRIMARY
	)

	submit_button.text = "بررسی ✓"

	submit_button.min_height = 112

	submit_button.font_size = 46

	submit_button.pressed.connect(
		_check_answer
	)

	container.add_child(
		submit_button
	)


func _show_item() -> void:
	var items: Array = exercise_data.get(
		"items",
		[]
	)

	if current_index >= items.size():
		complete()
		return

	answered = false

	input.text = ""

	var item: Dictionary = items[
		current_index
	]

	prompt_label.text = GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(str(
		item.get(
			"text",
			""
		)
	))
	prompt_label.text_direction = (
		Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		if GrammarTheme.is_fa_dominant(prompt_label.text)
		else Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
	)

	GrammarAnimation.appear(
		prompt_label
	)

	GrammarAnimation.appear(
		input,
		0.08
	)

	GrammarAnimation.appear(
		submit_button,
		0.16
	)


func _check_answer() -> void:
	if answered:
		return

	var user_answer := input.text.strip_edges()

	if user_answer.is_empty():
		return

	var item: Dictionary = exercise_data[
		"items"
	][current_index]

	var answers: Array = item.get(
		"answers",
		[]
	)

	var normalized_user := _normalize_answer(
		user_answer
	)

	var correct := false

	for answer in answers:
		var normalized_answer := _normalize_answer(
			str(answer)
		)

		if normalized_user == normalized_answer:
			correct = true
			break

	var explanation := ""

	if correct:
		explanation = str(
			item.get(
				"explanation_fa",
				"آفرین! پاسخ درست است."
			)
		)
	else:
		explanation = str(
			item.get(
				"wrong_explanation_fa",
				"پاسخ درست نیست. دوباره فکر کن."
			)
		)

	answered = true

	submit_result(
		correct,
		explanation
	)


func continue_to_next() -> void:
	current_index += 1

	_show_item()


func retry_current() -> void:
	# Clear the box and let the learner type a new answer for the same item.
	_show_item()


func get_current_hint() -> String:
	var items: Array = exercise_data.get("items", [])
	if current_index >= items.size():
		return ""
	var item: Dictionary = items[current_index]
	var hint := str(item.get("hint_fa", ""))
	if hint.is_empty():
		hint = "به معنای جمله فکر کن و جای خالی را با کلمهٔ مناسب پر کن."
	return hint


# Normalizes a typed answer so grading is robust to common keyboard noise:
# trimming, lowercasing, collapsing repeated spaces (a learner often types
# "was  talking" for the "was talking" answer), and folding smart/curly
# apostrophes to the ASCII one.
func _normalize_answer(s: String) -> String:
	var out := s.strip_edges().to_lower()
	out = out.replace(char(0x2019), "'")
	out = out.replace(char(0x2018), "'")
	while out.contains("  "):
		out = out.replace("  ", " ")
	return out.strip_edges()
```

## File: `res://scenes/grammar/exercises/MatchingExercise.gd`

```gdscript
class_name MatchingExercise
extends GrammarExercise

var counter_label: Label
var left_container: VBoxContainer
var right_container: VBoxContainer
var selected_left: GrammarButton
var selected_right: GrammarButton
var matched: int = 0
var left_buttons: Array[GrammarButton] = []
var right_buttons: Array[GrammarButton] = []


func setup(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	super.setup(data)
	_build_ui()
	_create_items()
	call_deferred("_equalize_button_heights")


func _build_ui() -> void:
	for child in get_children():
		child.queue_free()

	var root := VBoxContainer.new()
	root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	root.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	add_child(root)

	# Matched Pairs Counter Pill
	var top_bar := HBoxContainer.new()
	top_bar.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	root.add_child(top_bar)

	var pill := PanelContainer.new()
	var pill_style := GrammarTheme.rounded_box(GrammarTheme.accent_soft_color(), 16, GrammarTheme.accent_color(), 1)
	pill_style.content_margin_left = 18
	pill_style.content_margin_right = 18
	pill_style.content_margin_top = 6
	pill_style.content_margin_bottom = 6
	pill.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", pill_style)
	top_bar.add_child(pill)

	counter_label = Label.new()
	counter_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	counter_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.CAPTION_SIZE)
	counter_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.accent_color())
	pill.add_child(counter_label)

	var instruction := Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(
		instruction,
		str(exercise_data.get("instruction_fa", "جفت‌های درست را پیدا کن."))
	)
	instruction.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	instruction.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	instruction.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	instruction.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SMALL_SIZE)
	instruction.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	instruction.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	root.add_child(instruction)

	var columns := HBoxContainer.new()
	columns.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	columns.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	root.add_child(columns)

	left_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	left_container.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	left_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	columns.add_child(left_container)

	right_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	right_container.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	right_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	columns.add_child(right_container)


func _update_counter() -> void:
	if counter_label != null:
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(counter_label, "🔗 جفت‌های پیدا شده: %d از %d" % [matched, left_buttons.size()])


func _create_items() -> void:
	matched = 0
	left_buttons.clear()
	right_buttons.clear()

	var items: Array = exercise_data.get("items", [])
	var shuffled_right := items.duplicate()
	shuffled_right.shuffle()

	for i in range(items.size()):
		var item: Dictionary = items[i]
		var button := _create_button(str(item.get("left", "")), true)
		button.set_meta("match_value", str(item.get("right", "")))
		left_container.add_child(button)
		left_buttons.append(button)
		GrammarAnimation.appear(button, i * 0.04)

	for i in range(shuffled_right.size()):
		var item: Dictionary = shuffled_right[i]
		var button := _create_button(str(item.get("right", "")), false)
		button.set_meta("match_value", str(item.get("right", "")))
		right_container.add_child(button)
		right_buttons.append(button)
		GrammarAnimation.appear(button, i * 0.04 + 0.02)

	_update_counter()


func _create_button(text_value: String, is_left: bool) -> GrammarButton:
	var button := GrammarButton.new()
	button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
	button.play_click_sound = false
	button.neutral_states = true
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(button, text_value)
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 84)
	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE_MATCHING)
	button.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	button.no_clip = true
	button.set_meta("is_left", is_left)
	button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _select(button, is_left))
	return button


func _equalize_button_heights() -> void:
	var all_buttons: Array[GrammarButton] = []
	all_buttons.append_array(left_buttons)
	all_buttons.append_array(right_buttons)
	if all_buttons.is_empty():
		return

	var column_width: float = float(left_container.size.x)
	if column_width <= 0.0:
		var vp_width: float = float(get_viewport_rect().size.x)
		column_width = maxf(240.0, (vp_width - 36.0) * 0.5)

	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	var tallest: float = 0.0
	for button in all_buttons:
		var measured := GrammarTheme.measure_text(
			font,
			button.text,
			GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE_MATCHING,
			maxf(180.0, column_width - 18.0),
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		)
		tallest = maxf(tallest, measured.y)

	var final_height: int = int(ceil(tallest + 28.0))
	if final_height < 84:
		final_height = 84
	for button in all_buttons:
		button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, final_height)


func _select(button: GrammarButton, is_left: bool) -> void:
	if button.disabled:
		return
	Sfx.click()
	GrammarAnimation.press(button)

	if is_left:
		if selected_left != null and selected_left != button:
			selected_left.clear_selected_state()
		selected_left = button
	else:
		if selected_right != null and selected_right != button:
			selected_right.clear_selected_state()
		selected_right = button

	button.set_selected_state()

	if selected_left != null and selected_right != null:
		_check_pair()


func _check_pair() -> void:
	var left_value := str(selected_left.get_meta("match_value", ""))
	var right_value := str(selected_right.get_meta("match_value", ""))
	var correct := (left_value == right_value)

	if correct:
		selected_left.set_correct_state()
		selected_right.set_correct_state()
		selected_left.clear_selected_state()
		selected_right.clear_selected_state()
		matched += 1
		_update_counter()
		GrammarAnimation.small_pop(counter_label)
		selected_left = null
		selected_right = null

		if matched >= left_buttons.size():
			submit_result(true, "عالی! همه‌ی جفت‌ها را پیدا کردی.")
		else:
			Sfx.correct()
	else:
		Sfx.wrong()
		selected_left.clear_selected_state()
		selected_right.clear_selected_state()
		GrammarAnimation.wrong(selected_left)
		GrammarAnimation.wrong(selected_right)
		selected_left = null
		selected_right = null


func continue_to_next() -> void:
	complete()


func get_current_hint() -> String:
	return "هر عبارت در ستون چپ را با معادل درست آن در ستون راست جفت کن."
```

```gdscript
	q_style.content_margin_right = 24
	q_style.content_margin_top = 24
	q_style.content_margin_bottom = 24
	question_card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", q_style)
	question_card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 160)
	main.add_child(question_card)

	question_label = Label.new()
	question_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	question_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	question_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	question_label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	question_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.HEADING_SIZE)
	question_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	question_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_en_bold())
	question_card.add_child(question_label)

	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_child(spacer)

	options_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	options_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	main.add_child(options_container)


func _show_question() -> void:
	if current_index >= questions.size():
		complete()
		return
	answered = false

	if is_instance_valid(options_container) and options_container.get_parent() != null:
		_main.remove_child(options_container)
		options_container.queue_free()

	var question: Dictionary = questions[current_index]
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(counter_label, "سوال %d از %d" % [current_index + 1, questions.size()])
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(
		instruction_label,
		str(exercise_data.get("instruction_fa", "گزینه درست را انتخاب کن."))
	)
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(question_label, str(question.get("question", "")))

	var options: Array = question.get("options", [])
	var long_mode := false
	for i in range(options.size()):
		if str(options[i]).split(" ", false).size() > 3:
			long_mode = true
			break

	_long_mode_buttons.clear()
	if long_mode:
		var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
		vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
		options_container = vbox
	else:
		var grid := GridContainer.new()
		grid.columns = 2
		grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 14)
		grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 14)
		grid.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		options_container = grid

	_main.add_child(options_container)

	var long_mode_height: int = 0
	if long_mode:
		var texts: Array = []
		for i in range(options.size()):
			texts.append(GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(str(options[i])))
		long_mode_height = _long_mode_button_height(texts)

	for i in range(options.size()):
		var button := GrammarButton.new()
		button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
		button.play_click_sound = false
		button.neutral_states = true
		if long_mode:
			button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, long_mode_height)
			button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			button.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
			button.no_clip = true
			_long_mode_buttons.append(button)
		else:
			button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 96)
			button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(button, str(options[i]))
		button.set_meta("answer_index", i)
		button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _on_answer_pressed(button))
		options_container.add_child(button)
		GrammarAnimation.appear(button, i * 0.05)

	if long_mode:
		call_deferred("_equalize_long_mode_buttons")

	GrammarAnimation.appear(question_card)


func _long_mode_available_width() -> float:
	var available_width: float = float(_main.size.x if is_instance_valid(_main) else 0.0)
	if available_width <= 0.0:
		if is_inside_tree():
			available_width = float(get_viewport_rect().size.x)
		else:
			available_width = 800.0
		available_width -= float(GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN * 2)
		available_width -= float(GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN * 2)
		available_width -= 24.0
	return available_width


func _long_mode_button_height(texts: Array) -> int:
	var available_width: float = _long_mode_available_width()
	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	var tallest: float = 0.0
	for i in range(texts.size()):
		var measured := GrammarTheme.measure_text(
			font,
			str(texts[i]),
			GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE,
			maxf(240.0, available_width - 24.0),
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		)
		tallest = maxf(tallest, measured.y)
	var final_height: int = int(ceil(tallest + 34.0))
	if final_height < 92:
		final_height = 92
	return final_height


func _equalize_long_mode_buttons() -> void:
	if _long_mode_buttons.is_empty():
		return
	var texts: Array = []
	for button in _long_mode_buttons:
		texts.append(button.text)
	var final_height := _long_mode_button_height(texts)
	for button in _long_mode_buttons:
		button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, final_height)


func _on_answer_pressed(button: GrammarButton) -> void:
	if answered:
		return
	answered = true
	var question: Dictionary = questions[current_index]
	var correct_index := int(question.get("correct", -1))
	var selected_index := int(button.get_meta("answer_index", -1))
	var correct := (selected_index == correct_index)

	if correct:
		button.set_correct_state()
	else:
		button.set_wrong_state()

	var explanation := ""
	if correct:
		explanation = str(question.get("explanation_fa", "آفرین! پاسخ درست است."))
	else:
		explanation = str(question.get("wrong_explanation_fa", "این گزینه درست نیست. دوباره فکر کن."))

	submit_result(correct, explanation)


func continue_to_next() -> void:
	current_index += 1
	_show_question()


func retry_current() -> void:
	_show_question()


func get_current_hint() -> String:
	if current_index >= questions.size():
		return ""
	var q: Dictionary = questions[current_index]
	var hint := str(q.get("hint_fa", ""))
	if hint.is_empty():
		hint = str(q.get("wrong_explanation_fa", ""))
	if hint.is_empty():
		hint = "به معنی هر گزینه خوب دقت کن و جمله را دوباره بخوان."
	return hint
```

```gdscript
func _update_tray_state() -> void:
	if _blanks_mode:
		placeholder_label.visible = false
		var any_filled := false
		var all_filled := true
		for w in _blank_words:
			if w != "":
				any_filled = true
			else:
				all_filled = false
		clear_button.disabled = not any_filled
		check_button.disabled = not all_filled
	else:
		var empty := selected_words.is_empty()
		placeholder_label.visible = empty
		clear_button.disabled = empty
		check_button.disabled = empty


func _show_item() -> void:
	var items: Array = exercise_data.get("items", [])
	if current_index >= items.size():
		complete()
		return
	answered = false
	selected_words.clear()
	_word_button_width = 0

	for child in answer_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	for child in words_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()

	_blanks_mode = false
	_blank_words.clear()
	_blank_buttons.clear()
	_blank_sources.clear()
	_bank_buttons.clear()

	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(counter_label, "سوال %d از %d" % [current_index + 1, items.size()])

	var item: Dictionary = items[current_index]
	if item.has("template") and item.has("options"):
		_blanks_mode = true
		_show_blanks_item(item)
	else:
		_show_sentence_item(item)

	_update_tray_state()
	GrammarAnimation.appear(answer_card)
	call_deferred("_constrain_flow_widths")


func _constrain_flow_widths() -> void:
	var avail: float = size.x
	if avail <= 0.0:
		avail = 1000.0
	avail -= 48.0
	_cap_flow_container(answer_container, avail)
	_cap_flow_container(words_container, avail)


func _cap_flow_container(container: Container, avail: float) -> void:
	if container == null:
		return
	for child in container.get_children():
		if child is Label:
			var font: Font = child.get_theme_font("font")
			var fsize: int = child.get_theme_font_size("font_size")
			var tw: Vector2 = GrammarTheme.measure_text(font, child.text, fsize, -1.0, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT)
			if tw.x > avail:
				child.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(avail, 0)
				child.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		elif child is Button:
			if child.custom_minimum_size.x > avail:
				child.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(avail, child.custom_minimum_size.y)


func _measure_uniform_word_width(words: Array) -> int:
	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	var widest: float = 0.0
	for w in words:
		var s := str(w)
		widest = maxf(
			widest,
			GrammarTheme.measure_text(font, s, GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE, -1.0, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT).x
		)
	var width := int(ceil(widest + 38.0))
	if width < 88:
		width = 88
	return width


func _show_sentence_item(item: Dictionary) -> void:
	var words: Array = item.get("words", []).duplicate()
	_word_button_width = _measure_uniform_word_width(words)
	words.shuffle()

	for i in range(words.size()):
		var word := str(words[i])
		var button := GrammarButton.new()
		button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
		button.play_click_sound = false
		button.neutral_states = true
		button.text = word
		button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_word_button_width, 0)
		button.min_height = 68
		button.no_clip = true
		button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE)
		button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _select_word(button, word))
		words_container.add_child(button)
		GrammarAnimation.appear(button, i * 0.03)


func _show_blanks_item(item: Dictionary) -> void:
	var template := str(item.get("template", ""))
	var parts := template.split("___")
	for i in range(parts.size()):
		var part := parts[i].strip_edges()
		if not part.is_empty():
			var label := Label.new()
			GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(label, part)
			label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_LARGE_SIZE)
			label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
			answer_container.add_child(label)

		if i < parts.size() - 1:
			var blank := GrammarButton.new()
			blank.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
			blank.play_click_sound = false
			blank.neutral_states = true
			blank.text = "(%d)" % (i + 1)
			blank.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(72, 0)
			blank.min_height = 58
			blank.no_clip = true
			blank.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			blank.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_LARGE_SIZE)
			blank.set_meta("blank_index", i)
			blank.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _remove_blank(blank))
			_blank_buttons.append(blank)
			answer_container.add_child(blank)
			_blank_words.append("")
			_blank_sources.append(null)

	var options: Array = item.get("options", []).duplicate()
	_word_button_width = _measure_uniform_word_width(options)
	options.shuffle()

	for idx in range(options.size()):
		var word := str(options[idx])
		var btn := GrammarButton.new()
		btn.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
		btn.play_click_sound = false
		btn.neutral_states = true
		btn.text = word
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_word_button_width, 0)
		btn.min_height = 68
		btn.no_clip = true
		btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
		btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BUTTON_FONT_SIZE)
		btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _fill_blank(btn, word))
		_bank_buttons[word] = btn
		words_container.add_child(btn)
		GrammarAnimation.appear(btn, idx * 0.03)


func _fill_blank(btn: GrammarButton, word: String) -> void:
	if answered or btn.disabled:
		return
	for i in range(_blank_words.size()):
		if _blank_words[i] == "":
			Sfx.click()
			_blank_words[i] = word
			_blank_buttons[i].text = word
			_blank_buttons[i].set_selected_state()
			GrammarAnimation.small_pop(_blank_buttons[i])
			btn.disabled = true
			if i < _blank_sources.size():
				_blank_sources[i] = btn
			_update_tray_state()
			return


func _remove_blank(blank: GrammarButton) -> void:
	if answered:
		return
	var i := int(blank.get_meta("blank_index", -1))
	if i < 0 or i >= _blank_words.size():
		return
	var word: String = _blank_words[i]
	if word == "":
		return
	Sfx.click()
	_blank_words[i] = ""
	blank.text = "(%d)" % (i + 1)
	blank.clear_selected_state()
	if i < _blank_sources.size() and _blank_sources[i] is GrammarButton:
		var bank_btn: GrammarButton = _blank_sources[i]
		bank_btn.disabled = false
		_blank_sources[i] = null
	_update_tray_state()


func _select_word(button: GrammarButton, word: String) -> void:
	if answered or button.disabled:
		return
	Sfx.click()
	button.disabled = true
	selected_words.append(word)

	var answer_button := GrammarButton.new()
	answer_button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
	answer_button.play_click_sound = false
	answer_button.neutral_states = true
	answer_button.text = word
	answer_button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_word_button_width, 0)
	answer_button.min_height = 64
	answer_button.no_clip = true
	answer_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	answer_button.set_selected_state()
	answer_button.set_meta("source_button", button)
	answer_button.pressed.connect(func() -> void: _remove_word(answer_button))
	answer_container.add_child(answer_button)
	GrammarAnimation.appear(answer_button)
	_update_tray_state()


func _remove_word(answer_button: GrammarButton) -> void:
	if answered:
		return
	Sfx.click()
	var word := answer_button.text
	var index := selected_words.find(word)
	if index >= 0:
		selected_words.remove_at(index)
	var source_button = answer_button.get_meta("source_button", null)
	if source_button is GrammarButton:
		source_button.disabled = false
	answer_button.queue_free()
	_update_tray_state()


func _check_answer() -> void:
	if answered:
		return
	var items: Array = exercise_data.get("items", [])
	var item: Dictionary = items[current_index]
	var correct := false

	if _blanks_mode:
		correct = _check_blanks_answer(item)
	else:
		var expected := _normalize_unscramble(str(item.get("answer", "")))
		var actual := _normalize_unscramble(" ".join(selected_words))
		correct = (actual == expected)

	answered = true
	if correct:
		GrammarAnimation.correct(answer_card)
		submit_result(true, "عالی! جمله کاملاً درست است.")
	else:
		GrammarAnimation.wrong(answer_card)
		submit_result(false, "ترتیب کلمات هنوز درست نیست. دوباره امتحان کن.")


func _check_blanks_answer(item: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var expected: Array = item.get("answer", [])
	if expected.size() != _blank_words.size():
		return false
	for i in range(expected.size()):
		var a := str(_blank_words[i]).to_lower().strip_edges()
		var b := str(expected[i]).to_lower().strip_edges()
		if a != b:
			return false
	return true


func continue_to_next() -> void:
	current_index += 1
	_show_item()


func retry_current() -> void:
	_show_item()


func get_current_hint() -> String:
	var items: Array = exercise_data.get("items", [])
	if current_index >= items.size():
		return ""
	var item: Dictionary = items[current_index]
	var hint := str(item.get("hint_fa", ""))
	if hint.is_empty():
		hint = str(item.get("fa", ""))
	if hint.is_empty():
		hint = "کلمات را طوری مرتب کن که یک جملهٔ درست و معنادار بسازی."
	return hint


func _normalize_unscramble(s: String) -> String:
	var out := s.strip_edges().to_lower()
	while out.contains("  "):
		out = out.replace("  ", " ")
	for punct in [" .", " ?", " ,", " ،", " ؟", " !", " :", " ;"]:
		out = out.replace(punct, punct.strip_edges())
	return out.strip_edges()
```

```gdscript
class_name ExerciseFactory
extends RefCounted


static func create_exercise(
		type: String
	) -> GrammarExercise:

	match type:

		"multiple_choice":
			return MultipleChoiceExercise.new()

		"fill_blank":
			return FillBlankExercise.new()

		"true_false":
			return TrueFalseExercise.new()

		"matching":
			return MatchingExercise.new()

		"unscramble":
			return UnscrambleExercise.new()

		_:
			push_error(
				"Unknown exercise type: " + type
			)

			return null
```

```gdscript
class_name GrammarAnimation
extends RefCounted


static func _kill_tweens(control: Control) -> void:
	if not control.has_meta("grammar_tween"):
		return
	var tween: Tween = control.get_meta("grammar_tween")
	if tween != null and tween is Tween and tween.is_valid():
		tween.kill()


static func _store_tween(control: Control, tween: Tween) -> void:
	control.set_meta("grammar_tween", tween)


static func _center_pivot(control: Control) -> void:
	control.pivot_offset = control.size * 0.5


# ============================================================
# BUTTON PRESS
# ============================================================
static func press(control: Control) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	control.modulate.a = 1.0
	_center_pivot(control)
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(0.94, 0.94), 0.07)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(1.02, 1.02), 0.08)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.10)


# ============================================================
# BUTTON HOVER / ATTENTION
# ============================================================
static func small_pop(control: Control) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	control.modulate.a = 1.0
	_center_pivot(control)
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(1.04, 1.04), 0.12)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.16)


# ============================================================
# CORRECT (+ Sparkle Burst)
# ============================================================
static func correct(control: Control) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	_center_pivot(control)
	var original_position := control.position
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(1.06, 1.06), 0.12)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "position", original_position + Vector2(0, -6), 0.12)
	tween.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.16)
	tween.tween_property(control, "position", original_position, 0.14)
	spawn_sparkle_burst(control)


# ============================================================
# WRONG
# ============================================================
static func wrong(control: Control) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	_center_pivot(control)
	var original_position := control.position
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	var offsets := [-10.0, 10.0, -8.0, 8.0, -5.0, 5.0, 0.0]
	for offset in offsets:
		tween.tween_property(control, "position", original_position + Vector2(offset, 0), 0.045)


# ============================================================
# APPEAR
# ============================================================
static func appear(control: Control, delay: float = 0.0) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	_center_pivot(control)
	control.modulate.a = 0.0
	control.scale = Vector2(0.92, 0.92)
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	if delay > 0.0:
		tween.tween_interval(delay)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.30)


# ============================================================
# DISAPPEAR
# ============================================================
static func disappear(control: Control, duration: float = 0.18) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	_center_pivot(control)
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 0.0, duration)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(0.94, 0.94), duration)


# ============================================================
# SLIDE UP
# ============================================================
static func slide_up(control: Control, distance: float = 30.0, delay: float = 0.0) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	var final_position := control.position
	control.position.y += distance
	control.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	if delay > 0.0:
		tween.tween_interval(delay)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "position", final_position, 0.30)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)


# ============================================================
# POP
# ============================================================
static func pop(control: Control) -> void:
	_kill_tweens(control)
	_center_pivot(control)
	control.scale = Vector2(0.65, 0.65)
	control.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.35)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)


# ============================================================
# XP FLOAT & FLOATING XP TOAST
# ============================================================
static func float_up(control: Control) -> void:
	var final_position := control.position
	control.modulate.a = 1.0
	var tween := control.create_tween()
	_store_tween(control, tween)
	tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "position", final_position + Vector2(0, -70), 0.65)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.65)


static func spawn_xp_toast(host: Control, text: String, target_control: Control = null) -> void:
	if host == null or not host.is_inside_tree():
		return
	var badge := PanelContainer.new()
	badge.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	badge.z_index = 95
	var style := GrammarTheme.rounded_box(Color("#F59E0B"), 24, Color("#FDE68A"), 2)
	style.content_margin_left = 20
	style.content_margin_right = 20
	style.content_margin_top = 10
	style.content_margin_bottom = 10
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35)
	style.shadow_size = 10
	badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var lbl := Label.new()
	lbl.text = text
	lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	badge.add_child(lbl)
	host.add_child(badge)

	var vp_size := host.get_viewport_rect().size
	var start_pos := Vector2(vp_size.x * 0.5 - 90.0, vp_size.y * 0.22)
	if target_control != null and is_instance_valid(target_control):
		start_pos = target_control.global_position + Vector2(-20, 40)
	badge.global_position = start_pos
	badge.scale = Vector2(0.6, 0.6)

	var t := badge.create_tween()
	t.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	t.tween_property(badge, "scale", Vector2(1.1, 1.1), 0.2)
	t.tween_property(badge, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12)
	t.parallel().tween_property(badge, "global_position", start_pos + Vector2(0, -90), 0.85).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	t.tween_property(badge, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.35)
	t.tween_callback(badge.queue_free)


# ============================================================
# SPARKLE BURST (On Correct Answer)
# ============================================================
static func spawn_sparkle_burst(target: Control) -> void:
	if target == null or not target.is_inside_tree():
		return
	var root := target.get_tree().current_scene
	if root == null:
		return
	var center := target.global_position + target.size * 0.5
	var colors := [Color("#FBBF24"), Color("#34D399"), Color("#22D3EE"), Color("#A78BFA")]
	for i in range(10):
		var dot := ColorRect.new()
		dot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		dot.z_index = 90
		dot.size = Vector2(12, 12)
		dot.pivot_offset = Vector2(6, 6)
		dot.color = colors[i % colors.size()]
		dot.global_position = center - Vector2(6, 6)
		dot.rotation = randf() * TAU
		root.add_child(dot)

		var angle := (TAU / 10.0) * float(i) + randf_range(-0.2, 0.2)
		var dist := randf_range(65.0, 135.0)
		var dest := center + Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * dist

		var t := dot.create_tween()
		t.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		t.parallel().tween_property(dot, "global_position", dest, 0.45)
		t.parallel().tween_property(dot, "scale", Vector2.ZERO, 0.45)
		t.parallel().tween_property(dot, "rotation", dot.rotation + 3.0, 0.45)
		t.tween_callback(dot.queue_free)


# ============================================================
# PROCEDURAL CONFETTI CANNON (Full-screen celebration)
# ============================================================
static func spawn_confetti(host: Node, count: int = 75) -> void:
	if host == null or not host.is_inside_tree():
		return
	var layer := _ConfettiOverlay.new(count)
	host.add_child(layer)


class _ConfettiOverlay extends Control:
	var _particles: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var _elapsed: float = 0.0
	const DURATION: float = 3.4
	const PALETTE := [
		Color("#22D3EE"), # Cyan
		Color("#EC4899"), # Pink
		Color("#FBBF24"), # Gold
		Color("#34D399"), # Emerald
		Color("#A78BFA"), # Violet
		Color("#F87171")  # Coral
	]

	func _init(count: int = 75) -> void:
		set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		z_index = 120
		var vp := Vector2(1080, 1920)
		for i in range(count):
			var from_left := (i % 2 == 0)
			var start_x := randf_range(40.0, vp.x - 40.0)
			var start_y := randf_range(-80.0, 180.0)
			var vx := randf_range(-280.0, 280.0) if not from_left else randf_range(-220.0, 220.0)
			var vy := randf_range(-750.0, -250.0)
			_particles.append({
				"pos": Vector2(start_x, start_y),
				"vel": Vector2(vx, vy),
				"size": Vector2(randf_range(12.0, 22.0), randf_range(8.0, 14.0)),
				"color": PALETTE[i % PALETTE.size()],
				"rot": randf() * TAU,
				"rot_speed": randf_range(-9.0, 9.0),
				"sway_phase": randf() * TAU,
				"sway_speed": randf_range(3.0, 7.0),
				"circle": (i % 4 == 0)
			})

	func _ready() -> void:
		var vp_size := get_viewport_rect().size
		if vp_size.x > 0:
			for p in _particles:
				p["pos"].x = randf_range(40.0, vp_size.x - 40.0)

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		_elapsed += delta
		if _elapsed >= DURATION:
			queue_free()
			return
		for p in _particles:
			p["vel"].y += 980.0 * delta # gravity
			p["pos"].x += (p["vel"].x + sin(_elapsed * p["sway_speed"] + p["sway_phase"]) * 90.0) * delta
			p["pos"].y += p["vel"].y * delta
			p["rot"] += p["rot_speed"] * delta
		queue_redraw()

	func _draw() -> void:
		var fade := clampf(1.0 - maxf(0.0, (_elapsed - (DURATION - 0.8)) / 0.8), 0.0, 1.0)
		for p in _particles:
			var col: Color = p["color"]
			col.a = fade
			var pos: Vector2 = p["pos"]
			if p["circle"]:
				draw_circle(pos, p["size"].x * 0.45, col)
			else:
				var flip := cos(_elapsed * p["sway_speed"] + p["sway_phase"])
				var sz := Vector2(p["size"].x, maxf(3.0, p["size"].y * absf(flip)))
				draw_set_transform(pos, p["rot"], Vector2.ONE)
				draw_rect(Rect2(-sz * 0.5, sz), col, true)
		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)
```

```gdscript
class_name GrammarBookExercises
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
#  BOOK EXERCISES — تمرینات کتاب
#  Reached from the Grammar Hub's "تمرینات کتاب" button.
#  ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Content is authored in a JSON file and rendered with the
#  shared ExerciseEngine. Each exercise keeps its own "بررسی
#  پاسخ" button (normal engine behavior).
#
#  Content is loaded per book/lesson from a JSON file named
#  v{book}_l{lesson}_book_exercises.json inside res://data/grammar/,
#  e.g. res://data/grammar/v1_l1_book_exercises.json.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_HUB: String = "res://scenes/grammar/GrammarHub.tscn"
const DATA_DIR: String = "res://data/grammar/"

var _navigating: bool = false
var _engines: Array = []


func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	_build_ui()


# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
# Builds the per-book/lesson JSON path, e.g. v1_l1_book_exercises.json
# or v3_l2_book_exercises.json based on the current Global state.
func _data_path() -> String:
	return "%sv%d_l%d_book_exercises.json" % [DATA_DIR, Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson]


func _load_data() -> Dictionary:
	var path := _data_path()
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		push_error("Book exercises JSON not found: " + path)
		return {}
	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	var text: String = file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK:
		push_error("Book exercises JSON parse error: " + json.get_error_message())
		return {}
	var data: Variant = json.data
	if data is Dictionary and (data as Dictionary).has("book_exercises"):
		return (data as Dictionary)["book_exercises"]
	return {}


# ============================================================
# SHELL UI
# ============================================================
func _build_ui() -> void:
	var data: Dictionary = _load_data()
	var sections: Array = data.get("sections", [])

	var root_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	root_margin.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root_margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	add_child(root_margin)

	var main: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	main.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	main.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	root_margin.add_child(main)

	_build_header(main, data)

	var content_box: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	GrammarTheme.style_card(content_box)
	content_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_child(content_box)

	var content_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	content_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	content_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	content_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	content_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	content_box.add_child(content_margin)

	var scroll: ScrollContainer = ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	content_margin.add_child(scroll)

	var content: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	content.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", GrammarTheme.SPACING_LG)
	scroll.add_child(content)

	if sections.is_empty():
		_show_empty_message(content)
	else:
		_build_content(content, data, sections)


# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
func _build_header(main: VBoxContainer, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var header_box: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	header_box.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", GrammarTheme.rounded_box(Color.WHITE, 35, Color.TRANSPARENT, 0))
	main.add_child(header_box)

	var header_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 18)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 14)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 18)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 14)
	header_box.add_child(header_margin)

	var header_row: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
	header_row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	header_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	header_margin.add_child(header_row)

	var back_button: Button = GrammarTheme.make_header_icon_button("res://ui/images/Back.png", Callable(self, "_on_back_pressed"))
	header_row.add_child(back_button)

	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	var title_label: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(title_label, str(data.get("title_fa", "تمرینات کتاب")))
	title_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	title_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	title_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	if font != null:
		title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	header_row.add_child(title_label)

	# Same item grid as every other header in the app.
	GrammarTheme.unify_header_row(header_row)


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================
func _build_content(content: VBoxContainer, data: Dictionary, sections: Array) -> void:
	var subtitle: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(subtitle, str(data.get("subtitle_fa", "تمرین‌های این بخش را کامل کنید.")))
	subtitle.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	subtitle.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var body_font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular()
	if body_font != null:
		subtitle.add_theme_font_override("font", body_font)
	subtitle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	subtitle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	content.add_child(subtitle)

	for section in sections:
		var engine: ExerciseEngine = ExerciseEngine.new()
		content.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(section)
		_engines.append(engine)

	# Bottom spacer.
	var spacer: Control = Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 80)
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	content.add_child(spacer)


func _show_empty_message(content: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var empty: Label = Label.new()
	empty.text = "📘\nهنوز تمرینی در این بخش برای این درس نیست.\n\nلطفاً فایل زیر را با تمرین پر کنید:\n" + _data_path()
	empty.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	empty.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	empty.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular()
	if font != null:
		empty.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	content.add_child(empty)


# ============================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_HUB)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scenes/grammar/scripts/GrammarData.gd`

```gdscript
class_name GrammarData
extends RefCounted
# ============================================================
# GRAMMAR DATA — static loader & XP mastery calculator
# ============================================================

const DIR := "res://data/grammar/"


static func path_for(book: int, lesson: int) -> String:
	return "%svision%d_lesson%d.json" % [DIR, book, lesson]


static func load_lesson(book: int, lesson: int) -> Dictionary:
	var path := path_for(book, lesson)
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		push_error("Grammar JSON not found: " + path)
		return {}
	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	var text: String = file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	var err: Error = json.parse(text)
	if err != OK:
		push_error("Grammar JSON parse error at %s: %s" % [path, json.get_error_message()])
		return {}
	var data: Variant = json.data
	if not data is Dictionary:
		push_error("Grammar JSON root must be a Dictionary: " + path)
		return {}
	var lesson_dict: Dictionary = (data as Dictionary).get("lesson", {})
	var units: Array = lesson_dict.get("units", [])
	var valid: Array = []
	for unit in units:
		if not unit is Dictionary:
			push_warning("GrammarData: skipping non-dictionary unit in " + path)
			continue
		var unit_type := str(unit.get("type", ""))
		if unit_type == "group" and not (unit.get("activities", []) is Array and not (unit.get("activities", []) as Array).is_empty()):
			push_warning("GrammarData: group unit '%s' has no activities; skipped in %s" % [str(unit.get("id", "?")), path])
			continue
		valid.append(unit)
	lesson_dict["units"] = valid
	return lesson_dict


static func unit_icon(unit: Dictionary) -> String:
	match str(unit.get("type", "")):
		"group":
			return "📚"
		"learn":
			return "💡"
		"multiple_choice":
			return "🎯"
		"fill_blank":
			return "✍️"
		"true_false":
			return "✅"
		"matching":
			return "🔗"
		"unscramble":
			return "🧩"
		_:
			return "⭐"


static func unit_title(unit: Dictionary) -> String:
	var title: String = str(unit.get("title_fa", ""))
	if title.is_empty():
		title = str(unit.get("instruction_fa", ""))
	if title.is_empty():
		title = str(unit.get("type", "Unit"))
	return title


static func unit_label(unit: Dictionary) -> String:
	return "%s\n%s" % [unit_icon(unit), unit_title(unit)]


# ============================================================
# XP & MASTERY PROGRESSION SYSTEM
# ============================================================
# Returns a dictionary with:
# - current_xp: int
# - max_xp: int (base XP from all units + flawless/exam potential)
# - completed_units: int
# - total_units: int
# - progress_ratio: float (0.0 to 1.0)
# - rank_title_fa: String
# - rank_icon: String
# - rank_color: Color
# - next_rank_xp: int (XP needed to reach next rank, 0 if maxed)
static func get_mastery_status(book: int, lesson: int) -> Dictionary:
	var lesson_dict := load_lesson(book, lesson)
	var units: Array = lesson_dict.get("units", [])
	var xp_per_unit: int = int(lesson_dict.get("xp_per_unit", 10))
	var total_units: int = units.size()
	var completed_count: int = 0

	for i in range(total_units):
		var u: Dictionary = units[i]
		if Global.is_unit_completed(book, lesson, i, str(u.get("id", ""))):
			completed_count += 1

	var current_xp: int = Global.get_grammar_xp(book, lesson)
	# Base max XP is total_units * xp_per_unit (minimum 50 so empty/small lessons still scale nicely)
	var base_max_xp: int = maxi(total_units * xp_per_unit, 50)
	# If the student earned flawless bonuses or exam XP beyond base_max_xp, expand ceiling gracefully
	var max_xp: int = maxi(base_max_xp, current_xp)
	var ratio: float = clampf(float(current_xp) / float(base_max_xp), 0.0, 1.0)

	var rank_title := "مبتدی"
	var rank_icon := "🌱"
	var rank_color := Color("#94A3B8")
	var next_threshold := int(ceil(base_max_xp * 0.25))

	if ratio >= 1.0:
		rank_title = "استاد گرامر"
		rank_icon = "🏆"
		rank_color = Color("#F59E0B") # Gold
		next_threshold = 0
	elif ratio >= 0.75:
		rank_title = "حرفه‌ای"
		rank_icon = "👑"
		rank_color = Color("#A855F7") # Purple
		next_threshold = base_max_xp
	elif ratio >= 0.50:
		rank_title = "مسلط"
		rank_icon = "⚡"
		rank_color = Color("#06B6D4") # Cyan
		next_threshold = int(ceil(base_max_xp * 0.75))
	elif ratio >= 0.25 or current_xp > 0:
		rank_title = "یادگیرنده"
		rank_icon = "📘"
		rank_color = Color("#10B981") # Emerald
		next_threshold = int(ceil(base_max_xp * 0.50))

	var xp_to_next: int = maxi(0, next_threshold - current_xp)

	return {
		"current_xp": current_xp,
		"max_xp": max_xp,
		"base_max_xp": base_max_xp,
		"completed_units": completed_count,
		"total_units": total_units,
		"progress_ratio": ratio,
		"rank_title_fa": rank_title,
		"rank_icon": rank_icon,
		"rank_color": rank_color,
		"xp_to_next": xp_to_next
	}
```
