```gdscript
class_name GrammarExam
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
#  GRAMMAR EXAM — امتحان گرامر
#  Reached from the Grammar Hub's "امتحان گرامر" button.
#  ------------------------------------------------------------
#  Content is authored in a JSON file and rendered with the
#  shared ExerciseEngine. Each section of the JSON becomes one
#  engine with its own per-item "Check" hidden (hide_footer_buttons),
#  and the scene exposes a single global "بررسی پاسخ‌ها" button.
#  When pressed, every engine is graded and the total score is
#  shown out of 100 in a centered popup.
#
#  Content is loaded per book/lesson from a JSON file named
#  v{book}_l{lesson}_grammar_exam.json inside res://data/grammar/,
#  e.g. res://data/grammar/v1_l1_grammar_exam.json or
#  res://data/grammar/v3_l2_grammar_exam.json.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_HUB: String = "res://scenes/grammar/GrammarHub.tscn"
const DATA_DIR: String = "res://data/grammar/"

var _navigating: bool = false
var _engines: Array = []          # ExerciseEngine instances (one per section)
var _correct_total: int = 0       # accumulated correct answers
var _items_total: int = 0         # accumulated question count
var _check_btn: Button = null
var _score_overlay: Control = null
var _manual_writing_total: int = 0
var _writing_score_input: SpinBox = null
var _page_view: PageView = null


func _ready() -> void:
	super._ready()
	_build_ui()


# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
# Builds the per-book/lesson JSON path, e.g. v1_l1_grammar_exam.json
# or v3_l2_grammar_exam.json based on the current Global state.
func _data_path() -> String:
	return "%sv%d_l%d_grammar_exam.json" % [DATA_DIR, Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson]


func _load_data() -> Dictionary:
	var path := _data_path()
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		push_error("Grammar exam JSON not found: " + path)
		return {}
	var file: FileAccess = FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	var text: String = file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json: JSON = JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK:
		push_error("Grammar exam JSON parse error: " + json.get_error_message())
		return {}
	var data: Variant = json.data
	if data is Dictionary:
		return data
	return {}


# Flattens the exam file into an ordered list of content blocks, supporting
# both the newer "lessons -> exam_exercises" layout (with "h4" heading blocks)
# and the older "exam -> sections" layout.
func _extract_blocks(data: Dictionary) -> Array:
	if data.has("lessons"):
		var blocks: Array = []
		var lessons: Array = data["lessons"]
		for lesson in lessons:
			if lesson is Dictionary:
				var exam_exercises: Array = lesson.get("exam_exercises", [])
				for b in exam_exercises:
					blocks.append(b)
		return blocks
	if data.has("exam"):
		var exam: Dictionary = data["exam"]
		return exam.get("sections", [])
	return []


func _build_ui() -> void:
	var data: Dictionary = _load_data()
	var blocks: Array = _extract_blocks(data)

	var root_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	root_margin.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	root_margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	root_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", GrammarTheme.SAFE_MARGIN)
	add_child(root_margin)

	var main: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	main.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	main.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_LEFT)
	root_margin.add_child(main)

	_build_header(main, data)

	var content_box := PanelContainer.new()
	GrammarTheme.style_card(content_box)
	content_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_child(content_box)

	var page_host: Control = Control.new()
	page_host.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	page_host.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	main.add_child(page_host)

	_page_view = PageView.new()
	_page_view.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_page_view.tab_font_size = 28
	_page_view.tab_font_min = 20
	page_host.add_child(_page_view)

	if blocks.is_empty():
		var empty_page: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		_show_empty_message(empty_page)
		_page_view.add_page("empty", "آزمون", "📄", empty_page)
	else:
		_build_exam_pages(data, blocks)


# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
func _build_header(main: VBoxContainer, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var header_box: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	header_box.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", GrammarTheme.rounded_box(Color.WHITE, 35, Color.TRANSPARENT, 0))
	main.add_child(header_box)

	var header_margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 18)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 14)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 18)
	header_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 14)
	header_box.add_child(header_margin)

	var header_row: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
	header_row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	header_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	header_margin.add_child(header_row)

	var back_button: Button = GrammarTheme.make_header_icon_button("res://ui/images/Back.png", Callable(self, "_on_back_pressed"))
	header_row.add_child(back_button)

	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	var title_label: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(title_label, str(data.get("title_fa", "امتحان گرامر")))
	title_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	title_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	title_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	if font != null:
		title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	header_row.add_child(title_label)

	# Same item grid as every other header in the app.
	GrammarTheme.unify_header_row(header_row)


# ============================================================
# CONTENT
# ============================================================
func _build_exam_pages(data: Dictionary, blocks: Array) -> void:
	var section_pages: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var current: Dictionary = {"title": "آزمون", "blocks": []}

	for block_value in blocks:
		if not block_value is Dictionary:
			continue
		var block: Dictionary = block_value
		if str(block.get("type", "")) == "h4":
			if not (current["blocks"] as Array).is_empty():
				section_pages.append(current)
			current = {"title": str(block.get("text", "بخش")), "blocks": []}
		else:
			(current["blocks"] as Array).append(block)

	if not (current["blocks"] as Array).is_empty():
		section_pages.append(current)

	var next_letter_index: int = 0
	for index in section_pages.size():
		var section: Dictionary = section_pages[index]
		var content: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", GrammarTheme.SPACING_LG)
		next_letter_index = _build_exam_content(
			content,
			data,
			section["blocks"] as Array,
			index == 0,
			index == section_pages.size() - 1,
			next_letter_index
		)
		_page_view.add_page("section_%d" % index, _page_title(str(section["title"])), "", content)


func _page_title(source: String) -> String:
	var title: String = source.strip_edges()
	var separator_index: int = title.find("—")
	if separator_index >= 0:
		title = title.substr(0, separator_index).strip_edges()
	if title.is_empty():
		return "آزمون"
	return title


func _build_exam_content(
	content: VBoxContainer,
	data: Dictionary,
	blocks: Array,
	show_exam_instruction: bool,
	is_last_page: bool,
	letter_index: int
) -> int:
	if show_exam_instruction:
		var instruction: Label = Label.new()
		instruction.text = "لطفاً به همهٔ سؤال‌ها پاسخ دهید. برای مشاهدهٔ نمره و بازخورد، در صفحهٔ آخر روی دکمهٔ «بررسی پاسخ‌ها» بزنید."
		instruction.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		instruction.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		instruction.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		instruction.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
		instruction.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
		var instruction_font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular()
		if instruction_font != null:
			instruction.add_theme_font_override("font", instruction_font)
		content.add_child(instruction)

	var subtitle: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(subtitle, str(data.get("subtitle_fa", "")))
	subtitle.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	subtitle.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var body_font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular()
	if body_font != null:
		subtitle.add_theme_font_override("font", body_font)
	subtitle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	subtitle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	if not str(data.get("subtitle_fa", "")).is_empty():
		content.add_child(subtitle)

	for block_value in blocks:
		if not block_value is Dictionary:
			continue
		var block: Dictionary = block_value
		var type: String = str(block.get("type", ""))
		var exercise_block: Dictionary = block.duplicate(true)
		if bool(exercise_block.get("show_letter", true)) and _has_instruction_text(block):
			exercise_block["letter_index"] = letter_index
			letter_index += 1

		var engine: ExerciseEngine = ExerciseEngine.new()
		engine.hide_footer_buttons = true
		engine.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL | Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
		engine.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
		content.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise_block)
		var points_per_item: int = int(block.get("points_per_item", 1))
		engine.exercise_checked.connect(_on_exercise_checked.bind(points_per_item))
		if type in ["open_ended", "pronunciation", "writing"]:
			_manual_writing_total += int(block.get("score_points", 0))
		elif not type in ["passage", "reading"]:
			_engines.append(engine)

	if not is_last_page or _engines.is_empty():
		return letter_index

	var spacer: Control = Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
	content.add_child(spacer)

	_check_btn = Button.new()
	_check_btn.text = "بررسی پاسخ‌ها"
	_check_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 112)
	_check_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(_check_btn)
	_check_btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 46)
	_check_btn.pressed.connect(_on_check_pressed)
	content.add_child(_check_btn)

	if _manual_writing_total <= 0:
		return letter_index
	var grading_note: Label = Label.new()
	grading_note.text = "Writing score (self-assessment / teacher) — 0–%d" % _manual_writing_total
	grading_note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	grading_note.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	grading_note.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 64)
	grading_note.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	grading_note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	grading_note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	content.add_child(grading_note)

	_writing_score_input = SpinBox.new()
	_writing_score_input.min_value = 0
	_writing_score_input.max_value = _manual_writing_total
	_writing_score_input.step = 1
	_writing_score_input.value = 0
	_writing_score_input.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 72)
	_writing_score_input.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	_writing_score_input.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	content.add_child(_writing_score_input)

	var score_hint: Label = Label.new()
	score_hint.text = "Enter a manual score here. It is not included in the automatic result."
	score_hint.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	score_hint.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	score_hint.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	score_hint.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 21)
	score_hint.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	content.add_child(score_hint)

	var score_notice: Label = Label.new()
	score_notice.text = "Manual score is not included in the automatic result."
	score_notice.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	score_notice.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	score_notice.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 21)
	score_notice.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	content.add_child(score_notice)
	return letter_index


# Renders a bold section divider (the JSON "h4" blocks, e.g. "Part 1 — ...").
func _has_instruction_text(block: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var instruction: Variant = block.get("instruction", "")
	if instruction is Dictionary:
		return not str(instruction.get("en", instruction.get("fa", ""))).is_empty()
	return not str(instruction).is_empty()


func _add_section_header(content: VBoxContainer, block: Dictionary) -> void:
	var header: Label = Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(header, str(block.get("text", "")))
	header.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	header.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var bold: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	if bold != null:
		header.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.accent_color())
	content.add_child(header)


func _show_empty_message(content: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var empty: Label = Label.new()
	empty.text = "🎓\nهنوز سوالی در امتحان این درس نیست.\n\nلطفاً فایل زیر را با سوال پر کنید:\n" + _data_path()
	empty.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	empty.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	empty.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	empty.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	var font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular()
	if font != null:
		empty.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	content.add_child(empty)


# ============================================================
# GRADING
# ============================================================
func _on_exercise_checked(_id: String, correct: int, total: int, points_per_item: int = 1) -> void:
	_correct_total += correct * points_per_item
	_items_total += total * points_per_item


func _on_check_pressed() -> void:
	if _engines.is_empty():
		return
	_correct_total = 0
	_items_total = 0
	for engine in _engines:
		# Public API: grades every item in place (never enters the engine's
		# retry/rebuild path) and re-emits exercise_checked for scoring.
		engine.grade_all()
	_check_btn.disabled = true
	_check_btn.text = "پاسخ‌ها بررسی شد ✓"

	var score: int = 0
	var maximum_score: int = _items_total
	var earned_score: int = _correct_total
	if maximum_score > 0:
		score = int(round(float(earned_score) / float(maximum_score) * 100.0))
	_show_score_popup(score)


func _show_score_popup(score: int) -> void:
	if _score_overlay != null and is_instance_valid(_score_overlay):
		_score_overlay.queue_free()
	_score_overlay = Control.new()
	_score_overlay.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	add_child(_score_overlay)

	# Dim background.
	var dim: ColorRect = ColorRect.new()
	dim.color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.6)
	dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.add_child(dim)

	# Centered popup card.
	var center: CenterContainer = CenterContainer.new()
	center.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_score_overlay.add_child(center)

	var card: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = GrammarTheme.card_style()
	style.set_content_margin_all(GrammarTheme.CONTENT_MARGIN)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 480)
	center.add_child(card)

	var vb: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	vb.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	card.add_child(vb)

	var icon: Label = Label.new()
	icon.text = "🎓"
	icon.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 84)
	vb.add_child(icon)

	var head: Label = Label.new()
	head.text = "نمرهٔ شما"
	head.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	var bold: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	if bold != null:
		head.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	head.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	head.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	vb.add_child(head)

	var score_label: Label = Label.new()
	score_label.text = "%d / 100" % score
	score_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if bold != null:
		score_label.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	score_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 96)
	score_label.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		GrammarTheme.success_color() if score >= 50 else GrammarTheme.error_color()
	)
	vb.add_child(score_label)

	# A short encouraging line.
	var note: Label = Label.new()
	if score >= 80:
		note.text = "عالی! 👏"
	elif score >= 50:
		note.text = "خوب بود، ادامه بده! 💪"
	else:
		note.text = "دوباره تمرین کن تا بهتر شوی! 📚"
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if bold != null:
		note.add_theme_font_override("font", bold)
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	vb.add_child(note)

	var close_btn: Button = Button.new()
	close_btn.text = "بستن"
	close_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, GrammarTheme.BUTTON_HEIGHT)
	close_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	GrammarTheme.style_primary_button(close_btn)
	close_btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		if _score_overlay != null and is_instance_valid(_score_overlay):
			_score_overlay.queue_free()
			_score_overlay = null)
	vb.add_child(close_btn)


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_HUB)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scenes/grammar/scripts/GrammarExercise.gd`

```gdscript
class_name GrammarExercise
extends Control


signal answer_selected(correct: bool, explanation: String)
signal exercise_completed


var exercise_data: Dictionary = {}
var current_index: int = 0
var answered: bool = false


func setup(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	exercise_data = data
	current_index = 0
	answered = false


func get_item_count() -> int:
	if exercise_data.has("questions"):
		return exercise_data["questions"].size()

	if exercise_data.has("items"):
		return exercise_data["items"].size()

	return 0


func submit_result(
		correct: bool,
		explanation: String = ""
	) -> void:
	answer_selected.emit(
		correct,
		explanation
	)


func complete() -> void:
	exercise_completed.emit()


func continue_to_next() -> void:
	current_index += 1

	if current_index >= get_item_count():
		complete()


# Called when the learner answers wrong and chooses to try again.
# By default it just unlocks answering again; exercise subclasses
# override this to rebuild/reset their own UI for the same item.
func retry_current() -> void:
	answered = false


# Returns the hint text for the item the learner is currently on.
# Subclasses override this to pull the hint from their data.
func get_current_hint() -> String:
	return ""
```

```gdscript
	rank_lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	rank_lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", rank_color)

	var bar := ProgressBar.new()

func _make_row_card(
	emoji: String,
	title_text: String,
	badge_text: String,
	desc_text: String,
	footer_text: String,
	accent: Color,
	callback: Callable
) -> PanelContainer:
	# Outer PanelContainer handles the clean rounded border and card background

	hit_button.button_down.connect(func(): card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", pressed_box))
	hit_button.button_up.connect(func(): card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", hover_box if hit_button.is_hovered() else normal_box))
	hit_button.pressed.connect(callback)
	card.add_child(hit_button)

	return card


func _make_glossy_stylebox() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	# Translucent glassy body
	style.bg_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.28)
	# Full pill rounding
	style.corner_radius_top_left = 28
	style.corner_radius_top_right = 28
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 28
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 28
	# Glass rim highlights: brighter top edge for glossy reflection
	style.border_width_left = 2
	style.border_width_top = 3
	style.border_width_right = 2
	style.border_width_bottom = 1
	style.border_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.65)
	# Soft ambient shadow underneath the pill
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.25)
	style.shadow_size = 10
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 4.0)
	return style

func _build_card_stylebox(color: Color, alpha: float, border_alpha: float) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha)
	style.corner_radius_top_left = 32
	style.corner_radius_top_right = 32
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 32
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 32
	style.border_width_left = 2
	style.border_width_top = 2
	style.border_width_right = 2
	style.border_width_bottom = 2
	style.border_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, border_alpha)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.28)
	style.shadow_size = 16
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 6.0)
	return style


func _to_fa_digits(value: int) -> String:
	var s := str(value)
	var fa_digits := ["۰", "۱", "۲", "۳", "۴", "۵", "۶", "۷", "۸", "۹"]
	var out := ""
	for i in range(s.length()):
		var code := s.unicode_at(i) - 48
		if code >= 0 and code <= 9:
			out += fa_digits[code]
		else:
			out += s[i]
	return out


func _count_json_questions(path: String) -> int:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		return 0
	var file := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return 0
	var parsed = JSON.parse_string(file.get_as_text())
	if parsed is Array:
		return parsed.size()
	if parsed is Dictionary:
		for key in ["questions", "exercises", "items", "tasks", "units"]:
			if parsed.has(key) and parsed[key] is Array:
				return parsed[key].size()
	return 0


func _on_learning_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.set_last_scene(get_tree().current_scene.scene_file_path)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_UNITS)


func _on_workbook_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.set_last_scene(get_tree().current_scene.scene_file_path)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_BOOK_EXERCISES)


func _on_exam_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.set_last_scene(get_tree().current_scene.scene_file_path)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_GRAMMAR_EXAM)


func _on_main_menu_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_MAIN_MENU)


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU, TransitionManager.Slide.BACK)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()
```

```gdscript
	_progress_tween = create_tween()
	_progress_tween.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD)

	_progress_tween.tween_property(progress_bar, "value", target, 0.4)

	_progress_tween = create_tween()

func _constrain_scroll_content_width() -> void:
	if scroll == null or scroll_padding == null:
		return
	var v_scroll := scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()
	var sb_width: float = v_scroll.size.x if (v_scroll != null and v_scroll.visible) else 0.0
	var target_w: float = maxf(scroll.size.x - sb_width, 100.0)
	scroll_padding.custom_minimum_size.x = target_w
	scroll_padding.size.x = target_w


func _fix_children_overflow(node: Node) -> void:
	if node is Label:
		var lbl := node as Label
		# Enable word wrap on all multi-word labels inside the lesson card so they never push width out
		if lbl.text.length() > 12:
			lbl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	elif node is RichTextLabel:
		var rtl := node as RichTextLabel
		rtl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		rtl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	elif node is Control:
		var ctrl := node as Control
		if ctrl.custom_minimum_size.x > 300.0:
			ctrl.custom_minimum_size.x = 0.0

	for child in node.get_children():
		_fix_children_overflow(child)

	title_label.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	top_bar.add_child(title_label)


func _build_progress(main_vbox: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 32)
	main_vbox.add_child(row)

	var step_pill := PanelContainer.new()
	step_pill.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	step_pill.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _make_step_pill_style())
	row.add_child(step_pill)

	var step_margin := MarginContainer.new()
	step_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 14)
	step_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 14)
	step_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 4)
	step_margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 4)
	step_pill.add_child(step_margin)

	progress_label = Label.new()
	progress_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	progress_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	progress_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	progress_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	progress_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _accent.darkened(0.15))
	step_margin.add_child(progress_label)

	progress_bar = ProgressBar.new()
	progress_bar.show_percentage = false
	progress_bar.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	progress_bar.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	progress_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 16)
	progress_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", _make_progress_track_style())
	progress_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", _make_progress_fill_style())
	row.add_child(progress_bar)


func _show_unit() -> void:
	if current_unit_index >= units.size():
		_finish_lesson()
		return
	var unit: Dictionary = units[current_unit_index]
	var type := str(unit.get("type", ""))
	if type == "group":
		_activities = unit.get("activities", [])
	else:
		_activities = [unit]
	_activity_index = 0
	_unit_mistakes = 0

	var raw_title := str(lesson_data.get("title_fa", "گرامر"))
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(title_label, "%s  ✨" % raw_title)
	_show_current_activity()


func _show_current_activity() -> void:
	for child in content_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	if _activity_index >= _activities.size():
		_on_activity_group_finished()
		return

	var step_str := "🎯 گام %s از %s" % [
		_to_fa_digits(_activity_index + 1),
		_to_fa_digits(_activities.size())
	]
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(progress_label, step_str)
	_animate_progress()
	_wrong_attempts = 0
	hint_bulb.visible = false
	hint_bulb.stop_flash()
	hint_bulb.hide_bubble()

	var activity: Dictionary = _activities[_activity_index]
	var type := str(activity.get("type", ""))
	match type:
		"learn":
			_show_learning_unit(activity)
		"multiple_choice", "fill_blank", "true_false", "matching", "unscramble":
			_show_exercise(activity)
		_:
			push_warning("Unknown grammar activity type: %s (skipped)" % type)
			_advance_activity()
			return

	_fix_children_overflow(content_container)
	_constrain_scroll_content_width.call_deferred()
	_animate_activity_card_in()


func _animate_activity_card_in() -> void:
	if content_container == null:
		return
	content_container.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tw.set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(content_container, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.25)


func _advance_activity() -> void:
	_activity_index += 1
	if _activity_index < _activities.size():
		_show_current_activity()
	else:
		_on_activity_group_finished()


func _on_activity_group_finished() -> void:
	_sync_grammar_progress()
	_award_unit_xp()
	_fill_progress_bar()
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_show_unit_completed_reward()


func _show_learning_unit(unit: Dictionary) -> void:
	LearningUnitView.render(content_container, unit)

	var next_button := Button.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(next_button, "متوجه شدم، ادامه  🚀")
	next_button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 96)
	next_button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	next_button.mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	next_button.pressed.connect(_on_learning_continue)
	_style_modern_cta_button(next_button)
	content_container.add_child(next_button)
	GrammarAnimation.appear(next_button, 0.15)


func _show_exercise(unit: Dictionary) -> void:
	var exercise := ExerciseFactory.create_exercise(str(unit.get("type", "")))
	if exercise == null:
		return
	exercise.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	exercise.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	exercise.setup(unit)
	content_container.add_child(exercise)
	exercise.answer_selected.connect(_on_answer_selected)
	exercise.exercise_completed.connect(_on_exercise_completed)


func _on_answer_selected(correct: bool, explanation: String) -> void:
	if correct:
		correct_answers += 1
		_wrong_attempts = 0
		hint_bulb.visible = false
		hint_bulb.stop_flash()
		hint_bulb.hide_bubble()
		feedback_popup.show_correct(explanation)
	else:
		_wrong_attempts += 1
		_unit_mistakes += 1
		hint_bulb.visible = true
		hint_bulb.flash()
		feedback_popup.show_wrong(explanation)
		if _wrong_attempts >= 2:
			feedback_popup.show_skip_button()


func _update_xp_label() -> void:
	if xp_label != null:
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(xp_label, "⭐ %s XP" % _to_fa_digits(xp))
		if xp_pill != null:
			GrammarAnimation.small_pop(xp_pill)


func _current_exercise() -> GrammarExercise:
	for child in content_container.get_children():
		if child is GrammarExercise:
			return child
	return null


func _on_hint_requested() -> void:
	var exercise: GrammarExercise = _current_exercise()
	if exercise == null:
		return
	hint_bulb.set_hint(exercise.get_current_hint())
	hint_bulb.show_bubble()


func _on_feedback_continue() -> void:
	var exercise: GrammarExercise = _current_exercise()
	if exercise == null:
		return
	if feedback_popup.is_correct:
		exercise.continue_to_next()
	else:
		exercise.retry_current()


func _on_skip_pressed() -> void:
	_wrong_attempts = 0
	hint_bulb.visible = false
	hint_bulb.stop_flash()
	hint_bulb.hide_bubble()
	var exercise: GrammarExercise = _current_exercise()
	if exercise == null:
		return
	exercise.continue_to_next()


func _on_learning_continue() -> void:
	_advance_activity()


func _on_exercise_completed() -> void:
	_advance_activity()


func _has_exercise_in_unit() -> bool:
	for act in _activities:
		if act is Dictionary and str(act.get("type", "")) != "learn":
			return true
	return false


func _award_unit_xp() -> void:
	var unit: Dictionary = units[current_unit_index] if current_unit_index < units.size() else {}
	var unit_id := str(unit.get("id", ""))
	var already_done: bool = Global.is_unit_completed(
		Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, current_unit_index, unit_id
	)

	if already_done:
		_last_award = 0
		_last_bonus = 0
	else:
		Global.mark_unit_completed(
			Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, current_unit_index, unit_id
		)
		var base_xp := int(lesson_data.get("xp_per_unit", 10))
		_last_bonus = 5 if (_has_exercise_in_unit() and _unit_mistakes == 0) else 0
		_last_award = base_xp + _last_bonus
		xp += _last_award
		Global.add_grammar_xp(Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, _last_award)
		_update_xp_label()
		GrammarAnimation.spawn_xp_toast(self, "+%d XP ⭐" % _last_award, xp_label)


func _show_unit_completed_reward() -> void:
	if current_unit_index >= units.size() - 1:
		_finish_lesson()
		return
	var n: int = current_unit_index + 1
	reward_popup.show_reward(
		"بخش %d کامل شد!" % n,
		_last_award,
		"رفتن به بخش بعدی",
		true,
		_last_bonus
	)


func _on_reward_next() -> void:
	if current_unit_index >= units.size() - 1:
		_go_back_to_units()
		return
	current_unit_index += 1
	_show_unit()


func _on_reward_back() -> void:
	_go_back_to_units()


func _finish_lesson() -> void:
	for child in content_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	if hint_bulb != null:
		hint_bulb.visible = false
		hint_bulb.stop_flash()
		hint_bulb.hide_bubble()
	_fill_progress_bar()
	_update_xp_label()
	reward_popup.show_reward(
		"🎉 تمام بخش‌های این درس کامل شد!",
		_last_award,
		"بازگشت به بخش‌ها",
		false,
		_last_bonus
	)
	Sfx.complete()


func _sync_grammar_progress() -> void:
	var unlocked: int = current_unit_index + 2
	if units.size() > 0:
		unlocked = min(unlocked, units.size())
	Global.set_grammar_unlocked_units(Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, unlocked)


func _go_back_to_units() -> void:
	var last_scene: String = Global.get_last_scene()
	if last_scene.is_empty():
		last_scene = LESSON_MENU
	TransitionManager.change_scene(last_scene)


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	_go_back_to_units()


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()


# ============================================================
# STYLING HELPERS
# ============================================================

func _make_card_style(radius: int, border_width: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.98)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	style.border_width_left = border_width
	style.border_width_top = border_width
	style.border_width_right = border_width
	style.border_width_bottom = border_width + 1
	style.border_color = Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.92, 0.8)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.16, 0.08)
	style.shadow_size = 14
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 4)
	return style


func _make_xp_pill_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color("#FEF3C7")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.border_color = Color("#F59E0B")
	return style


func _make_step_pill_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(_accent.r, _accent.g, _accent.b, 0.10)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.border_color = Color(_accent.r, _accent.g, _accent.b, 0.25)
	return style


func _make_progress_track_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color("#EEF2F6")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	return style


func _make_progress_fill_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _accent
	style.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	return style


func _style_modern_cta_button(btn: Button) -> void:
	var bold_font: Font = GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold()
	if bold_font != null:
		btn.add_theme_font_override("font", bold_font)
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color.WHITE)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", Color.WHITE)

	var normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	normal.bg_color = _accent
	normal.set_corner_radius_all(24)
	normal.border_width_top = 1
	normal.border_width_left = 1
	normal.border_width_right = 1
	normal.border_width_bottom = 5
	normal.border_color = _accent.darkened(0.25)
	normal.shadow_color = Color(_accent.r, _accent.g, _accent.b, 0.28)
	normal.shadow_size = 12
	normal.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 4)

	var hover := normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	hover.bg_color = _accent.lightened(0.08)

	var pressed := normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	pressed.bg_color = _accent.darkened(0.08)
	pressed.border_width_bottom = 2
	pressed.shadow_size = 4
	pressed.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 1)

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pressed)


func _to_fa_digits(value: int) -> String:
	var s := str(value)
	var fa_digits := ["۰", "۱", "۲", "۳", "۴", "۵", "۶", "۷", "۸", "۹"]
	var out := ""
	for i in range(s.length()):
		var code := s.unicode_at(i) - 48
		if code >= 0 and code <= 9:
			out += fa_digits[code]
		else:
			out += s[i]
	return out
```

```gdscript
class_name GrammarTheme
extends RefCounted


# ============================================================
# BIDI (mixed Persian/English) HELPER
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Farsi-dominant lines that embed English tokens (will, going to,
# as...as, ...) render with a RTL base direction. Without help the
# Unicode bidi algorithm visually reorders the Latin fragments and
# any "+"-chained structure around them, producing scrambled text.
# Wrapping every contiguous Latin run in directional ISOLATES
# (LRI U+2066 ... PDI U+2069) pins each run's internal order and
# its position, no matter what surrounds it. Display-only: this
# must never be applied to strings used for answer comparison.
# ============================================================
# Returns true when Persian characters outnumber Latin ones in `text`.
# Same rule the shared exercise engine uses to pick the base direction.
static func is_fa_dominant(text: String) -> bool:
	var fa := 0
	var lat := 0
	for i in text.length():
		var u := text.unicode_at(i)
		if u >= 0x0600 and u <= 0x06FF:
			fa += 1
		elif (u >= 0x41 and u <= 0x5A) or (u >= 0x61 and u <= 0x7A) or (u >= 0xC0 and u <= 0x24F):
			lat += 1
	return fa > 0 and fa >= lat


# One-call way to display any (possibly mixed Persian/English) string on a
# Label or Button: applies bidi isolates and picks the correct base
# direction. Use this for every JSON-driven text in the grammar system.
static func set_bidi_text(control: Control, text: String) -> void:
	control.text = bidi_fix(text)
	control.text_direction = (
		Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL if is_fa_dominant(text) else Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
	)


static func _is_farsi(u: int) -> bool:
	return u >= 0x0600 and u <= 0x06FF


static func _is_latin(u: int) -> bool:
	return (u >= 0x41 and u <= 0x5A) or (u >= 0x61 and u <= 0x7A) or (u >= 0xC0 and u <= 0x24F)


# Characters that belong INSIDE an English phrase: letters, digits,
# apostrophes, hyphens and ZWNJ keep tokens like "be going to", "I'll",
# "well-known" from being split apart.
static func _is_run_char(u: int) -> bool:
	return _is_latin(u) or (u >= 0x30 and u <= 0x39) \
			or u == 0x27 or u == 0x2019 or u == 0x2D or u == 0x200C


static func bidi_fix(text: String) -> String:
	if text.is_empty():
		return text
	var fa := 0
	var lat := 0
	for i in text.length():
		var u := text.unicode_at(i)
		if _is_farsi(u):
			fa += 1
		elif _is_latin(u):
			lat += 1
	# Only Farsi-dominant lines need isolates; pure or Latin-dominant
	# lines already render correctly with an LTR base direction.
	if fa == 0 or fa < lat:
		return text
	var lri := char(0x2066)
	var pdi := char(0x2069)
	var out := ""
	var i := 0
	var n := text.length()
	while i < n:
		if _is_run_char(text.unicode_at(i)):
			# Start of an English phrase: swallow the WHOLE segment up to
			# the next Farsi character — including spaces between English
			# words and attached punctuation — so a multi-word phrase like
			# "May I ....?" becomes ONE LTR island. Wrapping each word in
			# its own isolate lets the neutral gaps between them resolve
			# to the RTL paragraph direction and visually scramble the
			# phrase into "?.... I May".
			var j := i
			while j < n and not _is_farsi(text.unicode_at(j)):
				j += 1
			# Trailing whitespace / bare connectors ("+", "=") / opening
			# brackets belong to the gap between the phrase and the
			# Persian text, not to the phrase itself.
			var end_i := j
			while end_i > i:
				var prev := text.unicode_at(end_i - 1)
				if prev == 0x20 or prev == 0x09 or prev == 0x0A \
						or prev == 0x2B or prev == 0x3D \
						or prev == 0x28 or prev == 0x5B or prev == 0x7B:
					end_i -= 1
				else:
					break
			out += lri + text.substr(i, end_i - i) + pdi
			# Emit the trailing neutrals we trimmed, outside the island.
			while end_i < j:
				out += text[end_i]
				end_i += 1
			i = j
		else:
			out += text[i]
			i += 1
	return out

# STYLE BOXES
# ============================================================

static func rounded_box(
	color: Color,
	radius: int = 20,
	border_color: Color = Color.TRANSPARENT,
	border_width: int = 0
) -> StyleBoxFlat:

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()

	style.bg_color = color

	style.corner_radius_top_left = radius
	style.corner_radius_top_right = radius
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left = radius
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = radius

	if border_width > 0:
		style.border_width_left = border_width
		style.border_width_right = border_width
		style.border_width_top = border_width
		style.border_width_bottom = border_width

		style.border_color = border_color

	return style


static func card_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := rounded_box(
		Global.get_theme_color("surface"),
		20,
		Global.get_theme_color("border"),
		1
	)

	style.shadow_color = Color(
		0.0,
		0.0,
		0.0,
		0.28
	)

	style.shadow_size = 10
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 4)

	return style


# Raised info card used for the teaching content on a unit's first learning
# page. Uses surface_alt so it clearly contrasts with the parent "surface"
# container — this avoids the flat / dull "white-on-white" (light) or
# "dark-on-dark" (dark) look that nested surface-on-surface boxes produce.
static func info_card_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := rounded_box(
		Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt"),
		20,
		Global.get_theme_color("border"),
		1
	)

	style.shadow_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.25)
	style.shadow_size = 8
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 3)

	return style


static func primary_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		accent_color(),
		18
	)


static func primary_button_hover() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		accent_bright_color(),
		18
	)


static func primary_button_pressed() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		accent_bright_color(),
		18
	)


static func secondary_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		Global.get_theme_color("surface"),
		18,
		Global.get_theme_color("border"),
		2
	)


static func success_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		success_soft_color(),
		18,
		success_color(),
		2
	)


static func error_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		error_soft_color(),
		18,
		error_color(),
		2
	)


static func selected_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		accent_soft_color(),
		18,
		accent_color(),
		3
	)


static func disabled_button() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return rounded_box(
		disabled_color(),
		18
	)


# ============================================================
# BUTTON STYLING
# ============================================================

static func style_primary_button(
	button: Button
) -> void:

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"normal",
		primary_button()
	)

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"hover",
		primary_button_hover()
	)

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"pressed",
		primary_button_pressed()
	)

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"focus",
		primary_button_hover()
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		Color.WHITE
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_hover_color",
		Color.WHITE
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_pressed_color",
		Color.WHITE
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_focus_color",
		Color.WHITE
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_disabled_color",
		text_muted_color()
	)

	button.add_theme_font_size_override(
		"font_size",
		BUTTON_FONT_SIZE
	)

	var font := get_fa_bold()

	if font != null:
		button.add_theme_font_override(
			"font",
			font
		)


static func style_secondary_button(
	button: Button
) -> void:

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"normal",
		secondary_button()
	)

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"hover",
		rounded_box(
			accent_soft_color(),
			18,
			accent_color(),
			2
		)
	)

	button.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"pressed",
		rounded_box(
			accent_soft_color(),
			18,
			accent_color(),
			2
		)
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_color",
		Global.get_theme_color("text")
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_hover_color",
		accent_font_color()
	)

	button.add_theme_color_override(
		"font_pressed_color",
		accent_font_color()
	)

	button.add_theme_font_size_override(
		"font_size",
		BUTTON_FONT_SIZE
	)

	var font := get_fa_bold()

	if font != null:
		button.add_theme_font_override(
			"font",
			font
		)


static func style_card(
	panel: PanelContainer
) -> void:

	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"panel",
		card_style()
	)


# Professional raised header bar — the SAME bar every other scene uses, so the
# grammar screens never drift from the rest of the app.
static func header_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return DesignTokens.header_bar(Global.theme_is_dark())


static func style_header_box(
	panel: PanelContainer
) -> void:

	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override(
		"panel",
		header_style()
	)


# Flat icon button used in grammar header bars — matches the app-wide header
# icon look (transparent resting state, soft accent hover/press disc).
static func make_header_icon_button(
	icon_path: String,
	callback: Callable,
	size: float = 112.0
) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.flat = true
	button.expand_icon = true
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(size, size)
	button.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	button.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL
	button.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_width", int(size))
	button.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_height", int(size))
	var accent: Color = accent_color()
	var clear := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	clear.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
	clear.set_border_width_all(0)
	var hover := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	hover.set_corner_radius_all(int(size / 2.0))
	hover.bg_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.16)
	var press := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	press.set_corner_radius_all(int(size / 2.0))
	press.bg_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.26)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", clear)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", press)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", hover)
	button.icon = load(icon_path)
	button.text = ""
	button.pressed.connect(callback)
	return button


# Puts a grammar header row on the same item grid as every other header in
# the app — back/home pinned left, title centred on the bar, extras on the
# right — so the grammar screens never drift from the rest of the app.
static func unify_header_row(row: HBoxContainer) -> void:
	ThemeService.layout_header_row(row)
```

```gdscript
func _build_mastery_banner(parent: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var mastery := GrammarData.get_mastery_status(Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson)
	var rank_color: Color = mastery["rank_color"]

	var banner := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := GrammarTheme.info_card_style()
	style.border_color = Color(rank_color.r, rank_color.g, rank_color.b, 0.55)
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	parent.add_child(banner)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 24)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 24)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 16)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 16)
	banner.add_child(margin)

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	margin.add_child(vbox)

	var top_row := HBoxContainer.new()
	top_row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	vbox.add_child(top_row)

	var xp_badge := Label.new()
	xp_badge.text = "⭐ %d / %d XP" % [mastery["current_xp"], mastery["base_max_xp"]]
	xp_badge.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	xp_badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	xp_badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.xp_color())
	top_row.add_child(xp_badge)

	var rank_lbl := Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(rank_lbl, "%s سطح: %s (%d/%d بخش)" % [
		mastery["rank_icon"],
		mastery["rank_title_fa"],
		mastery["completed_units"],
		mastery["total_units"]
	])
	rank_lbl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	rank_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	rank_lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", rank_color)
	top_row.add_child(rank_lbl)

	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.show_percentage = false
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 16)
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", GrammarTheme.rounded_box(GrammarTheme.disabled_color(), 8))
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", GrammarTheme.rounded_box(rank_color, 8))
	bar.value = mastery["progress_ratio"] * 100.0
	vbox.add_child(bar)

	var sub_lbl := Label.new()
	if mastery["xp_to_next"] > 0:
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(sub_lbl, "🎯 %d XP دیگر تا ارتقا به سطح بعدی! (پاسخ بدون اشتباه = +۵ XP پاداش)" % mastery["xp_to_next"])
	else:
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(sub_lbl, "🏆 تبریک! شما به بالاترین سطح تسلط در این درس رسیده‌اید!")
	sub_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	sub_lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular())
	sub_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 23)
	sub_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_muted_color())
	vbox.add_child(sub_lbl)


func _make_unit_button(index: int, unit: Dictionary) -> GrammarButton:
	var unlocked: bool = index < unlocked_units
	var completed: bool = Global.is_unit_completed(
		Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, index, str(unit.get("id", ""))
	)
	var xp_per_unit: int = int(lesson_data.get("xp_per_unit", 10))

	var button: GrammarButton = GrammarButton.new()
	button.no_clip = true
	button.variant = GrammarButton.ButtonVariant.SECONDARY
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0.0, 195.0)
	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	button.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	button.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_disabled_color", GrammarTheme.locked_text_color())

	var status_tag: String = "🔒 قفل"
	if completed:
		status_tag = "✅ کامل شد"
	elif unlocked:
		status_tag = "⭐ +%d XP" % xp_per_unit

	var label: String = GrammarData.unit_title(unit)
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(
		button,
		"%s  |  %s\nبخش %d\n%s" % [GrammarData.unit_icon(unit), status_tag, index + 1, label]
	)

	if unlocked:
		button.pressed.connect(_on_unit_pressed.bind(index))

	button.ready.connect(func() -> void: _apply_unit_styles(button, unlocked, completed))
	return button


func _apply_unit_styles(button: GrammarButton, unlocked: bool, completed: bool) -> void:
	if completed:
		# Completed units shine with a rich emerald/gold mastery border
		var fill := GrammarTheme.success_soft_color()
		var border := GrammarTheme.success_color()
		var normal := _unit_style(fill, border, 1.0, 1.0, 3)
		normal.shadow_color = Color(border.r, border.g, border.b, 0.32)
		normal.shadow_size = 14
		normal.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 5)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _unit_style(fill.lightened(0.08), border, 1.0, 1.0, 3))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _unit_style(fill.darkened(0.06), border, 1.0, 1.0, 3))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _unit_style(fill.lightened(0.08), border, 1.0, 1.0, 3))
	elif unlocked:
		# Active unlocked unit pops with accent glow
		var normal := _unit_style(GrammarTheme.primary_light_color(), GrammarTheme.primary_color(), 1.0, 1.0, 3)
		normal.shadow_color = Color(0.42, 0.47, 1.0, 0.45)
		normal.shadow_size = 18
		normal.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 6)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _unit_style(GrammarTheme.primary_light_color().lightened(0.09), GrammarTheme.primary_dark_color(), 1.0, 1.0, 3))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _unit_style(GrammarTheme.primary_light_color().darkened(0.06), GrammarTheme.primary_color(), 1.0, 1.0, 3))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _unit_style(GrammarTheme.primary_light_color().lightened(0.11), GrammarTheme.primary_dark_color(), 1.0, 1.0, 3))
	else:
		button.disabled = true
		var locked_fill: Color = GrammarTheme.disabled_color().darkened(0.15)
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _unit_style(locked_fill, GrammarTheme.locked_text_color(), 0.55, 0.18))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _unit_style(locked_fill, GrammarTheme.locked_text_color(), 0.55, 0.18))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _unit_style(locked_fill, GrammarTheme.locked_text_color(), 0.55, 0.18))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _unit_style(locked_fill, GrammarTheme.locked_text_color(), 0.55, 0.18))


func _unit_style(color: Color, border_color: Color, alpha: float, border_alpha: float, border_width: int = 2) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = GrammarTheme.rounded_box(
		Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, alpha),
		26,
		Color(border_color.r, border_color.g, border_color.b, border_alpha),
		border_width
	)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.24)
	style.shadow_size = 12
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 5.0)
	return style


func _on_unit_pressed(index: int) -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.set_last_scene(get_tree().current_scene.scene_file_path)
	Global.set_grammar_start_unit(index)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_GRAMMAR_LESSON)


func _on_main_menu_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_MAIN_MENU)


func _on_previous_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_GRAMMAR_HUB)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_previous_pressed()
```

```gdscript
class_name LearningUnitView
extends RefCounted
# ============================================================
#  LEARNING UNIT VIEW
#  Builds a "learn" (teaching) screen — title, explanation card
#  and structure/example cards — into a target VBoxContainer.
#  Keeps the teaching UI out of the main GrammarLesson controller
#  so the controller stays small and focused on the flow.
# ============================================================


static func render(target: VBoxContainer, unit: Dictionary) -> void:

	# --- Title (Persian) ---
	var title := Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(title, str(unit.get("title_fa", "")))
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.HEADING_SIZE)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
	target.add_child(title)
	GrammarAnimation.appear(title)

	# --- English subtitle ---
	var english_title := Label.new()
	english_title.text = str(unit.get("title_en", ""))
	english_title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	english_title.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	english_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SIZE)
	english_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	english_title.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_en_bold())
	# Converted lessons may carry no per-activity English title; skip the
	# empty placeholder so the learn page does not show a blank line.
	english_title.visible = not english_title.text.strip_edges().is_empty()
	target.add_child(english_title)

	# --- Explanation card ---
	var explanation_card := _make_card(target, 0)
	var explanation := Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(explanation, str(unit.get("explanation", "")))
	explanation.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	explanation.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	explanation.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	explanation.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	explanation.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SIZE)
	explanation.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_color())
	explanation.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular())
	_add_to_card(explanation_card, explanation)

	# --- Structure / example cards ---
	var cards: Array = unit.get("cards", [])
	var structure_fallback := str(unit.get("structure", ""))
	var has_structure := cards.size() > 0 or structure_fallback != ""

	if has_structure:
		var section_title := Label.new()
		section_title.text = "ساختار"
		section_title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
		section_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.SECTION_SIZE)
		section_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
		section_title.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_bold())
		target.add_child(section_title)

	if structure_fallback != "":
		var structure_label := Label.new()
		GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(structure_label, structure_fallback)
		structure_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		structure_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		structure_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_LARGE_SIZE)
		structure_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.primary_dark_color())
		structure_label.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_en_bold())
		target.add_child(structure_label)

	for card in cards:
		_add_structure_card(target, card)

	# Legacy examples (kept for older data)
	var examples: Array = unit.get("examples", [])
	for example in examples:
		_add_structure_card(target, example)


static func _add_structure_card(target: VBoxContainer, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var card := _make_card(target, 0)
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	_add_to_card(card, box)

	var en := Label.new()
	en.text = str(data.get("en", ""))
	en.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_LARGE_SIZE)
	en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.primary_dark_color())
	en.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_en_bold())
	box.add_child(en)

	var fa := Label.new()
	GrammarTheme.set_bidi_text(fa, str(data.get("fa", "")))
	fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	fa.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", GrammarTheme.BODY_SMALL_SIZE)
	fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", GrammarTheme.text_secondary_color())
	fa.add_theme_font_override("font", GrammarTheme.get_fa_regular())
	box.add_child(fa)


static func _make_card(target: VBoxContainer, min_height: int) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	if min_height > 0:
		card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, min_height)
	# Use the raised info-card style (surface_alt) so the teaching boxes
	# clearly contrast with the parent surface container in both themes.
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", GrammarTheme.info_card_style())
	target.add_child(card)
	GrammarAnimation.appear(card, 0.05)
	return card


static func _add_to_card(card: PanelContainer, content: Control) -> void:
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 18)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 18)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 12)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 12)
	margin.add_child(content)
	card.add_child(margin)
```

```gdscript
############################################################

const PERSIAN_DIGITS := ["۱", "۲", "۳", "۴", "۵", "۶", "۷", "۸", "۹", "۱۰"]

# Section definitions: [English label, Persian label, emoji, scene key]

	["Grammar",                 "گرامر",             "✏️", "GRAMMAR"],

	["Writing",                 "نوشتن",             "📝", "WRITING"],
	["What You Learned",        "آنچه آموختید",      "🔄", "WHAT_YOU_LEARNED"],
	["Workbook",                "کتاب کار",          "📘", "WORKBOOK"],
]

const SECTION_ACCENT_COLORS: Array[Color] = [
	Color("#3B82F6"), Color("#22C55E"), Color("#EF4444"),
	Color("#9333EA"), Color("#0D9488"), Color("#E11D48"),
	Color("#7C3AED"), Color("#D97706"), Color("#64748B"),
	Color("#0891B2"),
]

const BOOK_COLORS := {
	1: Color("#3B82F6"),   # Vision 1 — solid light blue
	2: Color("#22C55E"),   # Vision 2 — solid green
	3: Color("#EF4444"),   # Vision 3 — solid red
}


const LESSON_TITLES := {
	1: ["نجات طبیعت", "شگفتی‌های آفرینش", "ارزش دانش", "سفر به دور دنیا"],
	2: ["درک مردم", "سبک زندگی سالم", "هنر و فرهنگ"],
	3: ["حس قدردانی", "جستجو کن!", "انرژی تجدیدپذیر"],
}

# The book menu hands this screen its blurred cover, which is sharpened on
# arrival. The content fades in during the same window so the screen reads as
# one arrival instead of an empty sharp background that content then lands on.
const BG_UNBLUR_TIME := 0.55
const CONTENT_FADE_TIME := 0.40

# Fixed header bar on top of the screen, carrying the screen's top label.
# Same geometry as the main menu's header bar — full width, 200 px tall,
# 35 px bottom shoulders, 60 px side padding — so the two menu screens line
# up, and the cards start one gap below it.
const HEADER_HEIGHT := 200.0
const HEADER_RADIUS := 35
const HEADER_PAD_X := 60
const HEADER_LABEL_HEIGHT := 70
const HEADER_LABEL_SIZE := 40
const HEADER_GAP := 48
const HEADER_TEXT := "یک بخش را انتخاب کنید 👇"

# Section cards are GLOSSY buttons: one rounded corner radius drives both the
# card's styleboxes and the sheen overlay's mask, so the shine stops exactly at
# the rounded face instead of spilling into the corners.
const CARD_RADIUS := 26

var _navigating: bool = false
var _book: int = 1
var _lesson: int = 1

# Built UI state.
var _scroll: ScrollContainer = null
var _col: VBoxContainer = null
var _header: PanelContainer = null
var _title_label: Label = null
var _subtitle_badge: Label = null
var _card_buttons: Array[Button] = []
var _card_accents: Array[Color] = []
var _bg_blur: TextureRect = null
var _bg_clear: TextureRect = null


func _ready() -> void:
	_book = Global.current_book
	_lesson = Global.current_lesson

	# Kick off the on-demand download of this lesson's media (audio + images)
	# so every section opened from here has its files locally.
	Content.ensure_lesson(_book, _lesson)

	_build_ui()

	# The screen opens on the blurred cover the book menu left on screen, so
	# from the user's point of view nothing happened to the background at the
	# swap: it simply sharpens while the content arrives.
	_animate_background_in()

	# Save current scene for back navigation from drill-down scenes.
	# `current_scene` is only set when this screen is reached through a scene
	# change, so fall back to this node's own path: the screen must also be
	# instantiable in isolation (tooling, tests) without crashing on null.
	var current := get_tree().current_scene
	Global.set_last_scene(current.scene_file_path if current != null else scene_file_path)

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()

	# Gentle entrance: the header bar and the cards arrive together.
	_scroll.modulate.a = 0.0
	_header.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(_scroll, "modulate:a", 1.0, CONTENT_FADE_TIME) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(_header, "modulate:a", 1.0, CONTENT_FADE_TIME) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Fades the sharp artwork in over the blurred still the screen opened on.
## Runs on every entry (book menu, back from a section, tab bar), so the
## background always resolves from soft to sharp instead of popping in.
func _animate_background_in() -> void:
	if _bg_clear == null:
		return
	_bg_clear.modulate.a = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(_bg_clear, "modulate:a", 1.0, BG_UNBLUR_TIME)
	tw.tween_callback(_on_background_sharpened)


func _on_background_sharpened() -> void:
	# The blurred underlayer is fully covered now: drop it so the screen draws
	# one background instead of two.
	if is_instance_valid(_bg_blur):
		_bg_blur.visible = false
		_bg_blur.texture = null


func _get_lesson_title() -> String:
	var titles: Array = LESSON_TITLES.get(_book, [])
	if _lesson - 1 < titles.size():
		return titles[_lesson - 1]
	return ""


func _build_ui() -> void:
	# Book artwork, on its own canvas layer so scene transitions never slide it
	# (a sliding background is what used to flash the flat theme fill).
	# Two stacked stills: the blurred cover the book menu hands over on, and the
	# sharp picture faded in on top of it by _animate_background_in().
	var bg_layer := CanvasLayer.new()
	bg_layer.name = "BackgroundLayer"
	bg_layer.layer = -1

	_bg_blur = _make_background_still(
		"BackgroundBlur",
		"res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision%d_blur.png" % _book
	)
	bg_layer.add_child(_bg_blur)

	_bg_clear = _make_background_still(
		"BackgroundClear",
		"res://ui/images/book_scene/Vision%d.png" % _book
	)
	bg_layer.add_child(_bg_clear)

	add_child(bg_layer)

	# ---- Scrollable content ----
	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	_scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_scroll.offset_top = 0.0
	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	_scroll.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	add_child(_scroll)

	var outer := MarginContainer.new()
	outer.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	outer.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	outer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 40)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 40)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", int(HEADER_HEIGHT) + HEADER_GAP)
	outer.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 170)
	_scroll.add_child(outer)

	_col = VBoxContainer.new()
	_col.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_col.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_col.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	outer.add_child(_col)

	var sections: Array = SECTIONS_VISION_1 if _book == 1 else SECTIONS_VISION_2_3
	for i in sections.size():
		var sec: Array = sections[i]
		var label_en: String = sec[0]
		var label_fa: String = sec[1]
		var emoji: String = sec[2]
		var scene_key: String = sec[3]
		var accent: Color = SECTION_ACCENT_COLORS[i % SECTION_ACCENT_COLORS.size()]

		var card: Button = MenuStyle.make_card(label_en, label_fa, emoji, accent, 150)
		card.pressed.connect(_on_section_pressed.bind(scene_key))
		MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(card)
		# Glossy face + shine coating, both tinted with the section's accent.
		MenuStyle.style_gloss_card(card, accent, CARD_RADIUS)
		_col.add_child(card)
		_card_buttons.append(card)
		_card_accents.append(accent)

	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 40)
	_col.add_child(spacer)

	_col.add_child(MenuStyle.make_tip_card("بخشها را به ترتیب پیش ببر تا بهتر یاد بگیری 🌱", "🌟"))

	# ---- Header bar (added last so it paints over the scrolling cards) ----
	_build_header()


## Fixed bar across the top of the screen: the main menu's header bar, sized the
## same way, carrying this screen's top label. It ignores the mouse so wheel and
## drag gestures in the bar's area still reach the card list underneath it.
func _build_header() -> void:
	var bar_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	bar_style.bg_color = MenuStyle.surface()
	bar_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = HEADER_RADIUS
	bar_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = HEADER_RADIUS

	_header = PanelContainer.new()
	_header.name = "HeaderBar"
	_header.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
	_header.offset_bottom = HEADER_HEIGHT
	_header.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_header.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", bar_style)
	add_child(_header)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", HEADER_PAD_X)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", HEADER_PAD_X)
	_header.add_child(margin)

	var row := VBoxContainer.new()
	row.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	margin.add_child(row)

	# The screen's top label, now the title of the bar. _apply_theme() tints it
	# with the current book's accent colour.
	_title_label = Label.new()
	_title_label.text = HEADER_TEXT
	_title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	_title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", HEADER_LABEL_SIZE)
	_title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	_title_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_title_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_title_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, HEADER_LABEL_HEIGHT)
	_title_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.add_child(_title_label)


## Full-screen background still. Uses the same fit as the book menu's covers so
## the two screens line up pixel for pixel when the picture is handed over.
func _make_background_still(still_name: String, texture_path: String) -> TextureRect:
	var still := TextureRect.new()
	still.name = still_name
	still.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	still.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	still.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED
	still.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	still.texture = load(texture_path)
	return still


############################################################
# THEME
############################################################
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var book_accent: Color = BOOK_COLORS.get(_book, MenuStyle.accent())
	if _title_label:
		_title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", book_accent)
	if _subtitle_badge:
		_subtitle_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", MenuStyle.icon_chip(book_accent, 26))
		_subtitle_badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.pill_text(book_accent))
	for i in _card_buttons.size():
		var btn: Button = _card_buttons[i]
		var accent: Color = _card_accents[i]
		# Glossy cards: the same call that built them restyles them, so a theme
		# change re-tints the face and the sheen instead of dropping the gloss.
		MenuStyle.style_gloss_card(btn, accent, CARD_RADIUS)
		var tl: Label = btn.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/TitleLabel") as Label
		if tl:
			tl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
		var sl: Label = btn.get_node_or_null("Margin/Row/TextColumn/SubLabel") as Label
		if sl:
			sl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())


############################################################
# NAVIGATION
############################################################
func _on_section_pressed(scene_key: String) -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Global.set_last_scene(get_tree().current_scene.scene_file_path)

	if scene_key == "VOCAB":
		AppRouter.set_args({"mode": "lesson"})

	var scene_map := {
		"VOCAB": SCENE_VOCAB,
		"CONVERSATION": SCENE_CONVERSATION,
		"READING": SCENE_READING,
		"VOCAB_DEVELOPMENT": SCENE_VOCAB_DEVELOPMENT,
		"GRAMMAR": SCENE_GRAMMAR,
		"LISTENING_SPEAKING": SCENE_LISTENING_SPEAKING,
		"PRONUNCIATION": SCENE_PRONUNCIATION,
		"WRITING": SCENE_WRITING,
		"WHAT_YOU_LEARNED": SCENE_WHAT_YOU_LEARNED,
		"WORKBOOK": SCENE_WORKBOOK,
	}
	var path: String = scene_map.get(scene_key, "")
	if path == "":
		push_error("No scene path for key: " + scene_key)
		_navigating = false
		return

	await get_tree().create_timer(0.10).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	# Grammar is part of the main menu flow, so it slides FORWARD like
	# book-menu -> lesson-menu. Other drill-downs keep the fade transition.
	if scene_key == "GRAMMAR":
		TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(path, TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD)
	else:
		TransitionManager.change_scene(path)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.10).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(SCENE_BOOK_MENU, TransitionManager.Slide.BACK)
```
