```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
# LISTENING & SPEAKING SCENE — two swipeable pages via PageView
# Page 1 "Speaking"  → strategy, patterns, conversation partner, drills
# Page 2 "Listening" → listen-first audio cards + comprehension
#
# Dark-theme harmonized version.
# Titles are kept on one line with wrapping disabled.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

const FONT_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN    := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

# ---------- Dark theme ----------
const APP_BG := Color("#0b1229")
const PANEL_BG := Color("#0f1b3d")
const PANEL_BORDER := Color("#2d3a6a")

const TEXT_LIGHT := Color("#F1F5F9")
const TEXT_SOFT := Color("#CBD5E1")
const TEXT_MUTED := Color("#94A3B8")

const SUCCESS := Color("#34D399")

# Page accents: warm = speaking, cool = listening.
const SPEAK_ACCENT := Color("#EA580C")
const LISTEN_ACCENT := Color("#2563EB")

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

# ---------- Extra speaking state ----------
var _tts_fallback_tween: Tween
var _user_response_tween: Tween
const USER_RESPONSE_PAUSE := 4.0

# ---------- Extra listening state ----------
var _listening_tts_active_id := ""

# ---------- AudioPanel ----------
const AUDIO_PANEL_SCENE_PATH := "res://scenes/shared/AudioPanel.tscn"
var _audio_panel_instance: Node = null
var _audio_panel_active_id := ""

@onready var background: ColorRect = $Background
@onready var back_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var page_view: PageView = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView

# ---------- Speaking state ----------
var _turns: Array = []
var _turn_cards: Array = []
var _current_turn: int = -1
var _partner_mode: bool = false
var _status_label: Label
var _action_btn: Button
var _tts_done_cb: Callable
var _speaking_data: Dictionary = {}

# ---------- Listening state ----------
var _listening_players: Array = []
var _listened: Dictionary = {}

# ---------- Ambient dark background ----------
var _ambient_bg: ColorRect


func _ready() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold = load(FONT_BOLD_PATH)
	font_farsi = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)

	if font_bold:
		header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	# The bar owns its title's type ramp; see HeaderBarStyler.
	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)

	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	page_view.page_changed.connect(_on_page_changed)

	# Put a dark background behind the whole PageView.
	_ambient_bg = _add_page_view_background()
	_apply_ambient(SPEAK_ACCENT)

	# Theme-aware styling + live re-theme on toggle (runs for all data paths).
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	_apply_theme()

	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nشنیداری و گفتاری" % Global.current_lesson)

	var data: Dictionary = Global.load_category(
		"listening_speaking",
		Global.current_book,
		Global.current_lesson
	)

	if data.is_empty():
		return

	_speaking_data = data.get("speaking", {})

	page_view.add_page("speaking", "صحبت کردن", "🗣", _build_speaking_page(_speaking_data))
	page_view.add_page("listening", "شنیدن", "🎧", _build_listening_page(data.get("listening", [])))

	# Force themed backgrounds for PageView scroll areas.
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)


# ============================================================
# THEME-AWARE STYLING
# ============================================================

func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	if background != null:
		background.color = _navy_bg()

	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)

	if _ambient_bg != null:
		_ambient_bg.color = _app_bg()

	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)
	_retheme_turn_cards()


func _retheme_turn_cards() -> void:
	for entry in _turn_cards:
		var accent: Color = SPEAK_ACCENT if entry["is_app"] else SUCCESS
		entry["base_bg"] = _dark_tint(accent, 0.12)
		entry["highlight_bg"] = _dark_tint(accent, 0.35)
		var st: StyleBoxFlat = entry["style"]
		st.bg_color = entry["base_bg"]


# ============================================================
# DARK THEME HELPERS
# ============================================================

func _add_page_view_background() -> ColorRect:
	if page_view.has_meta("dark_bg"):
		return page_view.get_meta("dark_bg")

	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = _app_bg()
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	page_view.add_child(bg)
	page_view.move_child(bg, 0)
	page_view.set_meta("dark_bg", bg)

	return bg


func _apply_dark_scroll_background(root: Control) -> void:
	for child in root.get_children():
		if child is ScrollContainer:
			var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
			style.bg_color = _app_bg()
			child.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

		if child is Control:
			_apply_dark_scroll_background(child)


func _apply_ambient(accent: Color) -> void:
	if _ambient_bg == null:
		return

	# Skill identity is shown by page content, not by tinting the app background.
	_ambient_bg.color = _app_bg()


func _dark_tint(color: Color, amount := 0.16) -> Color:
	# Creates a panel color tinted by the given accent color.
	return _panel_bg().lerp(Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 1.0), amount)


# ---------- Theme-aware color helpers ----------
# All colors resolve through Global (the single theme source).
func _navy_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

func _app_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

func _panel_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("surface")

func _text_color() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("text")

func _text_soft() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")

func _text_muted() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")


func _get_en(val: Variant) -> String:
	if val is Dictionary:
		return str(val.get("en", ""))
	return str(val)


func _get_fa(val: Variant) -> String:
	if val is Dictionary:
		return str(val.get("fa", ""))
	return ""


# ============================================================
# PAGE 1 — SPEAKING
# ============================================================

func _build_speaking_page(speaking: Dictionary) -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)

	# --- Strategy banner ---
	page.add_child(_make_banner(
		str(speaking.get("icon", "🗣")),
		_get_en(speaking.get("strategy_name", "")),
		_get_fa(speaking.get("strategy_name", "")),
		_get_en(speaking.get("intro", "")),
		_get_fa(speaking.get("intro", "")),
		SPEAK_ACCENT
	))

	# --- Useful patterns ---
	var patterns: Array = speaking.get("patterns", [])
	if not patterns.is_empty():
		page.add_child(_make_section_title("الگوهای مفید", SPEAK_ACCENT))

		for p in patterns:
			page.add_child(_make_pattern_card(p))

	# --- Model conversation + partner mode ---
	_turns = speaking.get("model_conversation", {}).get("turns", [])

	if not _turns.is_empty():
		var conversation_title := _get_fa(
			speaking.get("model_conversation", {}).get("title", "")
		)

		if conversation_title == "":
			conversation_title = "گفتگو"

		page.add_child(_make_section_title(conversation_title, SPEAK_ACCENT))
		_build_partner_controls(page)
		_build_turn_cards(page)

	# --- Practice prompts ---
	var practice: Dictionary = speaking.get("practice", {})
	if not practice.get("prompts", []).is_empty():
		page.add_child(_make_section_title("نوبت شما برای پاسخ", SPEAK_ACCENT))
		_build_practice(page, practice)

	return page


func _build_partner_controls(page: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	var box := HBoxContainer.new()
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	_action_btn = _make_button("🤝  تمرین با برنامه", SPEAK_ACCENT)
	_action_btn.pressed.connect(_on_action_pressed)
	box.add_child(_action_btn)

	page.add_child(box)

	_status_label = Label.new()
	_status_label.text = "روی «تمرین با برنامه» بزنید — صدای سارا را اپ می‌گوید، شما جواب خود را می‌گویید."
	_status_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	_status_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	_status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text_color())

	if font_farsi:
		_status_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)

	page.add_child(_status_label)

func _stop_tts() -> void:
	# Cancel an unfinished speaking pause whenever playback is stopped or replaced.
	if is_instance_valid(_user_response_tween):
		_user_response_tween.kill()
		_user_response_tween = null

	# If a fallback listening TTS is active, reset its UI.
	_reset_listening_tts_ui()

	_tts_done_cb = Callable()

	if is_instance_valid(_tts_fallback_tween):
		_tts_fallback_tween.kill()

	_listening_tts_active_id = ""

	if DisplayServer.has_method("tts_stop"):
		DisplayServer.tts_stop()

func _build_turn_cards(page: VBoxContainer) -> void:
	_turn_cards.clear()

	for i in _turns.size():
		var turn: Dictionary = _turns[i]
		var is_app: bool = str(turn.get("role", "app")) == "app"

		var accent := SPEAK_ACCENT if is_app else SUCCESS

		var base_bg := _dark_tint(accent, 0.12)
		var highlight_bg := _dark_tint(accent, 0.35)

		var card := PanelContainer.new()

		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.bg_color = base_bg
		style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
		style.border_width_left = 5
		style.border_color = accent
		style.set_content_margin_all(16)

		card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

		var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
		vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)

		# Speaker label: one line.
		var role := Label.new()
		role.text = ("🤖 " if is_app else "🎤 ") + str(turn.get("speaker", ""))
		role.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		role.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
		role.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)

		if font_bold:
			role.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

		vb.add_child(role)

		# Conversation text stays wrapped.
		vb.add_child(_make_label(str(turn.get("text", "")), 44, _text_color(), false))
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(str(turn.get("fa", "")), 40, _text_color()))

		card.add_child(vb)
		page.add_child(card)

		_turn_cards.append({
			"card": card,
			"style": style,
			"is_app": is_app,
			"base_bg": base_bg,
			"highlight_bg": highlight_bg,
		})


func _on_action_pressed() -> void:
	if _current_turn >= 0:
		# User may skip the remaining response pause with the button.
		if is_instance_valid(_user_response_tween):
			_user_response_tween.kill()
			_user_response_tween = null
		_advance_turn()
	else:
		_start_partner()


func _advance_turn() -> void:
	_current_turn += 1
	_unhighlight_all()

	if _current_turn >= _turns.size():
		_finish_conversation()
		return

	var turn: Dictionary = _turns[_current_turn]
	var is_app: bool = str(turn.get("role", "app")) == "app"

	_highlight(_current_turn)

	if is_app or not _partner_mode:
		# The app speaks this line.
		_set_status("🔊 گوش دهید: «" + str(turn.get("text", "")) + "»")

		if _action_btn:
			_action_btn.disabled = true
			_action_btn.text = "🤝  تمرین با برنامه"

		_speak(str(turn.get("text", "")), _advance_turn)
	else:
		# User's turn: leave time to repeat the line, then continue automatically.
		_set_status("🎤 نوبت شماست! بگویید: «" + str(turn.get("text", "")) + "» — خط بعدی پس از چند ثانیه پخش می‌شود.")

		if _action_btn:
			_action_btn.disabled = false
			_action_btn.text = "➡  بعدی"

		if is_instance_valid(_user_response_tween):
			_user_response_tween.kill()
		_user_response_tween = create_tween()
		_user_response_tween.tween_interval(USER_RESPONSE_PAUSE)
		_user_response_tween.tween_callback(_advance_turn)

func _start_partner() -> void:
	_stop_all_listening_players()
	_stop_tts()
	_unhighlight_all()

	_partner_mode = true
	_current_turn = -1

	_advance_turn()

func _on_page_changed(_index: int, page_id: String) -> void:
	# Re-tint the dark background to match the skill being practiced.
	_apply_ambient(SPEAK_ACCENT if page_id == "speaking" else LISTEN_ACCENT)

	# Stop speaking-page playback.
	_stop_tts()
	_unhighlight_all()

	_current_turn = -1

	if is_instance_valid(_user_response_tween):
		_user_response_tween.kill()
		_user_response_tween = null

	if _action_btn:
		_action_btn.disabled = false
		_action_btn.text = "🤝  تمرین با برنامه"

	# Stop listening playback too.
	_stop_all_listening_players()


func _finish_conversation() -> void:
	_unhighlight_all()

	_current_turn = -1
	if is_instance_valid(_user_response_tween):
		_user_response_tween.kill()
	_user_response_tween = null

	if _action_btn:
		_action_btn.disabled = false
		_action_btn.text = "🤝  تمرین با برنامه"

	_set_status("🎉 آفرین! گفتگو به پایان رسید.")

func _highlight(index: int) -> void:
	if index < 0 or index >= _turn_cards.size():
		return

	var entry: Dictionary = _turn_cards[index]
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = entry["style"]
	style.bg_color = entry["highlight_bg"]

	var card: Control = entry["card"]
	card.pivot_offset = card.size / 2.0

	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(
		card,
		"scale",
		Vector2(1.02, 1.02),
		0.15
	).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _unhighlight_all() -> void:
	for entry in _turn_cards:
		var style: StyleBoxFlat = entry["style"]
		style.bg_color = entry["base_bg"]

		var card: Control = entry["card"]
		card.scale = Vector2.ONE


func _set_status(text: String) -> void:
	if _status_label:
		_status_label.text = text


# ---------- TTS with completion callback ----------

func _speak(text: String, on_done: Callable) -> void:
	# Kill any previous fallback tween.
	if is_instance_valid(_tts_fallback_tween):
		_tts_fallback_tween.kill()

	# If TTS is unavailable, simulate a short speaking delay.
	if Global.english_voice_id == "" or not DisplayServer.has_method("tts_speak"):
		if on_done.is_valid():
			_tts_fallback_tween = create_tween()
			_tts_fallback_tween.tween_callback(on_done).set_delay(1.2)
		return

	_tts_done_cb = on_done

	if DisplayServer.has_method("tts_set_utterance_callback"):
		DisplayServer.tts_set_utterance_callback(
			DisplayServer.TTS_UTTERANCE_ENDED,
			_on_tts_utterance_ended
		)
		DisplayServer.tts_set_utterance_callback(
			DisplayServer.TTS_UTTERANCE_CANCELED,
			_on_tts_utterance_ended
		)

	DisplayServer.tts_speak(
		text,
		Global.english_voice_id,
		100,   # volume (0-100) — was accidentally 0 (mute)
		1.0,   # pitch
		1.0,   # rate
		100,   # utterance_id
		false  # interrupt
	)

func _on_tts_utterance_ended(_utterance_id: int) -> void:
	var cb := _tts_done_cb
	_tts_done_cb = Callable()

	if cb.is_valid():
		cb.call()


# ---------- Practice prompts ----------

func _build_practice(page: VBoxContainer, practice: Dictionary) -> void:
	page.add_child(_make_fa_label(_get_fa(practice.get("instruction", "")), 40, _text_color()))

	var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
	flow.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 12)
	flow.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 12)
	flow.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	for prompt in practice.get("prompts", []):
		var chip := _make_button(str(prompt), SPEAK_ACCENT.lightened(0.1))
		chip.pressed.connect(func(): _ask_prompt(str(prompt), practice))
		flow.add_child(chip)

	page.add_child(flow)

	var sample := _make_label(
		"💡 " + str(practice.get("sample_yes", "")) + "   |   " + str(practice.get("sample_no", "")),
		38,
		SUCCESS,
		false
	)

	page.add_child(sample)


func _ask_prompt(prompt: String, practice: Dictionary) -> void:
	var question := str(practice.get("question_frame", "Are you going to ___?"))
	question = question.replace("___", prompt).replace("__", prompt)

	_set_status("🤖 " + question + "   (با صدای بلند جواب دهید!)")
	_speak(question, Callable())


# ============================================================
# PAGE 2 — LISTENING
# ============================================================

func _build_listening_page(conversations: Array) -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 26)

	page.add_child(_make_banner(
		"🎧",
		"Listening",
		"شنیدار",
		"Listen all the way through before you look at the words. Your ears first, your eyes second.",
		"قبل از نگاه کردن به کلمات، تا انتها گوش دهید. اول گوش‌ها، بعد چشم‌ها.",
		LISTEN_ACCENT
	))

	for conv in conversations:
		page.add_child(_build_conversation_card(conv))

	return page


func _build_conversation_card(conv: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var conv_id := str(conv.get("id", ""))

	var card := PanelContainer.new()

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _panel_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.border_width_left = 6
	style.border_color = LISTEN_ACCENT
	style.set_content_margin_all(22)

	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Title row.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	head.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	# Conversation title: one line, no wrapping.
	var title := _make_label(_get_en(conv.get("title", "")), 50, _text_color(), true, false)
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	head.add_child(title)

	vb.add_child(head)

	# Task instruction.
	vb.add_child(_make_label(_get_en(conv.get("task", "")), 42, _text_soft(), false))

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# AudioPanel reference (shared across all conversation cards).
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var audio_panel := _get_or_create_audio_panel()

	var play_btn := _make_button("پخش گفتگو", LISTEN_ACCENT)
	play_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Transcript — English (left-aligned) + Farsi (right-aligned).
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var transcript_box := VBoxContainer.new()
	transcript_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	transcript_box.visible = false

	var en_transcript := _make_label(_get_en(conv.get("transcript", "")), 40, _text_soft(), false)
	en_transcript.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
	en_transcript.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	transcript_box.add_child(en_transcript)

	var fa_transcript_text := _get_fa(conv.get("transcript", ""))
	if fa_transcript_text != "":
		var fa_transcript := _make_fa_label(fa_transcript_text, 40, _text_soft())
		transcript_box.add_child(fa_transcript)

	var transcript_btn := _make_button("📜  نمایش متن", LISTEN_ACCENT)
	transcript_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	# Store the button so other cards can reset this one.
	_listening_players.append({
		"audio_panel": audio_panel,
		"id": conv_id,
		"play_btn": play_btn,
		"transcript_btn": transcript_btn,
	})

	transcript_btn.pressed.connect(func():
		transcript_box.visible = not transcript_box.visible

		if transcript_box.visible:
			transcript_btn.text = "🙈  مخفی کردن متن"
		else:
			transcript_btn.text = "📜  نمایش متن"
	)

	play_btn.pressed.connect(func():
		_play_listening(conv, play_btn, transcript_btn)
	)

	vb.add_child(play_btn)
	vb.add_child(transcript_btn)
	vb.add_child(transcript_box)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Comprehension questions.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	for exercise in conv.get("exercises", []):
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		vb.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card

func _stop_all_listening_players() -> void:
	_audio_panel_active_id = ""
	for entry in _listening_players:
		var audio_panel := entry.get("audio_panel", null) as Node

		if audio_panel == null:
			continue

		if audio_panel.is_playing():
			audio_panel.stop_and_close()
			_set_listening_entry_stopped(entry)


func _set_listening_entry_stopped(entry: Dictionary) -> void:
	var btn := entry.get("play_btn", null) as Button

	if btn:
		btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"


func _reset_listening_tts_ui() -> void:
	if _listening_tts_active_id == "":
		return

	for entry in _listening_players:
		if str(entry.get("id", "")) == _listening_tts_active_id:
			_set_listening_entry_stopped(entry)
			break


func _on_listening_tts_finished(
	conv_id: String,
	play_btn: Button,
	transcript_btn: Button
) -> void:
	if _listening_tts_active_id != conv_id:
		return

	_listening_tts_active_id = ""
	_listened[conv_id] = true

	play_btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"

	transcript_btn.disabled = false
	transcript_btn.text = "📜  نمایش متن"
	_unlock_transcript_button(transcript_btn)


func _get_or_create_audio_panel() -> Node:
	if _audio_panel_instance != null and is_instance_valid(_audio_panel_instance):
		return _audio_panel_instance

	if is_inside_tree() and ResourceLoader.exists(AUDIO_PANEL_SCENE_PATH):
		var scene := load(AUDIO_PANEL_SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
		if scene != null:
			_audio_panel_instance = scene.instantiate()
			_audio_panel_instance.add_to_group("audio_panel")
			add_child(_audio_panel_instance)
			_audio_panel_instance.audio_finished.connect(_on_audio_panel_finished)
			_audio_panel_instance.audio_closed.connect(_on_audio_panel_closed)
			page_view.add_swipe_blocker(_audio_panel_instance)
			return _audio_panel_instance
	return null


func _on_audio_panel_finished() -> void:
	_audio_panel_active_id = ""
	for entry in _listening_players:
		var entry_id := str(entry.get("id", ""))
		if _listened.get(entry_id, false):
			continue
		var play_btn := entry.get("play_btn", null) as Button
		var transcript_btn := entry.get("transcript_btn", null) as Button
		if play_btn:
			play_btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"
		if transcript_btn:
			transcript_btn.disabled = false
			transcript_btn.text = "📜  نمایش متن"
			_unlock_transcript_button(transcript_btn)


func _on_audio_panel_closed() -> void:
	for entry in _listening_players:
		var play_btn := entry.get("play_btn", null) as Button
		if play_btn:
			play_btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"


func _unlock_transcript_button(btn: Button) -> void:
	var unlock_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	unlock_style.bg_color = LISTEN_ACCENT
	unlock_style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	unlock_style.set_content_margin_all(14)

	var unlock_hover: StyleBoxFlat = unlock_style.duplicate()
	unlock_hover.bg_color = LISTEN_ACCENT.lightened(0.15)

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", unlock_style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", unlock_hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", unlock_hover)


# Builds the logical res:// path for a conversation's audio clip. The JSON may
# store either a full path or a bare filename; either way it is resolved against
# assets/audio/v{book}/l{lesson}/. Lessons may ship more than one clip, so the
# conversation id (conv1, conv2, ...) is used as a sensible fallback filename.
func _resolve_listening_audio_path(conv: Dictionary) -> String:
	var audio_value := str(conv.get("audio", ""))
	var fallback := "listening_1.mp3"
	var conv_id := str(conv.get("id", ""))
	if conv_id.begins_with("conv"):
		var num := conv_id.substr(4).to_int()
		if num > 0:
			fallback = "listening_%d.mp3" % num
	return Global.resolve_audio_path(
		Global.current_book,
		Global.current_lesson,
		audio_value,
		fallback
	)


func _play_listening(
	conv: Dictionary,
	play_btn: Button,
	transcript_btn: Button
) -> void:
	var conv_id := str(conv.get("id", ""))
	var path := _resolve_listening_audio_path(conv)

	# A clip is only usable when it was bundled in the APK or already
	# downloaded — Content knows about both locations.
	var has_audio := path != "" and Content.has_asset(path)

	# True only if this same card is currently using fallback TTS.
	var same_tts_active := (_listening_tts_active_id == conv_id and not has_audio)

	# Stop any active conversation TTS and other conversation audio.
	_stop_all_listening_players()

	# Stop any TTS except the one we are about to toggle as "Stop".
	if not same_tts_active:
		_stop_tts()

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# No real audio file: fallback to TTS reading the transcript.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	if not has_audio:
		if _listening_tts_active_id == conv_id:
			# User hit Stop while fallback TTS was reading.
			_stop_tts()

			play_btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"
			return

		_listening_tts_active_id = conv_id

		play_btn.text = "در حال پخش..."

		_speak(
			_get_en(conv.get("transcript", "")),
			Callable(_on_listening_tts_finished).bind(conv_id, play_btn, transcript_btn)
		)
		return

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Real audio file — play through AudioPanel.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var audio_panel := _get_or_create_audio_panel()
	if audio_panel == null:
		push_warning("AudioPanel could not be created for: " + conv_id)
		return

	if audio_panel.is_playing():
		# User hit the button while audio was playing -> stop it.
		_audio_panel_active_id = ""
		audio_panel.stop_and_close()

		play_btn.text = "پخش گفتگو"
		return

	# Start the conversation audio through AudioPanel.
	_audio_panel_active_id = conv_id
	audio_panel.load_and_play(path)

	play_btn.text = "در حال پخش..."

# ============================================================
# SHARED WIDGETS
# ============================================================

func _make_banner(
	icon: String,
	en: String,
	fa: String,
	desc_en: String,
	desc_fa: String,
	accent: Color
) -> PanelContainer:
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()

	var b_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	b_style.bg_color = accent
	b_style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	b_style.set_content_margin_all(26)

	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", b_style)

	var bv := VBoxContainer.new()
	bv.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)

	var ic := Label.new()
	ic.text = icon
	ic.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 84)
	ic.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	ic.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	bv.add_child(ic)

	# Choose readable text color based on accent brightness.
	var text_color := Color.WHITE
	if accent.get_luminance() > 0.6:
		text_color = Color("#0b1229")

	var sub_color := Color(text_color.r, text_color.g, text_color.b, 0.85)

	# Banner title: wraps so long titles never inflate the page width.
	var en_l := _make_label(en, 62, text_color, true)
	en_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	bv.add_child(en_l)

	var fa_l := _make_fa_label(fa, 46, sub_color)
	fa_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	bv.add_child(fa_l)

	# Description stays wrapped.
	if desc_en != "":
		bv.add_child(_make_label(
			desc_en,
			40,
			Color(text_color.r, text_color.g, text_color.b, 0.95),
			false
		))

	if desc_fa != "":
		bv.add_child(_make_fa_label(
			desc_fa,
			38,
			Color(text_color.r, text_color.g, text_color.b, 0.8)
		))

	banner.add_child(bv)
	return banner


func _make_pattern_card(p: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _panel_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_left = 4
	style.border_color = SPEAK_ACCENT.lightened(0.2)
	style.set_content_margin_all(16)

	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)

	var q_text := _get_en(p.get("q", ""))
	var a_text := _get_en(p.get("a", ""))

	vb.add_child(_make_label("❓  " + q_text, 42, _text_color(), true))
	vb.add_child(_make_label("💬  " + a_text, 42, SUCCESS, false))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


func _make_section_title(en: String, accent: Color) -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	# Section title: wraps so it always fits the screen width.
	# Now displayed in Persian (RTL/right-aligned), so the accent bar
	# goes on the RIGHT side of the row.
	var title := _make_fa_label(en, 50, _text_color(), true)
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	row.add_child(title)

	var bar := ColorRect.new()
	bar.color = accent
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(6, 44)
	bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.add_child(bar)

	return row


func _make_button(text: String, color: Color) -> Button:
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = text
	btn.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = color
	style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	style.set_content_margin_all(14)

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)

	var hover: StyleBoxFlat = style.duplicate()
	hover.bg_color = color.lightened(0.15)

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hover)

	# Buttons now display Persian labels, so use the Persian font.
	if font_farsi:
		btn.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)

	btn.pressed.connect(func():
		btn.pivot_offset = btn.size / 2.0

		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2(0.95, 0.95), 0.06)
		t.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.1)
	)

	return btn


func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color, bold: bool, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	# Disable wrapping for titles when requested.
	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING

	# Slightly shrink very long one-line titles so they fit better.
	var final_size := font_size
	if not do_wrap:
		if text.length() > 30:
			final_size = int(float(font_size) * 0.85)
		if text.length() > 55:
			final_size = int(float(font_size) * 0.72)

	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", final_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)

	if bold and font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)

	return l


func _make_fa_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color = Color.WHITE, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING

	# Slightly shrink very long one-line Persian titles.
	var final_size := font_size
	if not do_wrap:
		if text.length() > 34:
			final_size = int(float(font_size) * 0.85)
		if text.length() > 60:
			final_size = int(float(font_size) * 0.72)

	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", final_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT

	if font_farsi:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)

	return l


# ============================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	_stop_tts()
	_stop_all_listening_players()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")

func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	_stop_tts()
	_stop_all_listening_players()

	back_button.pivot_offset = back_button.size / 2.0

	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(back_button, "scale", Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)

	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_button_pressed()
```

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

############################################################
# MAIN MENU — Continue + Leaderboards (Godot 4.7)
# One big scene-tree Continue button + two leaderboard panels
# (daily / lifetime) switched by two horizontal tab buttons.
############################################################

const COLOR_CONTINUE := Color("#3B82F6")

var _back_message_nodes: Array[Node] = []
var _daily_selected: bool = true
var _daily_request_id: int = 0
var _lifetime_request_id: int = 0

@onready var _continue_button: Button = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/ContinueSlot/ContinueButton

@onready var _brand_mark: TextureRect = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/HeroVBox/BrandMark
@onready var _daily_tab: Button = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/BoardTabs/DailyBoardButton
@onready var _lifetime_tab: Button = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/BoardTabs/LifetimeBoardButton

@onready var _daily_entries: VBoxContainer = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/LeaderboardPanelSlot/DailyPanel/DailyMargin/DailyVBox/DailyEntries
@onready var _lifetime_status: Label = $RootScroll/OuterMargin/MainColumn/LeaderboardPanelSlot/LifetimePanel/LifetimeMargin/LifetimeVBox/LifetimeStatus

	super._ready()
	_setup_continue_button()
	_daily_tab.pressed.connect(_on_daily_tab_pressed)
	_lifetime_tab.pressed.connect(_on_lifetime_tab_pressed)
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_panels_visibility()
	_update_tab_selection()
	_load_daily_board()
	_load_lifetime_board()
	if not Global.intro_animation_played:

	else:

func _setup_continue_button() -> void:
	if _continue_button.pressed.is_connected(_on_continue_pressed):
		_continue_button.pressed.disconnect(_on_continue_pressed)
	_continue_button.pressed.connect(_on_continue_pressed)
	_refresh_continue_state()


func _refresh_continue_state() -> void:
	var last: String = Global.get_last_scene()
	if last.is_empty() or not ResourceLoader.exists(last):
		_continue_button.disabled = true
		_continue_sub.text = "هنوز چیزی را شروع نکرده‌ای؛ یک بازی روزانه انجام بده تا اینجا ادامه‌اش بدهی! 🌱"
		_continue_button.tooltip_text = "اول یک بخش را باز کن تا ادامه‌اش اینجا باشد"
	else:
		_continue_button.disabled = false
		_continue_sub.text = _continue_destination_label(last)
		_continue_button.tooltip_text = "بازگشت به آخرین بخشی که باز کرده‌اید"


func _continue_destination_label(scene_path: String) -> String:
	var scene_names: Dictionary = {
		"res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn": "بازگشت به فهرست درس‌ها",
		"res://scenes/grammar/GrammarHub.tscn": "بازگشت به دستور زبان",
		"res://scenes/grammar/GrammarUnits.tscn": "ادامه تمرین دستور زبان",
		"res://scenes/grammar/GrammarLesson.tscn": "ادامه درس دستور زبان",
		"res://scenes/book_menu/BookSelection.tscn": "بازگشت به انتخاب کتاب",
		"res://scenes/word_game/WordGameHub.tscn": "ادامه بازی با کلمات",
		"res://scenes/word_game/DailyWordGame.tscn": "ادامه چالش روزانه",
	}
	return str(scene_names.get(scene_path, "بازگشت به آخرین بخش بازشده"))


func _on_continue_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	var last: String = Global.get_last_scene()
	if last.is_empty() or not ResourceLoader.exists(last):
		Global.set_last_scene("")
		_continue_sub.text = "مسیری پیدا نشد؛ اول یک بازی روزانه انجام بده! 🎮"
		_refresh_continue_state()
		return
	_navigating = true
	_continue_button.disabled = true
	_continue_sub.text = "در حال باز کردن بخش شما…"
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.10).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(last, TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD)


############################################################
# LEADERBOARD TABS — switch panels (like WordGameHub)
############################################################
func _on_daily_tab_pressed() -> void:
	_daily_selected = true
	_apply_panels_visibility()
	_update_tab_selection()


func _on_lifetime_tab_pressed() -> void:
	_daily_selected = false
	_apply_panels_visibility()
	_update_tab_selection()


func _apply_panels_visibility() -> void:
	_daily_panel.visible = _daily_selected
	_lifetime_panel.visible = not _daily_selected


func _update_tab_selection() -> void:
	_daily_tab.button_pressed = _daily_selected
	_lifetime_tab.button_pressed = not _daily_selected


############################################################
# LEADERBOARD LOAD — daily + lifetime panels
############################################################
func _load_daily_board() -> void:
	_daily_request_id += 1
	for child: Node in _daily_entries.get_children():
		_daily_entries.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	if not API.is_configured() or not API.is_logged_in():
		_daily_status.text = "برای دیدن رتبه‌بندی امروز اینترنت و ورود لازم است.\nوصل شو و برگرد! 🌐"
		return
	var request_id: int = _daily_request_id
	_daily_status.text = "در حال دریافت رتبه‌بندی امروز از سرور…"
	API.fetch_daily_leaderboard(50, 0, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void: _on_daily_loaded(request_id, ok, data))


func _load_lifetime_board() -> void:
	_lifetime_request_id += 1
	for child: Node in _lifetime_entries.get_children():
		_lifetime_entries.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	if not API.is_configured() or not API.is_logged_in():
		_lifetime_status.text = "برای دیدن رتبه‌بندی کل اینترنت و ورود لازم است.\nوصل شو و برگرد! 🌐"
		return
	var request_id: int = _lifetime_request_id
	_lifetime_status.text = "در حال دریافت رتبه‌بندی کل از سرور…"
	API.fetch_lifetime_leaderboard(50, 0, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void: _on_lifetime_loaded(request_id, ok, data))


func _on_daily_loaded(request_id: int, ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if request_id != _daily_request_id:
		return
	if not ok:
		_daily_status.text = "اینترنت وصل نیست! اتصالت را بررسی کن و دوباره تلاش کن. 📡"
		return
	var period: String = "امروز"
	if str(data.get("date", "")) != "":
		period = "امروز · %s" % MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(data.get("date", "")))
	var self_row: Variant = data.get("self", null)
	if self_row is Dictionary:
		var self_data: Dictionary = self_row
		_daily_status.text = "%s\nرتبهٔ شما: %s · امتیاز: %s" % [period, MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(self_data.get("rank", "—"))), MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(self_data.get("score", 0)))]
	else:
		_daily_status.text = "%s\nامروز هنوز بازی نکرده‌ای! همین حالا چالش روزانه را بازی کن و اسمت را به جدول اضافه کن! 🔥🎮" % period
	_fill_entries(_daily_entries, data, true)


func _on_lifetime_loaded(request_id: int, ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if request_id != _lifetime_request_id:
		return
	if not ok:
		_lifetime_status.text = "اینترنت وصل نیست! اتصالت را بررسی کن و دوباره تلاش کن. 📡"
		return
	var self_row: Variant = data.get("self", null)
	if self_row is Dictionary:
		var self_data: Dictionary = self_row
		_lifetime_status.text = "مجموع امتیازهای ثبت‌شده\nرتبهٔ شما: %s · امتیاز: %s" % [MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(self_data.get("rank", "—"))), MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(self_data.get("score", 0)))]
	else:
		_lifetime_status.text = "هنوز هیچ بازی ثبت نکرده‌ای! از امروز شروع کن و کم‌کم به بالای جدول برس! 🚀📚"
	_fill_entries(_lifetime_entries, data, false)


func _fill_entries(box: VBoxContainer, data: Dictionary, is_daily: bool) -> void:
	var rows: Array = data.get("entries", [])
	if rows.is_empty():
		var empty := Label.new()
		empty.text = "هنوز کسی امروز امتیاز نگرفته؛ اولین نفر باش! 🏆" if is_daily else "هنوز کسی امتیازی ثبت نکرده؛ اولین نفر باش! 🏆"
		empty.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		empty.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		empty.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		empty.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
		empty.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
		empty.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text_dim())
		box.add_child(empty)
		return
	for raw: Variant in rows:
		if not raw is Dictionary:
			continue
		var entry: Dictionary = raw
		var highlighted: bool = bool(entry.get("isSelf", false))
		var panel := PanelContainer.new()
		panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", MenuStyle.card_style(MenuStyle.accent() if highlighted else MenuStyle.border(), 18, highlighted, false))
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		panel.add_child(row)
		row.add_child(_make_cell("#%s" % MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(entry.get("rank", "—"))), 24))
		row.add_child(_make_cell(str(entry.get("name", "بازیکن")), 23))
		var score := _make_cell(MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(entry.get("score", 0))), 25)
		score.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		row.add_child(score)
		box.add_child(panel)


func _make_cell(value: String, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = value
	label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	return label


############################################################
# THEME + ANIMATION
############################################################
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_refresh_continue_state()


func _start_ambient() -> void:
	var tw: Tween = create_tween().set_loops()
	tw.tween_property(_brand_mark, "scale", Vector2(1.03, 1.03), 3.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(_brand_mark, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 3.0).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)


func _play_intro_animation() -> void:
	var targets: Array[Control] = []
	for child in _main_col.get_children():
		if child is Control and not child.is_queued_for_deletion():
			targets.append(child)
	for t in targets:
		t.modulate.a = 0.0
		t.position += Vector2(0, 30)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	for i in targets.size():
		var t: Control = targets[i]
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_interval(0.06 * i)
		tw.tween_property(t, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.30).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		tw.parallel().tween_property(t, "position:y", t.position.y - 30.0, 0.30).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.06 * targets.size() + 0.4).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_start_ambient()


############################################################
# ANDROID BACK (double-tap to exit)
############################################################
func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	var current_time := Time.get_unix_time_from_system()
	if back_pressed_time > 0 and current_time - back_pressed_time < double_back_timeout:
		get_tree().quit()
	else:
		back_pressed_time = current_time
		_show_back_message()


func _show_back_message() -> void:
	if not _back_message_nodes.is_empty():
		return
	var message := Label.new()
	message.text = "برای خروج دوباره دکمه برگشت را بزنید"
	message.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	message.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	message.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	message.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	message.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	message.anchor_left = 0.0
	message.anchor_top = 0.0
	message.anchor_right = 1.0
	message.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	message.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(message)
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = MenuStyle.c("overlay")
	bg.anchor_left = 0.0
	bg.anchor_top = 0.0
	bg.anchor_right = 1.0
	bg.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(bg)
	move_child(bg, 0)
	_back_message_nodes = [bg, message]
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.5).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.parallel().tween_property(bg, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(message, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.3)
	await tw.finished
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	bg.queue_free()
	message.queue_free()
	_back_message_nodes.clear()
```

## File: `res://scenes/pronunciation/pronunciation.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# PRONUNCIATION SCENE — powered by data/v_pronunciation.json
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Structure of the data file (books -> lessons -> pages):
#   books: [ { "book": "Vision N", "lessons": [ ... ] } ]
#   lesson: { "lesson_number", "lesson_title", "pronunciation_topic",
#             "pages": [ tip | exercise ] }
#   tip:      { "page_type":"tip", "content_en", "content_fa" }
#   exercise: { "page_type":"exercise", "exercise_letter":"A", ... }
#
# PAGING BEHAVIOUR:
#   * Page 1 shows only the pretty Tip box + an extra Persian explanation.
#   * Every exercise lives on its own page (A, B, ...).
#   * Exercises that require the workbook (e.g. "Go to Part IV...")
#     are skipped entirely.
#
# INTERACTIVE EXERCISES:
#   Answerable exercises carry an "engine" object in the JSON; they are
#   rendered with the shared ExerciseEngine (multiple-choice, etc.) with
#   the options/answers authored in data/v_pronunciation.json. Exercises
#   that only need listening/repeating stay as plain read-only cards.
#
# AUDIO:
#   Each exercise (A, B, ...) maps to the audio file
#   assets/audio/v{book}/l{lesson}/p{n}.mp3  (A=1, B=2, ...).
#   The audio button (shown at the top of the exercise) is only rendered
#   when that file actually exists; it opens the shared AudioPanel.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"
const PRONUNCIATION_DATA_PATH := "res://data/v_pronunciation.json"

# Global scale applied to every text size so fonts render larger.
const FONT_SCALE := 1.15

const FONT_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN    := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

# ---------- Accent / status colors ----------
const ACCENT := Color("#0891B2")
const EXERCISE_ACCENT := Color("#0EA5E9")
const TIP_BORDER := Color("#F59E0B")
const TIP_TITLE := Color("#F59E0B")

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

@onready var back_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var page_view: PageView = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView
@onready var background: ColorRect = $Background
@onready var audio_panel = $AudioPanel

var _page_reveals: Dictionary = {}
var _page_revealed: Dictionary = {}
var _data: Dictionary = {}

func _ready() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold = load(FONT_BOLD_PATH)
	font_farsi = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)

	if font_bold:
		header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	# The bar owns its title's type ramp; see HeaderBarStyler.
	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)

	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	page_view.page_changed.connect(_on_page_changed)
	page_view.set_accent(ACCENT)
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	_add_page_view_background()

	if audio_panel != null:
		audio_panel.audio_closed.connect(func(): _on_audio_closed())
		# Swiping on the AudioPanel (slider/buttons) must never swipe pages.
		page_view.add_swipe_blocker(audio_panel)

	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nتلفظ" % Global.current_lesson)
	_data = _load_v_pronunciation()
	if _data.is_empty():
		return

	_build_pages()
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)
	_play_reveal(0)
	_apply_theme()

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING (data/v_pronunciation.json)
# ============================================================
func _load_v_pronunciation() -> Dictionary:
	var result := {}
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(PRONUNCIATION_DATA_PATH):
		push_warning("Pronunciation data not found: " + PRONUNCIATION_DATA_PATH)
		return result

	var file := FileAccess.open(PRONUNCIATION_DATA_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		push_warning("Could not open " + PRONUNCIATION_DATA_PATH)
		return result
	var text := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()

	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK:
		push_error("v_pronunciation.json parse error: " + json.get_error_message())
		return result

	var root: Dictionary = json.data
	var lesson_entry := _find_lesson(root.get("books", []), Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson)
	if lesson_entry.is_empty():
		return result

	result["lesson_title"] = str(lesson_entry.get("lesson_title", ""))
	result["topic"] = str(lesson_entry.get("pronunciation_topic", ""))
	result["tip"] = {}
	result["exercises"] = []

	for page in lesson_entry.get("pages", []):
		match str(page.get("page_type", "")):
			"tip":
				result["tip"] = page
			"exercise":
				if _is_workbook_exercise(page):
					continue
				result["exercises"].append(page)

	return result

# Finds the requested lesson inside the nested books -> lessons structure.
func _find_lesson(books: Array, book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> Dictionary:
	for book in books:
		var bn := _book_number(book)
		if bn != book_number:
			continue
		for lesson in book.get("lessons", []):
			if int(lesson.get("lesson_number", 0)) == lesson_number:
				return lesson
	return {}

# "Vision 1" -> 1, "Vision 2" -> 2, ...
func _book_number(book: Dictionary) -> int:
	var book_name := str(book.get("book", ""))
	var m := RegEx.new()
	m.compile("(\\d+)")
	var match := m.search(book_name)
	if match:
		return int(match.get_string(1))
	return -1

# Exercises that point to the school workbook are skipped on purpose.
func _is_workbook_exercise(page: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var en := str(page.get("instruction_en", "")).to_lower()
	var fa := str(page.get("instruction_fa", "")).to_lower()
	if "workbook" in en or "part iv" in en or "part 4" in en:
		return true
	if "کتاب کار" in fa or "بخش چهارم" in fa:
		return true
	return false

# ============================================================
# PAGE BUILDING
# ============================================================
func _build_pages() -> void:
	var exercises: Array = _data.get("exercises", [])
	var tip: Dictionary = _data.get("tip", {})

	# Page 0 = the tip box + extra Persian explanation (tip only).
	if not tip.is_empty():
		_add_page(_page_reveals.size(), _build_tip_page(tip))

	# Page 1, 2, ... = one exercise per page (A, B, ...).
	for i in range(exercises.size()):
		_add_page(_page_reveals.size(), _build_exercise_page(exercises[i]))

func _add_page(index: int, content: Control) -> void:
	var title := _page_title(index)
	page_view.add_page("pron_%d" % index, title, _page_icon(index), content)
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)

func _page_title(index: int) -> String:
	if index == 0:
		return "نکته"
	var exercises: Array = _data.get("exercises", [])
	if index - 1 < exercises.size():
		return _exercise_letter(exercises[index - 1])
	return "تمرین"

func _page_icon(index: int) -> String:
	if index == 0:
		return "📖"
	return "✏️"

func _build_tip_page(tip: Dictionary) -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	var index := _page_reveals.size()
	_page_reveals[index] = []

	var banner := _make_lesson_banner(str(_data.get("lesson_title", "")), str(_data.get("topic", "")))
	page.add_child(banner)
	_page_reveals[index].append(banner)

	var tip_card := _make_tip_card(tip)
	page.add_child(tip_card)
	_page_reveals[index].append(tip_card)

	var info_card := _make_tip_info_card(tip)
	page.add_child(info_card)
	_page_reveals[index].append(info_card)
	return page

func _build_exercise_page(exercise: Dictionary) -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	var index := _page_reveals.size()
	_page_reveals[index] = []
	var ex_card := _make_exercise_card(exercise)
	page.add_child(ex_card)
	_page_reveals[index].append(ex_card)
	return page

# ============================================================
# WIDGETS
# ============================================================
func _make_lesson_banner(lesson_title: String, topic: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	style.set_content_margin_all(22)
	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)

	var title := _make_label(lesson_title, 44, Color.WHITE, true)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(title)

	if topic != "":
		var topic_l := _make_label(topic, 34, Color("E0F2FE"), false)
		topic_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		vb.add_child(topic_l)

	banner.add_child(vb)
	return banner

# A colourful, framed box for the pronunciation tip.
func _make_tip_card(tip: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _tip_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.border_width_left = 10
	style.border_color = TIP_BORDER
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)

	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	var icon := Label.new()
	icon.text = "💡"
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(58 * FONT_SCALE))
	icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	head.add_child(icon)
	var title := _make_label("Tip  /  نکته", 42, TIP_TITLE, true, false)
	title.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	head.add_child(title)
	vb.add_child(head)

	vb.add_child(_make_label(str(tip.get("content_en", "")), 37, _text_color(), false))

	var fa := str(tip.get("content_fa", ""))
	if fa != "":
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(fa, 33, _text_soft_color()))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card

func _tip_bg() -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return _dark_tint(TIP_BORDER)
	return Color("FEF3C7")

# Extra Persian explanation shown under the tip box to enrich the tip page.
# Reads "more_tip_fa" from the lesson's tip page in the JSON; falls back to
# a short generic explanation when a lesson has none.
func _make_tip_info_card(tip: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _info_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.border_width_left = 10
	style.border_color = Color("#0EA5E9")
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)

	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	var icon := Label.new()
	icon.text = "📌"
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(54 * FONT_SCALE))
	icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	head.add_child(icon)
	var title := _make_label("توضیح بیشتر  /  More", 40, Color("#0369A1"), true, false)
	title.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	head.add_child(title)
	vb.add_child(head)

	var more := str(tip.get("more_tip_fa", "")).strip_edges()
	if more != "":
		# Lesson-specific, richer explanation authored in the JSON.
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(more, 32, _text_color()))
	else:
		var info := "آهنگ جمله (intonation) یعنی بالا و پایین رفتن صدای شما در هنگام صحبت. به پایان هر جمله دقت کنید: اگر جمله خبری باشد یا اطلاعات جدیدی بدهد، صدای شما معمولاً در پایان پایین می‌رود؛ اگر جمله سؤال بله/خیر یا بررسی اطلاعات باشد، صدای شما در پایان بالا می‌رود. برای یادگیری بهتر، هر جمله را چند بار بلند بخوانید و با گزینهٔ صدا مقایسه کنید تا این مهارت برایتان طبیعی شود."
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(info, 32, _text_color()))
		var hint := "💬 سعی کنید ابتدا به صدای ضبط‌شده گوش دهید، سپس همان جمله را با همان آهنگ تکرار کنید و صدای خودتان را ضبط و مقایسه کنید."
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(hint, 30, _text_soft_color()))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card

func _info_bg() -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return _dark_tint(Color("#38BDF8"))
	return Color("E0F2FE")

func _make_exercise_card(exercise: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	style.border_width_left = 5
	style.border_color = EXERCISE_ACCENT
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)

	var letter := _exercise_letter(exercise)

	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	head.add_child(_make_letter_badge(letter))
	var ex_title := _make_label("Exercise  /  تمرین", 40, EXERCISE_ACCENT, true, false)
	ex_title.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	head.add_child(ex_title)
	vb.add_child(head)

	# Audio button near the top of the exercise (only when an audio file exists).
	var audio_path := _exercise_audio_path(letter)
	if audio_path != "" and Content.has_asset(audio_path):
		vb.add_child(_make_audio_btn(audio_path))

	# Answerable exercises run inside the shared interactive ExerciseEngine.
	var engine_data: Dictionary = exercise.get("engine", {})
	if not engine_data.is_empty():
		_build_engine_block(vb, exercise, engine_data)
	else:
		var instr_en := str(exercise.get("instruction_en", ""))
		if instr_en != "":
			vb.add_child(_make_label(instr_en, 35, _text_color(), false))
		var instr_fa := str(exercise.get("instruction_fa", ""))
		if instr_fa != "":
			vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(instr_fa, 30, _text_soft_color()))

		var note_text := str(exercise.get("note", ""))
		if note_text != "" and note_text.to_lower() != "none":
			vb.add_child(_make_note_label(note_text))

		for item in exercise.get("items", []):
			vb.add_child(_make_item_row(item))

		var text_en := str(exercise.get("text_en", ""))
		if text_en != "":
			vb.add_child(_make_item_row({"en": text_en, "fa": str(exercise.get("text_fa", ""))}))

		for line in exercise.get("dialogue", []):
			vb.add_child(_make_dialogue_line(line))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card

# ============================================================
# INTERACTIVE ENGINE BLOCK (answerable exercises)
# ============================================================
func _build_engine_block(target_vb: VBoxContainer, exercise: Dictionary, engine_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var merged := exercise.duplicate(true)
	merged["type"] = str(engine_data.get("type", "multiple_choice"))
	merged["items"] = engine_data.get("items", [])
	if engine_data.has("options"):
		merged["options"] = engine_data.get("options", [])
	if engine_data.has("passage"):
		merged["passage"] = engine_data.get("passage", "")
	if engine_data.has("note"):
		merged["note"] = engine_data.get("note", "")
	# The engine reads "instruction" (en/fa) directly.
	merged["instruction"] = {
		"en": str(exercise.get("instruction_en", "")),
		"fa": str(exercise.get("instruction_fa", ""))
	}
	# Our own header already shows the letter badge, so don't duplicate it.
	merged["show_letter"] = false

	var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
	target_vb.add_child(engine)
	engine.build(merged)
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(engine)

func _make_letter_badge(letter: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var badge := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = EXERCISE_ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(30)
	style.set_content_margin_all(10)
	badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = letter
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(44 * FONT_SCALE))
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	if font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	badge.add_child(l)
	return badge

func _make_note_label(text: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var note := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.0)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	style.border_width_bottom = 2
	style.border_color = _dark_tint(ACCENT)
	style.set_content_margin_all(10)
	note.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	var l := _make_label(text, 27, _text_soft_color(), false)
	l.add_theme_font_style_override("italic", true)
	note.add_child(l)
	return note

func _make_item_row(item: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _item_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	if not Global.theme_is_dark():
		style.border_width_left = 4
		style.border_color = EXERCISE_ACCENT
	style.set_content_margin_all(14)
	row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	var en := str(item.get("en", ""))
	if en != "":
		vb.add_child(_make_label(en, 35, _text_color(), false))
	var fa := str(item.get("fa", ""))
	if fa != "":
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(fa, 29, _text_soft_color()))
	row.add_child(vb)
	return row

func _item_bg() -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return _dark_tint(Color("38BDF8"))
	return Color("E0F2FE")

func _make_dialogue_line(line: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		style.bg_color = _dark_tint(Color("A78BFA"))
	else:
		style.bg_color = Color("EDE9FE")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	style.set_content_margin_all(12)
	row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var hb := HBoxContainer.new()
	hb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	var badge := _make_letter_badge(str(line.get("speaker", "?")))
	badge.modulate = Color("8B5CF6")
	hb.add_child(badge)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	vb.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	var en := str(line.get("en", ""))
	if en != "":
		vb.add_child(_make_label(en, 33, _text_color(), false))
	var fa := str(line.get("fa", ""))
	if fa != "":
		vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(fa, 28, _text_soft_color()))
	hb.add_child(vb)

	row.add_child(hb)
	return row

# ============================================================
# AUDIO BUTTON -> shared AudioPanel
# ============================================================
# Maps the exercise letter to an index: A=1, B=2, C=3, ...
func _letter_index(letter: String) -> int:
	var code := letter.unicode_at(0)
	if code >= 65 and code <= 90:   # 'A'..'Z'
		return code - 65 + 1
	return 1

func _exercise_letter(exercise: Dictionary) -> String:
	var letter := str(exercise.get("exercise_letter", ""))
	if letter == "":
		return "?"
	return letter

func _exercise_audio_path(letter: String) -> String:
	if letter == "?":
		return ""
	var filename := "p%d.mp3" % _letter_index(letter)
	return Global.get_audio_path(Global.current_book, Global.current_lesson, filename)

func _make_audio_btn(audio_path: String) -> Button:
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = "🔊  پخش صدا"
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(300, 0)
	btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(32 * FONT_SCALE))

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color("0EA5E9")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	style.set_content_margin_all(14)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
	var hover := style.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	hover.bg_color = Color("38BDF8")
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hover)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	if font_bold:
		btn.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	btn.pressed.connect(func():
		_tap_scale(btn)
		_open_audio(audio_path)
	)
	return btn

func _open_audio(audio_path: String) -> void:
	if audio_panel == null or not is_instance_valid(audio_panel):
		return
	audio_panel.load_and_play(audio_path)

func _on_audio_closed() -> void:
	pass

# ============================================================
# THEME / STYLE HELPERS
# ============================================================
func _add_page_view_background() -> void:
	if page_view.has_meta("dark_bg"):
		return
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	page_view.add_child(bg)
	page_view.move_child(bg, 0)
	page_view.set_meta("dark_bg", bg)

func _apply_dark_scroll_background(root: Control) -> void:
	for child in root.get_children():
		if child is ScrollContainer:
			var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
			style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
			child.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
		elif child is Control:
			_apply_dark_scroll_background(child)

func _dark_tint(color: Color, amount := 0.18) -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("surface").lerp(Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 1.0), amount)

func _text_color() -> Color:
	return Color.WHITE if Global.theme_is_dark() else Color.BLACK

func _text_soft_color() -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return Color("CBD5E1")
	return Color(0.25, 0.28, 0.34)

func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)
	if background != null:
		background.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	if page_view.has_meta("dark_bg"):
		var bg: ColorRect = page_view.get_meta("dark_bg")
		bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)

func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color, bold: bool, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(float(font_size) * FONT_SCALE))
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	if bold and font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	return l

func _make_fa_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color = Color.WHITE, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(float(font_size) * FONT_SCALE))
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	return l

# ============================================================
# INTERACTION / NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_page_changed(index: int, _page_id: String) -> void:
	_play_reveal(index)

func _play_reveal(index: int) -> void:
	if _page_revealed.get(index, false):
		return
	_page_revealed[index] = true
	var cards: Array = _page_reveals.get(index, [])
	for i in cards.size():
		var card: Control = cards[i]
		card.modulate.a = 0.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(
			card,
			"modulate:a",
			1.0,
			0.3
		).set_delay(0.07 * i).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

func _tap_scale(control: Control) -> void:
	control.pivot_offset = control.size / 2.0
	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(0.94, 0.94), 0.06)
	t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.1)

func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	if audio_panel != null and is_instance_valid(audio_panel):
		audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	_tap_scale(home_button)
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")

func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	if audio_panel != null and is_instance_valid(audio_panel):
		audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	_tap_scale(back_button)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)

func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_button_pressed()
```

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
#  PURCHASE — placeholder screen.
#  The real purchase flow isn't implemented yet; this screen
#  exists so the side menu shows a friendly, themed message
#  instead of a blank page.
# ============================================================
@onready var _message_label: Label = $CenterBox/MessageLabel
@onready var _subtitle_label: Label = $CenterBox/SubLabel
@onready var _background: ColorRect = $Bg

func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_refresh_status()
	API.logged_in.connect(func(_user: Dictionary) -> void: _refresh_status())
	API.logged_out.connect(_refresh_status)
	API.subscription_updated.connect(func(_sub: Dictionary) -> void: _refresh_status())


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_background.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	_message_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	_subtitle_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))


func _refresh_status() -> void:
	var tier: String = str(API.get_subscription().get("tier", "free"))
	if not API.is_logged_in():
		_message_label.text = "برای مشاهده و فعال‌سازی اشتراک وارد حساب شوید."
		_subtitle_label.text = "با ورود به حساب، وضعیت اشتراک شما اینجا نمایش داده می‌شود."
	elif tier != "free":
		_message_label.text = "اشتراک ویژه فعال است ✓"
		_subtitle_label.text = "به همه بخش‌های آموزشی دسترسی کامل دارید."
	else:
		_message_label.text = "اشتراک فعلی: رایگان"
		_subtitle_label.text = "همه بخش‌های آموزشی فعلاً رایگان هستند."


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")
```

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# READING SCENE — PageView Edition (Single Box Reading Layout)
# Three swipeable pages: Reading / Strategy / Practice
# Keeps: audio-text sync, dictionary popup, translation toggle,
#        clickable words, and the full Reading Strategy lesson.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

# Reading box accent colors
const PARA_BG_COLOR      := Color("#1a2f5c")
const PARA_BORDER_COLOR  := Color("#22D3EE")
const HIGHLIGHT_COLOR    := Color("#fbbf24")
const BACKGROUND_OPACITY := 0.08

# ---------- Font configuration ----------
const FONT_JAKARTA_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_JAKARTA_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_JAKARTA_ITALIC_PATH  := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Italic.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN            := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_italic: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

# ---------- Per-strategy visual theme (from Reading Strategy scene) ----------
const STRATEGY_THEMES := {
	"Scanning":                    { "accent": Color("#22D3EE"), "soft": Color("#1a2f5c"), "icon": "🔍" },
	"Skimming":                    { "accent": Color("#34D399"), "soft": Color("#1a2d2a"), "icon": "📖" },
	"Recognizing Reference Words": { "accent": Color("#EC4899"), "soft": Color("#2d1f4e"), "icon": "🔗" },
	"Question Generation":         { "accent": Color("#FBBF24"), "soft": Color("#2d2a1f"), "icon": "❓" },
	"Highlighting":                { "accent": Color("#A78BFA"), "soft": Color("#2d1f4e"), "icon": "🖍️" },
	"Note Taking":                 { "accent": Color("#34D399"), "soft": Color("#1a2d2a"), "icon": "📝" },
}
const DEFAULT_THEME := { "accent": Color("#22D3EE"), "soft": Color("#1a2f5c"), "icon": "🎯" }

# Touch tracking variables for mobile scrolling & word tap detection
var _touch_start_pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var _is_drag_scrolling: bool = false
var _touch_start_time: float = 0.0
var _touch_max_distance: float = 0.0

# ============================================================
# NODE REFERENCES
# ============================================================
@onready var header_bar: Control              = $HeaderBar
@onready var header_content: HBoxContainer    = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent
@onready var back_button: Button              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label              = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var audio_button: Button             = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/AudioButton
@onready var translation_toggle: Button       = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/TranslationToggleButton
@onready var background_image: TextureRect    = $BackgroundImage
@onready var page_view: PageView              = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView
@onready var audio_panel: PanelContainer      = $AudioPanel

# Reading page widgets (Single-box architecture)
var reading_image: TextureRect
var reading_title_label: Label
var author_label: Label
var hero_container: VBoxContainer
var reading_panel: PanelContainer
var reading_rtl: RichTextLabel
var reading_translation_label: Label
var raw_paragraphs_data: Array = []

# Collapsing cover state
const HERO_MAX_HEIGHT := 520.0
var _hero_collapse_progress: float = 0.0 # 0.0 = expanded, 1.0 = collapsed

# Strategy page widgets
var content_layout: VBoxContainer
var _strategy_entrance_played := false
var _reveal_cards: Array[Control] = []
var strategy_fa_nodes: Array[Control] = []

# Dictionary / Popup Variables
var word_regex := RegEx.new()
var current_word_data: Dictionary = {}
var current_highlighted_word: String = ""

# Audio Sync Variables
var all_sentences_sync: Array = []
var _last_active_sentence: Dictionary = {}
var _sync_index: int = 0
var dict_popup: DictionaryPopup

# Translation toggle
var show_translation: bool = false

# Store current lesson data
var current_book: int = 0
var current_lesson: int = 0


# ============================================================
# READY — build the three pages
# ============================================================
func _ready() -> void:
	page_view.add_swipe_blocker(audio_panel)
	page_view.add_swipe_blocker(header_bar)
	
	var apostrophes := "'%s%s" % [char(0x2018), char(0x2019)]
	word_regex.compile("\\b([a-zA-Z]+(?:[%s-][a-zA-Z]+)*)\\b" % apostrophes)
	_load_fonts()
	if font_bold:
		header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	
	dict_popup = DictionaryPopup.new()
	add_child(dict_popup)
	dict_popup.popup_closed.connect(_on_popup_closed)
	
	_configure_background_image()
	
	# General UI Connections
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	audio_button.pressed.connect(_on_audio_pressed)
	translation_toggle.pressed.connect(_on_translation_toggle_pressed)
	page_view.page_changed.connect(_on_page_changed)
	
	# Audio Panel Connections
	audio_panel.playback_updated.connect(_update_audio_sync)
	audio_panel.audio_closed.connect(_on_audio_stopped)
	audio_panel.audio_finished.connect(_on_audio_stopped)
	
	current_book = Global.current_book
	current_lesson = Global.current_lesson
	
	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nخواندن" % current_lesson)
	Content.ensure_lesson(current_book, current_lesson)
	
	var data: Dictionary          = Global.load_reading(current_book, current_lesson)
	var strategy_data: Dictionary = Global.load_category("reading_strategies", current_book, current_lesson)
	var comp_data: Dictionary     = Global.load_category("reading_comprehension", current_book, current_lesson)
	
	# Build the three pages
	_build_reading_page(data)
	_build_strategy_page(strategy_data) # adds a page only for Vision 2 & 3
	_build_comprehension_page(comp_data)
	
	_update_toggle_button_text()
	
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	_apply_theme()


# ============================================================
# PAGE BUILDERS
# ============================================================
func _make_page_spacer() -> Control:
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 200) # clears the audio panel
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return spacer


# ---------- PAGE 1: READING (Single Box) ----------
func _build_reading_page(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.name = "ReadingPage"
	page.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	
	# 1. Collapsible Hero Section (Cover Image + Title + Metadata)
	hero_container = VBoxContainer.new()
	hero_container.name = "HeroContainer"
	hero_container.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	hero_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	hero_container.clip_contents = true
	
	reading_image = TextureRect.new()
	reading_image.name = "SharpCover"
	_configure_main_image()
	hero_container.add_child(reading_image)
	
	var title_box := VBoxContainer.new()
	title_box.name = "TitleSection"
	title_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	
	reading_title_label = Label.new()
	reading_title_label.name = "ReadingTitleLabel"
	reading_title_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	reading_title_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	reading_title_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 54)
	reading_title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	if font_bold:
		reading_title_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	title_box.add_child(reading_title_label)
	
	author_label = Label.new()
	author_label.name = "AuthorLabel"
	author_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	author_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	author_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	author_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	if font_regular:
		author_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	author_label.visible = false
	title_box.add_child(author_label)
	
	hero_container.add_child(title_box)
	page.add_child(hero_container)
	
	# 2. Single Unified Reading Box
	reading_panel = PanelContainer.new()
	reading_panel.name = "ReadingPanel"
	reading_panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	reading_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
```
