```gdscript
# ============================================================
# INPUT & COLLAPSING COVER ANIMATION
# ============================================================
func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	super._input(event)
	
	if event is InputEventScreenTouch or (event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT):
		if event.pressed:
			_touch_start_pos = event.position
			_touch_start_time = Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
			_touch_max_distance = 0.0
			_is_drag_scrolling = false
		else:
			if _touch_start_pos.distance_to(event.position) > 15.0:
				_is_drag_scrolling = true
				
	elif event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed:
		if event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
			_update_hero_collapse(-60.0)
		elif event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
			_update_hero_collapse(60.0)
			
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag or (event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)):
		var dist := _touch_start_pos.distance_to(event.position)
		if dist > _touch_max_distance:
			_touch_max_distance = dist
		if dist > 15.0:
			_is_drag_scrolling = true
			_update_hero_collapse(event.relative.y)


func _update_hero_collapse(scroll_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(reading_image) or not reading_image.visible:
		return
	
	var delta_progress := -scroll_delta / HERO_MAX_HEIGHT
	_hero_collapse_progress = clampf(_hero_collapse_progress + delta_progress, 0.0, 1.0)
	
	var current_h := lerpf(HERO_MAX_HEIGHT, 0.0, _hero_collapse_progress)
	reading_image.custom_minimum_size.y = current_h
	reading_image.modulate.a = 1.0 - (_hero_collapse_progress * 0.85)

# IMAGE / FONT CONFIG
# ============================================================
func _configure_main_image() -> void:
	reading_image.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	reading_image.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED

# ============================================================
# DATA LOADING & SINGLE-BOX TEXT BUILDING
# ============================================================
func _build_reading(_book: int, _lesson: int, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	all_sentences_sync.clear()
	_sync_index = 0
	_hero_collapse_progress = 0.0
	
	var image_filename: String = data.get("image", "") as String
	if image_filename != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(image_filename):
		var tex: Texture2D = load(image_filename)
		background_image.texture = tex
		background_image.visible = true
		reading_image.texture = tex
		reading_image.visible = true
		reading_image.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, HERO_MAX_HEIGHT)
		reading_image.modulate.a = 1.0
	else:
		background_image.visible = false
		reading_image.visible = false
		reading_image.custom_minimum_size = Vector2.ZERO
	
	var title: String = data.get("title", "") as String
	reading_title_label.text = title
	reading_title_label.visible = title != ""
	
	var author: String = data.get("author", "") as String
	if is_instance_valid(author_label):
		author_label.text = author
		author_label.visible = author != ""
	
	var paragraphs: Array = data.get("paragraphs", []) as Array
	_build_single_reading_box(paragraphs)
	
	var audio_path: String = data.get("audio", "") as String
	set_meta("audio_path", audio_path)


func _build_single_reading_box(paragraphs: Array) -> void:
	raw_paragraphs_data.clear()
	var fa_blocks: PackedStringArray = []
	
	for p_idx in range(paragraphs.size()):
		var para_obj: Dictionary = paragraphs[p_idx] as Dictionary
		if para_obj.is_empty():
			continue
		var sentences: Array = para_obj.get("sentences", []) as Array
		if sentences.is_empty():
			continue
			
		var block_idx: int = raw_paragraphs_data.size()
		raw_paragraphs_data.append(sentences)
		
		var para_fa := ""
		for s_idx in range(sentences.size()):
			var sentence: Dictionary = sentences[s_idx]
			var fa_str: String = sentence.get("fa", "").strip_edges()
			if fa_str != "":
				para_fa += fa_str + " "
			if sentence.has("start") and sentence.has("end"):
				all_sentences_sync.append({
					"block_idx": block_idx,
					"sentence_idx": s_idx,
					"start": sentence.get("start", 0.0),
					"end": sentence.get("end", 0.0)
				})
		para_fa = para_fa.strip_edges()
		if para_fa != "":
			fa_blocks.append(para_fa)
			
	if is_instance_valid(reading_translation_label):
		reading_translation_label.text = "\n\n".join(fa_blocks)
		
	_refresh_all_text()

func _update_audio_sync(current_time: float) -> void:
	var active_sentence: Dictionary = _find_active_sentence(current_time)
	if not _is_same_sentence(active_sentence, _last_active_sentence):
		_last_active_sentence = active_sentence
		_refresh_all_text()


## Time-ordered sentence lookup with a forward-advancing cursor (O(1) per
## frame on forward playback) instead of scanning the whole array every frame.
func _find_active_sentence(current_time: float) -> Dictionary:
	var arr: Array = all_sentences_sync
	if arr.is_empty():
		_sync_index = 0
		return {}
	if _sync_index >= arr.size():
		_sync_index = arr.size() - 1
	if current_time < float(arr[_sync_index].get("start", 0.0)):
		_sync_index = 0 # backward seek — restart the scan
	while _sync_index < arr.size() \
			and current_time > float(arr[_sync_index].get("end", 0.0)):
		_sync_index += 1
	if _sync_index >= arr.size():
		_sync_index = arr.size() - 1
		return {}
	var s: Dictionary = arr[_sync_index]
	if current_time >= float(s.get("start", 0.0)) \
			and current_time <= float(s.get("end", 0.0)):
		return s
	return {}


func _is_same_sentence(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if a.is_empty() and b.is_empty():
		return true
	if a.is_empty() or b.is_empty():
		return false
	return a["block_idx"] == b["block_idx"] and a["sentence_idx"] == b["sentence_idx"]


func _refresh_all_text() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(reading_rtl):
		return
		
	var paragraph_bbcodes: PackedStringArray = []
	for block_idx in range(raw_paragraphs_data.size()):
		var sentences: Array = raw_paragraphs_data[block_idx]
		var para_bbcode := ""
		for s_idx in range(sentences.size()):
			var s: Dictionary = sentences[s_idx]
			var en_text: String = s.get("en", "").strip_edges()
			if en_text == "":
				continue
			var clickable_sentence := _format_clickable_text(en_text, current_highlighted_word)
			if _last_active_sentence.has("block_idx") and _last_active_sentence["block_idx"] == block_idx and _last_active_sentence["sentence_idx"] == s_idx:
				if Global.theme_is_dark():
					para_bbcode += "[bgcolor=#fbbf24][color=#111111]" + clickable_sentence + "[/color][/bgcolor] "
				else:
					para_bbcode += "[bgcolor=#bfdbfe]" + clickable_sentence + "[/bgcolor] "
			else:
				para_bbcode += clickable_sentence + " "
		para_bbcode = para_bbcode.strip_edges()
		if para_bbcode != "":
			paragraph_bbcodes.append(para_bbcode)
			
	reading_rtl.text = "\n\n".join(paragraph_bbcodes)


# ============================================================
# DICTIONARY POPUP & TOGGLES
# ============================================================
func _format_clickable_text(base_text: String, highlight_word: String) -> String:
	var out := ""
	var last_end := 0

	var normalized_highlight := ""
	if highlight_word != "":
		normalized_highlight = _normalize_word(highlight_word)

	for m in word_regex.search_all(base_text):
		var start: int = m.get_start()
		var end: int = m.get_end()
		var word: String = base_text.substr(start, end - start)

		out += base_text.substr(last_end, start - last_end)
		var safe_meta := _encode_word_meta(word)

		if normalized_highlight != "" and _normalize_word(word) == normalized_highlight:
			out += "[bgcolor=#fef08a][color=#000000][url=%s]%s[/url][/color][/bgcolor]" % [
				safe_meta, word
			]
		else:
			out += "[url=%s]%s[/url]" % [
				safe_meta, word
			]

		last_end = end

	out += base_text.substr(last_end, base_text.length() - last_end)
	return out


func _normalize_word(word: String) -> String:
	var normalized := word
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x2018), "'") # ‘
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x2019), "'") # ’
	normalized = normalized.replace(char(0x00B4), "'") # ´
	normalized = normalized.replace("`", "'")
	return normalized.to_lower()


func _encode_word_meta(word: String) -> String:
	return _normalize_word(word).replace("'", "%27")


func _on_word_clicked(meta: Variant) -> void:
	var press_duration := (Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0) - _touch_start_time

	if _is_drag_scrolling or _touch_max_distance > 15.0 or press_duration > 0.35:
		return

	var clicked_string := str(meta).replace("%27", "'")
	clicked_string = _normalize_word(clicked_string)

	var def := Global.get_word_definition_from_current_lesson(clicked_string)
	if def.is_empty():
		return

	current_word_data = def
	current_highlighted_word = clicked_string

	_refresh_all_text()
	dict_popup.show_word(def)


func _on_popup_closed() -> void:
	current_highlighted_word = ""
	_refresh_all_text()


func _update_toggle_button_text() -> void:
	Global.set_translation_toggle_state(translation_toggle, show_translation)


func _on_translation_toggle_pressed() -> void:
	show_translation = !show_translation
	_update_toggle_button_text()
	
	if is_instance_valid(reading_translation_label):
		reading_translation_label.visible = show_translation
			
	for node in strategy_fa_nodes:
		if is_instance_valid(node):
			node.visible = show_translation

func _build_steps(strategy: Dictionary, th: Dictionary) -> void:
	var steps: Array = strategy.get("steps", [])
	if steps.is_empty():
		return
	var accent: Color = th["accent"]
	var soft: Color = th["soft"]
	
	content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("How to do it", "چگونه انجام دهیم", accent))
	
	var timeline := VBoxContainer.new()
	timeline.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	
	for i in steps.size():
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
		
		var rail := VBoxContainer.new()
		rail.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
		rail.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56, 0)
		
		var circle := Label.new()
		circle.text = str(i + 1)
		circle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
		circle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
		circle.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		circle.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		var c_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		c_style.bg_color = accent
		c_style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
		c_style.set_content_margin_all(12)
		circle.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", c_style)
		if font_bold:
			circle.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
		rail.add_child(circle)
		
		if i < steps.size() - 1:
			var connector := ColorRect.new()
			connector.color = accent.lightened(0.6)
			connector.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(3, 0)
			connector.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			connector.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			rail.add_child(connector)
		
		var card := _make_soft_card(soft, accent)
		var step_vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
		step_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
		
		var en := Label.new()
		en.text = steps[i]["en"]
		en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
		en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
		if font_regular:
			en.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
		step_vbox.add_child(en)
		
		var fa := Label.new()
		fa.text = steps[i]["fa"]
		fa.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
		fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
		fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
		if font_farsi:
			fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
		fa.visible = show_translation
		strategy_fa_nodes.append(fa)
		step_vbox.add_child(fa)
		
		card.add_child(step_vbox)
		_add_hover_lift(card)
		
		row.add_child(rail)
		row.add_child(card)
		timeline.add_child(row)
		_reveal_cards.append(row)
	
	content_layout.add_child(timeline)


func _build_reference_materials(strategy: Dictionary, th: Dictionary) -> void:
	var accent: Color = th["accent"]
	var soft: Color = th["soft"]
	
	if strategy.has("question_starters"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Question Starters", "کلمات پرسشی", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for qs in strategy["question_starters"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(
				qs["starter"] + "  →  " + qs["answer_type"]["en"],
				qs["fa"] + "  →  " + qs["answer_type"]["fa"],
				accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	if strategy.has("common_reference_words"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Common Reference Words", "کلمات ارجاعی رایج", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for rw in strategy["common_reference_words"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(rw["en"], rw["fa"], accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	if strategy.has("useful_symbols"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Useful Symbols & Abbreviations", "نمادها و اختصارات", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for sym in strategy["useful_symbols"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(sym["symbol"] + "  =  " + sym["meaning"]["en"], sym["meaning"]["fa"], accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	if strategy.has("key_questions"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Ask Yourself", "از خود بپرسید", accent))
		for kq in strategy["key_questions"]:
			var card := _make_soft_card(soft, accent)
			var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
			vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
			var en := _make_label(kq["en"], 36, Global.get_theme_color("text"), false)
			var fa := _make_label(kq["fa"], 33, Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"), false)
			fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
			fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
			if font_farsi:
				fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
			fa.visible = show_translation
			strategy_fa_nodes.append(fa)
			vb.add_child(en)
			vb.add_child(fa)
			card.add_child(vb)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)


func _build_persian_insights(strategy: Dictionary, th: Dictionary) -> void:
	var accent: Color = th["accent"]
	
	var extra: Array = strategy.get("extra_fa", [])
	if not extra.is_empty():
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("بیشتر بدانید", "More to Know", accent, true))
		for tip in extra:
			var card := _make_insight_card(str(tip), accent)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)
	
	var tips: Array = strategy.get("tips_fa", [])
	if not tips.is_empty():
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("نکات کاربردی", "Practical Tips", accent, true))
		for t in tips:
			var card := _make_insight_card("✅ " + str(t), accent)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)


func _make_insight_card(text: String, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _card_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_right = 5
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35)
	style.shadow_size = 8
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 4)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi:
		label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	card.add_child(label)
	_add_hover_lift(card)
	return card


func _build_practice(exercises: Array, th: Dictionary) -> void:
	if exercises.is_empty():
		return
	content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Practice", "تمرین", th["accent"]))
	for exercise in exercises:
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		content_layout.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)
		_reveal_cards.append(engine)


# ============================================================
# STRATEGY WIDGET HELPERS
# ============================================================
func _make_section_title(en: String, fa: String, accent: Color, rtl_primary := false) -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	
	var bar := ColorRect.new()
	bar.color = accent
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(6, 44)
	row.add_child(bar)
	
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = en if not rtl_primary else fa
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	if rtl_primary:
		title.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		if font_farsi:
			title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	else:
		if font_bold:
			title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	row.add_child(title)
	
	var sub := Label.new()
	sub.text = fa if not rtl_primary else en
	sub.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	sub.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	if not rtl_primary and font_farsi:
		sub.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	sub.visible = show_translation
	strategy_fa_nodes.append(sub)
	row.add_child(sub)
	
	return row


func _make_soft_card(_soft: Color, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_left = 5
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_content_margin_all(18)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.35)
	style.shadow_size = 8
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 4)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	return card


func _make_chip(main: String, sub: String, accent: Color, _soft: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var chip := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _card_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(22)
	style.border_width_left = 1
	style.border_width_right = 1
	style.border_width_top = 1
	style.border_width_bottom = 1
	style.border_color = accent.lightened(0.2)
	style.set_content_margin_all(14)
	chip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	
	var m := Label.new()
	m.text = main
	m.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	m.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	if font_bold:
		m.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = sub
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	s.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	s.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi:
		s.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	s.visible = show_translation
	strategy_fa_nodes.append(s)
	
	vb.add_child(m)
	vb.add_child(s)
	chip.add_child(vb)
	_add_hover_lift(chip)
	return chip


func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color, bold: bool) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	if bold and font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	return l


func _add_hover_lift(control: Control) -> void:
	control.mouse_entered.connect(func():
		control.pivot_offset = control.size / 2.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(1.015, 1.015), 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	)
	control.mouse_exited.connect(func():
		control.pivot_offset = control.size / 2.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	)


# ============================================================
# ENTRANCE ANIMATION — staggered reveal (strategy page)
# ============================================================
func _play_entrance() -> void:
	var icon := content_layout.find_child("BannerIcon", true, false) as Control
	if icon:
		icon.pivot_offset = icon.size / 2.0
		icon.scale = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
		var pop := create_tween()
		pop.tween_property(icon, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	for i in _reveal_cards.size():
		var card: Control = _reveal_cards[i]
		if not is_instance_valid(card):
			continue
		card.modulate.a = 0.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(card, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.35).set_delay(0.08 * i).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


# ============================================================
# AUDIO CONTROL
# ============================================================
func _on_audio_pressed() -> void:
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(audio_button, "scale", Vector2(0.93, 0.93), 0.08).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(audio_button, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	if not audio_panel.is_playing():
		var path: String = get_meta("audio_path", "")
		audio_panel.load_and_play(path)


func _on_audio_stopped() -> void:
	_last_active_sentence = {}
	_sync_index = 0
	_refresh_all_text()


# ============================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")


func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	audio_panel.stop_and_close()
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	if dict_popup != null and dict_popup.is_open():
		dict_popup._hide_popup()
	else:
		_on_back_button_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scenes/reading_strategy/reading_strategy.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# READING STRATEGY SCENE
# Loads from res://data/categories/reading_strategies.json
# Renders: strategy banner, step timeline, reference chips,
#          Persian tips, and interactive practice (ExerciseEngine).
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

# ---------- Fonts ----------
const FONT_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN    := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

# ---------- Per-strategy visual theme ----------
const STRATEGY_THEMES := {
	"Scanning":                     {"accent": Color("#0891B2"), "soft": Color("#ECFEFF"), "icon": "🔍"},
	"Skimming":                     {"accent": Color("#2563EB"), "soft": Color("#EFF6FF"), "icon": "📖"},
	"Recognizing Reference Words":  {"accent": Color("#7C3AED"), "soft": Color("#F5F3FF"), "icon": "🔗"},
	"Question Generation":          {"accent": Color("#EA580C"), "soft": Color("#FFF7ED"), "icon": "❓"},
	"Highlighting":                 {"accent": Color("#CA8A04"), "soft": Color("#FEFCE8"), "icon": "🖍️"},
	"Note Taking":                  {"accent": Color("#059669"), "soft": Color("#ECFDF5"), "icon": "📝"},
}
const DEFAULT_THEME := {"accent": Color("#2563EB"), "soft": Color("#EFF6FF"), "icon": "🎯"}

# ---------- Node references ----------
@onready var back_button: Button      = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var header_title: Label      = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var background: ColorRect    = $BackgroundColor
@onready var content_layout: VBoxContainer = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/ScrollContainer/ContentLayout

var _reveal_cards: Array = []   # collected for staggered entrance


func _ready() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold = load(FONT_BOLD_PATH)
	font_farsi = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)
	
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	if font_bold: header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	# Restyle live when the app theme toggles.
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	
	var book: int = Global.current_book
	var lesson: int = Global.current_lesson
	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nراهبرد خواندن" % lesson)
	
	var data: Dictionary = Global.load_category("reading_strategies", book, lesson)
	if data.is_empty() or not data.has("strategy"):
		_build_unavailable()
		return
	
	var strategy: Dictionary = data["strategy"]
	var palette: Dictionary = STRATEGY_THEMES.get(strategy["name"]["en"], DEFAULT_THEME)
	
	_build_banner(strategy, palette)
	_build_steps(strategy, palette)
	_build_reference_materials(strategy, palette)
	_build_persian_insights(strategy, palette)
	_build_practice(data.get("exercises", []), palette)
	_build_bottom_spacer()
	_play_entrance()
	_apply_theme()


# ============================================================
# THEME
# ============================================================
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	background.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	background.material = null


# ============================================================
# BANNER — the strategy's identity, big and bold
# ============================================================
func _build_banner(strategy: Dictionary, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	var accent: Color = palette["accent"]
	
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = accent
	style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	style.set_content_margin_all(28)
	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	
	var icon := Label.new()
	icon.name = "BannerIcon"
	icon.text = str(palette["icon"])
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 84)
	icon.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vbox.add_child(icon)
	
	var name_en := Label.new()
	name_en.text = strategy["name"]["en"]
	name_en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	name_en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 56)
	name_en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	name_en.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_bold: name_en.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	vbox.add_child(name_en)
	
	var name_fa := Label.new()
	name_fa.text = strategy["name"]["fa"]
	name_fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	name_fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85))
	name_fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	name_fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_farsi: name_fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	vbox.add_child(name_fa)
	
	var desc := Label.new()
	desc.text = strategy["description"]["en"]
	desc.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	desc.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	desc.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95))
	if font_regular: desc.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	vbox.add_child(desc)
	
	var desc_fa := Label.new()
	desc_fa.text = strategy["description"]["fa"]
	desc_fa.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	desc_fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	desc_fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
	desc_fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	desc_fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi: desc_fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	vbox.add_child(desc_fa)
	
	banner.add_child(vbox)
	content_layout.add_child(banner)
	_reveal_cards.append(banner)


# ============================================================
# STEPS — numbered vertical timeline
# ============================================================
func _build_steps(strategy: Dictionary, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	var steps: Array = strategy.get("steps", [])
	if steps.is_empty(): return
	
	var accent: Color = palette["accent"]
	var soft: Color = palette["soft"]
	
	content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("How to do it", "چگونه انجام دهیم", accent))
	
	var timeline := VBoxContainer.new()
	timeline.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
	
	for i in steps.size():
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
		
		# Number circle + connector line
		var rail := VBoxContainer.new()
		rail.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
		rail.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56, 0)
		
		var circle := Label.new()
		circle.text = str(i + 1)
		circle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
		circle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
		circle.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		circle.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		var c_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		c_style.bg_color = accent
		c_style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
		c_style.set_content_margin_all(12)
		circle.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", c_style)
		if font_bold: circle.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
		rail.add_child(circle)
		
		if i < steps.size() - 1:
			var connector := ColorRect.new()
			connector.color = accent.lightened(0.6)
			connector.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(3, 0)
			connector.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
			connector.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
			rail.add_child(connector)
		
		# Step text card
		var card := _make_soft_card(soft, accent)
		var step_vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
		step_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
		
		var en := Label.new()
		en.text = steps[i]["en"]
		en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
		en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", DesignTokens.INK)
		if font_regular: en.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
		step_vbox.add_child(en)
		
		var fa := Label.new()
		fa.text = steps[i]["fa"]
		fa.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
		fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#64748B"))
		fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
		if font_farsi: fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
		step_vbox.add_child(fa)
		
		card.add_child(step_vbox)
		_add_hover_lift(card)
		
		row.add_child(rail)
		row.add_child(card)
		timeline.add_child(row)
		_reveal_cards.append(row)
	
	content_layout.add_child(timeline)


# ============================================================
# REFERENCE MATERIALS — question starters / ref words / symbols
# ============================================================
func _build_reference_materials(strategy: Dictionary, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	var accent: Color = palette["accent"]
	var soft: Color = palette["soft"]
	
	# Question starters (Question Generation)
	if strategy.has("question_starters"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Question Starters", "کلمات پرسشی", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for qs in strategy["question_starters"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(
				qs["starter"] + "  →  " + qs["answer_type"]["en"],
				qs["fa"] + "  →  " + qs["answer_type"]["fa"],
				accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	# Common reference words (Recognizing Reference Words)
	if strategy.has("common_reference_words"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Common Reference Words", "کلمات ارجاعی رایج", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for rw in strategy["common_reference_words"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(rw["en"], rw["fa"], accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	# Useful symbols (Note Taking)
	if strategy.has("useful_symbols"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Useful Symbols & Abbreviations", "نمادها و اختصارات", accent))
		var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
		flow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
		for sym in strategy["useful_symbols"]:
			flow.add_child(_make_chip(sym["symbol"] + "  =  " + sym["meaning"]["en"], sym["meaning"]["fa"], accent, soft))
		content_layout.add_child(flow)
		_reveal_cards.append(flow)
	
	# Key questions (Skimming)
	if strategy.has("key_questions"):
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Ask Yourself", "از خود بپرسید", accent))
		for kq in strategy["key_questions"]:
			var card := _make_soft_card(soft, accent)
			var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
			vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
			var en := _make_label(kq["en"], 36, DesignTokens.INK, false)
			var fa := _make_label(kq["fa"], 33, Color("#64748B"), false)
			fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
			fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
			if font_farsi: fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
			
			# Ensure Farsi text toggles with translation
			
			vb.add_child(en)
			vb.add_child(fa)
			card.add_child(vb)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)


# ============================================================
# PERSIAN INSIGHTS — extra_fa + tips_fa
# ============================================================
func _build_persian_insights(strategy: Dictionary, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	var accent: Color = palette["accent"]
	
	var extra: Array = strategy.get("extra_fa", [])
	if not extra.is_empty():
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("More to Know", "بیشتر بدانید", accent))
		for tip in extra:
			var card := _make_insight_card(str(tip), accent)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)
	
	var tips: Array = strategy.get("tips_fa", [])
	if not tips.is_empty():
		content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Practical Tips", "نکات کاربردی", accent))
		for t in tips:
			var card := _make_insight_card("✅ " + str(t), accent)
			content_layout.add_child(card)
			_reveal_cards.append(card)

func _make_insight_card(text: String, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color.WHITE
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_right = 5
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", DesignTokens.INK)
	label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi: label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	card.add_child(label)
	
	# Hide Farsi insight cards initially and hook into translation toggle
	
	_add_hover_lift(card)
	return card

# ============================================================
# PRACTICE — reuse your ExerciseEngine
# ============================================================
func _build_practice(exercises: Array, palette: Dictionary) -> void:
	if exercises.is_empty(): return
	content_layout.add_child(_make_section_title("Practice", "تمرین", palette["accent"]))
	for exercise in exercises:
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		content_layout.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)
		_reveal_cards.append(engine)


# ============================================================
# SHARED WIDGET HELPERS
# ============================================================
func _make_section_title(en: String, fa: String, accent: Color, rtl_primary := false) -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	
	var bar := ColorRect.new()
	bar.color = accent
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(6, 44)
	row.add_child(bar)
	
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = fa if rtl_primary else en
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", DesignTokens.INK)
	
	if rtl_primary:
		title.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		if font_farsi:
			title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	else:
		if font_bold:
			title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	
	row.add_child(title)
	
	var sub := Label.new()
	sub.text = en if rtl_primary else fa
	sub.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	sub.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#94A3B8"))
	
	if rtl_primary:
		if font_bold:
			sub.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	else:
		if font_farsi:
			sub.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	
	
	return row


func _make_soft_card(soft: Color, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = soft
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_left = 4
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_content_margin_all(18)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	return card


func _make_chip(main: String, sub: String, accent: Color, soft: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var chip := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color.WHITE
	style.set_corner_radius_all(22)
	style.border_width_left = 1; style.border_width_right = 1
	style.border_width_top = 1; style.border_width_bottom = 1
	style.border_color = accent.lightened(0.3)
	style.set_content_margin_all(14)
	chip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	var m := Label.new()
	m.text = main
	m.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	m.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	if font_bold: m.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	var s := Label.new()
	s.text = sub
	s.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	s.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#64748B"))
	s.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	s.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi: s.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	vb.add_child(m)
	vb.add_child(s)
	chip.add_child(vb)
	_add_hover_lift(chip)
	return chip


func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color, bold: bool) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	if bold and font_bold: l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular: l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	return l


func _add_hover_lift(control: Control) -> void:
	control.mouse_entered.connect(func():
		control.pivot_offset = control.size / 2.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2(1.015, 1.015), 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	)
	control.mouse_exited.connect(func():
		control.pivot_offset = control.size / 2.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	)


# ============================================================
# ENTRANCE ANIMATION — staggered reveal
# ============================================================
func _play_entrance() -> void:
	# Pop the banner icon
	var icon := content_layout.find_child("BannerIcon", true, false)
	if icon:
		icon.pivot_offset = icon.size / 2.0
		icon.scale = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
		var pop := create_tween()
		pop.tween_property(icon, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Stagger the cards
	for i in _reveal_cards.size():
		var card: Control = _reveal_cards[i]
		card.modulate.a = 0.0
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(card, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.35).set_delay(0.08 * i).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _build_unavailable() -> void:
	var label := _make_label("📚 This lesson has no Reading Strategy section.\nReading Strategies appear in Vision 2 and Vision 3.", 38, Color("#64748B"), false)
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	content_layout.add_child(label)


func _build_bottom_spacer() -> void:
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 120)
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	content_layout.add_child(spacer)


func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	back_button.pivot_offset = back_button.size / 2.0
	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(back_button, "scale", Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)
```

## File: `res://scenes/review/word_review.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
#  WORD REVIEW SCENE — Anki-style spaced repetition
#  Replaces the old Quiz scene for reviewing saved words.
#
#  Flow per card:
#    1. Show word only (Front)
#    2. User taps "Show Answer" → reveals Back (meaning/example/etc.)
#    3. User rates Again / Hard / Good / Easy
#    4. Word is rescheduled via Global.review_word()
#       "Again" comes back later in the SAME session.
#       Hard/Good/Easy schedule it for a future day.
#    5. Repeat until the due queue for today is empty.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_SAVED_WORDS := "res://scenes/saved_words/SavedWords.tscn"

@onready var back_button: Button           = $HeaderBar/MarginContainer/Header/BackButton
@onready var due_counter: Label            = $HeaderBar/MarginContainer/Header/DueCounter
@onready var review_side_menu              = $ReviewSideMenu
@onready var open_list_menu_button: Button = $OpenListMenuButton
@onready var background_color: ColorRect = $BackgroundColor

@onready var card_panel: PanelContainer    = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel
@onready var front: PanelContainer        = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/Front
@onready var word_label: Label             = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/Front/WordLabel

@onready var back: VBoxContainer           = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace
@onready var type_label: Label             = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace/WordRow/WordRowContent/BackWordLabel
@onready var meaning_label: Label          = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace/MeaningFaRow/MeaningFaRowContent/MeaningFaLabel
@onready var example_label: Label          = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace/ExampleRow/ExampleRowContent/ExampleLabel
@onready var extra_label: Label            = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace/Extra/ExtraRowContent/ExtraLabel
@onready var phonetics_label: Label        = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/CardMargin/CardPanel/CardContent/BackFace/PhoneticsRow/PhoneticsRowContent/PhoneticsLabel

@onready var show_answer_button: Button    = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/ShowAnswerButton
@onready var rating_buttons: HBoxContainer = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/RatingButtons
@onready var again_button: Button          = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/RatingButtons/Again
@onready var hard_button: Button           = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/RatingButtons/Hard
@onready var good_button: Button           = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/RatingButtons/Good
@onready var easy_button: Button           = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/Controls/RatingButtons/Easy


var review_queue: Array       = []
var current_entry: Dictionary = {}

# How many times a single card may be pushed back into the queue within one
# session. Without a cap, repeatedly answering "again" re-appended the card
# forever and the session could never end.
const MAX_SESSION_REQUEUES := 3
var _session_requeues: Dictionary = {}


func _ready() -> void:
	Global.review_words_changed.connect(_on_review_words_changed)
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	show_answer_button.pressed.connect(_on_show_answer_pressed)
	again_button.pressed.connect(_on_rate_pressed.bind("again"))
	hard_button.pressed.connect(_on_rate_pressed.bind("hard"))
	good_button.pressed.connect(_on_rate_pressed.bind("good"))
	easy_button.pressed.connect(_on_rate_pressed.bind("easy"))
	
	# Connect the new word_selected signal
	review_side_menu.word_selected.connect(_on_word_selected_from_menu)
	
	# متصل کردن دکمه باز کردن منو
	review_side_menu.set_hamburger_button(open_list_menu_button)
	open_list_menu_button.pivot_offset = open_list_menu_button.size / 2.0 
	
	open_list_menu_button.pressed.connect(review_side_menu.toggle)
	
	_style_rating_buttons()

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()

	review_queue = Global.get_due_words()
	_load_next_card()
	_populate_word_list()

# Add this new function to handle word selection
func _on_word_selected_from_menu(word_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	"""Navigate to a specific word in the review queue"""
	# Find the word in the queue
	for i in range(review_queue.size()):
		if _is_same_entry(review_queue[i], word_data):
			# Reorder queue to put this word first
			var temp = review_queue[i]
			review_queue.remove_at(i)
			review_queue.insert(0, temp)
			_load_next_card()
			return

	# Not in the current queue (it may be scheduled for a future day, or the
	# queue was capped at SRS_NEW_CARDS_PER_SESSION). Refresh from Global and
	# try once more — the old code found the entry but never moved it to the
	# front, so it silently displayed the first card instead of the chosen one.
	review_queue = Global.get_due_words()
	for i in range(review_queue.size()):
		if _is_same_entry(review_queue[i], word_data):
			var temp = review_queue[i]
			review_queue.remove_at(i)
			review_queue.insert(0, temp)
			_load_next_card()
			return
	_update_due_counter()


func _is_same_entry(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
	return str(a.get("word", "")) == str(b.get("word", "")) \
		and int(a.get("book", 0)) == int(b.get("book", 0)) \
		and int(a.get("lesson", 0)) == int(b.get("lesson", 0))

func _on_review_words_changed():
	# This will be called every time a word is added or removed.
	# Rebuild the queue, but keep studying the card that is currently on
	# screen: re-deriving the queue and jumping to position 0 used to yank the
	# student onto an unrelated card the moment they added or removed a word.
	var keep_key := _entry_key(current_entry) if not current_entry.is_empty() else ""
	review_queue = Global.get_due_words()
	if keep_key != "":
		for i in range(review_queue.size()):
			if _entry_key(review_queue[i]) == keep_key:
				var entry = review_queue[i]
				review_queue.remove_at(i)
				review_queue.insert(0, entry)
				break
	_load_next_card()

func _populate_word_list() -> void:
	_on_review_words_changed()


func _on_review_menu_closed() -> void:
	# گرفتن مجدد صف کلمات از گلوبال در صورتی که لیست تغییر کرده باشد
	review_queue = Global.get_due_words()
	_load_next_card()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
#  VISUAL STYLING FOR RATING BUTTONS (Anki's standard color code)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
func _style_rating_buttons() -> void:
	_apply_button_color(again_button, Color("#EF4444"))  # red
	_apply_button_color(hard_button,  Color("#F59E0B"))  # orange
	_apply_button_color(good_button,  Color("#22C55E"))  # green
	_apply_button_color(easy_button,  Color("#2563EB"))  # blue

	for btn in [again_button, hard_button, good_button, easy_button]:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#FFFFFF"))
		btn.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(200, 100)  # Ensure buttons have size


func _apply_button_color(btn: Button, color: Color) -> void:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color                   = color
	style.corner_radius_top_left     = 14
	style.corner_radius_top_right    = 14
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left  = 14
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 14
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)

	var hover := style.duplicate()
	hover.bg_color = color.darkened(0.12)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
#  THEME AWARENESS — restyle cards, header, labels & buttons for
#  Dark / Light without touching layout or logic.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_theme_walk(self)


func _theme_walk(node: Node) -> void:
	# The side menu is its own theme-aware scene; don't restyle it here.
	if node.name == "ReviewSideMenu":
		return
	if node is ColorRect and node.name == "BackgroundColor":
		background_color.color = _page_bg_color()
	elif node.name == "HeaderBar" and node is PanelContainer:
		# Use the app's unified header styling so this scene matches every
		# other scene's header (bar, buttons and labels). It styles the whole
		# subtree, so don't recurse into it afterwards.
		Global.style_header(node)
		return
	elif node is PanelContainer:
		_restyle_panel(node)
	elif node is Label:
		_theme_label(node)
	elif node is Button:
		_theme_button(node)
	for child in node.get_children():
		_theme_walk(child)


func _page_bg_color() -> Color:
	if Global.theme_is_dark():
		return Color(0.10, 0.11, 0.20, 1)   # deep indigo
	return Color(0.91, 0.92, 0.98, 1)      # soft lavender-blue


func _card_color(dark: bool) -> Color:
	if dark:
		return Color(0.12, 0.35, 0.38, 1)  # deep teal
	return Color(0.34, 0.80, 0.74, 1)      # fresh mint/teal


func _row_colors(dark: bool) -> Dictionary:
	if dark:
		return {
			"WordRow":      Color(0.12, 0.42, 0.30, 1),
			"PhoneticsRow": Color(0.42, 0.40, 0.09, 1),
			"MeaningFaRow": Color(0.32, 0.23, 0.52, 1),
			"ExampleRow":   Color(0.48, 0.33, 0.07, 1),
			"Extra":        Color(0.16, 0.33, 0.52, 1),
		}
	return {
		"WordRow":      Color(0.84, 0.99, 0.90, 1),
		"PhoneticsRow": Color(0.86, 0.95, 0.60, 1),
		"MeaningFaRow": Color(0.93, 0.90, 1.00, 1),
		"ExampleRow":   Color(1.00, 0.97, 0.76, 1),
		"Extra":        Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.00, 1),
	}


# Give each panel a theme-appropriate, colourful look. The Front word face
# is transparent (no border) so it no longer draws an odd rectangle inside
# the card.
func _restyle_panel(node: PanelContainer) -> void:
	var n: String = node.name
	var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()

	# The main card — vibrant in both themes.
	if n == "CardPanel":
		style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
		style.bg_color = _card_color(dark)
		style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.25)
		style.shadow_size = 18
		style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 8)
		node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
		return

	# Front word face — fully transparent, no border.
	if n == "Front":
		var clear := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		clear.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
		clear.set_border_width_all(0)
		node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", clear)
		return

	# Back-face information rows — colourful chips.
	var row_colors := _row_colors(dark)
	if row_colors.has(n):
		style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
		style.bg_color = row_colors[n]
		node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
		return

	# Fallback for any other panel.
	style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	style.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85) if not dark else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.06)
	node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)


func _theme_label(label: Label) -> void:
	var n: String = label.name
	# Icon chips keep their fixed black-on-color styling in both themes.
	if n in ["PhonIcon", "FaIcon", "ExIcon", "ExtraIcon"]:
		return
	elif n == "WordLabel":
		# The main word reads crisply in white with a soft shadow on the
		# colourful card in both themes.
		var ls: LabelSettings = label.label_settings
		var white := Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
		var shadow := Color(0, 0, 0, 0.40)
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", white)
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
		label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 0)
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_shadow_color", shadow)
		label.add_theme_constant_override("shadow_offset_y", 5)
		if ls:
			ls.font_color = white
			ls.outline_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0)
			ls.outline_size = 0
			ls.shadow_color = shadow
			ls.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 5)
	elif n in ["DueCounter", "BackWordLabel"]:
		_set_label_color(label, Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	else:
		_set_label_color(label, Global.get_theme_color("text"))


# Sets both the theme override AND the LabelSettings font color, so the
# hardcoded black label_settings from the scene never overrides the theme.
func _set_label_color(label: Label, color: Color) -> void:
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	var ls: LabelSettings = label.label_settings
	if ls:
		ls.font_color = color


func _theme_button(btn: Button) -> void:
	if btn == back_button:
		return  # flat icon button
	elif btn == show_answer_button:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("on_accent"))
	elif btn in [again_button, hard_button, good_button, easy_button]:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	elif btn == open_list_menu_button:
		var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
		var ham := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		ham.set_corner_radius_all(30)
		# Extend the pill far to the left so the handle sticks out past the
		# left edge of the screen, like a tab of the side menu.
		ham.expand_margin_left = 200
		if dark:
			ham.bg_color = Color(0, 0.29, 0.29, 1)
			ham.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10)
		else:
			ham.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
			ham.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
		ham.set_border_width_all(1)
		open_list_menu_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", ham)
		open_list_menu_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", ham)
		open_list_menu_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", ham)
		open_list_menu_button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	else:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
#  CARD FLOW
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
func _load_next_card() -> void:
	_update_due_counter()
	
	if review_queue.is_empty():
		if Global.review_words.is_empty():
			_show_no_words_saved()
		else:
			_show_all_done()
		return
	
	current_entry = review_queue[0]
	word_label.text    = current_entry.get("word", "")
	meaning_label.text = "%s\n%s" % [
		current_entry.get("meaning_en", ""),
		current_entry.get("meaning_fa", "")
	]
	example_label.text = current_entry.get("example", "")
	
	var phonetics_text: String = current_entry.get("phonetics", "")
	if phonetics_text != "":
		phonetics_label.text = phonetics_text
		phonetics_label.visible = true
	else:
		phonetics_label.text = ""
		phonetics_label.visible = false
	
	var book: int   = current_entry.get("book", 0)
	var lesson: int = current_entry.get("lesson", 0)
	extra_label.text = ("Vision %d — Lesson %d" % [book, lesson]) if book > 0 else ""
	type_label.text = _get_state_badge(current_entry)
	
	_show_front()

# Shows a badge describing where this word is in its learning journey
func _get_state_badge(entry: Dictionary) -> String:
	Global._ensure_srs_fields(entry)
	var due: int  = entry.get("srs_due", -1)
	var reps: int = entry.get("srs_reps", 0)

	if due == -1:
		return "🆕 کلمه جدید"
	elif reps < 2:
		return "🔁 در حال یادگیری"
	else:
		return "✅ مرور"


func _show_front() -> void:
	front.visible           = true
	back.visible             = false
	show_answer_button.visible = true
	rating_buttons.visible     = false


func _on_show_answer_pressed() -> void:
	front.visible              = false
	back.visible               = true
	show_answer_button.visible = false
	rating_buttons.visible     = true
	
	# Make sure rating buttons are properly positioned and visible
	rating_buttons.show()
	rating_buttons.modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
	
	_update_rating_previews()


# Shows "in 1 day / 3 days / ..." on each rating button so the student
# understands the consequence of each choice, just like real Anki.
func _update_rating_previews() -> void:
	var previews: Dictionary = Global.preview_intervals(current_entry)
	again_button.text = "دوباره\n(%s)" % previews["again"]
	hard_button.text  = "سخت\n(%s)"   % previews["hard"]
	good_button.text  = "خوب\n(%s)"   % previews["good"]
	easy_button.text  = "آسان\n(%s)"  % previews["easy"]


func _on_rate_pressed(rating: String) -> void:
	if current_entry.is_empty():
		return
	var key := _entry_key(current_entry)

	Global.review_word(
		current_entry.get("word", ""),
		current_entry.get("book", 0),
		current_entry.get("lesson", 0),
		rating
	)

	review_queue.pop_front()
	_session_requeues.erase(key)

	# "Again" words come back later in the SAME session, not tomorrow — but
	# only up to a limit, so a word the student keeps forgetting can never
	# trap them in an endless loop.
	if rating == "again" and int(_session_requeues.get(key, 0)) < MAX_SESSION_REQUEUES:
		_session_requeues[key] = int(_session_requeues.get(key, 0)) + 1
		# Re-queue a copy: the entry in Global has just been rescheduled, and
		# the badge shown on the next visit must reflect the new state.
		review_queue.append(current_entry.duplicate(true))

	_load_next_card()


## Stable per-card key, used to count how often a card was re-queued.
func _entry_key(entry: Dictionary) -> String:
	return "%s|%d|%d" % [
		entry.get("word", ""),
		int(entry.get("book", 0)),
		int(entry.get("lesson", 0))
	]


func _update_due_counter() -> void:
	var remaining := review_queue.size()
	due_counter.text = "%s کلمه باقی مانده" % MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(remaining)) \
		if remaining > 0 else "تمام شد ✅"


# ----------------------------------------------------------------
#  SESSION COMPLETE STATE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
func _show_all_done() -> void:
	word_label.text    = "🎉\nهمه‌ی کلمات مرور شده!\nفردا دوباره سر بزن."
	front.visible               = true
	back.visible                 = false
	show_answer_button.visible   = false
	rating_buttons.visible       = false

	due_counter.text = "تمام شد ✅"

func _show_no_words_saved() -> void:
	word_label.text = "📭\nهیچ کلمه ای در لایتنر ذخیره نشده است."
	front.visible               = true
	back.visible                 = false
	show_answer_button.visible   = false
	rating_buttons.visible       = false
	due_counter.text = "لیست خالی است"

func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	# Return to whichever scene opened this review session
	var target: String = str(AppRouter.get_arg("return_route", ""))
	if target == "":
		target = SCENE_SAVED_WORDS   # safe fallback if never set
	TransitionManager.change_scene(target)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_button_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scenes/saved_words/saved_words.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
#  SAVED WORDS
#  If words exist → switches to VocabFlashcards in SAVED mode.
#  If empty → shows a friendly empty state; navigation remains available below.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_FLASHCARDS := "res://scenes/vocabulary/VocabFlashcards.tscn"

@onready var empty_state: VBoxContainer = $EmptyState


func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()

	# The empty state is only for the genuinely-empty case, so hide it up
	# front. This screen is a pass-through whenever words exist and must
	# never flash "Empty" while it is routing on to the flashcards.
	empty_state.visible = false

	# The same route is reached directly from the Main Menu drawer and from
	# older saved-word navigation. Check the current Global list at entry time.
	var saved_words: Array = Global.get_saved_words()
	if saved_words.is_empty():
		empty_state.visible = true
		return

	# Explicitly route into saved flashcards; do not depend on stale route args.
	AppRouter.set_args({"mode": "saved", "return_route": SCENE_FLASHCARDS})
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_FLASHCARDS)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	# Return to the screen that opened the saved-word flow (the flashcard hub),
	# falling back to the main menu when none was recorded.
	var back_route: String = str(AppRouter.get_arg("saved_back_route", "res://scenes/vocabulary/FlashcardHub.tscn"))
	TransitionManager.change_scene(back_route)
```
