## File: `res://scenes/settings/settings.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
## ============================================================
##  SETTINGS — a polished, feature-complete settings screen.
##  Sections:
##    • صدا و گفتار  (sound effects + English TTS)
##    • داده‌ها      (clear saved words / review words / reset all)
##    • درباره برنامه (app version, subscription, developer)
##  The app uses the Light appearance exclusively.
##  Settings persist to user://settings.json via Global.
## ============================================================


# --- Node references (match Settings.tscn) ---
@onready var bg: ColorRect          = $Bg
@onready var sound_toggle: Button    = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/SoundCard/VBox/SoundRow/SoundToggle
@onready var tts_toggle: Button      = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/SoundCard/VBox/TtsRow/TtsToggle
@onready var clear_saved_button: Button = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/DataCard/VBox/ClearSavedButton
@onready var clear_review_button: Button = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/DataCard/VBox/ClearReviewButton
@onready var reset_button: Button        = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/DataCard/VBox/ResetButton
@onready var version_value: Label = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/AboutCard/VBox/VersionRow/VersionValue
@onready var sub_value: Label     = $Scroll/Margin/Layout/AboutCard/VBox/SubRow/SubValue

var _modal_root: Control = null      # full-screen wrapper (dims + centers the card)
var _confirm_card: PanelContainer
var _dim: ColorRect
var _confirm_title: Label
var _confirm_message: Label
var _confirm_ok: Button
var _confirm_cancel: Button
var _pending_action: Callable = Callable()


func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()
	# Initialise the toggles from the persisted settings.
	_set_toggle(sound_toggle, Global.sound_enabled)
	_set_toggle(tts_toggle, Global.tts_enabled)

	# About section values.
	version_value.text = _app_version()
	sub_value.text = _subscription_text()

	# Wiring.
	sound_toggle.pressed.connect(_on_sound_toggled)
	tts_toggle.pressed.connect(_on_tts_toggled)
	clear_saved_button.pressed.connect(_on_clear_saved_pressed)
	clear_review_button.pressed.connect(_on_clear_review_pressed)
	reset_button.pressed.connect(_on_reset_pressed)

	_build_extra_sections()
	_build_confirm_dialog()
	_apply_theme()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  SOUND & TTS TOGGLES (custom on/off switch buttons)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _set_toggle(btn: Button, on: bool) -> void:
	btn.text = "روشن" if on else "خاموش"
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.content_margin_left = 26.0
	style.content_margin_top = 16.0
	style.content_margin_right = 26.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 16.0
	if on:
		style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent")
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright")
		style.set_border_width_all(2)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("on_accent"))
	else:
		style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("border")
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  THEME AWARENESS — restyle this screen with the fixed Light palette
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	# Keep the settings page on the same flat background as the rest of the app.
	bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

	# Cards + text walk the whole scene.
	_theme_walk(self)

	# Rebuild the custom toggles with the current palette.
	_set_toggle(sound_toggle, Global.sound_enabled)
	_set_toggle(tts_toggle, Global.tts_enabled)

	# Danger (reset) button: shared UI/Styles/danger treatment reads clearly
	# in both themes. Reused resource — edit the .tres to restyle.
	UiTheme.style_button(reset_button, "danger")

	# The two "clear" buttons: the scene's default white-on-white styles only
	# read on dark cards, so in Light theme they get a visible outline + fill.
	# (Hover states are irrelevant on touch devices, so every state is the same.)
	var clear_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	clear_style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	clear_style.content_margin_left = 26.0
	clear_style.content_margin_top = 20.0
	clear_style.content_margin_right = 26.0
	clear_style.content_margin_bottom = 20.0
	clear_style.set_border_width_all(2)
	clear_style.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85)
	clear_style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent")
	clear_saved_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", clear_style)
	clear_saved_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", clear_style)
	clear_saved_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", clear_style)
	clear_saved_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", clear_style)
	clear_review_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", clear_style)
	clear_review_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", clear_style)
	clear_review_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", clear_style)
	clear_review_button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", clear_style)
	var clear_fc: Color = Global.get_theme_color("accent")
	clear_saved_button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", clear_fc)
	clear_review_button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", clear_fc)

	# The runtime confirm modal follows the palette too.
	if _confirm_card != null:
		var p := _confirm_card.get_theme_stylebox("panel") as StyleBoxFlat
		p.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
		p.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent")
	_confirm_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	_confirm_message.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))

	_style_extra_buttons()


func _theme_walk(node: Node) -> void:
	var node_name: String = node.name
	if node == _modal_root:
		return
	# The bottom NavigationBar owns its own bespoke styling — leave it alone.
	if node_name == "NavigationBar":
		return
	# The app-wide header bar paints its own surface and type ramp; the card
	# style below must never repaint it.
	if node_name == "HeaderBar":
		return
	if node is ColorRect and node_name == "Bg":
		bg.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

	elif node is PanelContainer:
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(26)
		style.content_margin_left = 44.0
		style.content_margin_top = 38.0
		style.content_margin_right = 44.0
		style.content_margin_bottom = 38.0
		style.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85)
		style.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		node.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	elif node is Label:
		_theme_label(node)

	elif node is Button and node != sound_toggle and node != tts_toggle and node != reset_button:
		var btn := node as Button
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))

	for child in node.get_children():
		_theme_walk(child)


func _theme_label(label: Label) -> void:
	var n: String = label.name
	if n.ends_with("Title"):
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	elif n in ["VersionName", "DevName", "SubName"]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	else:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))


func _on_sound_toggled() -> void:
	Global.sound_enabled = not Global.sound_enabled
	Global.save_settings()
	_set_toggle(sound_toggle, Global.sound_enabled)
	if Global.sound_enabled:
		Sfx.click()


func _on_tts_toggled() -> void:
	Global.tts_enabled = not Global.tts_enabled
	Global.save_settings()
	_set_toggle(tts_toggle, Global.tts_enabled)
	# Give instant feedback: speak a sample word when it's turned on.
	if Global.tts_enabled:
		Global.speak_word("Hello")
	Sfx.click()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  DATA MANAGEMENT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_clear_saved_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	_confirm(
		"پاک کردن فلش‌کارت‌ها",
		"همه لغات ذخیره‌شده شما پاک خواهد شد. این عمل قابل بازگشت نیست.\nادامه می‌دهید؟",
		func() -> void:
			Global.clear_saved_words()
			_show_toast("فلش‌کارت‌ها پاک شدند ✓")
	)


func _on_clear_review_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	_confirm(
		"پاک کردن لایتنر",
		"همه لغات در نوبت مرور (لایتنر) پاک خواهد شد.\nتوجه: با توجه به همگام‌بودن لیست‌ها، لغات ذخیره‌شده (فلش‌کارت‌ها) هم پاک می‌شوند. این عمل قابل بازگشت نیست.\nادامه می‌دهید؟",
		func() -> void:
			Global.clear_review_words()
			_show_toast("نوبت مرور پاک شد ✓")
	)


func _on_reset_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	_confirm(
		"بازنشانی کامل",
		"همه پیشرفت شما (فلش‌کارت‌ها، لایتنر، پیشرفت گرامر و ...) برای همیشه حذف خواهد شد.\nآیا مطمئن هستید؟",
		func() -> void:
			Global.reset_all_progress()
			_show_toast("همه داده‌ها بازنشانی شد ✓")
	)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  CONFIRM MODAL — a fully custom, big and readable popup
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const ACCENT    := Color(0.545098, 0.360784, 0.964706)
const ACCENT_ON := Color(0.760784, 0.611765, 1)
const FONT_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"


func _build_confirm_dialog() -> void:
	var font: Font = load(FONT_PATH)

	# Full-screen wrapper that catches taps so nothing behind it is clickable.
	_modal_root = Control.new()
	_modal_root.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_modal_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_modal_root.visible = false
	add_child(_modal_root)

	# Dimmed backdrop so the page behind is clearly masked.
	_dim = ColorRect.new()
	_dim.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
	_dim.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_dim.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	_modal_root.add_child(_dim)

	# Centered card via a margin wrapper.
	var center_wrap := MarginContainer.new()
	center_wrap.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	center_wrap.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	center_wrap.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 90)
	center_wrap.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 240)
	center_wrap.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 90)
	center_wrap.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 240)
	_modal_root.add_child(center_wrap)

	_confirm_card = PanelContainer.new()
	_confirm_card.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	var panel := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	panel.bg_color = Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.10, 1.0)
	panel.border_width_left = 4
	panel.border_width_top = 4
	panel.border_width_right = 4
	panel.border_width_bottom = 4
	panel.border_color = ACCENT
	panel.set_corner_radius_all(28)
	panel.shadow_color = Color(ACCENT.r, ACCENT.g, ACCENT.b, 0.45)
	panel.shadow_size = 30
	panel.shadow_offset = Vector2.ZERO
	panel.content_margin_left = 56
	panel.content_margin_top = 56
	panel.content_margin_right = 56
	panel.content_margin_bottom = 52
	_confirm_card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", panel)
	center_wrap.add_child(_confirm_card)

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 34)
	_confirm_card.add_child(vbox)

	# Title — big, accent-tinted.
	_confirm_title = Label.new()
	_confirm_title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_confirm_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	_confirm_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 46)
	_confirm_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", ACCENT_ON)
	_confirm_title.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5))
	_confirm_title.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 8)
	vbox.add_child(_confirm_title)

	# Message — large and readable.
	_confirm_message = Label.new()
	_confirm_message.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_confirm_message.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_confirm_message.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	_confirm_message.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	_confirm_message.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.98))
	_confirm_message.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.4))
	_confirm_message.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
	vbox.add_child(_confirm_message)

	# Buttons — large, clear.
	var buttons := HBoxContainer.new()
	buttons.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	buttons.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 40)
	vbox.add_child(buttons)

	_confirm_ok = Button.new()
	_confirm_ok.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(270, 100)
	_confirm_ok.text = "تایید"
	_confirm_ok.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	_confirm_ok.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	_style_dialog_button(_confirm_ok, ACCENT)
	_confirm_ok.pressed.connect(_on_confirm_accepted)
	buttons.add_child(_confirm_ok)

	_confirm_cancel = Button.new()
	_confirm_cancel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(270, 100)
	_confirm_cancel.text = "انصراف"
	_confirm_cancel.add_theme_font_override("font", font)
	_confirm_cancel.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	_style_dialog_button(_confirm_cancel, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14))
	_confirm_cancel.pressed.connect(_close_confirm)
	buttons.add_child(_confirm_cancel)


func _style_dialog_button(btn: Button, bg_col: Color) -> void:
	var normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	normal.bg_color = bg_col
	normal.border_color = bg_col.lightened(0.25)
	normal.set_border_width_all(2)
	normal.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	normal.content_margin_left = 34
	normal.content_margin_top = 22
	normal.content_margin_right = 34
	normal.content_margin_bottom = 22

	var hover := normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	hover.bg_color = bg_col.lightened(0.12)
	hover.shadow_color = Color(bg_col.r, bg_col.g, bg_col.b, 0.5)
	hover.shadow_size = 14
	hover.shadow_offset = Vector2.ZERO

	var pressed := hover.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	pressed.bg_color = bg_col.darkened(0.12)

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pressed)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", normal)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color.WHITE)


func _confirm(title: String, message: String, action: Callable) -> void:
	_pending_action = action
	_confirm_title.text = title
	_confirm_message.text = message
	_confirm_ok.disabled = false

	_modal_root.visible = true
	_confirm_card.scale = Vector2(0.86, 0.86)
	_confirm_card.pivot_offset = _confirm_card.size / 2.0
	_confirm_card.modulate.a = 0.0
	_dim.modulate.a = 0.0

	var tw := create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(_dim, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.25)
	tw.tween_property(_confirm_card, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.28)
	tw.tween_property(_confirm_card, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.34) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _close_confirm() -> void:
	_pending_action = Callable()
	_modal_root.visible = false


func _on_confirm_accepted() -> void:
	if _pending_action.is_valid():
		_pending_action.call()
	_pending_action = Callable()
	_modal_root.visible = false


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ABOUT VALUES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _app_version() -> String:
	var v: Variant = ProjectSettings.get_setting("application/config/version", "")
	return str(v) if not str(v).is_empty() else "1.0.0"


func _subscription_text() -> String:
	# Placeholder — the app's purchase flow (Purchase.tscn) manages real state.
	return "نسخه رایگان"


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  TOAST — a big, prominent confirmation banner
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _show_toast(text: String) -> void:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.15, 0.97)
	style.border_width_left = 3
	style.border_width_top = 3
	style.border_width_right = 3
	style.border_width_bottom = 3
	style.border_color = ACCENT_ON
	style.set_corner_radius_all(24)
	style.content_margin_left = 48
	style.content_margin_top = 26
	style.content_margin_right = 48
	style.content_margin_bottom = 26
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	label.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 8)
	panel.add_child(label)

	add_child(panel)
	panel.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	panel.position.y -= 150
	# `panel.size` is still (0,0) right after add_child — wait one frame so
	# the pivot is centered on the real size, then pop the animation in.
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_instance_valid(panel):
		return
	panel.pivot_offset = panel.size / 2.0
	panel.scale = Vector2(0.82, 0.82)
	panel.modulate.a = 0.0

	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.22)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(panel, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.32) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_interval(1.4)
	tw.tween_property(panel, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.45)
	tw.tween_callback(panel.queue_free)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  ACCOUNT + CONTENT DOWNLOADS (built at runtime)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
const SCENE_AUTH := "res://scenes/auth/Auth.tscn"

var _account_status: Label
var _account_button: Button
var _account_logout_button: Button
var _download_info: Label
var _download_progress_label: Label
var _download_button: Button
var _clear_content_button: Button


func _build_extra_sections() -> void:
	var layout: VBoxContainer = $Scroll/Margin/Layout
	layout.add_child(_build_account_card())
	layout.add_child(_build_downloads_card())
	# Surface account + content downloads at the top of the screen.
	layout.move_child(layout.get_node("AccountCard"), 0)
	layout.move_child(layout.get_node("DownloadsCard"), 1)

	_refresh_account_section()
	_refresh_downloads_section()

	API.logged_in.connect(func(_user: Dictionary) -> void: _refresh_account_section())
	API.logged_out.connect(_refresh_account_section)
	API.subscription_updated.connect(func(_sub: Dictionary) -> void: _refresh_account_section())
	Content.manifest_ready.connect(_refresh_downloads_section)
	Content.download_progress.connect(_on_download_progress)
	Content.download_finished.connect(_on_download_finished)


func _build_account_card() -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.name = "AccountCard"
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	card.add_child(vbox)

	vbox.add_child(_section_title("حساب کاربری"))

	_account_status = _section_body("")
	vbox.add_child(_account_status)

	_account_button = _section_button("ورود / ثبت‌نام")
	_account_button.pressed.connect(_on_account_pressed)
	vbox.add_child(_account_button)

	_account_logout_button = _section_button("خروج از حساب")
	_account_logout_button.pressed.connect(_on_logout_pressed)
	vbox.add_child(_account_logout_button)
	return card


func _build_downloads_card() -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.name = "DownloadsCard"
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	card.add_child(vbox)

	vbox.add_child(_section_title("دانلود محتوا"))

	_download_info = _section_body("")
	vbox.add_child(_download_info)

	_download_progress_label = _section_body("")
	vbox.add_child(_download_progress_label)

	_download_button = _section_button("دانلود همه محتوا")
	_download_button.pressed.connect(_on_download_all_pressed)
	vbox.add_child(_download_button)

	_clear_content_button = _section_button("پاک کردن محتوای دانلودشده")
	_clear_content_button.pressed.connect(_on_clear_content_pressed)
	vbox.add_child(_clear_content_button)
	return card


func _section_title(text: String) -> Label:
	var lbl := Label.new()
	lbl.text = text
	lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	return lbl


func _section_body(text: String) -> Label:
	var lbl := Label.new()
	lbl.text = text
	lbl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	return lbl


func _section_button(text: String) -> Button:
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = text
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 92)
	btn.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(btn)
	return btn


func _style_extra_buttons() -> void:
	if _account_button == null:
		return
	_style_action_button(_account_button, true)
	_style_action_button(_account_logout_button, false)
	_style_action_button(_download_button, true)
	_style_action_button(_clear_content_button, false)
	if _account_status != null:
		_account_status.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	if _download_info != null:
		_download_info.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	if _download_progress_label != null:
		_download_progress_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))


func _style_action_button(btn: Button, primary: bool) -> void:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	style.content_margin_left = 26.0
	style.content_margin_top = 20.0
	style.content_margin_right = 26.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 20.0
	if primary:
		style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent")
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright")
		style.set_border_width_all(2)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("on_accent"))
	else:
		style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("border")
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", style)


func _refresh_account_section() -> void:
	if _account_status == null:
		return
	if API.is_logged_in():
		var phone := MenuStyle.persian_digits(API.get_phone())
		var tier := str(API.get_subscription().get("tier", "free"))
		var tier_fa := "ویژه" if tier != "free" else "رایگان"
		_account_status.text = "شماره: %s\nوضعیت اشتراک: %s" % [phone, tier_fa]
		_account_button.visible = false
		_account_logout_button.visible = true
	else:
		_account_status.text = "برای همگام‌سازی پیشرفت و دانلود محتوا با شماره موبایل وارد شوید."
		_account_button.visible = true
		_account_logout_button.visible = false


func _refresh_downloads_section() -> void:
	if _download_info == null:
		return
	var size_text := MenuStyle.persian_digits(_format_mb(Content.total_downloaded_bytes()))
	if Content.has_manifest():
		_download_info.text = "حجم دانلودشده: %s" % size_text
	else:
		_download_info.text = "حجم دانلودشده: %s\n(برای دانلود، وارد حساب شوید)" % size_text


func _format_mb(bytes: int) -> String:
	if bytes < 1048576:
		return "%d کیلوبایت" % int(bytes / 1024.0)
	return "%.1f مگابایت" % (float(bytes) / 1048576.0)


func _on_account_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_AUTH)


func _on_logout_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	_confirm(
		"خروج از حساب",
		"از حساب خود خارج می‌شوید. پیشرفت محلی حفظ می‌شود.\nادامه می‌دهید؟",
		func() -> void:
			API.logout()
			_show_toast("از حساب خارج شدید ✓")
	)


func _on_download_all_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	if not API.is_logged_in():
		_show_toast("ابتدا وارد حساب شوید تا محتوا دانلود شود")
		return
	_download_button.disabled = true
	_download_progress_label.text = "در حال آماده‌سازی دانلود…"
	Content.download_all()


func _on_clear_content_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	_confirm(
		"پاک کردن محتوای دانلودشده",
		"همه فایل‌های صوتی و تصویری دانلودشده حذف می‌شوند.\nبا باز کردن هر درس دوباره دانلود خواهند شد. ادامه می‌دهید؟",
		func() -> void:
			Content.clear_downloads()
			_refresh_downloads_section()
			_download_progress_label.text = ""
			_show_toast("محتوای دانلودشده پاک شد ✓")
	)


func _on_download_progress(done_count: int, total_count: int, done_bytes: int, total_bytes: int) -> void:
	if _download_progress_label == null:
		return
	if total_count == 0:
		return
	_download_progress_label.text = "دانلود %d از %d فایل  (%s از %s)" % [
		done_count, total_count,
		MenuStyle.persian_digits(_format_mb(done_bytes)),
		MenuStyle.persian_digits(_format_mb(total_bytes)),
	]


func _on_download_finished(success: bool) -> void:
	if _download_button == null:
		return
	_download_button.disabled = false
	_download_progress_label.text = "دانلود کامل شد ✓" if success else "دانلود با خطا مواجه شد — دوباره تلاش کنید."
	_refresh_downloads_section()


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  NAVIGATION
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")
```

## File: `res://scenes/shared/app_router.gd`

```gdscript
class_name AppRouter
## ============================================================
##  APP ROUTER — named navigation + typed route arguments.
##
##  Replaces the old pattern of passing state between screens
##  through muddy global fields (Global.flashcard_mode,
##  Global.word_review_return, ...) and hard-coded res:// paths.
##
##  - ROUTES is a single named registry, so screens navigate by a
##    stable route name instead of inline scene strings.
##  - `push()` / `change()` resolve a route and drive the shared
##    TransitionManager (slide for drill-downs, fade for side-menu).
##  - Exit state is carried explicitly in `args` (a typed payload
##    for the destination) instead of hidden globals. `set_args`
##    merges key-by-key so multi-field payloads (mode + return route)
##    composed at different steps never clobber each other.
## ============================================================

const ROUTES := {
	"main_menu":      "res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn",
	"book_menu":      "res://scenes/book_menu/BookSelection.tscn",
	"lesson_menu":    "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn",
	"flashcards":     "res://scenes/vocabulary/VocabFlashcards.tscn",
	"flashcard_hub":  "res://scenes/vocabulary/FlashcardHub.tscn",
	"saved_words":    "res://scenes/saved_words/SavedWords.tscn",
	"review":         "res://scenes/review/WordReview.tscn",
	"settings":       "res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn",
	"account":        "res://scenes/auth/Auth.tscn",
	"final_exams":    "res://scenes/exam/FinalExams.tscn",
	"final_exam_list": "res://scenes/exam/FinalExamList.tscn",
	"final_exam":     "res://scenes/exam/FinalExam.tscn",
	"purchase":       "res://scenes/purchase/Purchase.tscn",
	"about_me":       "res://scenes/about_me/AboutMe.tscn",
	"conversation":   "res://scenes/conversation/Conversation.tscn",
	"reading":        "res://scenes/reading/Reading.tscn",
	"grammar_hub":    "res://scenes/grammar/GrammarHub.tscn",
	"dictionary":     "res://scenes/shared/DictionaryPopup.tscn",
}

## Payload for the route currently being pushed (or last pushed).
static var _args: Dictionary = {}
## The route name currently active ("main_menu" etc.).
static var _route_name: String = ""


## Resolve a route name to its .tscn path; unknown names are returned
## untouched so raw scene paths still work as a fallback.
static func resolve(route: String) -> String:
	return str(ROUTES.get(route, route))


## Slide to a route (going deeper in the menu flow), carrying `args`.
static func push(route: String, args: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	_navigate(route, args)
	TransitionManager.slide_change_scene(resolve(route), TransitionManager.Slide.FORWARD)


## Fade to a route (side-menu destinations), carrying `args`.
static func change(route: String, args: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	_navigate(route, args)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(resolve(route))


## Fade back to a route (up one level), carrying `args`.
static func back(route: String, args: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	_navigate(route, args)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(resolve(route))


## Merge `args` into the current payload (overwrite on collision), so a
## destination built up in steps (mode set first, return-route added later)
## never drops a field. Shallow merge is enough for our scalar/array values.
static func set_args(args: Dictionary) -> void:
	for key in args:
		_args[key] = args[key]


## Read a payload field for the destination scene.
static func get_arg(key: String, default: Variant = null) -> Variant:
	return _args.get(key, default)


static func _navigate(route: String, args: Dictionary) -> void:
	_route_name = route
	_args = (args.duplicate(true) if not args.is_empty() else {})


## The active route name ("" until a named navigation happens).
static func route_name() -> String:
	return _route_name
```

## File: `res://scenes/shared/audio_panel.gd`

```gdscript
extends PanelContainer

signal playback_updated(current_time: float)
signal audio_closed
signal audio_finished
signal visibility_changed_state(is_open: bool)

const SEEK_STEP: float = 10.0 #
const TAP_PRESS_SCALE: Vector2 = Vector2(0.85, 0.85)
const TAP_PRESS_DURATION: float = 0.06
const TAP_RELEASE_DURATION: float = 0.26
var is_dragging_slider: bool = false #
var _transparent_tex: ImageTexture = null

@onready var audio_player: AudioStreamPlayer = $AudioStreamPlayer
@onready var audio_slider: HSlider = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/TimeRow/AudioSlider
@onready var current_time_label: Label = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/TimeRow/CurrentTimeLabel
@onready var total_time_label: Label = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/TimeRow/TotalTimeLabel
@onready var rewind_button: TextureButton = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/ControlsLayout/RewindButton
@onready var play_pause_button: TextureButton = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/ControlsLayout/PlayPauseButton
@onready var forward_button: TextureButton = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/ControlsLayout/ForwardButton
@onready var close_audio_button: TextureButton = $MarginContainer/AudioUILayout/ControlsLayout/CloseAudioButton

func _ready() -> void:
	# Connect internal signals[cite: 2, 3]
	rewind_button.pressed.connect(_on_rewind_pressed)
	play_pause_button.pressed.connect(_on_play_pause_pressed)
	forward_button.pressed.connect(_on_forward_pressed)
	close_audio_button.pressed.connect(_on_close_audio_pressed)
	
	audio_slider.drag_started.connect(_on_slider_drag_started)
	audio_slider.drag_ended.connect(_on_slider_drag_ended)
	audio_slider.value_changed.connect(_on_slider_value_changed)
	audio_player.finished.connect(_on_audio_finished)

	# Juicy tap animations on every control button.
	for button: TextureButton in [rewind_button, play_pause_button, forward_button, close_audio_button]:
		_wire_tap_animation(button)

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()
	_apply_slider_theme()
	_setup_animated_dot()
	# Only tick while audio is actually playing (re-enabled by
	# load_and_play / the play-pause resume branches).
	set_process(false)


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var panel_sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	panel_sb.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("accent") if Global.theme_is_dark() else Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	panel_sb.corner_radius_top_left = 150
	panel_sb.corner_radius_top_right = 150
	add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", panel_sb)

	# Time labels (current on the left, total on the right).
	current_time_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	total_time_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))


func _apply_slider_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var dark: bool = Global.theme_is_dark()
	# Thick rounded track (unplayed portion).
	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	track.bg_color = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.28) if dark else Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.12)
	track.content_margin_top = 10
	track.content_margin_bottom = 10
	track.corner_radius_top_left = 10
	track.corner_radius_top_right = 10
	track.corner_radius_bottom_left = 10
	track.corner_radius_bottom_right = 10
	audio_slider.add_theme_stylebox_override("slider", track)
	# Played portion fill.
	var fill := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	fill.bg_color = Color.WHITE if dark else Global.get_theme_color("accent")
	fill.content_margin_top = 10
	fill.content_margin_bottom = 10
	fill.corner_radius_top_left = 10
	fill.corner_radius_top_right = 10
	fill.corner_radius_bottom_left = 10
	fill.corner_radius_bottom_right = 10
	audio_slider.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber_area", fill)
	audio_slider.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber_area_highlight", fill)
	# The visible dot is drawn by an overlay (AudioSliderDot) so it can be hidden
	# and animated; the slider's own grabber stays invisible.
	audio_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber", _make_transparent_texture())
	audio_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber_highlight", _make_transparent_texture())
	# Center the grabber on the fill edge so the dot travels the full width
	# of the track (reaches the very start and the very end of the slide).
	audio_slider.add_theme_constant_override("center_grabber", 1)


func _setup_animated_dot() -> void:
	# Replace the slider's built-in grabber with an overlay dot that is only
	# visible (and animated) while the user touches the bar.
	var dot := AudioSliderDot.new()
	audio_slider.add_child(dot)
	dot.setup(audio_slider)

	audio_slider.drag_started.connect(dot.show_dot)
	audio_slider.drag_ended.connect(func(_changed: bool) -> void: dot.hide_dot())


func _make_transparent_texture() -> ImageTexture:
	if _transparent_tex == null:
		var img := Image.create(1, 1, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
		img.fill(Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
		_transparent_tex = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
	return _transparent_tex


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()
	_apply_slider_theme()

# ==========================================
# TAP ANIMATIONS
# ==========================================
func _wire_tap_animation(button: TextureButton) -> void:
	button.pivot_offset = button.size * 0.5
	button.resized.connect(func() -> void: button.pivot_offset = button.size * 0.5)
	button.button_down.connect(func() -> void: _animate_button_press(button))
	button.button_up.connect(func() -> void: _animate_button_release(button))


func _animate_button_press(button: TextureButton) -> void:
	_stop_tap_tween(button)
	var tween: Tween = button.create_tween()
	button.set_meta("tap_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(button, "scale", TAP_PRESS_SCALE, TAP_PRESS_DURATION) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _animate_button_release(button: TextureButton) -> void:
	_stop_tap_tween(button)
	var tween: Tween = button.create_tween()
	button.set_meta("tap_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(button, "scale", Vector2.ONE, TAP_RELEASE_DURATION) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _stop_tap_tween(button: TextureButton) -> void:
	if button.has_meta("tap_tween"):
		var tween: Tween = button.get_meta("tap_tween") as Tween
		if is_instance_valid(tween):
			tween.kill()
		button.remove_meta("tap_tween")


func _reset_button_scales() -> void:
	for button: TextureButton in [rewind_button, play_pause_button, forward_button, close_audio_button]:
		_stop_tap_tween(button)
		button.scale = Vector2.ONE

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	# Nothing to broadcast while stopped: stop ticking until a playback site
	# re-enables us (load_and_play / play-pause resume).
	if not (audio_player.playing or audio_player.stream_paused):
		set_process(false)
		return
	# Broadcast the current time for syncing text
	if not is_dragging_slider:
		var current_time = audio_player.get_playback_position()
		audio_slider.value = current_time
		playback_updated.emit(current_time)

# ==========================================
# PUBLIC API (Called by Parent Scenes)
# ==========================================
func load_and_play(audio_path: String) -> void:
	if audio_path == "":
		push_warning("Audio not found: " + audio_path)
		return

	# Content resolves the clip whether it is bundled (res://) or was
	# downloaded on demand into user://content/.
	var stream: AudioStream = null
	if Content.has_asset(audio_path):
		stream = Content.load_audio(audio_path)
	if stream == null:
		push_warning("Audio not available yet: " + audio_path)
		return

	show()
	call_deferred("_notify_visibility_changed", true)
	_reset_button_scales()
	audio_player.stream = stream
	set_process(true)
	audio_player.play()
	audio_player.stream_paused = false
	audio_slider.max_value = stream.get_length()
	total_time_label.text = _format_time(stream.get_length())
	audio_slider.value = 0.0

func stop_and_close() -> void:
	_on_close_audio_pressed()

func is_playing() -> bool:
	return audio_player.playing or audio_player.stream_paused

# ==========================================
# INTERNAL EVENT HANDLERS
# ==========================================
func _on_play_pause_pressed() -> void:
	if audio_player.stream == null: return
	
	if audio_player.stream_paused:
		audio_player.stream_paused = false
		set_process(true)
		if not audio_player.playing:
			audio_player.play(audio_slider.value)
	elif audio_player.playing:
		audio_player.stream_paused = true
	else:
		# Stream finished (or was stopped): hit play again to replay from the start.
		audio_slider.value = 0.0
		set_process(true)
		audio_player.play()

func _on_rewind_pressed() -> void:
	if audio_player.stream != null:
		audio_player.seek(max(0.0, audio_player.get_playback_position() - SEEK_STEP)) #[cite: 2, 3]
		audio_slider.value = audio_player.get_playback_position()

func _on_forward_pressed() -> void:
	if audio_player.stream != null:
		var max_len = audio_player.stream.get_length()
		audio_player.seek(min(max_len, audio_player.get_playback_position() + SEEK_STEP)) #[cite: 2, 3]
		audio_slider.value = audio_player.get_playback_position()

func _notify_visibility_changed(is_open: bool) -> void:
	visibility_changed_state.emit(is_open)


func _on_close_audio_pressed() -> void:
	audio_player.stop() #[cite: 2, 3]
	audio_player.stream_paused = false #[cite: 2, 3]
	audio_slider.value = 0.0 #[cite: 2, 3]
	_reset_button_scales()
	hide()
	_notify_visibility_changed(false)
	audio_closed.emit()

func _on_audio_finished() -> void:
	# Snap the slider to the very end so the dot lands on the far edge.
	audio_slider.value = audio_slider.max_value
	audio_finished.emit()

func _on_slider_drag_started() -> void: 
	is_dragging_slider = true #[cite: 2, 3]

func _on_slider_drag_ended(_value_changed: bool) -> void:
	is_dragging_slider = false #[cite: 2, 3]
	if audio_player.stream != null: 
		audio_player.seek(audio_slider.value) #[cite: 2, 3]


func _on_slider_value_changed(value: float) -> void:
	current_time_label.text = _format_time(value)


func _format_time(seconds: float) -> String:
	var total: int = maxi(0, int(floor(seconds)))
	var hours: int = floori(total / 3600.0)
	var minutes: int = floori((total % 3600) / 60.0)
	var secs: int = total % 60
	if hours > 0:
		return "%d:%02d:%02d" % [hours, minutes, secs]
	return "%d:%02d" % [minutes, secs]
```

## File: `res://scenes/shared/audio_slider_dot.gd`

```gdscript
class_name AudioSliderDot
extends Control

const GRABBER_TEXTURE: Texture2D = preload("res://ui/images/audio_grabber.png")
const SHOW_DURATION: float = 0.18
const HIDE_DURATION: float = 0.16

var _slider: Range = null
var _tween: Tween = null

var dot_scale: float = 0.0:
	set(value):
		dot_scale = value
		queue_redraw()


func setup(slider: Range) -> void:
	_slider = slider
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	# Keep the overlay anchored to the slider's origin. Its own size is unused;
	# drawing positions are computed from the slider's rect instead.
	position = Vector2.ZERO
	clip_contents = false


func show_dot() -> void:
	_kill_tween()
	_tween = create_tween()
	_tween.tween_property(self, "dot_scale", 1.0, SHOW_DURATION) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func hide_dot() -> void:
	_kill_tween()
	_tween = create_tween()
	_tween.tween_property(self, "dot_scale", 0.0, HIDE_DURATION) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)


func _kill_tween() -> void:
	if _tween != null and _tween.is_valid():
		_tween.kill()
	_tween = null


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	# Keep tracking the slider value while the dot is shown.
	if dot_scale > 0.01 and is_visible_in_tree():
		queue_redraw()


func _draw() -> void:
	if _slider == null or dot_scale <= 0.01:
		return
	var span: float = _slider.max_value - _slider.min_value
	if span <= 0.0:
		return
	var ratio := clampf((_slider.value - _slider.min_value) / span, 0.0, 1.0)
	var tex_size: Vector2 = GRABBER_TEXTURE.get_size() * dot_scale
	var pos := Vector2(ratio * _slider.size.x - tex_size.x * 0.5, _slider.size.y * 0.5 - tex_size.y * 0.5)
	draw_texture_rect(GRABBER_TEXTURE, Rect2(pos, tex_size), false)
```

```gdscript
func show_word(def: Dictionary) -> void:
	current_word_data = def
	title_label.text = str(def.get("word", "")).capitalize()
	
	var type_str := str(def.get("word_type", "Unknown")).capitalize()
	if type_str.to_lower() == "noun" and def.get("countable") != null:
		type_str += " (Countable)" if def.get("countable") else " (Uncountable)"
	type_label.text = type_str
	
	var en_meaning = def.get("meaning_en", "")
	var fa_meaning = def.get("meaning_fa", "")
	meaning_label.text = en_meaning + ("\n" + fa_meaning if fa_meaning != "" else "")
	
	if fa_meaning != "" and font_farsi != null:
		meaning_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	else:
		meaning_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	
	extra_label.text = ""
	if type_str.to_lower().begins_with("verb") and def.has("verb_forms"):
		var forms = def["verb_forms"]
		var form_strings := []
		if forms.has("past"): form_strings.append("Past: " + forms["past"])
		if forms.has("past_participle"): form_strings.append("PP: " + forms["past_participle"])
		if forms.has("present_participle"): form_strings.append("ING: " + forms["present_participle"])
		extra_label.text = " • ".join(form_strings)
	
	extra_label.visible = extra_label.text != ""
	
	if Global.is_word_saved(def.get("word"), def.get("book"), def.get("lesson")):
		btn_save_word.text = "✓ ذخیره شد"
		btn_save_word.disabled = true
	else:
		btn_save_word.text = "ذخیره کنید"
		btn_save_word.disabled = false

	var tween = create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(popup_panel, "position:y", 0, 0.35).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK)

func _hide_popup() -> void:
	var tween = create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(popup_panel, "position:y", -popup_panel.size.y - 50, 0.25).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC)
	tween.tween_callback(func(): popup_closed.emit())

func _on_save_word_pressed() -> void:
	if not current_word_data.is_empty():
		Global.save_word(current_word_data)
		btn_save_word.text = "✓ ذخیره شد"
		btn_save_word.disabled = true
		Global.button_bounce(btn_save_word)

func _on_audio_pressed() -> void:
	Global.button_bounce(audio_button)
	
	var audio_filename: String = current_word_data.get("audio", "")
	var word_text: String = current_word_data.get("word", "")

	# Trigger unified audio playback (with built-in TTS fallback)
	Global.play_word_audio(audio_filename, word_text)

func is_open() -> bool:
	return popup_panel.position.y >= 0


func _ready() -> void:
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	popup_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	type_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	meaning_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	btn_close_popup.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	btn_close_popup.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	close_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")
	close_pressed.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()
```

## File: `res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/Dropdown.gd`

```gdscript
# ============================================================
# ExerciseEngine - Dropdown popup button (was an inner class of
# ExerciseEngine). Part of the split ExerciseEngine module.
# ============================================================
class_name ExerciseDropdown
extends Button

signal item_selected(index: int)

var selected: int = 0
var placeholder := "Choose"
var _options: Array = []
var _font: Font
var _popup: PopupPanel
var _scroll: ScrollContainer
var _list: VBoxContainer

const _ITEM_FONT := 39
const _MAX_W := 900
const _MIN_W := 360
const _MAX_H := 560
const _PAD_L := 16
const _PAD_R := 14
const _PAD_V := 10

func set_font(f: Font) -> void:
	_font = f

func add_item(label: String) -> void:
	_options.append(label)

# Restores the placeholder selection (index 0) and refreshes the face text.
# Used by the exercise engine's in-place "Try Again" reset.
func reset() -> void:
	selected = 0
	if is_inside_tree():
		_refresh_face()

func get_item_text(index: int) -> String:
	if index <= 0 or index > _options.size():
		return "— " + placeholder + " —"
	return str(_options[index - 1])

func _ready() -> void:
	alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	clip_text = true
	text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
	add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _ITEM_FONT)
	add_theme_color_override("font_color", preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd")._c_text())
	add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY)
	if _font:
		add_theme_font_override("font", _font)

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd")._c_surface()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	style.border_width_bottom = 2
	style.border_color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.lightened(0.3)
	style.set_content_margin_all(12)
	add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)

	var hover: StyleBoxFlat = style.duplicate()
	hover.border_color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY
	add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)

	var pressed_style: StyleBoxFlat = hover.duplicate()
	pressed_style.bg_color = Color(preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.r, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.g, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.b, 0.1)
	add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pressed_style)

	_build_popup()
	_refresh_face()
	connect("pressed", _open_popup)

func _build_popup() -> void:
	_popup = PopupPanel.new()
	var panel := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	panel.bg_color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd")._c_surface()
	panel.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	panel.border_width_left = 1
	panel.border_width_right = 1
	panel.border_width_top = 1
	panel.border_width_bottom = 1
	panel.border_color = Color(preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.r, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.g, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.b, 0.4)
	panel.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5)
	panel.shadow_size = 16
	panel.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 8)
	panel.set_content_margin_all(8)
	_popup.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", panel)

	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	_popup.add_child(_scroll)

	_list = VBoxContainer.new()
	_list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	_scroll.add_child(_list)

	add_child(_popup)
	_popup.about_to_popup.connect(_on_about_to_popup)

func _open_popup() -> void:
	var btn_rect := get_global_rect()
	var f: Font = _font if _font else ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var longest := 0.0
	for opt in _options:
		longest = maxf(
			longest,
			f.get_string_size(str(opt), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, _ITEM_FONT).x
		)
	# Keep the popup inside the visible screen.
	var vp_w := 1280.0
	var vp := get_viewport()
	if vp != null:
		vp_w = vp.get_visible_rect().size.x
	var max_w := minf(float(_MAX_W), vp_w - 24.0)
	var w := clampi(int(maxf(btn_rect.size.x, longest + 70.0)), _MIN_W, int(max_w))
	var wrap_w := float(w - 16 - 10 - _PAD_L - _PAD_R)
	_populate(wrap_w)
	var content_h := int(_list.get_combined_minimum_size().y) + 16
	var h := mini(content_h, _MAX_H)
	_scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(w - 16, h - 16)
	var x := clampi(int(btn_rect.position.x), 8, int(vp_w - w - 8))
	_popup.popup(Rect2i(
		Vector2i(x, int(btn_rect.end.y + 8)),
		Vector2i(w, h)
	))

func _populate(wrap_w: float) -> void:
	for c in _list.get_children():
		_list.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()

	var f: Font = _font if _font else ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var labels := ["— " + placeholder + " —"]
	labels.append_array(_options)

	for i in labels.size():
		var is_sel := (i == selected)
		var is_placeholder := (i == 0)
		var display: String = ("✓  " + str(labels[i])) if is_sel else str(labels[i])
		# Mixed Farsi/English dropdown items need bidi isolates + direction.
		var face := GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(display)
		var fa_dir := GrammarTheme.is_fa_dominant(display)

		var row := Button.new()
		row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		row.custom_minimum_size.y = maxf(
			f.get_multiline_string_size(
				face,
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,
				wrap_w,
				_ITEM_FONT
			).y + _PAD_V * 2,
			76.0
		)

		var normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		if is_sel:
			normal.bg_color = Color(preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.r, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.g, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.b, 0.2)
		else:
			normal.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
		normal.set_corner_radius_all(8)
		if is_sel:
			normal.border_width_left = 3
			normal.border_color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY
		row.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)

		var hover: StyleBoxFlat = normal.duplicate()
		if is_sel:
			hover.bg_color = Color(preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.r, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.g, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.b, 0.16)
		else:
			hover.bg_color = Color(preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.r, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.g, preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY.b, 0.08)
		row.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
		row.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hover)
		row.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", StyleBoxEmpty.new())

		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.text = face
		lbl.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
		lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _ITEM_FONT)
		lbl.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL if fa_dir else Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
		var base_color: Color = preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd")._c_text_dim() if is_placeholder else preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd")._c_text()
		lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", base_color)
		if _font:
			lbl.add_theme_font_override("font", _font)
		lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		lbl.anchor_right = 1.0
		lbl.anchor_bottom = 1.0
		lbl.offset_left = _PAD_L
		lbl.offset_right = -_PAD_R
		lbl.offset_top = _PAD_V
		lbl.offset_bottom = -_PAD_V
		row.add_child(lbl)

		row.pressed.connect(_on_row_pressed.bind(i))
		row.mouse_entered.connect(func():
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", preload("res://scenes/shared/exercise_engine/exercise_theme.gd").C_PRIMARY)
		)
		row.mouse_exited.connect(func():
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", base_color)
		)
		_list.add_child(row)

func _on_about_to_popup() -> void:
	var tw := create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	var rows := _list.get_children()
	for i in rows.size():
		var r: Control = rows[i]
		r.modulate.a = 0.0
		tw.tween_property(r, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.12).set_delay(i * 0.02)

func _on_row_pressed(index: int) -> void:
	selected = index
	_refresh_face()
	_popup.hide()
	item_selected.emit(index)

func _refresh_face() -> void:
	var face := get_item_text(selected) + "   ▾"
	# Bidi-safe face text so mixed Farsi/English items never scramble.
	text = GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(face)
	text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL if GrammarTheme.is_fa_dominant(face) else Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
```

```gdscript
	_ensure_layout_target()

func _add_common_passage() -> void:
	var passage_raw: Variant = _exercise.get("passage", _exercise.get("reading", ""))
	if passage_raw == null:
		return
	var text := ""
	if passage_raw is Array:

			if s != "":
				paras.append(s)
		text = "\n\n".join(paras)
	else:

	if text.strip_edges() == "":

	rtl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	rtl.bbcode_enabled = true

	rtl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	rtl.add_theme_font_size_override("normal_font_size", 40)
	rtl.add_theme_font_size_override("bold_font_size", 40)
	rtl.add_theme_font_size_override("italics_font_size", 40)
	rtl.add_theme_font_size_override("bold_italics_font_size", 40)
	rtl.add_theme_color_override("default_color", _c_text())
	if _font_regular:
		rtl.add_theme_font_override("normal_font", _font_regular)

		rtl.set_meta("text_fa", _get_fa_text(passage_raw))
	_active_vbox.add_child(rtl)
	_add_fa_label(_get_fa_text(passage_raw), 32)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Returns this engine's 0-based position among its ExerciseEngine
# siblings under the same parent (e.g. the lesson page's VBox).
# This replaces the previous approach of a global static counter,
# which never reset between lessons and could drift (Lesson 5's
# first exercise showing "F." because of exercises the student did
# earlier in the same app session). Because this is recomputed from
# the live scene tree on every build(), it is always correct for
# whatever page currently has this engine as a child, with no
# manual reset required anywhere else in the app.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
func _compute_letter_index() -> int:
	if _exercise.has("letter_index"):
		return int(_exercise["letter_index"])
	var parent := get_parent()
	if parent == null:
		return 0
	var idx := 0
	# Count how many sibling ExerciseEngine instances precede this one.
	# We check the type directly instead of group membership because the
	# engine's _ready() (which registers the "exercise_engines" group) only
	# fires once the node is inside the scene tree — but build() is typically
	# called while the parent page is still detached, so the group would be
	# empty and every engine would incorrectly report index 0 (i.e. "A").
	for child in parent.get_children():
		if child == self:
			return idx
		if child is ExerciseEngineBuilders:
			idx += 1
	return idx


func _add_instruction() -> void:
	var text_raw = _exercise.get("instruction", "")
	var text_val := _get_en_text(text_raw)
	if text_val == "":
		return
	var show_letter: bool = bool(_exercise.get("show_letter", true))
	var letter_code: String = ""
	if show_letter:
		letter_code = char(65 + (_compute_letter_index() % 26))

	var fa_text: String = _get_fa_text(text_raw)
	# Layout follows the displayed instruction language. Farsi translation is
	# rendered separately below, so it must not flip an English instruction RTL.
	var fa_dominant: bool = _is_fa_dominant(text_val)
	var instruction_row: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
	instruction_row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	instruction_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)

	var instruction: Label = Label.new()
	instruction.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	instruction.text = GrammarTheme.bidi_fix(text_val)
	instruction.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	instruction.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	instruction.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 44)
	instruction.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _c_text())
	instruction.set_meta("text_fa", fa_text)
	instruction.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL if fa_dominant else Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
	instruction.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT if fa_dominant else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	if fa_dominant and _font_farsi:
		instruction.add_theme_font_override("font", _font_farsi)
	elif _font_bold:
		instruction.add_theme_font_override("font", _font_bold)

	if not letter_code.is_empty():
		var letter_badge: Label = Label.new()
		letter_badge.text = letter_code
		letter_badge.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		letter_badge.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		letter_badge.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(64, 64)
		letter_badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
		letter_badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
		var badge_style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new()
		badge_style.bg_color = Color(0.10, 0.14, 0.22, 1.0)
		badge_style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
		badge_style.set_content_margin_all(8)
		letter_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", badge_style)
		letter_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", badge_style)
		letter_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", badge_style)
		letter_badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", badge_style)
		# The badge paints white type on its own dark square, so keep the
		# app-wide theme walk from repainting the letter in the theme text
		# colour (which made it vanish into the square).
		letter_badge.add_to_group(ThemeSceneStyler.KEEP_FONT_COLOR_GROUP)
		if fa_dominant:
			instruction_row.add_child(instruction)
			instruction_row.add_child(letter_badge)
		else:
			instruction_row.add_child(letter_badge)
			instruction_row.add_child(instruction)
	else:
		instruction_row.add_child(instruction)

	_active_vbox.add_child(instruction_row)
	_add_fa_label(fa_text, 34)

	var sep := HSeparator.new()
	sep.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var sep_style := StyleBoxLine.new()
	sep_style.color = _c_text_dim().lightened(0.7)
	sep_style.thickness = 2
	sep.add_theme_stylebox_override("separator", sep_style)
	_active_vbox.add_child(sep)


func _add_note() -> void:
	var note_raw = _exercise.get("note", "")
	var note := _get_en_text(note_raw)
	if note == "":
		return
	_note_label = _make_label(_t("info_prefix") + note, 32, _c_text_dim(), false)
	_note_label.set_meta("text_fa", _get_fa_text(note_raw))
```
