```gdscript
	_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
	_vbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	add_child(_vbox)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Tab bar.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	_tab_bar = PanelContainer.new()

	_tab_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_tab_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	_tab_style.set_content_margin_all(16)
	_tab_style.corner_radius_top_left = 32
	_tab_style.corner_radius_top_right = 32
	# No bottom border — the accent indicator pill is the visual anchor.

	_tab_bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _tab_style)
	_vbox.add_child(_tab_bar)

	_tab_inner = Control.new()
	_tab_inner.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 76)
	_tab_inner.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	_tab_bar.add_child(_tab_inner)

	_indicator = Panel.new()
	_indicator.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	_ind_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_ind_style.bg_color = _accent
	_ind_style.set_corner_radius_all(28)

	_indicator.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _ind_style)
	_tab_inner.add_child(_indicator)

	_tabs_hbox = HBoxContainer.new()
	_tabs_hbox.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_tabs_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	_tabs_hbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	_tab_inner.add_child(_tabs_hbox)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Page viewport / slider.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	_viewport = Control.new()
	_viewport.clip_contents = true
	_viewport.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_viewport.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	_vbox.add_child(_viewport)

	_slider = HBoxContainer.new()
	_slider.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 0)
	_slider.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	_viewport.add_child(_slider)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Dots (wrapped in a bottom-rounded panel).
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	_dots_panel = PanelContainer.new()
	_dots_panel_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_dots_panel_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface")
	_dots_panel_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 32
	_dots_panel_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 32
	_dots_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _dots_panel_style)
	_vbox.add_child(_dots_panel)

	_dots_row = HBoxContainer.new()
	_dots_row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_dots_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	_dots_row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 52)
	_dots_row.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_dots_panel.add_child(_dots_row)


# ============================================================
# PUBLIC API
# ============================================================

func add_page(id: String, title: String, icon: String, content: Control) -> void:
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Wrap content in its own vertical scroller + padding.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Wrap content in its own vertical scroller + padding.
	# Each page sits inside a fixed-width slot (a plain Control). A plain
	# Control never auto-grows to its child's width, so the page width stays
	# locked to one viewport no matter how wide the content is — oversized
	# content can never push a page into the neighbouring page.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var slot := Control.new()
	slot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	slot.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	slot.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	slot.clip_contents = true
	_slider.add_child(slot)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	scroll.vertical_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO
	scroll.follow_focus = true
	scroll.scroll_deadzone = 24
	scroll.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_ALL
	# Clip page content so it can never spill over the page edges.
	scroll.clip_contents = true
	slot.add_child(scroll)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 24)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 60)
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.add_child(margin)

	content.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	content.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	# Lock the page's content to the viewport width so wrapped text never
	# inflates the ScrollContainer's minimum size (which would push the whole
	# page slot wider than one viewport and spill past the right edge).
	content.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_content_width(), 0)
	margin.add_child(content)

	_style_page_scroll(scroll)

	_pages.append({
		"id": id,
		"title": title,
		"icon": icon,
		"scroll": scroll,
		"slot": slot,
		"content": content,
		"margin": margin,
	})
	if _audio_panel_open:
		_apply_audio_panel_clearance()

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Tab button.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var btn := Button.new()
	btn.text = (icon + "  " + title) if icon != "" else title
	btn.flat = true

	# Fill horizontally and give longer titles more space.
	btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	btn.size_flags_stretch_ratio = maxf(1.0, float(btn.text.length()))

	# Allow shrinking so the tab bar can fit horizontally.
	btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 72)

	# Keep tab titles on one line.
	btn.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	btn.clip_text = true
	btn.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS

	btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", tab_font_size)
	btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))

	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
	# Compact horizontal padding so long/many tab labels fit without clipping.
	var btn_normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	btn_normal.content_margin_left = 12
	btn_normal.content_margin_right = 12
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", btn_normal)

	if font_bold:
		btn.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	var page_index := _pages.size() - 1
	btn.pressed.connect(func(): go_to_page(page_index))

	_tabs_hbox.add_child(btn)
	_tab_buttons.append(btn)

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Dot.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	var dot := Panel.new()
	dot.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	var d_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	d_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
	d_style.set_corner_radius_all(7)

	dot.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", d_style)
	dot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(14, 14)

	_dots_row.add_child(dot)
	_dot_controls.append(dot)

	_refresh_layout()
	_refresh_tab_fit()

	if _pages.size() == 1:
		go_to_page(0, false)


func go_to_page(index: int, animate := true) -> void:
	if _pages.is_empty():
		return

	_stop_scroll_tween()

	index = clampi(index, 0, _pages.size() - 1)
	_current = index
	_page_width = _viewport.size.x

	var target_x := -index * _page_width

	if animate and _page_width > 0.0:
		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(
			_slider,
			"position:x",
			target_x,
			0.35
		).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

		_animate_indicator_to(float(index))
	else:
		_slider.position.x = target_x
		_set_indicator_to(float(index))

	_update_tabs(index)
	_update_dots(index)

	page_changed.emit(index, _pages[index]["id"])


func get_current_page() -> int:
	return _current


func scroll_current_to_top() -> void:
	var scroll := _get_current_scroll()
	if scroll == null:
		return

	_stop_scroll_tween()
	scroll.scroll_vertical = 0


func set_accent(color: Color) -> void:
	_accent = color

	_ind_style = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_ind_style.bg_color = _accent
	_ind_style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
	_indicator.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _ind_style)

	# Update page scrollbars to match the new accent.
	for page in _pages:
		var scroll := page.get("scroll") as ScrollContainer
		if is_instance_valid(scroll):
			_style_page_scroll(scroll)

	_update_tabs(_current)
	_update_dots(_current)


# ============================================================
# LAYOUT
# ============================================================

func _page_content_width() -> float:
	# Width available to a page's content: one full viewport minus the
	# horizontal margins applied in add_page() (28 left + 28 right).
	return maxf(0.0, _page_width - 56.0)


func _refresh_layout() -> void:
	_page_width = _viewport.size.x

	if _page_width <= 0.0 or _pages.is_empty():
		return

	_slider.size = Vector2(_page_width * _pages.size(), _viewport.size.y)
	_slider.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN

	for page in _pages:
		var slot := page.get("slot") as Control
		if is_instance_valid(slot):
			slot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_width, 0)

		var scroll := page.get("scroll") as ScrollContainer
		if is_instance_valid(scroll):
			scroll.clip_contents = true
			scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_width, 0)

		var content := page.get("content") as Control
		if is_instance_valid(content):
			content.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_content_width(), 0)

	_slider.position.x = -_current * _page_width
	_set_indicator_to(float(_current))

	_refresh_tab_fit()

	# Post-layout safety: force every page to exactly the viewport width &
	# height so oversized content can never push a page past its boundary.
	call_deferred("_clamp_page_size")


func _clamp_page_size() -> void:
	if _page_width <= 0.0 or _pages.is_empty():
		return

	var vh := _viewport.size.y

	for page in _pages:
		var slot := page.get("slot") as Control
		if is_instance_valid(slot):
			slot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_width, 0)
			slot.size = Vector2(_page_width, vh)

		var scroll := page.get("scroll") as ScrollContainer
		if is_instance_valid(scroll):
			scroll.clip_contents = true
			scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_width, 0)
			scroll.size = Vector2(_page_width, vh)

		var content := page.get("content") as Control
		if is_instance_valid(content):
			content.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_page_content_width(), 0)


func _style_page_scroll(scroll: ScrollContainer) -> void:
	# Page background.
	var scroll_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	scroll_style.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	scroll.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", scroll_style)

	# Dark vertical scrollbar.
	var vbar := scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()
	if vbar == null:
		return

	vbar.custom_minimum_size.x = 10

	# Hide scrollbar arrow buttons for a cleaner mobile look.
	var empty := StyleBoxEmpty.new()
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("decrement", empty)
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("decrement_highlight", empty)
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("increment", empty)
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("increment_highlight", empty)

	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	track.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")
	track.set_corner_radius_all(5)
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("scroll", track)

	var grabber := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	grabber.bg_color = Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
	grabber.set_corner_radius_all(5)
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber", grabber)

	var grabber_highlight := grabber.duplicate()
	grabber_highlight.bg_color = _accent
	vbar.add_theme_stylebox_override("grabber_highlight", grabber_highlight)


func _refresh_tab_fit() -> void:
	if _tab_buttons.is_empty():
		return

	var available := _tab_inner.size.x
	if available <= 0.0:
		return

	var sep := _tabs_hbox.get_theme_constant("separation")
	available -= sep * float(_tab_buttons.size() - 1)

	var font: Font = _tab_buttons[0].get_theme_font("font")
	if font == null:
		font = ThemeDB.fallback_font

	var base_size := tab_font_size
	var min_size := tab_font_min
	var padding := tab_font_padding
	var chosen := base_size

	# Reduce the tab font size until all tabs roughly fit.
	while chosen > min_size:
		var total := 0.0

		for btn in _tab_buttons:
			var b: Button = btn
			total += font.get_string_size(
				b.text,
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT,
				-1,
				chosen
			).x + padding

		if total <= available:
			break

		chosen -= 1

	for btn in _tab_buttons:
		var b: Button = btn
		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", chosen)


# ============================================================
# INDICATOR (sliding pill)
# ============================================================

func _indicator_rect_for(float_index: float) -> Rect2:
	if _tab_buttons.is_empty():
		return Rect2()

	var i0 := clampi(floori(float_index), 0, _tab_buttons.size() - 1)
	var i1 := clampi(ceili(float_index), 0, _tab_buttons.size() - 1)
	var t: float = float_index - floor(float_index)

	var r0: Rect2 = _tab_buttons[i0].get_rect()
	var r1: Rect2 = _tab_buttons[i1].get_rect()

	var x := lerpf(r0.position.x, r1.position.x, t)
	var w := lerpf(r0.size.x, r1.size.x, t)
	var h := 58.0
	var y := (r0.position.y + r0.size.y / 2.0) - h / 2.0

	return Rect2(x, y, w, h)


func _set_indicator_to(float_index: float) -> void:
	var r := _indicator_rect_for(float_index)
	_indicator.position = r.position
	_indicator.size = r.size


func _animate_indicator_to(float_index: float) -> void:
	var r := _indicator_rect_for(float_index)

	var t: Tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	t.tween_property(
		_indicator,
		"position",
		r.position,
		0.3
	).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

	t.tween_property(
		_indicator,
		"size",
		r.size,
		0.3
	).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


# ============================================================
# TABS & DOTS
# ============================================================

func _update_tabs(active: int) -> void:
	for i in _tab_buttons.size():
		var btn: Button = _tab_buttons[i]
		var target: Color = Global.get_theme_color("text") if i == active else Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")

		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(
			btn,
			"theme_override_colors/font_color",
			target,
			0.25
		)


func _update_dots(active: int) -> void:
	for i in _dot_controls.size():
		var dot: Panel = _dot_controls[i]
		var is_active := i == active

		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.bg_color = _accent if is_active else Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
		style.set_corner_radius_all(7)
		dot.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

		var target_size := Vector2(36, 14) if is_active else Vector2(14, 14)

		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(
			dot,
			"custom_minimum_size",
			target_size,
			0.25
		).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


# ============================================================
# SWIPE + SMOOTH SCROLL GESTURES
# ============================================================

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if _pages.is_empty() or _page_width <= 0.0:
		return

	var vp := get_viewport()
	if vp == null:
		return

	var can_swipe := _pages.size() > 1
	var vp_rect := _viewport.get_global_rect()

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Press / release.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	if event is InputEventScreenTouch or (event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT):
		if event.pressed:
			if vp_rect.has_point(event.position) and not _is_touch_blocked(event.position):
				# If a previous gesture was still blocked, clean it up.
				if _gesture_blocked:
					_reset_exercise_gestures()

				_touch_start = event.position
				_axis = 0
				_dragging = false
				_drag_offset = 0.0
				_touch_active = true
				_press_time_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				_gesture_blocked = false

				# Reset vertical scroll tracking.
				_v_drag_active = false
				_v_last_y = event.position.y
				_v_last_time_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				_v_velocity = 0.0
				_stop_scroll_tween()
			else:
				# Press landed on a blocker or outside the page viewport.
				_touch_active = false
				_dragging = false
				_v_drag_active = false
				_axis = 2
		else:
			# A long press with no drag should not trigger buttons or typing fields.
			if _touch_active and not _dragging and not _v_drag_active:
				var hold_duration := Time.get_ticks_msec() - _press_time_msec
				if hold_duration > _HOLD_MAX_MSEC:
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()
					_reset_exercise_gestures()
					vp.set_input_as_handled()

			# If the user paused before releasing, do not apply stale inertia.
			if Time.get_ticks_msec() - _v_last_time_msec > 120:
				_v_velocity = 0.0

			if _dragging and _axis == 1:
				_finish_drag()
				_reset_exercise_gestures()
				vp.set_input_as_handled()
			elif _v_drag_active and _axis == 2:
				_finish_vertical_drag()
				_reset_exercise_gestures()
				vp.set_input_as_handled()

			_dragging = false
			_v_drag_active = false
			_axis = 0
			_touch_active = false

	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	# Drag / motion.
	# ------------------------------------------------------------
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag or (event is InputEventMouseMotion and Input.is_mouse_button_pressed(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)):
		if not _touch_active:
			return

		# Decide gesture axis.
		if _axis == 0:
			var delta: Vector2 = event.position - _touch_start
			var abs_dx := absf(delta.x)
			var abs_dy := absf(delta.y)
			var can_scroll_vertical := _can_current_scroll_vertically()

			if abs_dx > _GESTURE_THRESHOLD or abs_dy > _GESTURE_THRESHOLD:
				# Horizontal page swipe.
				if can_swipe and abs_dx > abs_dy * 1.1:
					_axis = 1
					_dragging = true
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()

				# Vertical page scroll.
				elif can_scroll_vertical and abs_dy > abs_dx * 1.1:
					_axis = 2
					_v_drag_active = true
					_v_last_y = event.position.y
					_v_last_time_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec()
					_v_velocity = 0.0
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()

				# Fallback rules.
				elif can_swipe and not can_scroll_vertical and abs_dx > _GESTURE_THRESHOLD:
					_axis = 1
					_dragging = true
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()
				elif can_scroll_vertical:
					_axis = 2
					_v_drag_active = true
					_v_last_y = event.position.y
					_v_last_time_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec()
					_v_velocity = 0.0
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()
				elif can_swipe:
					_axis = 1
					_dragging = true
					_cancel_exercise_gestures()

		# ------------------------------------------------------------
		# Horizontal page swipe.
		# ------------------------------------------------------------
		if _dragging and _axis == 1:
			_cancel_exercise_gestures()
			vp.set_input_as_handled()

			var delta_x: float = event.position.x - _touch_start.x

			# Rubber-band at the edges.
			var proposed := _current * _page_width - delta_x
			if proposed < 0.0 or proposed > (_pages.size() - 1) * _page_width:
				delta_x *= 0.35

			_slider.position.x = -_current * _page_width + delta_x
			_drag_offset = delta_x

			var float_index := clampf(
				-_slider.position.x / _page_width,
				0.0,
				float(_pages.size() - 1)
			)
			_set_indicator_to(float_index)

		# ------------------------------------------------------------
		# Vertical smooth scrolling.
		# ------------------------------------------------------------
		elif _v_drag_active and _axis == 2:
			var scroll := _get_current_scroll()
			if scroll == null:
				return

			var max_v := _get_max_scroll(scroll)
			if max_v <= 0:
				# Nothing to scroll. Do not reset the gesture here,
				# because dragging should still not trigger buttons.
				_v_drag_active = false
				return

			_cancel_exercise_gestures()
			vp.set_input_as_handled()

			var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
			var dt := maxf(float(now - _v_last_time_msec) / 1000.0, 0.001)
			var drag_dy: float = event.position.y - _v_last_y

			_v_last_y = event.position.y
			_v_last_time_msec = now

			# Positive velocity means scrolling downward.
			var instant_velocity := -drag_dy / dt
			_v_velocity = lerpf(_v_velocity, instant_velocity, 0.35)

			var new_scroll := int(scroll.scroll_vertical - drag_dy)
			scroll.scroll_vertical = clampi(new_scroll, 0, max_v)

func _finish_drag() -> void:
	var threshold := _page_width * 0.25
	var target := _current

	if _drag_offset < -threshold:
		target = _current + 1
	elif _drag_offset > threshold:
		target = _current - 1

	go_to_page(target)


func _finish_vertical_drag() -> void:
	var scroll := _get_current_scroll()
	if scroll == null:
		return

	var max_v := _get_max_scroll(scroll)
	if max_v <= 0:
		return

	# Too slow: no fling.
	if absf(_v_velocity) < 140.0:
		return

	# Inertia distance.
	var distance := _v_velocity * 0.42
	var target := clampi(int(scroll.scroll_vertical + distance), 0, max_v)

	if target == scroll.scroll_vertical:
		return

	_stop_scroll_tween()

	var duration := clampf(
		absf(float(target - scroll.scroll_vertical)) / maxf(absf(_v_velocity), 1.0),
		0.18,
		0.75
	)

	_scroll_tween = create_tween()
	_scroll_tween.tween_property(
		scroll,
		"scroll_vertical",
		target,
		duration
	).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _get_current_scroll() -> ScrollContainer:
	if _pages.is_empty():
		return null

	var idx := clampi(_current, 0, _pages.size() - 1)
	var scroll := _pages[idx].get("scroll") as ScrollContainer

	if is_instance_valid(scroll):
		return scroll

	return null


func _get_max_scroll(scroll: ScrollContainer) -> int:
	if scroll == null:
		return 0

	var vbar := scroll.get_v_scroll_bar()
	if vbar == null:
		return 0

	return int(maxf(vbar.max_value - vbar.page, 0.0))


func _can_current_scroll_vertically() -> bool:
	return _get_max_scroll(_get_current_scroll()) > 0


func _stop_scroll_tween() -> void:
	if _scroll_tween != null and _scroll_tween.is_valid():
		_scroll_tween.kill()

	_scroll_tween = null


# ============================================================
# SWIPE BLOCKERS
# ============================================================

func add_swipe_blocker(control: Control) -> void:
	if control and not _swipe_blockers.has(control):
		_swipe_blockers.append(control)
		if control.has_signal("visibility_changed_state"):
			var callback: Callable = _on_audio_panel_visibility_changed.bind(control)
			if not control.visibility_changed_state.is_connected(callback):
				control.visibility_changed_state.connect(callback)
			if control.visible:
				_on_audio_panel_visibility_changed(true, control)


func _on_audio_panel_visibility_changed(is_open: bool, panel: Control) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(panel):
		return
	_audio_panel_open = is_open
	_audio_panel_clearance = panel.size.y if is_open else 0.0
	if _audio_panel_open:
		var panel_top: float = panel.get_global_rect().position.y
		var covered_height: float = maxf(0.0, get_global_rect().end.y - panel_top)
		_audio_panel_clearance = covered_height
	_apply_audio_panel_clearance()


func _apply_audio_panel_clearance() -> void:
	for page_data: Dictionary in _pages:
		var scroll: ScrollContainer = page_data.get("scroll") as ScrollContainer
		var margin: MarginContainer = page_data.get("margin") as MarginContainer
		if not is_instance_valid(scroll) or not is_instance_valid(margin):
			continue
		var bottom_padding: int = 60 + int(ceil(_audio_panel_clearance))
		margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", bottom_padding)
		margin.reset_size()
		margin.queue_sort()
		scroll.queue_sort()
		if _audio_panel_open:
			if not page_data.has("audio_saved_scroll"):
				page_data["audio_saved_scroll"] = scroll.scroll_vertical
			call_deferred("_apply_audio_scroll_after_layout", page_data)
		else:
			if page_data.has("audio_saved_scroll"):
				scroll.set_deferred("scroll_vertical", int(page_data["audio_saved_scroll"]))
				page_data.erase("audio_saved_scroll")
			margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 60)


func _apply_audio_scroll_after_layout(page_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if not _audio_panel_open:
		return
	var scroll: ScrollContainer = page_data.get("scroll") as ScrollContainer
	var margin: MarginContainer = page_data.get("margin") as MarginContainer
	if not is_instance_valid(scroll) or not is_instance_valid(margin):
		return
	var max_scroll: float = maxf(0.0, margin.get_combined_minimum_size().y - scroll.size.y)
	var required_scroll: int = int(ceil(_audio_panel_clearance))
	var applied_scroll: float = minf(max_scroll, float(required_scroll))
	var target_scroll: float = maxf(float(page_data.get("audio_saved_scroll", 0)), applied_scroll)
	scroll.scroll_vertical = int(ceil(target_scroll))


func _is_touch_blocked(global_pos: Vector2) -> bool:
	for blocker in _swipe_blockers:
		if is_instance_valid(blocker) and blocker.is_visible_in_tree():
			if blocker.get_global_rect().has_point(global_pos):
				return true

	# Ordering drag handles (≡): presses on a grab handle must never start a
	# page scroll/swipe — the exercise engine owns the gesture there. Handles
	# are added to this group by the engine (timing-independent, rebuilt
	# handles re-join automatically).
	var handles := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("order_drag_handles")
	for h in handles:
		var handle_ctrl := h as Control
		if handle_ctrl != null and handle_ctrl.is_visible_in_tree():
			if handle_ctrl.get_global_rect().has_point(global_pos):
				return true

	return false

func _exercise_request_keyboard_visibility() -> void:
	var focused := get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner()

	if focused == null:
		return

	if not (focused is LineEdit or focused is TextEdit):
		return

	# Give Android a moment to display the keyboard and report
	# its actual height.
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout

	if not is_instance_valid(focused):
		return

	var scroll := _get_current_scroll()

	if scroll == null:
		return

	# First let Godot's built-in focus-follow behavior do its job.
	scroll.ensure_control_visible(focused)

	# Android keyboard height.
	var keyboard_height := DisplayServer.virtual_keyboard_get_height()

	if keyboard_height <= 0:
		return

	# Give the field a comfortable gap above the keyboard.
	var safe_gap := 32.0

	var field_rect := focused.get_global_rect()

	var keyboard_top := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.y - keyboard_height

	var field_bottom := field_rect.position.y + field_rect.size.y
	var allowed_bottom := keyboard_top - safe_gap

	if field_bottom > allowed_bottom:
		var amount := field_bottom - allowed_bottom

		scroll.scroll_vertical = clampi(
			int(scroll.scroll_vertical + amount),
			0,
			_get_max_scroll(scroll)
		)
```

```gdscript
@onready var search_container: HBoxContainer = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/SearchContainer
@onready var search_input: LineEdit = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/SearchContainer/SearchInput
@onready var clear_search_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/SearchContainer/ClearSearchButton

var ENG_FONT : Font = load("res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Medium.ttf")
var FARSI_FONT : Font = load("res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf")

# متغیری برای ذخیره انیمیشن فعلی تا تداخلی پیش نیاید
var is_open := false
var tween: Tween
var hamburger_button: Button
var hamburger_original_position: Vector2
var menu_closed_position: float
var menu_open_position: float

# Search state
var is_searching := false
var current_search_results: Array = []
var all_review_words: Array = []

func _ready() -> void:
	# Hide menu immediately to prevent flash
	menu_panel.visible = false
	
	overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
	overlay.visible = false
	
	# Calculate positions based on viewport
	menu_closed_position = -menu_panel.size.x  # Off-screen left
	menu_open_position = 0  # At screen's left edge
	
	# Set initial position (off-screen left)
	menu_panel.position.x = menu_closed_position
	
	# Now show the menu (it's off-screen so won't be visible)
	menu_panel.visible = true
	
	overlay.gui_input.connect(_on_overlay_gui_input)
	
	# Setup search
	search_input.text_changed.connect(_on_search_text_changed)
	clear_search_button.pressed.connect(_clear_search)
	
	# Connect to Global signal to update list when review words change
	Global.review_words_changed.connect(_on_review_words_changed)
	
	# Theme awareness — restyle the panel live on theme toggle.
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()

	# Initially hide clear button
	clear_search_button.visible = false

func set_hamburger_button(button: Button) -> void:
	hamburger_button = button
	hamburger_original_position = hamburger_button.position

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# THEME AWARENESS — restyle the panel for Dark / Light
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()

	# Panel background per theme.
	var st := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	st.set_corner_radius_all(24)
	if dark:
		st.bg_color = Color(0, 0.29, 0.29, 1)
		st.set_border_width_all(0)
	else:
		st.bg_color = Color(0.97, 0.98, 1, 1)
		st.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.08)
		st.set_border_width_all(1)
	menu_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", st)

	# Overlay dims the page behind — neutral in both themes.
	overlay.color = Color(0, 0, 0, 1) if not dark else Color(0, 0.29, 0.29, 1)

	# Static panel labels. These use LabelSettings resources that override the
	# theme font colour, so drive them explicitly.
	var _dim: Color = Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
	var _text: Color = Global.get_theme_color("text")
	title_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text)
	total_words_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text)
	for _l in [title_label, total_words_label]:
		if _l.label_settings != null:
			var _ls: LabelSettings = _l.label_settings
			_ls.font_color = _text
	# Make the search LineEdit readable in both themes (bg + text + caret).
	var _field := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	_field.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	_field.content_margin_left = 14
	_field.content_margin_right = 14
	if dark:
		_field.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.10)
		_field.border_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.15)
	else:
		_field.bg_color = Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
		_field.border_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.15)
	_field.set_border_width_all(1)
	var _field_focus: StyleBoxFlat = _field.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	_field_focus.border_color = DesignTokens.ACCENT
	_field_focus.set_border_width_all(2)
	search_input.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _field)
	search_input.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _field_focus)
	search_input.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _text)
	search_input.add_theme_color_override("font_placeholder_color", _dim)
	search_input.add_theme_color_override("caret_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent"))

	# Button text + backgrounds readable on the panel in both themes.
	var text_color: Color = Global.get_theme_color("text")
	var btn_bg := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.08) if dark else Color(0, 0, 0, 0.05)
	var btn_border := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.12) if dark else Color(0, 0, 0, 0.10)
	var btn_hover_bg := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.15) if dark else Color(0.545, 0.361, 0.965, 0.12)

	for btn in [clear_search_button]:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text_color)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", text_color)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", text_color)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", text_color)

		# The visible text is a child Label inside the button — recolor it too.
		for lbl in btn.find_children("TextLabel", "Label", true, false):
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text_color)

		# Give the buttons a subtle, theme-appropriate backdrop.
		var normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		normal.bg_color = btn_bg
		normal.border_color = btn_border
		normal.set_border_width_all(1)
		normal.set_corner_radius_all(12)
		normal.content_margin_left = 16
		normal.content_margin_right = 16
		normal.content_margin_top = 10
		normal.content_margin_bottom = 10
		var hover := normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
		hover.bg_color = btn_hover_bg
		hover.border_color = DesignTokens.ACCENT
		hover.set_border_width_all(2)
		var pressed := hover.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
		var focus := hover.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pressed)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", focus)

func toggle() -> void:
	if is_open:
		close()
	else:
		open()

func open() -> void:
	# Refresh data when opening
	_refresh_data()
	_populate_list()
	
	if is_open: 
		return
	
	is_open = true
	overlay.visible = true
	
	if tween: 
		tween.kill()
	
	tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	
	# Move panel from left (off-screen) to fully open
	tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "position:x", menu_open_position, 0.4)\
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Fade in overlay
	tween.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.5, 0.4)
	
	if hamburger_button:
		# Move hamburger button to stay at the right edge of the menu panel
		var target_btn_x = menu_panel.size.x - hamburger_original_position.x
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "position:x", target_btn_x, 0.4)\
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Clear search when opening menu
	_clear_search()
	# NOTE: we deliberately do NOT grab focus on the search field here.
	# On mobile that would immediately pop the soft keyboard; the user opens
	# it by tapping the search box instead.

func close() -> void:
	if not is_open: 
		return
	
	is_open = false
	
	if tween: 
		tween.kill()
	
	tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	
	# Move panel back off-screen left
	tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "position:x", menu_closed_position, 0.4)\
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Fade out overlay
	tween.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.4)
	
	if hamburger_button:
		# Return hamburger button to the original position (stuck to the menu panel)
		var target_btn_x = hamburger_original_position.x
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "position:x", target_btn_x, 0.4)\
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "rotation_degrees", 0.0, 0.4)\
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Hide overlay after animation completes
	tween.chain().tween_callback(func(): overlay.visible = false)

func _on_overlay_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		close()

# ==========================================
# SEARCH SYSTEM
# ==========================================

func _refresh_data() -> void:
	"""Refresh the all_review_words cache"""
	all_review_words = Global.get_review_words()
	current_search_results = []

func _on_review_words_changed() -> void:
	"""Called when review words change - refresh the list"""
	_refresh_data()
	if is_searching and search_input.text != "":
		_perform_search(search_input.text)
	else:
		_populate_list()

func _on_search_text_changed(new_text: String) -> void:
	if new_text == "":
		_clear_search()
		return
	
	is_searching = true
	clear_search_button.visible = true
	_perform_search(new_text)

func _perform_search(query: String) -> void:
	"""Search through review words and display results"""
	var trimmed_query = query.strip_edges().to_lower()
	if trimmed_query == "":
		_clear_search()
		return
	
	current_search_results = []
	
	# Search through all review words
	for entry in all_review_words:
		var word = entry.get("word", "").to_lower()
		var meaning_en = entry.get("meaning_en", "").to_lower()
		var meaning_fa = entry.get("meaning_fa", "").to_lower()
		
		# Check if the query matches word, English meaning, or Persian meaning
		if word.find(trimmed_query) != -1 or \
		   meaning_en.find(trimmed_query) != -1 or \
		   meaning_fa.find(trimmed_query) != -1:
			current_search_results.append(entry)
	
	# Update the word count label
	_update_total_count(current_search_results.size(), true)
	
	# Clear and repopulate the word list with search results
	_clear_word_list()
	for entry in current_search_results:
		_create_word_item(entry, true)  # true = search result mode

func _clear_search() -> void:
	"""Clear the search and show all words"""
	is_searching = false
	search_input.text = ""
	clear_search_button.visible = false
	current_search_results = []
	_populate_list()
	# Remove focus from search input
	if search_input:
		search_input.release_focus()

func _clear_word_list() -> void:
	"""Clear all children from the word list"""
	for child in word_list.get_children():
		child.queue_free()

# ==========================================
# WORD LIST POPULATION
# ==========================================

func _populate_list() -> void:
	"""Populate the word list with all review words"""
	_clear_word_list()
	
	var review_words: Array = Global.get_review_words()
	_update_total_count(review_words.size(), false)
	
	for entry in review_words:
		_create_word_item(entry, false)  # false = normal mode

func _create_word_item(entry: Dictionary, is_search_result: bool = false) -> void:
	var item_box = HBoxContainer.new()
	item_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	item_box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	
	# Add click behavior to select word
	item_box.gui_input.connect(_on_word_item_clicked.bind(entry, item_box))
	
	# Word label
	var word_label = Label.new()
	word_label.text = entry.get("word", "Unknown")
	word_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	
	if ENG_FONT:
		word_label.add_theme_font_override("font", ENG_FONT)
	
	# Set font size
	word_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 45)
	
	# Theme-aware text so words stay readable on the panel in both modes.
	word_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text"))
	
	# Add search highlight if this is a search result
	if is_search_result and search_input.text != "":
		word_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#3B82F6"))  # Blue highlight
	
	# Delete button
	var delete_btn = Button.new()
	delete_btn.text = "حذف"
	delete_btn.modulate = Color("#EF4444") 
	
	if FARSI_FONT:
		delete_btn.add_theme_font_override("font", FARSI_FONT)
	
	# Set font size
	delete_btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 45)
	delete_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("000000ff"))
	
	# Add Corner Radius Styling
	var style_box_normal = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style_box_normal.bg_color = Color("#EF4444")
	style_box_normal.set_corner_radius_all(30)
	style_box_normal.set_border_width_all(0)
	style_box_normal.content_margin_left = 15
	style_box_normal.content_margin_right = 15
	style_box_normal.content_margin_top = 5
	style_box_normal.content_margin_bottom = 5

	var style_box_hover = style_box_normal.duplicate()
	style_box_hover.bg_color = Color("#DC2626")

	var style_box_pressed = style_box_normal.duplicate()
	style_box_pressed.bg_color = Color("#B91C1C")

	# Apply the style overrides
	delete_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style_box_normal)
	delete_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style_box_hover)
	delete_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style_box_pressed)
	
	delete_btn.pressed.connect(func(): _on_delete_word_pressed(entry, item_box))
	
	item_box.add_child(word_label)
	item_box.add_child(delete_btn)
	
	word_list.add_child(item_box)

func _on_word_item_clicked(event: InputEvent, entry: Dictionary, _item_node: Node) -> void:
	"""Handle clicking on a word item to navigate to it"""
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		# Emit signal that a word was selected
		word_selected.emit(entry)
		# Close the menu
		close()

func _on_delete_word_pressed(entry: Dictionary, item_node: Node) -> void:
	var word: String = entry.get("word", "")
	var book: int = entry.get("book", 0)
	var lesson: int = entry.get("lesson", 0)
	
	Global.remove_review_word(word, book, lesson)
	item_node.queue_free()
	
	# Refresh the list if in search mode
	if is_searching:
		current_search_results.erase(entry)
		_update_total_count(current_search_results.size(), true)
		# If no results left, clear search
		if current_search_results.is_empty():
			_clear_search()
	else:
		var new_count = Global.get_review_words().size()
		_update_total_count(new_count, false)

func _update_total_count(count: int, is_search: bool = false) -> void:
	if is_search:
		var query = search_input.text.strip_edges()
		if query != "":
			# فقط تعداد کلمات را نشان می‌دهیم بدون نمایش کلمه جستجو شده
			total_words_label.text = "%d کلمه یافت شد" % count
		else:
			total_words_label.text = "تعداد کل کلمات در مرور: %d" % count
	else:
		total_words_label.text = "تعداد کل کلمات در مرور: %d" % count

# ==========================================
# UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

func focus_search() -> void:
	"""Focus the search input field"""
	if search_input:
		search_input.grab_focus()
```

```gdscript
var _panel_stylebox: StyleBoxFlat

@onready var purchase_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/PurchaseButton
@onready var leitner_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/LeitnerButton
@onready var settings_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/SettingsButton
@onready var account_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AccountButton
@onready var about_me_button: Button = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AboutMeButton

@onready var welcome_label: Label   = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/Header/WelcomeText
@onready var version_label: Label   = $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/VersionLabel

var is_open := false
var tween: Tween
var hamburger_button: Button
var hamburger_original_position: Vector2
var menu_closed_position: float
var menu_open_position: float

# ─── Emoji mapping for each button ─────────────────────────────
const BUTTON_EMOJIS := {
	"SavedWords": "📚",
	"Leitner":    "🧠",
	"Purchase":   "💎",
	"Account":    "📱",
	"Settings":   "⚙️",
	"AboutMe":    "👤",
}

const BUTTON_TEXT_FONT_SIZE := 45
const EMOJI_FONT_SIZE := 55
const EMOJI_MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH := 44.0

# Fixed width for the emoji column so all emojis align vertically
const EMOJI_WIDTH := 40.0

func _ready() -> void:
	# Hide menu immediately to prevent flash
	menu_panel.visible = false

	# Give the VBoxContainer a cleaner rhythm
	var vbox := $MenuPanel/MarginContainer/VBoxContainer as VBoxContainer
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 40)

	overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
	overlay.visible = false

	# Calculate positions based on viewport
	_update_menu_positions()

	# Recompute if the window/viewport is ever resized (desktop testing,
	# foldables) so the panel always parks fully off/on screen.
	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_update_menu_positions)

	# Set initial position (off-screen right)
	menu_panel.position.x = menu_closed_position
	# Keep the closed drawer hidden. It is shown only by open(), so a fresh
	# MainMenu never draws a parked sliver or a shadow bleed on the edge.
	menu_panel.visible = false

	overlay.gui_input.connect(_on_overlay_gui_input)
	saved_words_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("saved_words_pressed"); close())
	leitner_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("leitner_pressed"); close())
	purchase_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("purchase_pressed"); close())
	settings_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("settings_pressed"); close())
	account_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("account_pressed"); close())
	about_me_button.pressed.connect(func(): emit_signal("about_me_pressed"); close())

	_setup_modern_buttons()

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()


# How far past the right viewport edge the closed drawer is parked. A plain
# "viewport width" is NOT enough: the panel is laid out from its offsets each
# frame and actually settles a few px on-screen (and its shadow bleeds further),
# which shows a sliver of the menu on the fresh MainMenu after leaving a
# side-menu destination and coming back. Pushing it off with a margin — and
# keeping it invisible while closed — guarantees nothing is ever drawn.
const CLOSED_OFFSCREEN_MARGIN := 60.0

# Recomputes the off-screen / on-screen X positions from the current
# viewport size. Called in _ready and again whenever the viewport resizes
# so the drawer always parks exactly at the right edge.
func _update_menu_positions() -> void:
	menu_closed_position = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x + CLOSED_OFFSCREEN_MARGIN
	menu_open_position = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x - menu_panel.size.x
	# If the drawer is currently closed, keep it fully off-screen.
	if not is_open:
		menu_panel.position.x = menu_closed_position


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# THEME AWARENESS — restyle the panel for Dark / Light
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


# The drawer palette comes straight from the design tokens, so it matches the
# rest of the app: the soft-UI charcoal shell in Dark, warm paper in Light,
# with the signature gold rim along the leading edge.
func _panel_bg() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "sidebar")


func _panel_border() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "gold_rim")


func _overlay_color() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "overlay")


func _text_color() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "text")


func _dim_text_color() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "text_dim")


func _chip_bg() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "surface_alt")


func _chip_hover() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "accent_soft")


func _chip_border() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(Global.theme_is_dark(), "border")

func _apply_theme() -> void:
	var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
	var panel_bg := _panel_bg()
	var overlay_col := _overlay_color()
	var text_col := _text_color()
	var dim_text_col := _dim_text_color()
	# Panel — the drawer surface, with a gold hairline along its leading edge.
	var st := DesignTokens.box(
		panel_bg,
		0,
		_panel_border(),
		DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE,
		Color(0, 0, 0, 0.40 if dark else 0.16),
		DesignTokens.SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
		Vector2(-6, 0)
	)
	st.corner_radius_top_left = DesignTokens.RADIUS_MD
	st.corner_radius_bottom_left = DesignTokens.RADIUS_MD
	st.border_width_left = DesignTokens.BORDER_STANDARD
	_panel_stylebox = st
	menu_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", st)

	# While the drawer is closed its panel hides off-screen; keep the shadow
	# disabled so it can't cast a visible strip onto the scene edge. open()
	# re-enables it, close() keeps it off.
	if not is_open:
		st.shadow_size = 0
		st.shadow_offset = Vector2.ZERO

	# Overlay dims the page behind.
	overlay.color = overlay_col

	# Header / footer text.
	user_name_label.text = "سلام! 👋"
	welcome_label.text = "چطور میتوانم کمکت کنم؟"
	for l in [user_name_label, version_label]:
		if l.label_settings != null:
			l.label_settings.font_color = text_col
		else:
			l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text_col)
	# Menu titles stay centred in the drawer.
	user_name_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	welcome_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	version_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if welcome_label.label_settings != null:
		welcome_label.label_settings.font_color = dim_text_col
	else:
		welcome_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", dim_text_col)

	for btn in [saved_words_button, leitner_button, purchase_button, settings_button, account_button, about_me_button]:
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text_col)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", text_col)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", text_col)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", text_col)

		# The visible text is a child Label inside the button — recolor it too.
		for lbl in btn.find_children("TextLabel", "Label", true, false):
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text_col)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MODERN BUTTON STYLING
# Accent colours come from the palette now that the drawer no longer carries
# its own violet identity — the app has ONE accent (the design system's blue).
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


func _apply_modern_style(btn: Button) -> void:
	# Drawer rows are "chips": the raised surface with a hairline border, an
	# accent wash on hover and a solid accent fill when pressed.
	var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
	var t := Theme.new()

	var normal := DesignTokens.box(_chip_bg(), DesignTokens.RADIUS_SM, _chip_border(), DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE)
	DesignTokens.pad(normal, DesignTokens.SPACE_SM, 12)

	var hover := DesignTokens.box(
		_chip_hover(),
		DesignTokens.RADIUS_SM,
		DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent_bright"),
		DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE
	)
	DesignTokens.pad(hover, DesignTokens.SPACE_SM, 12)

	var pressed := DesignTokens.box(
		DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"),
		DesignTokens.RADIUS_SM,
		DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent_bright"),
		DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE
	)
	DesignTokens.pad(pressed, DesignTokens.SPACE_SM, 12)

	t.set_stylebox("normal",   "Button", normal)
	t.set_stylebox("hover",    "Button", hover)
	t.set_stylebox("pressed",  "Button", pressed)
	t.set_stylebox("focus",    "Button", DesignTokens.button_focus(dark))
	t.set_stylebox("disabled", "Button", normal)

	# --- Typography ---
	t.set_color("font_color",         "Button", _text_color())
	t.set_color("font_hover_color",   "Button", DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent_bright"))
	t.set_color("font_pressed_color", "Button", DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "on_accent"))
	t.set_color("font_focus_color",   "Button", _text_color())
	t.set_font_size("font_size", "Button", DesignTokens.FONT_SMALL)
	t.set_constant("h_separation", "Button", 10)

	btn.theme = t


func _setup_modern_buttons() -> void:
	var button_data: Array[Dictionary] = [
		{"button": saved_words_button, "key": "SavedWords"},
		{"button": leitner_button,     "key": "Leitner"},
		{"button": purchase_button,    "key": "Purchase"},
		{"button": account_button,     "key": "Account"},
		{"button": settings_button,    "key": "Settings"},
		{"button": about_me_button,    "key": "AboutMe"},
	]

	for data in button_data:
		var btn: Button = data.get("button")
		var key: String = data.get("key", "")

		if btn == null:
			continue

		# Keep the original minimum size as a base minimum.
		if not btn.has_meta("base_min_size"):
			btn.set_meta("base_min_size", btn.custom_minimum_size)

		# Store the original visible text before rebuilding the button content.
		if not btn.has_meta("original_text"):
			btn.set_meta("original_text", _extract_button_text(btn))

		_apply_modern_style(btn)
		_rebuild_button_content(btn, key)
		_add_hover_animation(btn)



func _add_hover_animation(btn: Button) -> void:
	# Keep pivot centered so the button scales from its middle
	var update_pivot := func() -> void:
		btn.pivot_offset = btn.size / 2.0
	update_pivot.call()
	btn.resized.connect(update_pivot)

	# Smooth grow on hover
	btn.mouse_entered.connect(func() -> void:
		_tween_scale(btn, Vector2(1.04, 1.04), 0.15)
	)
	# Shrink back when mouse leaves
	btn.mouse_exited.connect(func() -> void:
		_tween_scale(btn, Vector2.ONE, 0.15)
	)
	# Quick "press-down" feedback
	btn.button_down.connect(func() -> void:
		_tween_scale(btn, Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)
	)
	btn.button_up.connect(func() -> void:
		_tween_scale(btn, Vector2(1.04, 1.04), 0.08)
	)


func _tween_scale(btn: Button, target: Vector2, duration: float) -> void:
	# Kill any previous scale tween on this button to avoid conflicts
	if btn.has_meta("scale_tween"):
		var old := btn.get_meta("scale_tween") as Tween
		if old.is_valid():
			old.kill()

	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(btn, "scale", target, duration) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	btn.set_meta("scale_tween", tw)


# ─── Menu open / close ─────────────────────────────────────────
func set_hamburger_button(button: Button) -> void:
	hamburger_button = button
	# Position is captured lazily on the first open() — by then the button is
	# laid out (a floating control may still be settling in _ready).


func toggle() -> void:
	if is_open:
		close()
	else:
		open()


func open() -> void:
	if is_open:
		return
	is_open = true
	menu_panel.visible = true

	# Restore shadow for the open animation.
	if _panel_stylebox:
		_panel_stylebox.shadow_size = 24
		_panel_stylebox.shadow_offset = Vector2(-6, 0)

	overlay.visible = true
	if tween:
		tween.kill()

	tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "position:x", menu_open_position, 0.4) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.85, 0.4)

	if hamburger_button:
		if hamburger_original_position == Vector2.ZERO:
			hamburger_original_position = hamburger_button.position
		var target_btn_x := hamburger_original_position.x - menu_panel.size.x
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "position:x", target_btn_x, 0.4) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		# Counter-clockwise 90° so the ☰ turns into a vertical "close" glyph.
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "rotation_degrees", -90.0, 0.4) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func close() -> void:
	if not is_open:
		return
	is_open = false

	# Kill shadow immediately so it can't bleed onto the next scene.
	if _panel_stylebox:
		_panel_stylebox.shadow_size = 0
		_panel_stylebox.shadow_offset = Vector2.ZERO

	if tween:
		tween.kill()

	tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	tween.tween_property(menu_panel, "position:x", menu_closed_position, 0.4) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(overlay, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.4)

	if hamburger_button:
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "position:x", hamburger_original_position.x, 0.4) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		tween.tween_property(hamburger_button, "rotation_degrees", 0.0, 0.4) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUART).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)

	tween.chain().tween_callback(_on_close_tween_complete)


func _on_close_tween_complete() -> void:
	overlay.visible = false
	menu_panel.visible = false


func _on_overlay_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		close()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Button content helpers
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Tries to get the original text from the Button itself.
# If the Button text is empty, it looks for an existing Label child.
func _extract_button_text(btn: Button) -> String:
	var direct_text := btn.text.strip_edges()
	if not direct_text.is_empty():
		return direct_text

	for child in btn.find_children("*", "Label"):
		var label := child as Label
		if label and not label.text.strip_edges().is_empty():
			return label.text.strip_edges()

	# Fallback: SavedWordsButton -> SavedWords
	return btn.name.trim_suffix("Button")


# Rebuilds the button content as:
# [LeftSpacer] [Centered Text] [Emoji]
#
# The LeftSpacer has the same width as the emoji column.
# This makes the text visually centered inside the whole button,
# while the emoji stays aligned on the right side.
func _rebuild_button_content(btn: Button, emoji_key: String) -> void:
	var button_text: String = btn.get_meta("original_text", "")
	btn.text = ""
	btn.clip_contents = false

	# Keep full width so all right-side emojis align with each other.
	btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	# Let the button height fit its content instead of stretching unnecessarily.
	btn.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER

	# Remove old custom children safely.
	for child in btn.get_children():
		if child.is_internal():
			continue
		btn.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()

	# Main row inside the button.
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.name = "ButtonContent"
	row.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	btn.add_child(row)

	# Invisible spacer on the left.
	# It balances the emoji width on the right, so the text stays centered.
	var left_spacer := Control.new()
	left_spacer.name = "LeftSpacer"
	left_spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	left_spacer.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	left_spacer.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_FILL
	row.add_child(left_spacer)

	# Centered text label.
	var text_label := Label.new()
	text_label.name = "TextLabel"
	text_label.text = button_text
	text_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	text_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	text_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	text_label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_FILL
	text_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	text_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#FFFFFF") if Global.theme_is_dark() else Color("#1E1E1E"))
	text_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", BUTTON_TEXT_FONT_SIZE)
	row.add_child(text_label)

	# Right emoji label.
	var emoji_label := Label.new()
	emoji_label.name = "EmojiLabel"
	emoji_label.text = BUTTON_EMOJIS.get(emoji_key, "")
	emoji_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	emoji_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	emoji_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_END
	emoji_label.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_FILL
	emoji_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	emoji_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", EMOJI_FONT_SIZE)
	row.add_child(emoji_label)

	# Refresh layout and minimum size whenever something changes.
	var refresh := func() -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(btn) or not is_instance_valid(row):
			return
		_sync_emoji_column_width(left_spacer, emoji_label)
		_apply_content_margins(btn, row)
		_update_button_minimum_size(btn, row)

	btn.theme_changed.connect(refresh)
	row.minimum_size_changed.connect(refresh)
	text_label.minimum_size_changed.connect(refresh)
	emoji_label.minimum_size_changed.connect(refresh)

	# Initial refresh.
	refresh.call()


# Keeps the left spacer and emoji label using the same column width.
func _sync_emoji_column_width(left_spacer: Control, emoji_label: Label) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(left_spacer) or not is_instance_valid(emoji_label):
		return

	var font_size := emoji_label.get_theme_font_size("font_size")
	var column_width : float = max(EMOJI_MIN_COLUMN_WIDTH, float(font_size) * 1.5)

	if left_spacer.custom_minimum_size.x != column_width:
		left_spacer.custom_minimum_size.x = column_width

	if emoji_label.custom_minimum_size.x != column_width:
		emoji_label.custom_minimum_size.x = column_width


# Applies the Button StyleBox content margins to the inner HBoxContainer.
func _apply_content_margins(btn: Button, content: Control) -> void:
	var style := btn.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
	if style == null:
		return

	content.offset_left = style.get_content_margin(SIDE_LEFT)
	content.offset_top = style.get_content_margin(SIDE_TOP)
	content.offset_right = -style.get_content_margin(SIDE_RIGHT)
	content.offset_bottom = -style.get_content_margin(SIDE_BOTTOM)


# Makes the Button large enough to fit its custom child content.
func _update_button_minimum_size(btn: Button, content: Control) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(btn) or not is_instance_valid(content):
		return

	var base_min: Vector2 = btn.get_meta("base_min_size", Vector2.ZERO)
	var style := btn.get_theme_stylebox("normal")

	var margin := Vector2.ZERO
	if style:
		margin.x += style.get_content_margin(SIDE_LEFT)
		margin.x += style.get_content_margin(SIDE_RIGHT)
		margin.y += style.get_content_margin(SIDE_TOP)
		margin.y += style.get_content_margin(SIDE_BOTTOM)

	var needed := content.get_combined_minimum_size() + margin

	var final_min := Vector2(
		max(base_min.x, needed.x),
		max(base_min.y, needed.y)
	)

	if btn.custom_minimum_size != final_min:
		btn.custom_minimum_size = final_min
```

```gdscript
class_name FlashcardHub
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# FLASHCARD HUB — فلش کارت و لایتنر
# Entry hub reached from the bottom navigation bar's "فلش کارت"
# item. Provides two modes:
#   - فلش کارت  -> VocabFlashcards in saved_word mode
#   - لایتنر    -> WordReview (spaced-repetition review)
# ============================================================

const SCENE_FLASHCARDS: String = "res://scenes/vocabulary/VocabFlashcards.tscn"
const SCENE_SAVED_WORDS: String = "res://scenes/saved_words/SavedWords.tscn"
const SCENE_REVIEW: String = "res://scenes/review/WordReview.tscn"
const SCENE_SELF: String = "res://scenes/vocabulary/FlashcardHub.tscn"

@onready var flashcard_button: Button = $Content/FlashcardButton
@onready var leitner_button: Button = $Content/LeitnerButton
@onready var flashcard_label: Label = $Content/FlashcardButton/Margin/Row/Title
@onready var leitner_label: Label = $Content/LeitnerButton/Margin/Row/Title

var _navigating: bool = false


func _ready() -> void:
	wire_header_bar()
	for label: Label in [flashcard_label, leitner_label]:
		label.self_modulate = Color.WHITE
		label.modulate = Color.WHITE
	flashcard_button.pressed.connect(_on_flashcard_pressed)
	leitner_button.pressed.connect(_on_leitner_pressed)
	_wire_button_animations()
	# Remove initial entrance animation - buttons appear instantly at full opacity
	flashcard_button.modulate = Color.WHITE
	leitner_button.modulate = Color.WHITE


############################################################
# BUTTON ANIMATIONS
############################################################
func _wire_button_animations() -> void:
	for btn: Button in [flashcard_button, leitner_button]:
		btn.pivot_offset = btn.size / 2.0
		btn.resized.connect(_update_mode_button_pivot.bind(btn))
		btn.mouse_entered.connect(_on_mode_button_hovered.bind(btn))
		btn.mouse_exited.connect(_on_mode_button_exited.bind(btn))
		btn.button_down.connect(_animate_mode_button.bind(btn, Vector2(0.97, 0.97)))
		btn.button_up.connect(_on_mode_button_up.bind(btn))
	_play_entrance_animation()


func _update_mode_button_pivot(btn: Button) -> void:
	btn.pivot_offset = btn.size / 2.0


func _on_mode_button_hovered(btn: Button) -> void:
	if not btn.button_pressed:
		_animate_mode_button(btn, Vector2(1.03, 1.03))


func _on_mode_button_exited(btn: Button) -> void:
	if not btn.button_pressed:
		_animate_mode_button(btn, Vector2.ONE)


func _on_mode_button_up(btn: Button) -> void:
	var target_scale: Vector2 = Vector2(1.03, 1.03) if btn.is_hovered() else Vector2.ONE
	_animate_mode_button(btn, target_scale)


func _animate_mode_button(btn: Button, target_scale: Vector2) -> void:
	if btn.has_meta("flashcard_hub_scale_tween"):
		var old_tween: Tween = btn.get_meta("flashcard_hub_scale_tween") as Tween
		if old_tween != null and old_tween.is_valid():
			old_tween.kill()
	var tween: Tween = btn.create_tween()
	btn.set_meta("flashcard_hub_scale_tween", tween)
	tween.tween_property(btn, "scale", target_scale, 0.14).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _play_entrance_animation() -> void:
	var buttons: Array[Button] = [flashcard_button, leitner_button]
	for btn: Button in buttons:
		btn.modulate.a = 0.0
		btn.position.y += 40.0

	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	for i: int in buttons.size():
		var btn: Button = buttons[i]
		var tw: Tween = create_tween()
		tw.tween_interval(0.08 * i)
		tw.tween_property(btn, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.32) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
		tw.parallel().tween_property(btn, "position:y", btn.position.y - 40.0, 0.32) \
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


############################################################
# NAVIGATION
############################################################
func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")


func _on_flashcard_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Sfx.click()
	AppRouter.set_args({
		"mode": "saved",
		"return_route": SCENE_FLASHCARDS,
		"saved_back_route": SCENE_SELF,
	})
	if Global.get_saved_words().is_empty():
		TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_SAVED_WORDS)
	else:
		TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_FLASHCARDS)


func _on_leitner_pressed() -> void:
	if _navigating:
		return
	_navigating = true
	Sfx.click()
	AppRouter.set_args({"return_route": SCENE_SELF})
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_REVIEW)
```
