## File: `res://scenes/word_game/DailyWordGame.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
class_name DailyWordGame

const DailyChallengeStateStore = preload("res://autoload/DailyChallengeState.gd")

const HUB_SCENE: String = "res://scenes/word_game/WordGameHub.tscn"
const OFFICIAL_GAME_SCENE: String = "res://scenes/word_game/OfficialChallengeGame.tscn"
const SCORE_PANEL: PackedScene = preload("res://scenes/word_game/ScorePanel.tscn")
const GAME_TYPES: Array[String] = ["wordle", "wordef", "unscramble"]
const GAME_TITLES: Dictionary = {"wordle": "Wordle", "wordef": "Wordef", "unscramble": "Unscramble"}
var _root: VBoxContainer
var _status: Label
var _month_title: Label
var _day_strip: HBoxContainer
var _scroll: ScrollContainer
var _game_buttons: Dictionary = {}
var _calendar_data: Dictionary = {}
var _selected_date: String = ""
var _summary: Dictionary = {}
var _score_panel: ChallengeScorePanel
var _busy: bool = false
var _summary_request_date: String = ""
var _attempt_status_request_date: String = ""
var _summary_refresh_generation: int = 0

func _ready() -> void:
	_build_ui()
	_load_calendar()

func _build_ui() -> void:
	var bg: ColorRect = ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = MenuStyle.c("bg")
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(bg)

	var scroll_page: ScrollContainer = ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll_page.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll_page.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	add_child(scroll_page)

	var margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 32)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 32)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 240)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 250)
	scroll_page.add_child(margin)

	_root = VBoxContainer.new()
	_root.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	margin.add_child(_root)

	_month_title = _make_label("در حال دریافت تقویم…", 30, true)
	_root.add_child(_month_title)

	_scroll = ScrollContainer.new()
	_scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = 178
	_scroll.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO
	_scroll.vertical_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	_root.add_child(_scroll)
	_day_strip = HBoxContainer.new()
	_day_strip.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	_day_strip.layout_direction = Control.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
	_scroll.add_child(_day_strip)

	var summary_title: Label = _make_label("امتیاز روز انتخاب‌شده", 28, true)
	_root.add_child(summary_title)
	_score_panel = SCORE_PANEL.instantiate() as ChallengeScorePanel
	_root.add_child(_score_panel)
	_score_panel.set_scores(0, 0, "امتیاز روز")

	var status_row: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	status_row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", MenuStyle.card_style(MenuStyle.accent(), 22, false, true))
	var status_pad: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	status_pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 18)
	status_pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 18)
	status_pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 12)
	status_pad.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 12)
	status_row.add_child(status_pad)
	_status = _make_label("", 24, false)
	_status.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_status.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	status_pad.add_child(_status)
	_root.add_child(status_row)

	for game_type: String in GAME_TYPES:
		var button: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("%s  ·  شروع بازی" % GAME_TITLES[game_type], "primary", 112)
		button.layout_direction = Control.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL
		button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		button.pressed.connect(_on_game_pressed.bind(game_type))
		_root.add_child(button)
		_game_buttons[game_type] = button
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(_game_buttons["wordle"])
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(_game_buttons["wordef"])
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(_game_buttons["unscramble"])
	_wire_header()

## The screen wears the app-wide header bar authored in DailyWordGame.tscn, the
## same bar the lesson screens carry. The bar is moved to the end of the child
## list so the scrolling page glides underneath it instead of over it.
func _wire_header() -> void:
	var header: Control = get_node_or_null("HeaderBar") as Control
	if header == null:
		return
	move_child(header, get_child_count() - 1)
	var back: Button = header.get_node_or_null("HeaderContent/BackButton") as Button
	if back != null:
		back.pressed.connect(_go_back)

func _load_calendar() -> void:
	if not API.is_configured() or not API.is_logged_in():
		_set_error("برای چالش رسمی، ورود به حساب و اتصال اینترنت لازم است.")
		return
	_status.text = "در حال بارگذاری تقویم از سرور…"
	API.fetch_challenge_calendar(_on_calendar_loaded)

func _on_calendar_loaded(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if not ok:
		_set_error(_error_message(data))
		return
	_calendar_data = data
	var today: String = str(data.get("today", ""))
	var persisted: String = DailyChallengeStateStore.load_selected_date()
	_selected_date = persisted if _date_is_in_calendar(persisted, data.get("days", [])) else today
	DailyChallengeStateStore.set_selected_date(_selected_date)
	var jalali: Dictionary = data.get("jalali", {})
	_month_title.text = "%s %s" % [JalaliCalendar.month_name(int(jalali.get("month", 1))), JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(jalali.get("year", "")))]
	_build_day_cards(data.get("days", []))
	_load_summary()
	_status.text = "تاریخ چالش بر اساس ساعت رسمی تهران است. آینده قابل انتخاب نیست."

func _date_is_in_calendar(date_key: String, days: Array) -> bool:
	for raw: Variant in days:
		if raw is Dictionary and str(raw.get("date", "")) == date_key and not bool(raw.get("future", false)):
			return true
	return false

func _build_day_cards(days: Array) -> void:
	for child: Node in _day_strip.get_children():
		_day_strip.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	# Keep chronological ascending data order; the container uses RTL layout so
	# the current/latest date appears at the right edge.
	for index: int in range(days.size()):
		var item: Variant = days[index]
		if not item is Dictionary:
			continue
		var cell: Dictionary = item
		var date_key: String = str(cell.get("date", ""))
		var jalali: Dictionary = cell.get("jalali", {})
		var button: Button = Button.new()
		button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(144, 150)
		button.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		button.disabled = bool(cell.get("future", false))
		button.set_meta("date", date_key)
		button.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _day_style(date_key == _selected_date, button.disabled))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", _day_style(date_key == _selected_date, true))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _day_style(true, false))
		button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _day_style(date_key == _selected_date, button.disabled))
		button.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
		button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 1)
		var box: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		box.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
		box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		button.add_child(box)
		box.add_child(_make_label(JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(jalali.get("day", ""))), 35, true))
		box.add_child(_make_label("%s امتیاز" % JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(cell.get("totalScore", 0))), 19, false))
		box.add_child(_make_label("%s/۳" % JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(cell.get("completedGames", 0))), 18, false))
		button.pressed.connect(_select_date.bind(date_key))
		_day_strip.add_child(button)
		button.resized.connect(_center_selected_card)
	call_deferred("_center_selected_card")

func _day_style(selected: bool, disabled: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = MenuStyle.card_style(MenuStyle.accent() if selected else MenuStyle.border(), 20, selected, false)
	if disabled:
		style.bg_color = MenuStyle.surface().darkened(0.18)
		style.border_color = Color(MenuStyle.border(), 0.45)
	return style

func _center_selected_card() -> void:
	if _day_strip == null or _day_strip.get_child_count() == 0:
		return
	for i: int in range(_day_strip.get_child_count()):
		var child: Button = _day_strip.get_child(i) as Button
		var days: Array = _calendar_data.get("days", [])
		if i >= days.size():
			continue
		var cell: Dictionary = days[i]
		var selected: bool = str(cell.get("date", "")) == _selected_date
		child.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(160 if selected else 136, 160 if selected else 142)
		child.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _day_style(selected, child.disabled))
	var selected_control: Control = null
	for child_node: Node in _day_strip.get_children():
		var day_button: Button = child_node as Button
		if day_button != null and str(day_button.get_meta("date", "")) == _selected_date:
			selected_control = day_button
	if selected_control != null:
		var target: int = int(selected_control.position.x + selected_control.size.x * 0.5 - _scroll.size.x * 0.5)
		_scroll.scroll_horizontal = maxi(0, target)

func _select_date(date_key: String) -> void:
	_selected_date = date_key
	_summary.clear()
	DailyChallengeStateStore.set_selected_date(date_key)
	_build_day_cards(_calendar_data.get("days", []))
	_load_summary()

func _load_summary() -> void:
	if _selected_date.is_empty():
		return
	_summary_refresh_generation += 1
	var generation: int = _summary_refresh_generation
	var request_date: String = _selected_date
	_summary_request_date = request_date
	API.fetch_challenge_summary(request_date, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		if generation != _summary_refresh_generation or request_date != _selected_date:
			return
		_on_summary_loaded(ok, data)
	)

func _refresh_current_attempt_status() -> void:
	var attempt_id: String = DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_id
	if attempt_id.is_empty() or DailyChallengeState.selected_date != _selected_date:
		return
	var request_key: String = _selected_date + ":" + attempt_id
	if _attempt_status_request_date == request_key:
		return
	_attempt_status_request_date = request_key
	API.fetch_challenge_attempt(attempt_id, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		if _selected_date != DailyChallengeState.selected_date or attempt_id != DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_id:
			return
		if not ok:
			return
		var attempt: Dictionary = data.get("attempt", {})
		DailyChallengeStateStore.begin_attempt(
			DailyChallengeState.selected_game,
			attempt_id,
			bool(attempt.get("counted", DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_counted)),
			DailyChallengeState.current_public_content,
			str(attempt.get("startedAt", DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_started_at)),
			attempt.get("state", {}),
			str(attempt.get("status", DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_status))
		)
		_load_summary()
	)

func _on_summary_loaded(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if _summary_request_date != _selected_date:
		return
	if not ok:
		_set_error(_error_message(data))
		return
	_summary = data
	_score_panel.set_scores(int(data.get("dayTotal", 0)), int(data.get("lifetimeTotal", 0)), "امتیاز روز")
	var games: Dictionary = data.get("games", {})
	_refresh_current_attempt_status()
	for game_type: String in GAME_TYPES:
		var game: Dictionary = games.get(game_type, {})
		var button: Button = _game_buttons[game_type] as Button
		button.set_meta("game_type", game_type)
		var completed: bool = bool(game.get("completed", false))
		var in_progress: bool = bool(game.get("inProgress", false))
		button.set_meta("existing_attempt", in_progress and not completed)
		button.set_meta("counted", bool(game.get("counted", false)))
		if completed:
			# Game already played/completed
			button.text = "%s\nانجام شده" % GAME_TITLES[game_type]
			button.disabled = true
		elif in_progress:
			# Game in progress - still playable
			button.text = "%s\nادامه بازی" % GAME_TITLES[game_type]
		else:
			# Game not started - playable
			button.text = "%s\nبازی را شروع کن" % GAME_TITLES[game_type]
		button.disabled = _is_future_selected() or not _date_is_today()

func _date_is_today() -> bool:
	for raw: Variant in _calendar_data.get("days", []):
		if raw is Dictionary and str(raw.get("date", "")) == _selected_date:
			return bool(raw.get("today", false))
	return false

func _on_game_pressed(game_type: String) -> void:
	if _busy or _summary.is_empty() or _selected_date.is_empty() or _is_future_selected():
		return
	if not _date_is_today():
		_set_error("بازی روزهای گذشته فقط برای مشاهده و تمرین قابل دسترسی است.")
		return
	var game: Dictionary = _summary.get("games", {}).get(game_type, {})
	if bool(game.get("completed", false)):
		_set_error("این بازی قبلاً کامل شده است. تکرار بدون امتیاز از بخش یادگیری انجام می‌شود.")
		return
	var counted: bool = true
	if not API.is_configured() or not API.is_logged_in():
		_set_error("برای شروع چالش رسمی، اینترنت و ورود به حساب لازم است.")
		return
	_busy = true
	_status.text = "در حال رزرو تلاش رسمی…"
	var existing_attempt: bool = bool(game.get("inProgress", false))
	var key: String = "%s:%s:%s" % [API.get_user_id(), _selected_date, game_type]
	if existing_attempt:
		key = ""
	API.start_challenge_attempt(_selected_date, game_type, key, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			_set_error(_error_message(data))
			_load_summary()
			return
		var attempt: Dictionary = data.get("attempt", {})
		var reserved_id: String = str(attempt.get("id", ""))
		if reserved_id.is_empty():
			_set_error("سرور تلاش بازی را ایجاد نکرد. دوباره تلاش کنید.")
			return
		var attempt_is_counted: bool = bool(attempt.get("counted", counted))
		if str(attempt.get("status", "in_progress")) == "abandoned":
			_set_error("این تلاش پیش‌تر بسته شده است و امکان ادامه ندارد.")
			_load_summary()
			return
		DailyChallengeStateStore.set_selected_date(_selected_date)
		DailyChallengeStateStore.begin_attempt(game_type, reserved_id, attempt_is_counted, data.get("publicContent", {}), str(attempt.get("startedAt", "")), attempt.get("state", {}), str(attempt.get("status", "in_progress")))
		TransitionManager.change_scene(OFFICIAL_GAME_SCENE)
	)

func _is_future_selected() -> bool:
	for raw: Variant in _calendar_data.get("days", []):
		if raw is Dictionary and str(raw.get("date", "")) == _selected_date:
			return bool(raw.get("future", false))
	return true

func _set_error(message: String) -> void:
	_status.text = message

func _error_message(data: Dictionary) -> String:
	var code: String = str(data.get("error", ""))
	if code == "unauthorized" or code == "missing_token" or code == "invalid_token":
		return "برای چالش رسمی ابتدا وارد حساب کاربری شوید."
	if code == "no_base_url" or code == "future_date" or code == "date_unavailable":
		return "چالش رسمی در دسترس نیست؛ اتصال اینترنت و تاریخ انتخاب‌شده را بررسی کنید."
	if code == "attempt_closed":
		return "این تلاش قبلاً بسته شده و قابل بازیابی نیست."
	return "دریافت اطلاعات از سرور ناموفق بود. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید."

func _make_label(text_value: String, font_size: int, bold: bool) -> Label:
	var label: Label = Label.new()
	label.text = text_value
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir() if not bold else MenuStyle.jakarta_bold())
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return label

func _go_back() -> void:
	TransitionManager.change_scene(HUB_SCENE)

func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_go_back()
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/jalali_calendar.gd`

```gdscript
class_name JalaliCalendar
extends RefCounted

## Port of the well-established Borkowski/Jalaali-JS conversion algorithm.
## Dates for official challenges still remain canonical Gregorian ISO keys;
## this helper is presentation-only and never reads the device clock.

const BREAKS: Array[int] = [-61, 9, 38, 199, 426, 686, 756, 818, 1111, 1181, 1210, 1635, 2060, 2097, 2192, 2262, 2324, 2394, 2456, 3178]

static func _div(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	return a / b

static func _mod(a: int, b: int) -> int:
	return a - _div(a, b) * b

static func _jal_cal(jy: int) -> Dictionary:
	var gy: int = jy + 621
	var leap_j: int = -14
	var jp: int = BREAKS[0]
	var jump: int = 0
	var n: int = 0
	if jy < BREAKS[0] or jy >= BREAKS[BREAKS.size() - 1]:
		return {}
	for i: int in range(1, BREAKS.size()):
		var jm: int = BREAKS[i]
		jump = jm - jp
		if jy < jm:
			break
		leap_j += _div(jump, 33) * 8 + _div(_mod(jump, 33), 4)
		jp = jm
	n = jy - jp
	leap_j += _div(n, 33) * 8 + _div(_mod(n, 33) + 3, 4)
	if _mod(jump, 33) == 4 and jump - n == 4:
		leap_j += 1
	var leap_g: int = _div(gy, 4) - _div((_div(gy, 100) + 1) * 3, 4) - 150
	var march: int = 20 + leap_j - leap_g
	if jump - n < 6:
		n = n - jump + _div(jump + 4, 33) * 33
	var leap: int = _mod(_mod(n + 1, 33) - 1, 4)
	if leap == -1:
		leap = 4
	return {"leap": leap, "gy": gy, "march": march}

static func _g2d(gy: int, gm: int, gd: int) -> int:
	var d: int = _div((gy + _div(gm - 8, 6) + 100100) * 1461, 4) + _div(153 * _mod(gm + 9, 12) + 2, 5) + gd - 34840408
	d = d - _div(_div(gy + 100100 + _div(gm - 8, 6), 100) * 3, 4) + 752
	return d

static func _d2g(jdn: int) -> Dictionary:
	var j: int = 4 * jdn + 139361631
	j += _div(_div(4 * jdn + 183187720, 146097) * 3, 4) * 4 - 3908
	var i: int = _div(_mod(j, 1461), 4) * 5 + 308
	var gd: int = _div(_mod(i, 153), 5) + 1
	var gm: int = _mod(_div(i, 153), 12) + 1
	var gy: int = _div(j, 1461) - 100100 + _div(8 - gm, 6)
	return {"year": gy, "month": gm, "day": gd}

static func _j2d(jy: int, jm: int, jd: int) -> int:
	var r: Dictionary = _jal_cal(jy)
	if r.is_empty():
		return 0
	return _g2d(int(r.gy), 3, int(r.march)) + (jm - 1) * 31 - _div(jm, 7) * (jm - 7) + jd - 1

static func _d2j(jdn: int) -> Dictionary:
	var gy: int = int(_d2g(jdn).year)
	var jy: int = gy - 621
	var r: Dictionary = _jal_cal(jy)
	if r.is_empty():
		return {}
	var jdn1f: int = _g2d(gy, 3, int(r.march))
	var k: int = jdn - jdn1f
	if k >= 0:
		if k <= 185:
			return {"year": jy, "month": 1 + _div(k, 31), "day": _mod(k, 31) + 1}
		k -= 186
	else:
		jy -= 1
		k += 179
		if int(r.leap) == 1:
			k += 1
	return {"year": jy, "month": 7 + _div(k, 30), "day": _mod(k, 30) + 1}

static func from_gregorian(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> Dictionary:
	return _d2j(_g2d(year, month, day))

static func to_gregorian(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> Dictionary:
	return _d2g(_j2d(year, month, day))

static func month_length(year: int, month: int) -> int:
	if month <= 6:
		return 31
	if month <= 11:
		return 30
	var leap_info: Dictionary = _jal_cal(year)
	return 30 if not leap_info.is_empty() and int(leap_info.leap) == 0 else 29

static func iso_key(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> String:
	var g: Dictionary = to_gregorian(year, month, day)
	return "%04d-%02d-%02d" % [int(g.get("year", 0)), int(g.get("month", 0)), int(g.get("day", 0))]

static func iso_to_jalali(date_key: String) -> Dictionary:
	var parts: PackedStringArray = date_key.split("-")
	if parts.size() != 3:
		return {}
	return from_gregorian(int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))

static func persian_digits(value: String) -> String:
	var output: String = ""
	for character: String in value:
		var code: int = character.unicode_at(0)
		output += char(code + 1728) if code >= 48 and code <= 57 else character
	return output

static func month_name(month: int) -> String:
	var names: Array[String] = ["فروردین", "اردیبهشت", "خرداد", "تیر", "مرداد", "شهریور", "مهر", "آبان", "آذر", "دی", "بهمن", "اسفند"]
	return names[month - 1] if month >= 1 and month <= 12 else "ماه"
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/meaning_quiz.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

const HUB_SCENE := "res://scenes/word_game/WordGameHub.tscn"
const OPTIONS_COUNT := 4
const DATA_PATH := "res://data/extracted_words.json"
const FONT: FontFile = preload("res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf")

@onready var back_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var title_label: Label = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var content: VBoxContainer = $Content

var _mode: String = ""
var _book: int = 1
var _lesson: int = 1
var _questions: Array[Dictionary] = []
var _question_index: int = 0
var _timer: Timer


func _ready() -> void:
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_pressed)
	_timer = Timer.new()
	_timer.wait_time = 0.1
	_timer.timeout.connect(_on_learning_timer_tick)
	add_child(_timer)
	_show_modes()


func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	if _mode == "question" or _mode == "result":
		_timer.stop()
		_show_modes()
		return
	if _mode == "lesson_select":
		_show_book_select()
		return
	if _mode == "book_select":
		_show_modes()
		return
	TransitionManager.change_scene_now(HUB_SCENE)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_pressed()


func _show_modes() -> void:
	_mode = "select"
	_clear_content()
	title_label.text = "بازی معنی"
	var heading: Label = _make_label("یک شیوه را برای تمرین انتخاب کنید", 38, true)
	content.add_child(heading)
	_animate_in(heading, 0)
	var learning: Button = _make_button("یادگیری درس\nبدون زمان و امتیاز")
	learning.pressed.connect(_show_book_select)
	content.add_child(learning)
	_animate_in(learning, 1)


func _card_style(fill: Color, border: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = fill
	style.border_color = border
	style.set_border_width_all(3)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(30)
	style.content_margin_left = 28.0
	style.content_margin_right = 28.0
	style.content_margin_top = 22.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 22.0
	return style




func _show_book_select() -> void:
	_mode = "book_select"
	_clear_content()
	title_label.text = "یادگیری · انتخاب کتاب"
	content.add_child(_make_label("کتاب موردنظر را انتخاب کنید", 38, true))
	var found_book: bool = false
	for book: int in [1, 2, 3]:
		var path: String = "res://data/v%d_vocabularies.json" % book
		if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
			continue
		found_book = true
		var button: Button = _make_button("Vision %d" % book)
		button.pressed.connect(_show_lesson_select.bind(book))
		content.add_child(button)
	if not found_book:
		_show_message("فایل واژگان کتاب‌ها پیدا نشد.")


func _show_lesson_select(book: int) -> void:
	_book = book
	_mode = "lesson_select"
	_clear_content()
	title_label.text = "یادگیری · کتاب %d" % book
	content.add_child(_make_label("درس را انتخاب کنید", 38, true))
	var lessons: Array[int] = _get_book_lessons(book)
	for lesson: int in lessons:
		var button: Button = _make_button("درس %d" % lesson)
		button.pressed.connect(_start_learning.bind(book, lesson))
		content.add_child(button)
	if lessons.is_empty():
		content.add_child(_make_label("درسی برای این کتاب پیدا نشد.", 28, true))


func _start_learning(book: int, lesson: int) -> void:
	_book = book
	_lesson = lesson
	_questions = _load_lesson_words(book, lesson)
	if _questions.size() < OPTIONS_COUNT:
		_show_message("این درس برای ساخت پرسش به دست‌کم چهار واژه نیاز دارد.")
		return
	_questions.shuffle()
	_mode = "question"
	_question_index = 0
	_show_question()


func _show_question() -> void:
	_timer.stop()
	_clear_content()
	if _question_index >= _questions.size():
		_show_result()
		return
	var entry: Dictionary = _questions[_question_index]
	title_label.text = "پرسش %d از %d" % [_question_index + 1, _questions.size()]
	content.add_child(_make_question_card("واژه را به معنی درست وصل کنید", str(entry.get("word", "")), true))
	var options: Array[String] = _make_options(entry, true)
	for option: String in options:
		var answer_button: Button = _make_button(option)
		_style_answer_button(answer_button, option == str(entry.get("_correct", "")))
		answer_button.pressed.connect(_answer.bind(option, entry, true))
		content.add_child(answer_button)
		_animate_in(answer_button, content.get_child_count() - 1)


func _make_question_card(question: String, word: String, learning: bool) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
	panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 230)
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _card_style(Color("#FFFFFF"), Color("#A5B4FC")))
	var column: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
	column.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	panel.add_child(column)
	column.add_child(_make_label("واژه را به معنی درست وصل کنید" if learning else "گزینهٔ درست را انتخاب کنید", 26, true))
	var prompt: Label = _make_label(question, 42, true)
	prompt.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 80)
	column.add_child(prompt)
	var word_label: Label = _make_label(word, 54, true)
	word_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_LTR
	word_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#1D4ED8"))
	column.add_child(word_label)
	return panel


func _answer(option: String, entry: Dictionary, _learning: bool) -> void:
	if option == str(entry.get("_correct", entry.get("answer", ""))):
		_question_index += 1
		_show_question()


func _show_result() -> void:
	_mode = "result"
	_clear_content()
	title_label.text = "نتیجه"
	content.add_child(_make_label("درس به پایان رسید", 42, true))
	content.add_child(_make_label("آفرین! تمرین این درس تمام شد.", 34, true))
	var again: Button = _make_button("بازگشت به درس‌ها")
	again.pressed.connect(_show_modes)
	content.add_child(again)


func _on_learning_timer_tick() -> void:
	_timer.stop()


func _make_options(entry: Dictionary, learning: bool) -> Array[String]:
	if not learning:
		var question_options: Array[String] = []
		for option: Variant in entry.get("options", []):
			question_options.append(str(option))
		return question_options
	var correct: String = str(entry.get("meaning_fa", ""))
	entry["_correct"] = correct
	var candidates: Array[String] = []
	for other: Dictionary in _questions:
		var value: String = str(other.get("meaning_fa", "") if learning else other.get("word", ""))
		if value != correct and not candidates.has(value):
			candidates.append(value)
	var bank: Array[Dictionary] = _load_extracted_words() if not learning else _load_lesson_words(_book, _lesson)
	for other: Dictionary in bank:
		var value: String = str(other.get("meaning_fa", "") if learning else other.get("word", ""))
		if value != correct and value != "" and not candidates.has(value):
			candidates.append(value)
	candidates.shuffle()
	var options: Array[String] = [correct]
	for i: int in mini(OPTIONS_COUNT - 1, candidates.size()):
		options.append(candidates[i])
	options.shuffle()
	return options


func _load_extracted_words() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(DATA_PATH):
		return result
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(DATA_PATH))
	if not parsed is Array:
		return result
	for raw: Variant in parsed:
		if not raw is Dictionary:
			continue
		var entry: Dictionary = raw
		if str(entry.get("word", "")).is_empty() or str(entry.get("meaning_fa", "")).is_empty():
			continue
		result.append(entry.duplicate())
	return result


func _load_lesson_words(book: int, lesson: int) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var result: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var path: String = "res://data/v%d_vocabularies.json" % book
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		return result
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))
	if not parsed is Array:
		return result
	for lesson_data: Variant in parsed:
		if not lesson_data is Dictionary or int(lesson_data.get("book", 0)) != book or int(lesson_data.get("lesson", 0)) != lesson:
			continue
		var vocabulary: Dictionary = lesson_data.get("vocabulary", {})
		var words: Variant = vocabulary.get("words", [])
		if not words is Array:
			return result
		for raw: Variant in words:
			if raw is Dictionary:
				var entry: Dictionary = raw
				if not str(entry.get("word", "")).is_empty() and not str(entry.get("meaning_fa", "")).is_empty():
					result.append(entry.duplicate())
		return result
	return result


func _get_book_lessons(book: int) -> Array[int]:
	var result: Array[int] = []
	var path: String = "res://data/v%d_vocabularies.json" % book
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path)) if FileAccess.file_exists(path) else null
	if not parsed is Array:
		return result
	for raw: Variant in parsed:
		if raw is Dictionary and int(raw.get("book", 0)) == book:
			result.append(int(raw.get("lesson", 0)))
	result.sort()
	return result


func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, centered: bool) -> Label:
	var label: Label = Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if centered else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	label.add_theme_font_override("font", FONT)
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#17324D"))
	return label


func _style_answer_button(button: Button, _is_correct: bool) -> void:
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 118)
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#172554"))
	var base: StyleBoxFlat = _card_style(Color("#FFFFFF"), Color("#CBD5E1"))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", base)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _card_style(Color("#EEF2FF"), Color("#6366F1")))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _card_style(Color("#DBEAFE"), Color("#2563EB")))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", _card_style(Color("#F8FAFC"), Color("#4F46E5")))


func _animate_in(control: Control, index: int) -> void:
	control.modulate.a = 0.0
	control.scale = Vector2(0.97, 0.97)
	control.pivot_offset = control.size * 0.5
	var tween: Tween = create_tween()
	tween.tween_interval(0.035 * index)
	tween.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tween.parallel().tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.24).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _make_button(text: String) -> Button:
	var button: Button = Button.new()
	button.text = text
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 150)
	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	button.add_theme_font_override("font", FONT)
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	var normal: StyleBoxFlat = _card_style(Color("#2563EB"), Color("#1D4ED8"))
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color.WHITE)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
	var hover: StyleBoxFlat = normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	hover.bg_color = Color("#1D4ED8")
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	var pressed: StyleBoxFlat = normal.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	pressed.bg_color = Color("#1E40AF")
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", pressed)
	return button


func _show_message(message: String) -> void:
	_clear_content()
	content.add_child(_make_label(message, 34, true))


func _clear_content() -> void:
	for child: Node in content.get_children():
		content.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/meaning_quiz_daily.gd`

```gdscript
class_name MeaningQuizDaily
extends RefCounted

const DATA_PATH := "res://data/extracted_words.json"
const DAILY_QUESTION_COUNT := 10
const SECONDS_PER_DAY := 86400


static func now_utc_unix() -> int:
	return int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system())


static func date_key() -> String:
	return Time.get_date_string_from_unix_time(now_utc_unix())


static func puzzle_id() -> String:
	return "meaning-%s" % date_key()


static func seconds_until_next_day() -> int:
	var now: int = now_utc_unix()
	var day_start: int = int(floor(float(now) / float(SECONDS_PER_DAY))) * SECONDS_PER_DAY
	return maxi(1, day_start + SECONDS_PER_DAY - now)


static func time_left_text() -> String:
	var left: int = seconds_until_next_day()
	var hours: int = int(floor(float(left) / 3600.0))
	var minutes: int = int(floor(float(left % 3600) / 60.0))
	if hours > 0:
		return "%s ساعت و %s دقیقه" % [digits(hours), digits(minutes)]
	if minutes > 0:
		return "%s دقیقه" % digits(minutes)
	return "کمتر از یک دقیقه"


static func digits(value: int) -> String:
	var output: String = ""
	for character: String in str(value):
		var code: int = character.unicode_at(0)
		output += char(code + 1728) if code >= 48 and code <= 57 else character
	return output


static func questions_for_date(question_date_key: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var words: Array[Dictionary] = _load_words()
	var pool: Array[Dictionary] = MeaningQuizQuestionBuilder.build_questions(words)
	var selected: Array[Dictionary] = []
	if pool.is_empty():
		return selected
	var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = hash(question_date_key)
	var count: int = mini(DAILY_QUESTION_COUNT, pool.size())
	for _index: int in count:
		var pick: int = rng.randi_range(0, pool.size() - 1)
		selected.append(pool[pick])
		pool.remove_at(pick)
	return selected


static func _load_words() -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var words: Array[Dictionary] = []
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(DATA_PATH):
		return words
	var parsed: Variant = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(DATA_PATH))
	if not parsed is Array:
		return words
	for raw: Variant in parsed:
		if raw is Dictionary:
			words.append(raw)
	return words
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/meaning_quiz_question_builder.gd`

```gdscript
class_name MeaningQuizQuestionBuilder
extends RefCounted

const OPTION_COUNT := 4
const MODE_MEANING := "meaning"
const MODE_SYNONYM := "synonym"
const MODE_ANTONYM := "antonym"
const MODE_LABELS := {
	MODE_MEANING: "معنی",
	MODE_SYNONYM: "مترادف",
	MODE_ANTONYM: "متضاد",
}


static func build_questions(words: Array[Dictionary]) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var records: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var answer_terms: Dictionary = {}
	var word_terms: Dictionary = {}
	var definition_by_word: Dictionary = {}
	var synonyms_by_word: Dictionary = {}
	var antonyms_by_word: Dictionary = {}
	for entry: Dictionary in words:
		var word: String = _clean(str(entry.get("word", "")))
		var definition: String = _clean(str(entry.get("meaning_en", "")))
		if word.is_empty() or definition.is_empty():
			continue
		word_terms[word.to_lower()] = word
		definition_by_word[word.to_lower()] = definition
		var synonyms: Array[String] = _terms(entry.get("synonyms", {}), "en")
		var antonyms: Array[String] = _terms(entry.get("antonyms", {}), "en")
		synonyms_by_word[word.to_lower()] = synonyms
		antonyms_by_word[word.to_lower()] = antonyms
		if synonyms.size() > 0:
			answer_terms[MODE_SYNONYM] = answer_terms.get(MODE_SYNONYM, [])
			for term: String in synonyms:
				_add_unique(answer_terms[MODE_SYNONYM], term)
		if antonyms.size() > 0:
			answer_terms[MODE_ANTONYM] = answer_terms.get(MODE_ANTONYM, [])
			for term: String in antonyms:
				_add_unique(answer_terms[MODE_ANTONYM], term)
		_add_unique(answer_terms.get_or_add(MODE_MEANING, []), definition)

	for entry: Dictionary in words:
		var word: String = _clean(str(entry.get("word", "")))
		var meaning: String = _clean(str(entry.get("meaning_en", "")))
		if word.is_empty() or meaning.is_empty():
			continue
		var options: Array[Dictionary] = []
		var synonyms: Array[String] = _without_word(_terms(entry.get("synonyms", {}), "en"), word)
		var antonyms: Array[String] = _without_word(_terms(entry.get("antonyms", {}), "en"), word)
		if not synonyms.is_empty():
			options.append(_question(MODE_SYNONYM, word, synonyms[0], entry, answer_terms, word_terms, definition_by_word, synonyms_by_word, antonyms_by_word))
		if not antonyms.is_empty():
			options.append(_question(MODE_ANTONYM, word, antonyms[0], entry, answer_terms, word_terms, definition_by_word, synonyms_by_word, antonyms_by_word))
		options.append(_question(MODE_MEANING, word, meaning, entry, answer_terms, word_terms, definition_by_word, synonyms_by_word, antonyms_by_word))
		for question: Dictionary in options:
			if question.get("options", []).size() == OPTION_COUNT:
				records.append(question)
	return records


static func _question(kind: String, word: String, answer: String,
		entry: Dictionary, answer_terms: Dictionary, word_terms: Dictionary,
		definition_by_word: Dictionary, synonyms_by_word: Dictionary,
		antonyms_by_word: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var pool: Array = answer_terms.get(kind, [])
	var correct_word: String = word.to_lower()
	if kind == MODE_SYNONYM:
		pool = []
		for other_word: Variant in synonyms_by_word.keys():
			if str(other_word) != correct_word:
				pool.append_array(synonyms_by_word[other_word])
	elif kind == MODE_ANTONYM:
		pool = []
		for other_word: Variant in antonyms_by_word.keys():
			if str(other_word) != correct_word:
				pool.append_array(antonyms_by_word[other_word])
	else:
		pool = definition_by_word.values()
	if kind == MODE_MEANING and pool.size() < OPTION_COUNT:
		return {}
	if pool.size() < OPTION_COUNT:
		pool = definition_by_word.values()
	var result: Array[String] = [answer]
	var attempts: int = 0
	while result.size() < OPTION_COUNT and attempts < 200:
		attempts += 1
		if pool.is_empty():
			break
		var candidate: String = str(pool[randi_range(0, pool.size() - 1)])
		if candidate.to_lower() == answer.to_lower() or candidate.to_lower() == word.to_lower():
			continue
		_add_unique(result, candidate)
	if result.size() < OPTION_COUNT:
		var words: Array = word_terms.values()
		attempts = 0
		while result.size() < OPTION_COUNT and attempts < 200:
			attempts += 1
			if words.is_empty():
				break
			var candidate: String = str(words[randi_range(0, words.size() - 1)])
			if candidate.to_lower() != word.to_lower() and candidate.to_lower() != answer.to_lower():
				_add_unique(result, candidate)
	if result.size() < OPTION_COUNT:
		return {}
	result.shuffle()
	return {
		"kind": kind,
		"kind_label": str(MODE_LABELS.get(kind, "معنی")),
		"word": word,
		"prompt": answer,
		"answer": answer,
		"options": result,
		"meaning_fa": str(entry.get("meaning_fa", "")),
	}


static func _without_word(terms: Array[String], word: String) -> Array[String]:
	var result: Array[String] = []
	for term: String in terms:
		if term.to_lower() != word.to_lower():
			_add_unique(result, term)
	return result


static func _related_terms(raw_value: Variant, word: String) -> Array[String]:
	var result: Array[String] = []
	if not raw_value is Dictionary:
		return result
	for key: String in ["en", "fa"]:
		var terms: Array[String] = _terms(raw_value, key)
		for term: String in terms:
			if term.to_lower() != word.to_lower():
				_add_unique(result, term)
	return result


static func _terms(raw_value: Variant, language: String) -> Array[String]:
	var result: Array[String] = []
	if not raw_value is Dictionary:
		return result
	var list: Variant = raw_value.get(language, [])
	if not list is Array:
		return result
	for value: Variant in list:
		var term: String = _clean(str(value))
		if not term.is_empty():
			_add_unique(result, term)
	return result


static func _add_unique(list: Array, value: String) -> void:
	var normalized: String = value.strip_edges().to_lower()
	for existing: Variant in list:
		if str(existing).strip_edges().to_lower() == normalized:
			return
	list.append(value.strip_edges())


static func _clean(value: String) -> String:
	var result: String = value.strip_edges()
	while result.ends_with(".") or result.ends_with("!") or result.ends_with("?"):
		result = result.left(result.length() - 1).strip_edges()
	return result
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/OfficialChallengeGame.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
class_name OfficialChallengeGame

const DailyChallengeStateStore = preload("res://autoload/DailyChallengeState.gd")

const HUB_SCENE: String = "res://scenes/word_game/WordGameHub.tscn"
const GAME_NAMES: Dictionary = {"wordle": "Wordle", "wordef": "Wordef", "unscramble": "Unscramble"}
const GAME_LIMITS: Dictionary = {"wordle": 180.0, "wordef": 90.0, "unscramble": 180.0}

var _game_type: String = ""
var _attempt_id: String = ""
var _public: Dictionary = {}
var _root: VBoxContainer
var _status: Label
var _body: VBoxContainer
var _busy: bool = false
var _finished: bool = false
var _remaining: float = 0.0
var _timer: Timer
var _wordle_guesses: int = 0
var _wordle_length: int = 5
var _wordef_index: int = -1
var _wordef_question: Dictionary = {}
var _solved_words: Array[bool] = [false, false, false, false, false]
var _score_panel: ChallengeScorePanel

func _ready() -> void:
	_game_type = DailyChallengeState.selected_game
	_attempt_id = DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_id
	_public = DailyChallengeState.current_public_content.duplicate(true)
	_wire_header()
	if _attempt_id.is_empty() or not GAME_NAMES.has(_game_type):
		_show_fatal("اطلاعات تلاش رسمی پیدا نشد.")
		return
	_build_shell()
	if DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_status != "in_progress":
		_show_settled_attempt()
		return
	_remaining = float(GAME_LIMITS.get(_game_type, 180.0))
	var start_time: String = str(DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_started_at)
	if start_time != "":
		var elapsed: int = int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system() - float(Time.get_unix_time_from_datetime_string(start_time)))
		_remaining = maxf(0.0, _remaining - float(maxi(0, elapsed)))
	_timer = Timer.new()
	_timer.wait_time = 0.2
	_timer.timeout.connect(_on_timer_tick)
	add_child(_timer)
	_timer.start()
	match _game_type:
		"wordle":
			_wordle_length = int(_public.get("wordLength", 5))
			_build_wordle()
			_restore_wordle_state()
		"wordef":
			_restore_wordef_state()
		"unscramble":
			_build_unscramble()
			_restore_unscramble_state()

func _build_shell() -> void:
	var background: ColorRect = ColorRect.new()
	background.color = MenuStyle.c("bg")
	background.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	background.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(background)
	var scroll: ScrollContainer = ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	add_child(scroll)
	var margin: MarginContainer = MarginContainer.new()
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 36)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 36)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 250)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 240)
	scroll.add_child(margin)
	_root = VBoxContainer.new()
	_root.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	margin.add_child(_root)
	var timer_label: Label = _label("", 28, true)
	timer_label.name = "TimerLabel"
	_root.add_child(timer_label)
	_score_panel = preload("res://scenes/word_game/ScorePanel.tscn").instantiate() as ChallengeScorePanel
	_score_panel.visible = false
	_root.add_child(_score_panel)
	_body = VBoxContainer.new()
	_body.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	_root.add_child(_body)
	_status = _label("بارگذاری بازی…", 24, false)
	_status.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	_root.add_child(_status)
	_raise_header()

## The screen wears the app-wide header bar authored in
## OfficialChallengeGame.tscn — the same bar the lesson screens carry — so the
## back arrow plus the centered title replace the old in-page title row.
func _wire_header() -> void:
	var header: Control = get_node_or_null("HeaderBar") as Control
	if header == null:
		return
	var title: Label = header.get_node_or_null("HeaderContent/HeaderTitle") as Label
	if title != null:
		title.text = "چالش رسمی · %s" % str(GAME_NAMES.get(_game_type, ""))
	var back: Button = header.get_node_or_null("HeaderContent/BackButton") as Button
	if back != null:
		back.pressed.connect(_confirm_exit)

## Puts the bar on top of the tree so the built page scrolls underneath it.
func _raise_header() -> void:
	var header: Control = get_node_or_null("HeaderBar") as Control
	if header != null:
		move_child(header, get_child_count() - 1)

func _restore_wordle_state() -> void:
	var state: Dictionary = DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_state
	var guesses: Array = state.get("guesses", [])
	_wordle_guesses = guesses.size()
	var history: Label = _body.get_node_or_null("WordleFeedback") as Label
	var input: LineEdit = _body.get_node_or_null("WordleInput") as LineEdit
	if history == null or input == null:
		return
	for raw: Variant in guesses:
		if not raw is Dictionary:
			continue
		var entry: Dictionary = raw
		var symbols: String = ""
		var feedback: Array = entry.get("feedback", [])
		for cell: Variant in feedback:
			symbols += "🟩" if int(cell) == 2 else ("🟨" if int(cell) == 1 else "⬛")
		history.text += ("\n" if history.text != "" else "") + "%s  %s" % [str(entry.get("guess", "")).to_upper(), symbols]
		if feedback.size() == _wordle_length:
			var solved: bool = true
			for cell: Variant in feedback:
				if int(cell) != 2:
					solved = false
			if solved:
				_finished = true
	if _wordle_guesses >= 6:
		_finished = true
	if _finished:
		input.editable = false

func _build_wordle() -> void:
	_body.add_child(_label("واژهٔ %d حرفی را در شش حدس پیدا کنید." % _wordle_length, 30, true))
	var input: LineEdit = LineEdit.new()
	input.name = "WordleInput"
	input.placeholder_text = "واژهٔ انگلیسی"
	input.max_length = _wordle_length
	input.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	input.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	input.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	input.text_submitted.connect(_on_wordle_submitted)
	_body.add_child(input)
	var submit: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("ثبت حدس", "primary", 96)
	submit.pressed.connect(_on_wordle_submit_button)
	_body.add_child(submit)
	var guesses: Label = _label("", 30, true)
	guesses.name = "WordleFeedback"
	_body.add_child(guesses)

func _on_wordle_submit_button() -> void:
	var input: LineEdit = _body.get_node_or_null("WordleInput") as LineEdit
	if input != null:
		_on_wordle_submitted(input.text)

func _on_wordle_submitted(value: String) -> void:
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	var guess: String = value.strip_edges().to_lower()
	if guess.length() != _wordle_length:
		_status.text = "حدس باید دقیقاً %d حرف داشته باشد." % _wordle_length
		return
	_busy = true
	_status.text = "در حال بررسی حدس توسط سرور…"
	API.submit_wordle_guess(_attempt_id, guess, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "timeout":
				_finish_attempt("زمان رسمی به پایان رسیده است.")
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
			return
		if not bool(data.get("valid", false)):
			_status.text = "این واژه در فهرست معتبر نیست."
			return
		_wordle_guesses += 1
		var feedback: Array = data.get("feedback", [])
		var symbols: String = ""
		for cell: Variant in feedback:
			symbols += "🟩" if int(cell) == 2 else ("🟨" if int(cell) == 1 else "⬛")
		var history: Label = _body.get_node("WordleFeedback") as Label
		history.text += ("\n" if history.text != "" else "") + "%s  %s" % [guess.to_upper(), symbols]
		var input: LineEdit = _body.get_node("WordleInput") as LineEdit
		input.clear()
		if bool(data.get("solved", false)):
			_finish_attempt("واژه را پیدا کردید!")
		elif _wordle_guesses >= 6:
			_finish_attempt("حدس‌ها تمام شد.")
		else:
			_status.text = "حدس پذیرفته شد."
	)

func _restore_wordef_state() -> void:
	var state: Dictionary = DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_state
	var answers: Array = state.get("answers", [])
	if answers.size() >= int(_public.get("questions", []).size()) and not answers.is_empty():
		_finish_attempt("همهٔ پرسش‌ها قبلاً پاسخ داده شده‌اند.")
	else:
		_load_next_wordef()

func _load_next_wordef() -> void:
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	_busy = true
	API.next_wordef_question(_attempt_id, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "timeout":
				_finish_attempt("زمان رسمی بازی به پایان رسیده است.")
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
			return
		if bool(data.get("done", false)):
			_finish_attempt("همهٔ پرسش‌ها پاسخ داده شدند.")
			return
		_wordef_index = int(data.get("index", -1))
		_wordef_question = data.get("question", {})
		_render_wordef_question()
	)

func _render_wordef_question() -> void:
	_clear_body()
	var question: Dictionary = _wordef_question
	var text: String = str(question.get("prompt", ""))
	var kind: String = str(question.get("kind", "meaning"))
	var question_type: String = "معنی" if kind == "meaning" else ("مترادف" if kind == "synonym" else "متضاد")
	_body.add_child(_label("پرسش %s · %s" % [str(_wordef_index + 1), question_type], 28, true))
	_body.add_child(_label(str(question.get("word", "")), 46, true))
	_body.add_child(_label(text, 26, true))
	for option_raw: Variant in question.get("options", []):
		var option: String = str(option_raw)
		var answer_button: Button = MenuStyle.make_button(option, "secondary", 100)
		answer_button.pressed.connect(_submit_wordef_answer.bind(option))
		_body.add_child(answer_button)

func _submit_wordef_answer(option: String) -> void:
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	_busy = true
	_status.text = "در حال ثبت پاسخ…"
	API.answer_wordef_question(_attempt_id, _wordef_index, option, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "timeout":
				_finish_attempt("زمان رسمی بازی به پایان رسیده است.")
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
			return
		if bool(data.get("timedOut", false)):
			_status.text = "زمان این پرسش تمام شد."
		else:
			_status.text = "پاسخ درست بود." if bool(data.get("correct", false)) else "پاسخ ثبت شد."
		_load_next_wordef()
	)

func _restore_unscramble_state() -> void:
	var state: Dictionary = DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_state
	for raw: Variant in state.get("solved", []):
		if not raw is Dictionary:
			continue
		var entry: Dictionary = raw
		var index: int = int(entry.get("index", -1))
		if index < 0 or index >= _solved_words.size():
			continue
		_solved_words[index] = true
		var panel: PanelContainer = _body.get_node_or_null("Word%d" % index) as PanelContainer
		if panel != null:
			panel.modulate = Color(0.72, 1.0, 0.75, 1.0)
			var answer: LineEdit = panel.find_child("Answer", true, false) as LineEdit
			if answer != null:
				answer.editable = false

func _build_unscramble() -> void:
	var words: Array = _public.get("words", [])
	if words.size() != 5:
		_status.text = "محتوای این بازی از سرور کامل دریافت نشد."
		return
	for i: int in range(words.size()):
		var row_data: Variant = words[i]
		if not row_data is Dictionary:
			continue
		var word_data: Dictionary = row_data
		var panel: PanelContainer = PanelContainer.new()
		panel.name = "Word%d" % i
		panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", MenuStyle.card_style(MenuStyle.border(), 20, false, false))
		var column: VBoxContainer = VBoxContainer.new()
		column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
		panel.add_child(column)
		column.add_child(_label("واژهٔ %d: %s" % [i + 1, str(word_data.get("scrambledWord", ""))], 32, true))
		var clue: Label = _label("راهنما هنوز باز نشده است.", 20, true)
		clue.name = "Clue"
		column.add_child(clue)
		var input: LineEdit = LineEdit.new()
		input.name = "Answer"
		input.placeholder_text = "واژهٔ مرتب‌شده"
		input.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		column.add_child(input)
		var actions: HBoxContainer = HBoxContainer.new()
		column.add_child(actions)
		var solve: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("بررسی", "primary", 74)
		solve.pressed.connect(_solve_unscramble.bind(i, input, panel))
		actions.add_child(solve)
		var hint: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("راهنما", "secondary", 74)
		hint.pressed.connect(_request_clue.bind(i, clue))
		actions.add_child(hint)
		_body.add_child(panel)

func _request_clue(index: int, label: Label) -> void:
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	_busy = true
	API.reveal_unscramble_clue(_attempt_id, index, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "timeout":
				_finish_attempt("زمان رسمی بازی به پایان رسیده است.")
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
			return
		label.text = str(data.get("clueFa", data.get("clue", "راهنما موجود نیست.")))
		_status.text = "راهنما ثبت شد؛ جریمهٔ آن را سرور هنگام محاسبه اعمال می‌کند."
	)

func _solve_unscramble(index: int, input: LineEdit, panel: PanelContainer) -> void:
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	var answer: String = input.text.strip_edges()
	if answer.is_empty():
		_status.text = "ابتدا پاسخ را بنویسید."
		return
	_busy = true
	API.solve_unscramble_word(_attempt_id, index, answer, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "timeout":
				_finish_attempt("زمان رسمی بازی به پایان رسیده است.")
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
			return
		if not bool(data.get("correct", false)):
			_status.text = "پاسخ درست نیست؛ دوباره تلاش کنید."
			return
		_solved_words[index] = true
		panel.modulate = Color(0.72, 1.0, 0.75, 1.0)
		input.editable = false
		_status.text = "درست بود! زمان و امتیاز را سرور ثبت کرد."
		var complete: bool = true
		for solved: bool in _solved_words:
			complete = complete and solved
		if complete:
			_finish_attempt("هر پنج واژه حل شد!")
	)

func _on_timer_tick() -> void:
	_remaining = maxf(0.0, _remaining - _timer.wait_time)
	var timer_label: Label = _root.get_node_or_null("TimerLabel") as Label
	if timer_label != null:
		timer_label.text = "زمان تقریبی: %s ثانیه" % JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(int(ceil(_remaining))))
	if _remaining <= 0.0 and not _finished and not _busy:
		_finish_attempt("زمان به پایان رسید؛ امتیاز بر اساس داده‌های ثبت‌شده محاسبه می‌شود.")

func _show_settled_attempt() -> void:
	_finished = true
	_busy = true
	if DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_status == "completed":
		_status.text = "در حال دریافت نتیجهٔ ثبت‌شده…"
		API.settle_challenge_attempt(_attempt_id, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
			_busy = false
			if not ok:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data)
				return
			var result: Dictionary = data.get("result", {})
			var score: int = int(result.get("adjustedScore", 0))
			_score_panel.visible = true
			_score_panel.set_scores(score, 0, "نتیجهٔ ثبت‌شده")
			if DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_counted:
				API.fetch_challenge_summary(DailyChallengeState.selected_date, func(summary_ok: bool, summary: Dictionary) -> void:
					if summary_ok and is_instance_valid(_score_panel):
						_score_panel.set_scores(score, int(summary.get("lifetimeTotal", 0)), "نتیجهٔ ثبت‌شده")
				)
			_status.text = "این تلاش قبلاً تکمیل شده است؛ نتیجهٔ رسمی: %s" % JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(score))
			var back: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("بازگشت به تقویم", "secondary", 90)
			back.pressed.connect(_return_to_calendar)
			_root.add_child(back)
		)
	else:
		_busy = false
		_finished = true
		_status.text = "این تلاش قبلاً بدون امتیاز بسته شده است."
		var back: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("بازگشت به تقویم", "secondary", 90)
		back.pressed.connect(_return_to_calendar)
		_root.add_child(back)

func _finish_attempt(message: String) -> void:
	if _finished:
		return
	_finished = true
	_busy = true
	if _timer != null:
		_timer.stop()
	_status.text = message + " در حال محاسبهٔ نتیجه توسط سرور…"
	API.settle_challenge_attempt(_attempt_id, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			_finished = false
			if str(data.get("error", "")) == "not_finished":
				_status.text = "بازی هنوز به پایان نرسیده است. اگر از صفحه خارج شوید، تلاش رسمی بدون امتیاز بسته می‌شود؛ دوباره تلاش کنید یا خروج را تأیید کنید."
			else:
				_status.text = _friendly_error(data) + " نتیجه روی سرور باقی مانده؛ دوباره تلاش کنید."
			return
		var result: Dictionary = data.get("result", {})
		var score: int = int(result.get("adjustedScore", 0))
		_score_panel.visible = true
		if DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_counted:
			_score_panel.set_scores(score, 0, "امتیاز رسمی این بازی")
			API.fetch_challenge_summary(DailyChallengeState.selected_date, func(summary_ok: bool, summary: Dictionary) -> void:
				if summary_ok and is_instance_valid(_score_panel):
					_score_panel.set_scores(score, int(summary.get("lifetimeTotal", 0)), "امتیاز رسمی این بازی")
			)
		else:
			_score_panel.set_scores(score, 0, "امتیاز تمرین")
		_status.text = "%s امتیاز %s: %s · نسخهٔ امتیازدهی %s" % [message, "رسمی" if DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_counted else "تمرین", JalaliCalendar.persian_digits(str(score)), str(result.get("scoringVersion", "—"))]
		if not DailyChallengeState.current_attempt_counted:
			_status.text += "\nامتیاز تمرین در رتبه‌بندی ثبت نمی‌شود."
		var back: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("بازگشت به تقویم", "secondary", 90)
		back.pressed.connect(_return_to_calendar)
		_root.add_child(back)
	)

func _confirm_exit() -> void:
	if _finished:
		_return_to_calendar()
		return
	var dialog: ConfirmationDialog = ConfirmationDialog.new()
	dialog.title = "پایان تلاش رسمی"
	dialog.dialog_text = "با خروج پیش از تکمیل بازی، تلاش رسمی بدون امتیاز بسته می‌شود. خارج می‌شوید؟"
	dialog.ok_button_text = "خروج بدون امتیاز"
	dialog.cancel_button_text = "ادامه بازی"
	dialog.confirmed.connect(func() -> void: _abandon_attempt(dialog))
	add_child(dialog)
	dialog.popup_centered(Vector2i(720, 320))

func _abandon_attempt(dialog: ConfirmationDialog) -> void:
	dialog.queue_free()
	if _busy or _finished:
		return
	_busy = true
	_status.text = "در حال بستن تلاش رسمی…"
	API.abandon_challenge_attempt(_attempt_id, func(ok: bool, data: Dictionary) -> void:
		_busy = false
		if not ok:
			_status.text = _friendly_error(data) + " تلاش روی سرور باز ماند."
			return
		_finished = true
		_return_to_calendar()
	)

func _return_to_calendar() -> void:
	DailyChallengeStateStore.clear_attempt()
	TransitionManager.change_scene(HUB_SCENE)

func _show_fatal(message: String) -> void:
	var label: Label = _label(message, 30, true)
	label.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER)
	add_child(label)
	var back: Button = MenuStyle.make_button("بازگشت", "secondary", 90)
	back.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_CENTER_BOTTOM)
	back.pressed.connect(_return_to_calendar)
	add_child(back)

func _friendly_error(data: Dictionary) -> String:
	match str(data.get("error", "")):
		"timeout":
			return "زمان رسمی بازی به پایان رسیده است."
		"invalid_word", "invalid_guess":
			return "واژه در فهرست پاسخ‌های معتبر نیست."
		"closed":
			return "این تلاش دیگر باز نیست."
		_:
			return "ارتباط با سرور ناموفق بود؛ اتصال را بررسی کنید و دوباره تلاش کنید."

func _clear_body() -> void:
	for child: Node in _body.get_children():
		_body.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()

func _label(value: String, font_size: int, centered: bool) -> Label:
	var label: Label = Label.new()
	label.text = value
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if centered else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	return label

func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_confirm_exit()
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/daily_word_picker.gd`

```gdscript
class_name ScrambledDailyPicker
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  DAILY WORD PICKER — the five words of today's مسابقه.
##
##  Deterministic by design: the same day must deal every player the same
##  five words, in the same order, so the bank is shuffled once with a fixed
##  seed and each day then claims its own fixed window of WORDS_PER_DAY
##  entries. Consecutive days therefore never overlap until the whole bank
##  has been walked through.
##
##  now_utc_unix() is the single clock hook — a server time could replace it
##  without touching anything else in the game.
## ============================================================

const WORDS_PER_DAY := 5
## Fixed on purpose: the daily order is frozen, never seeded from the clock.
const SHUFFLE_SEED := 20260214
const SECONDS_PER_DAY := 86400

static var _shuffled: Array = []
static var _shuffled_built := false


## The game's clock. UTC on purpose, like the rest of the app's daily logic.
static func now_utc_unix() -> int:
	return int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system())


## Days since the Unix epoch, UTC — the game's notion of "today".
static func day_index() -> int:
	return int(floor(float(now_utc_unix()) / float(SECONDS_PER_DAY)))


## Today's date as "YYYY-MM-DD" (UTC). Used as the save key of the daily
## score, so a day can never be recorded twice.
static func date_key() -> String:
	return Time.get_date_string_from_unix_time(now_utc_unix())


## Stable identifier of today's puzzle ("scrambled-2026-09-17").
static func puzzle_id() -> String:
	return "scrambled-%s" % date_key()


static func seconds_until_next_day() -> int:
	var now := now_utc_unix()
	var into_day := now - day_index() * SECONDS_PER_DAY
	return maxi(1, SECONDS_PER_DAY - into_day)


## "۵ ساعت و ۱۲ دقیقه" — how long the current challenge stays available.
static func time_left_text() -> String:
	var left := seconds_until_next_day()
	var hours := int(floor(float(left) / 3600.0))
	var minutes := int(floor(float(left % 3600) / 60.0))
	if hours > 0:
		return "%s ساعت و %s دقیقه" % [digits(hours), digits(minutes)]
	if minutes > 0:
		return "%s دقیقه" % digits(minutes)
	return "کمتر از یک دقیقه"


## Today's five words (fewer only when the bank is smaller than that).
static func pick() -> Array:
	var bank := _bank()
	if bank.is_empty():
		return []
	var count := mini(WORDS_PER_DAY, bank.size())
	var start := (day_index() * WORDS_PER_DAY) % bank.size()
	var picked: Array = []
	for i in count:
		picked.append(bank[(start + i) % bank.size()])
	return picked


## The word window of any given day, without touching the clock. Used by the
## tests to prove that the daily order is stable and never repeats within it.
static func pick_for_day(day: int) -> Array:
	var bank := _bank()
	if bank.is_empty():
		return []
	var count := mini(WORDS_PER_DAY, bank.size())
	var start := (day * WORDS_PER_DAY) % bank.size()
	var picked: Array = []
	for i in count:
		picked.append(bank[(start + i) % bank.size()])
	return picked


static func reset_cache() -> void:
	_shuffled = []
	_shuffled_built = false


## ------------------------------------------------------------ internals --
## The bank in its frozen daily order: shuffled once with SHUFFLE_SEED.
static func _bank() -> Array:
	if _shuffled_built:
		return _shuffled
	_shuffled_built = true
	_shuffled = ScrambledData.all_words().duplicate()
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = SHUFFLE_SEED
	for i in range(_shuffled.size() - 1, 0, -1):
		var j := rng.randi_range(0, i)
		var held = _shuffled[i]
		_shuffled[i] = _shuffled[j]
		_shuffled[j] = held
	return _shuffled


## Persian numerals, so the countdown reads like the rest of the app. Kept
## local on purpose: the picker is data logic and must not need the UI layer
## (MenuStyle pulls in the Global autoload).
static func digits(value: int) -> String:
	var out := ""
	for ch in str(value):
		var code := ch.unicode_at(0)
		if code >= 48 and code <= 57:
			out += char(code + 1728)
		else:
			out += ch
	return out
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/game_manager.gd`

```gdscript
class_name ScrambledGameManager
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  GAME MANAGER — the session state machine of «بازی املا».
##
##  One session is one run of either mode:
##    LEARNING    — a whole lesson, words dealt short-to-long, no score and
##                  no pressure, the meaning available after 30s.
##    COMPETITION — the five words of the day, the meaning after 60s, one
##                  score per word from the time table and one daily total.
##
##  The manager is static on purpose: the gameplay screen drives it, the
##  results screen reads it, and moving between screens never loses the
##  session in progress.
## ============================================================

enum Mode { LEARNING, COMPETITION }
enum State { IDLE, PLAYING, SOLVED, FINISHED }

## The meaning of the word becomes available after this long — generous in
## learning mode, where spelling matters more than speed, and twice as long
## in the competition, where the meaning costs points.
const LEARNING_HINT_DELAY := 30.0
const COMPETITION_HINT_DELAY := 60.0

## Beat between solving a word and the next one being dealt.
const NEXT_WORD_DELAY := 1.8

static var mode: Mode = Mode.LEARNING
static var state: State = State.IDLE
static var book := 1
static var lesson := 1
static var controller: ScrambledWordController = null
## True when the run that just finished took the day's best score.
static var last_run_new_best := false

static var _words: Array = []
static var _index := 0
static var _results: Array = []
static var _word_started_ms := 0
static var _word_hint_used := false
static var _session_started_ms := 0
static var _hints_used := 0
## "book_lesson" -> how often it has been played: replays get a fresh
## scramble, while the first run of a lesson is always dealt the same way.
static var _play_counts: Dictionary = {}


## ------------------------------------------------------------- starting --
## Deals a lesson in learning mode. Returns false when the lesson has no
## playable words (the screens then show their empty-bank card).
static func start_learning(p_book: int, p_lesson: int) -> bool:
	return _start(Mode.LEARNING, ScrambledData.words_ordered(p_book, p_lesson), p_book, p_lesson)


## Retained for scoring/state tests and backward compatibility. The legacy
## mode selector no longer exposes this daily competition entry point.
static func start_competition() -> bool:
	if ScrambledScoreManager.today_played():
		return false
	var words: Array = ScrambledDailyPicker.pick()
	var first: Dictionary = {}
	if not words.is_empty() and words[0] is Dictionary:
		first = words[0]
	return _start(Mode.COMPETITION, words, int(first.get("book", 1)), int(first.get("lesson", 1)))


static func _start(p_mode: Mode, words: Array, p_book: int, p_lesson: int) -> bool:
	if words.is_empty():
		state = State.IDLE
		return false
	mode = p_mode
	book = p_book
	lesson = p_lesson
	_words = words
	_index = 0
	_results = []
	_hints_used = 0
	last_run_new_best = false
	_session_started_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	state = State.PLAYING
	_deal_current_word()
	return true


static func _deal_current_word() -> void:
	var data := current_word_data()
	controller = ScrambledWordController.new()
	controller.setup(data, _scramble_seed(data, _index))
	_word_hint_used = false
	_word_started_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec()


## The scramble seed of a word. Competition seeds come from the day alone, so
## everybody spells the same arrangement; learning seeds add how often the
## lesson has been played, so a replay is a fresh puzzle.
static func _scramble_seed(word_data: Dictionary, position: int) -> int:
	var base := str(word_data.get("word", "")).hash()
	if mode == Mode.COMPETITION:
		return base ^ (ScrambledDailyPicker.day_index() * 7919 + position * 104729)
	var plays := int(_play_counts.get(_lesson_key(), 0))
	return base ^ (plays * 15485863 + position * 7919)


static func _lesson_key() -> String:
	return ScrambledScoreManager.practice_key(book, lesson)


## ------------------------------------------------------------- the word --
static func current_word_data() -> Dictionary:
	if _index < 0 or _index >= _words.size():
		return {}
	var entry = _words[_index]
	return entry if entry is Dictionary else {}


static func word_count() -> int:
	return _words.size()


## 1-based position of the word being spelled, for the "کلمه ۲ از ۵" chip.
static func word_position() -> int:
	return _index + 1


static func is_last_word() -> bool:
	return _index >= _words.size() - 1


static func is_competition() -> bool:
	return mode == Mode.COMPETITION


static func mode_label() -> String:
	return "مسابقه روزانه" if mode == Mode.COMPETITION else "یادگیری"


static func hint_delay() -> float:
	return COMPETITION_HINT_DELAY if mode == Mode.COMPETITION else LEARNING_HINT_DELAY


## Seconds spent on the word being spelled right now.
static func elapsed_seconds() -> float:
	if controller == null:
		return 0.0
	if state == State.PLAYING:
		return float(Time.get_ticks_msec() - _word_started_ms) / 1000.0
	return _last_word_seconds()


static func _last_word_seconds() -> float:
	if _results.is_empty():
		return 0.0
	return float((_results[_results.size() - 1] as Dictionary).get("seconds", 0.0))


static func mark_hint_used() -> void:
	_word_hint_used = true


static func current_word_hint_used() -> bool:
	return _word_hint_used


## What the word being spelled is still worth, so the gameplay screen can show
## the player what a hint is about to cost.
static func current_word_potential_points() -> int:
	if mode != Mode.COMPETITION or controller == null:
		return 0
	return ScrambledScoreManager.points_for(elapsed_seconds(), _word_hint_used)
## Records the solved word and returns its result entry.
static func solve_current_word() -> Dictionary:
	if controller == null or state != State.PLAYING:
		return {}
	var seconds := elapsed_seconds()
	var points := 0
	if mode == Mode.COMPETITION:
		points = ScrambledScoreManager.points_for(seconds, _word_hint_used)
	var entry := {
		"word": controller.word,
		"meaning": controller.meaning,
		"meaning_fa": controller.meaning_fa,
		"seconds": seconds,
		"hint_used": _word_hint_used,
		"points": points,
		"book": book,
		"lesson": lesson,
	}
	_results.append(entry)
	if _word_hint_used:
		_hints_used += 1
	state = State.SOLVED
	# Learning practice is recorded word by word, so leaving a long lesson
	# halfway never throws away what has already been spelled correctly.
	if mode == Mode.LEARNING:
		ScrambledScoreManager.record_practice_word(book, lesson, _word_hint_used, seconds)
	return entry


## Moves on to the next word. Returns false when the session is over.
static func advance() -> bool:
	if state == State.FINISHED:
		return false
	if is_last_word():
		finish()
		return false
	_index += 1
	_deal_current_word()
	state = State.PLAYING
	return true


## Reveal a single letter in the scrambled board.
## Returns the index of the letter that was corrected.
static func reveal_letter(current_arrangement: Array) -> int:
	if controller == null:
		return -1

	# Identify positions that are currently wrong
	var misplaced_indices := []
	for i in controller.target.size():
		if i >= current_arrangement.size() or \
		   str(current_arrangement[i]).to_upper() != controller.target[i]:
			misplaced_indices.append(i)

	if misplaced_indices.is_empty():
		return -1

	# Pick a random misplaced index
	var idx: int = misplaced_indices.pick_random()
	_word_hint_used = true
	_hints_used += 1

	return idx


## Closes a finished session and writes its records.
static func finish() -> void:
	if state == State.FINISHED:
		return
	state = State.FINISHED
	if mode == Mode.COMPETITION:
		last_run_new_best = ScrambledScoreManager.save_daily_attempt(
			total_score(), _results.size(), _hints_used, session_seconds())
	_play_counts[_lesson_key()] = int(_play_counts.get(_lesson_key(), 0)) + 1


## Leaves a session early (the player pressed back). A competition keeps the
## points already earned, so quitting is never punished, and a lesson keeps
## the per-word practice it has already recorded.
static func abandon() -> void:
	if state == State.FINISHED:
		return
	if mode == Mode.COMPETITION:
		state = State.FINISHED
		last_run_new_best = ScrambledScoreManager.save_daily_attempt(
			total_score(), words_attempted(), _hints_used, session_seconds())
		_play_counts[_lesson_key()] = int(_play_counts.get(_lesson_key(), 0)) + 1
		return
	state = State.IDLE


## -------------------------------------------------------------- summary --
static func results() -> Array:
	return _results


static func correct_count() -> int:
	return _results.size()


## Words the player actually faced, so a run quit halfway reports honestly.
static func words_attempted() -> int:
	return maxi(_results.size(), word_position())


static func hints_used() -> int:
	return _hints_used


static func total_score() -> int:
	var total := 0
	for entry in _results:
		total += int((entry as Dictionary).get("points", 0))
	return total


static func session_seconds() -> float:
	return float(Time.get_ticks_msec() - _session_started_ms) / 1000.0


static func total_word_seconds() -> float:
	var total := 0.0
	for entry in _results:
		total += float((entry as Dictionary).get("seconds", 0.0))
	return total


static func average_seconds() -> float:
	if _results.is_empty():
		return 0.0
	return total_word_seconds() / float(_results.size())


## How the session's words were spelled, for the results card:
## fast (≤10s) · quick (≤30s) · steady (≤50s) · slow · hinted.
static func score_band_counts() -> Dictionary:
	var counts := {"fast": 0, "quick": 0, "steady": 0, "slow": 0, "hinted": 0}
	for entry in _results:
		var data: Dictionary = entry
		var seconds := float(data.get("seconds", 0.0))
		if bool(data.get("hint_used", false)):
			counts["hinted"] = int(counts["hinted"]) + 1
		elif seconds <= 10.0:
			counts["fast"] = int(counts["fast"]) + 1
		elif seconds <= 30.0:
			counts["quick"] = int(counts["quick"]) + 1
		elif seconds <= 50.0:
			counts["steady"] = int(counts["steady"]) + 1
		else:
			counts["slow"] = int(counts["slow"]) + 1
	return counts


## --------------------------------------------------------------- resets --
static func reset() -> void:
	_words = []
	_index = 0
	_results = []
	_hints_used = 0
	controller = null
	state = State.IDLE
	last_run_new_best = false


## Only for tests: forgets how often lessons have been played.
static func reset_play_counts() -> void:
	_play_counts = {}
```
