## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/gameplay.gd`

```gdscript
extends Control
## ============================================================
##  GAMEPLAY — the board screen of «بازی املا».
##
##  Hosted inside ScrambledWords.tscn (which owns the header bar and the back
##  navigation), so this screen is only the game itself.
##
##  This script is a COORDINATOR. Every piece of the screen's furniture — the
##  chips, the clock, the meaning card, the action buttons, the win feedback
##  and the quit question — is a component scene of its own under ui/, and this
##  script wires their signals to ScrambledGameManager and decides what happens
##  next. It builds nothing and positions nothing: the layout lives in
##  Gameplay.tscn and each component owns its own look, as the project's UI
##  rules ask.
##
##  The screen also owns the game's THEME. It puts one Theme in place on the
##  way into the tree, and every component resolves its look through it by
##  naming a type variation — so a restyle is a change to ScrambledTheme and a
##  Dark/Light toggle is a single theme swap, not a walk over thirty nodes.
##
##  It drives ScrambledGameManager rather than holding session state, which is
##  why the results screen can read the very same run and why leaving the
##  screen never loses a session.
##
##  Two rules shape every decision here: a wrong arrangement is never punished
##  (the tiles only nudge amber when the word is one or two letters away) and
##  the word is never solved *for* the player — the hint gives the meaning,
##  which is the whole point of a spelling game.
## ============================================================

signal session_finished()
signal quit_requested()

const INSTRUCTION_TEXT := "حروف را با انگشت بکش و کلمه را بساز"
const INSTRUCTION_FADE_TIME := 7.0
const HINT_READY_TEXT := "راهنما آماده است — معنی کلمه را ببین"
## How long the "the hint is ready" note stands before the line steps aside.
const HINT_READY_NOTE_TIME := 3.2
const INSTRUCTION_FADE_OUT := 0.35
const CONFIRM_TITLE := "از بازی خارج می‌شوی؟"
const CONFIRM_BODY := "پیشرفت همین بازی از دست می‌رود."
const CONFIRM_BODY_SAVED := "امتیازهایی که گرفته‌ای ثبت می‌شود."
## The competition bar fills towards the slowest scoring band; a lesson fills
## towards the moment its hint becomes available.
const COMPETITION_LIMIT := 60.0
## Where the confetti is thrown from, as a fraction of the board's height.
const CONFETTI_HEIGHT_RATIO := 0.45

@onready var _background: ColorRect = $Background
@onready var _chips: ScrambledGameplayChips = $Layout/Chips
@onready var _timer: ScrambledGameplayTimer = $Layout/Timer
@onready var _instruction: Label = $Layout/MessageBand/InstructionInset/Instruction
@onready var _hint_card: ScrambledHintCard = $Layout/MessageBand/HintCard
@onready var _board: ScrambledTileBoard = $Layout/Board
@onready var _actions: ScrambledGameplayActions = $Layout/Actions
@onready var _confetti: ScrambledConfettiBurst = $Layout/Confetti
@onready var _praise: ScrambledPraiseOverlay = $PraiseOverlay
@onready var _confirm: ScrambledConfirmDialog = $ConfirmDialog

var _elapsed := 0.0
var _playing := false
var _solved := false
var _hint_shown := false
var _hint_ready := false
var _closing := false
## The worth last shown on the chips, so the ticking clock only redraws them
## when the number the player is watching actually changes.
var _last_worth := -1


## The theme goes in before any child is ready, because a component resolves
## its variation through it the moment it first draws.
func _enter_tree() -> void:
	_swap_theme()


func _ready() -> void:
	_board.arrangement_settled.connect(_on_arrangement_settled)
	_board.tile_grabbed.connect(_on_tile_grabbed)
	_actions.hint_requested.connect(_on_hint_requested)
	_actions.reveal_requested.connect(_on_reveal_letter_requested)
	_confirm.confirmed.connect(_on_leave_confirmed)
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_start_word(true)


func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not _playing:
		return
	_elapsed += delta
	_refresh_timer()
	# Waiting is what keeps the meaning from being the first thing tried, so the
	# hint only becomes available once the word has been going long enough.
	if not _hint_ready and _elapsed >= ScrambledGameManager.hint_delay():
		_hint_ready = true
		_actions.reveal_hint()
		_flash_hint_ready()


## Called by the host on the Android back button (and by its own header).
func handle_back() -> void:
	if _confirm.is_open():
		_confirm.close()
		return
	_open_confirm()


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


## A Dark/Light toggle repaints the app, so the game's own theme is rebuilt from
## the token palette and swapped in. Godot then tells every descendant and each
## repaints itself from the new variations, so there is nothing to walk and
## nothing to re-apply by hand.
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	_swap_theme()
	# The page tint is a plain ColorRect rather than a themed Control, and the
	# board paints itself (its tiles must stay invisible to the app-wide theme
	# walk), so those two are asked to repaint explicitly.
	_background.color = ScrambledTheme.page_tint()
	_board.queue_redraw()


func _swap_theme() -> void:
	theme = ScrambledTheme.build_theme()


############################################################
# LEAVING
############################################################
## Leaving mid-session asks first: quitting is forgiving (the points already
## earned are saved) but it still ends the run.
func _open_confirm() -> void:
	_confirm.open(CONFIRM_TITLE,
		CONFIRM_BODY_SAVED if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition() else CONFIRM_BODY)


## A competition keeps the points already earned, a lesson keeps the words
## already practised — both are written by the manager.
func _on_leave_confirmed() -> void:
	_closing = true
	ScrambledGameManager.abandon()
	quit_requested.emit()


############################################################
# THE WORD FLOW
############################################################
func _start_word(animate: bool) -> void:
	var controller := ScrambledGameManager.controller
	if controller == null:
		_finish_session()
		return
	_solved = false
	_playing = true
	_hint_shown = false
	_hint_ready = false
	_elapsed = 0.0
	_last_worth = -1
	_hint_card.hide_hint()
	_actions.hide_hint()
	_praise.clear()
	_instruction.visible = true
	_instruction.modulate.a = 1.0
	_instruction.text = INSTRUCTION_TEXT
	_board.set_board_locked(false)
	_board.build(controller, animate)
	_refresh_chips()
	_refresh_timer()
	if animate:
		_fade_instruction()


## The how-to line steps aside after a few seconds — and the moment the player
## starts playing, which is sooner.
func _fade_instruction() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(INSTRUCTION_FADE_TIME).timeout
	if not is_instance_valid(self) or not is_inside_tree() or _closing or _hint_card.is_shown():
		return
	_dismiss_instruction()


func _dismiss_instruction() -> void:
	if not _instruction.visible or _hint_card.is_shown() or _instruction.modulate.a <= 0.0:
		return
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(_instruction, "modulate:a", 0.0, INSTRUCTION_FADE_OUT) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Turns the how-to line into a "the hint is ready" note for a few seconds, so
## a button arriving at the bottom is not the only clue that it did.
func _flash_hint_ready() -> void:
	_instruction.text = HINT_READY_TEXT
	_instruction.visible = true
	_instruction.modulate.a = 1.0
	await get_tree().create_timer(HINT_READY_NOTE_TIME).timeout
	if not is_instance_valid(self) or not is_inside_tree() or _closing or _hint_card.is_shown():
		return
	_dismiss_instruction()


func _on_tile_grabbed(_tile: ScrambledTile) -> void:
	_dismiss_instruction()


func _on_arrangement_settled(solved: bool) -> void:
	if _solved or _closing:
		return
	if solved:
		_on_word_solved()
		return
	Sfx.click()
	# Never punished, never given away: when the word is only one or two letters
	# away the wrong tiles pulse amber.
	var controller := ScrambledGameManager.controller
	if controller != null and controller.is_near_miss(_board.tiles_letters()):
		_board.play_near_miss_nudge()


func _on_word_solved() -> void:
	_solved = true
	_playing = false
	_board.play_solved_flourish()
	_board.set_board_locked(true)
	Sfx.correct()
	var entry := ScrambledGameManager.solve_current_word()
	_praise.celebrate()
	if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition():
		_praise.float_points(int(entry.get("points", 0)))
	_refresh_chips()
	_confetti.burst(_board.position
		+ Vector2(_board.size.x * 0.5, _board.size.y * CONFETTI_HEIGHT_RATIO))
	_await_next_word()


func _await_next_word() -> void:
	await get_tree().create_timer(ScrambledGameManager.NEXT_WORD_DELAY).timeout
	if not is_instance_valid(self) or not is_inside_tree() or _closing:
		return
	if ScrambledGameManager.advance():
		_start_word(true)
	else:
		_finish_session()


func _finish_session() -> void:
	_playing = false
	Sfx.complete()
	session_finished.emit()


############################################################
# THE HINT
############################################################
## The hint button hands over the meaning, at the price of the word's worth.
func _on_hint_requested() -> void:
	if _hint_shown or _solved:
		return
	_hint_shown = true
	_hint_ready = true
	ScrambledGameManager.mark_hint_used()
	_actions.hide_hint()
	Sfx.click()


## One letter of the answer is placed for the player — and because that is
## already a real concession, the meaning comes with it, plus an updated worth.
func _on_reveal_letter_requested() -> void:
	if _hint_shown or _solved:
		return
	var index := ScrambledGameManager.reveal_letter(_board.tiles_letters())
	if index >= 0:
		_board.reveal_letter_at(index)
		Sfx.click()
	_show_hint_card()
	_refresh_chips()


## The meaning card takes the place of the how-to line: the English meaning
## first (that is the hint), the Persian one underneath as a second hand.
func _show_hint_card() -> void:
	var controller := ScrambledGameManager.controller
	if controller == null:
		return
	_instruction.visible = false
	_hint_card.show_hint(controller.meaning, controller.meaning_fa, _worth_caption())


## What reading the meaning costs, said in the competition only: a lesson has
## no score for a hint to shrink.
func _worth_caption() -> String:
	if not ScrambledGameManager.is_competition():
		return ""
	return "با راهنما این کلمه %s امتیاز دارد" % MenuStyle.persian_digits(
		str(ScrambledGameManager.current_word_potential_points()))


############################################################
# THE STANDING
############################################################
## The clock fills towards the hint in a lesson and towards the slowest scoring
## band in the day's competition, and its colour follows the same idea.
func _refresh_timer() -> void:
	var competition := ScrambledGameManager.is_competition()
	var limit := COMPETITION_LIMIT if competition else ScrambledGameManager.hint_delay()
	var color := ScrambledTheme.timer_color(_elapsed) if competition else MenuStyle.accent_bright()
	_timer.set_elapsed(_elapsed, limit, color)
	# The word is worth less every second, and watching that number fall is the
	# whole point of the competition — so the chips follow it down.
	if not competition or _solved:
		return
	var worth := ScrambledGameManager.current_word_potential_points()
	if worth != _last_worth:
		_last_worth = worth
		_refresh_chips()


func _refresh_chips() -> void:
	var competition := ScrambledGameManager.is_competition()
	_chips.set_progress(ScrambledGameManager.word_position(), ScrambledGameManager.word_count())
	_chips.set_mode(ScrambledGameManager.mode_label())
	_chips.set_competition(competition)
	if not competition:
		return
	_chips.set_points(ScrambledGameManager.total_score())
	_chips.set_worth(ScrambledGameManager.current_word_potential_points(), _hint_shown)
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/lesson_select.gd`

```gdscript
extends Control
## ============================================================
##  LESSON SELECT — pick a book, then the lesson to practise.
##
##  Everything here is built from ScrambledData, so adding a book, a lesson or
##  a word to res://data/scrambled_words.json is all it takes for it to show up
##  here (the folder README describes the format).
##
##  Each lesson button also carries the practice record of that lesson, which
##  is the closest thing learning mode has to a score: how many words have been
##  spelled correctly there so far.
## ============================================================

signal lesson_chosen(book: int, lesson: int)
signal back_requested()

const BOOK_ACCENTS := {
	1: Color("#3B82F6"),
	2: Color("#22C55E"),
	3: Color("#EF4444"),
}
const FALLBACK_ACCENT := DesignTokens.ACCENT

var _book := 1
var _book_row: HBoxContainer = null
var _lesson_column: VBoxContainer = null
var _summary_label: Label = null


func _ready() -> void:
	_book = _pick_initial_book()
	_build_ui()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_refresh()


func screen_title() -> String:
	return "انتخاب درس"


func handle_back() -> void:
	back_requested.emit()


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	var background := get_node_or_null("Background") as ColorRect
	if background != null:
		background.color = ScrambledTheme.page_tint()
	_refresh()


## Opens on the last book played, falling back to the first book the bank has.
func _pick_initial_book() -> int:
	if ScrambledData.has_book(ScrambledGameManager.book):
		return ScrambledGameManager.book
	var books := ScrambledData.books()
	if books.is_empty():
		return 1
	return int(books[0]["book"])


func _accent_for(book: int) -> Color:
	return BOOK_ACCENTS.get(book, FALLBACK_ACCENT)


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout --
func _build_ui() -> void:
	var background := ColorRect.new()
	background.name = "Background"
	background.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	background.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(background)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	add_child(scroll)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 60)
	scroll.add_child(margin)

	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	margin.add_child(column)

	var intro := Label.new()
	intro.name = "IntroLabel"
	intro.text = "کدام کتاب و کدام درس؟"
	intro.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	intro.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	intro.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 46)
	column.add_child(intro)

	_book_row = HBoxContainer.new()
	_book_row.name = "BookRow"
	_book_row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_book_row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	column.add_child(_book_row)

	_summary_label = Label.new()
	_summary_label.name = "SummaryLabel"
	_summary_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_summary_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	_summary_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	_summary_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	column.add_child(_summary_label)

	_lesson_column = VBoxContainer.new()
	_lesson_column.name = "LessonColumn"
	_lesson_column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	column.add_child(_lesson_column)


## --------------------------------------------------------------- refresh --
func _refresh() -> void:
	if _book_row == null:
		return
	for child in _book_row.get_children():
		_book_row.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	for child in _lesson_column.get_children():
		_lesson_column.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()

	var books := ScrambledData.books()
	for book_data in books:
		_book_row.add_child(_make_book_button(book_data))

	if books.is_empty():
		_summary_label.text = ""
		_lesson_column.add_child(MenuStyle.make_tip_card(
			"هنوز واژه‌ای در بانک بازی ثبت نشده است.", ""))
		return

	var book_data := ScrambledData.book_data(_book)
	if book_data.is_empty():
		_summary_label.text = ""
		_lesson_column.add_child(MenuStyle.make_tip_card(
			"برای این کتاب درسی ثبت نشده است.", "📕"))
		return

	_summary_label.text = "%s · %s — %s درس، %s کلمه" % [
		str(book_data.get("title", "")),
		str(book_data.get("grade_fa", "")),
		digits(int(book_data.get("lesson_count", 0))),
		digits(int(book_data.get("word_count", 0))),
	]
	for lesson_data in book_data.get("lessons", []):
		_lesson_column.add_child(_make_lesson_button(lesson_data))


## Book chips: the open book is filled with its own accent, the others are
## flat cards, so the choice is obvious at a glance.
func _make_book_button(book_data: Dictionary) -> Button:
	var book := int(book_data.get("book", 0))
	var accent := _accent_for(book)
	var selected := book == _book
	var button := Button.new()
	button.name = "Book%d" % book
	button.text = str(book_data.get("title", "Vision %d" % book))
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(240, 108)
	button.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.nunito())
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
		MenuStyle.on_accent(accent) if selected else MenuStyle.text())
	var normal := MenuStyle.card_style(accent, 24, false, not selected)
	if selected:
		normal = ScrambledTheme.chip_style(accent, 24, ScrambledTheme.tile_edge(accent), 3)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", MenuStyle.card_hover_style(accent, 24, not selected))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", MenuStyle.card_pressed_style(accent, 24, not selected))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", normal)
	button.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		Sfx.click()
		_book = book
		_refresh())
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(button)
	return button


## One lesson: the Persian title, how many words it holds, and what the player
## has already spelled there.
func _make_lesson_button(lesson_data: Dictionary) -> Button:
	var lesson := int(lesson_data.get("lesson", 0))
	var words := int(lesson_data.get("word_count", 0))
	var accent := _accent_for(_book)
	var button := Button.new()
	button.name = "Lesson%d" % lesson
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 148)
	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", MenuStyle.card_style(accent, 26, false, true))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", MenuStyle.card_hover_style(accent, 26, true))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", MenuStyle.card_pressed_style(accent, 26, true))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", MenuStyle.card_hover_style(accent, 26, true))
	button.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		Sfx.click()
		lesson_chosen.emit(_book, lesson))
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(button)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 26)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 26)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 14)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 14)
	button.add_child(margin)

	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
	column.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	column.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	margin.add_child(column)

	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	column.add_child(row)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	title.text = _lesson_label(lesson, str(lesson_data.get("title_fa", "")))
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 40)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	row.add_child(title)
	var count: Label = MenuStyle.pill_label("%s کلمه" % digits(words), accent, 28)
	count.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	row.add_child(count)

	var record := ScrambledScoreManager.practice_stats(_book, lesson)
	var note := Label.new()
	note.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	note.text = _practice_note(record)
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	column.add_child(note)
	return button


func _lesson_label(lesson: int, title_fa: String) -> String:
	var number := digits(lesson)
	if title_fa.is_empty():
		return "درس %s" % number
	return "درس %s · %s" % [number, title_fa]


func _practice_note(record: Dictionary) -> String:
	var words := int(record.get("words", 0))
	if words <= 0:
		return "هنوز تمرین نشده"
	return "%s کلمه تمرین شده · %s بار بازی" % [digits(words), digits(int(record.get("plays", 0)))]


func digits(value: int) -> String:
	return MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(value))
```

```gdscript
extends Control
signal learning_requested()
signal exit_requested()
const COLOR_LEARNING := Color("#22C55E")
func _ready() -> void:
	_build_ui()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
func screen_title() -> String:
	return "بازی املا"
func handle_back() -> void:
	exit_requested.emit()
func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()
func _apply_theme() -> void:
	var background := get_node_or_null("Background") as ColorRect
	if background != null:
		background.color = ScrambledTheme.page_tint()
func _build_ui() -> void:
	var background := ColorRect.new()
	background.name = "Background"
	background.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	background.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(background)
	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	add_child(scroll)
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 30)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 60)
	scroll.add_child(margin)
	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 20)
	margin.add_child(column)
	column.add_child(_make_hero())
	column.add_child(_make_mode_card(
		"LearningCard", "یادگیری", "تمرین با آرامش", "بدون زمان‌سنج و بدون امتیاز", "📚",
		COLOR_LEARNING, false))
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 20)
	column.add_child(spacer)
func _make_mode_card(node_name: String, title_text: String, tag_text: String,
		description_text: String, icon_text: String, accent: Color, _locked: bool) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.name = node_name
	button.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 300)
	button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _mode_card_style(accent, false, false))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _mode_card_style(accent, true, false))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _mode_card_style(accent, false, false))
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", MenuStyle.text())
	button.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", MenuStyle.text())
	button.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 1)
	button.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 0)
	button.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_width", 0)
	button.alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_FILL
	button.pressed.connect(_on_mode_card_pressed.bind(node_name))

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.name = "ModeCardContent"
	margin.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	margin.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 26)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 26)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 22)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 22)
	button.add_child(margin)

	var layout := HBoxContainer.new()
	layout.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	layout.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)
	layout.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	margin.add_child(layout)

	var icon_panel := PanelContainer.new()
	icon_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	icon_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(140, 140)
	icon_panel.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	icon_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _mode_icon_style(accent, false))
	layout.add_child(icon_panel)
	var icon := Label.new()
	icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	icon.text = icon_text
	icon.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	icon.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 68)
	icon_panel.add_child(icon)

	var copy := VBoxContainer.new()
	copy.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	copy.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	copy.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 5)
	copy.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	layout.add_child(copy)
	var tag := Label.new()
	tag.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	tag.text = tag_text
	tag.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	tag.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	tag.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	tag.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent.darkened(0.08))
	copy.add_child(tag)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	title.text = title_text
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	title.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	copy.add_child(title)
	var description := Label.new()
	description.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	description.text = description_text
	description.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	description.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	description.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	description.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	description.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
	description.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	copy.add_child(description)
	return button


func _on_mode_card_pressed(card_name: String) -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	if card_name == "LearningCard":
		learning_requested.emit()


func _mode_card_style(accent: Color, hovered: bool, locked: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	var dark := MenuStyle.is_dark()
	style.bg_color = MenuStyle.paper() if not dark else DesignTokens.color_of(true, "surface")
	if hovered and not locked:
		style.bg_color = style.bg_color.lightened(0.035)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
	style.set_border_width_all(3 if not locked else 1)
	style.border_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.82 if not locked else 0.24)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.02, 0.08, 0.18, 0.20 if hovered and not locked else 0.09)
	style.shadow_size = 14 if hovered and not locked else 7
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 5)
	style.content_margin_left = 8
	style.content_margin_right = 8
	style.content_margin_top = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8
	return style


func _mode_icon_style(accent: Color, locked: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.13 if not locked else 0.06)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(28)
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	style.border_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.32 if not locked else 0.14)
	return style


func _make_hero() -> VBoxContainer:
	var hero := VBoxContainer.new()
	hero.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.name = "HeroTitle"
	title.text = "حروف را درست بچین"
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 54)
	hero.add_child(title)
	var subtitle := Label.new()
	subtitle.name = "Subtitle"
	subtitle.text = "حرف‌های به‌هم‌ریخته‌ی هر کلمه را با انگشت جابه‌جا کن تا کلمه ساخته شود"
	subtitle.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	subtitle.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	subtitle.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	subtitle.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	subtitle.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	hero.add_child(subtitle)
	return hero
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/results.gd`

```gdscript
extends Control
## ============================================================
##  RESULTS — what the session that just ended was worth.
##
##  Reads ScrambledGameManager, which still holds the finished session, so it
##  can report both modes honestly:
##    COMPETITION — the daily total out of 500, its rating, the record and the
##                  points of every word.
##    LEARNING    — how many words of the lesson were spelled, how long it took
##                  and how often the meaning was revealed.
##
##  "بازی دوباره" replays the very same mode; the host screen does the dealing.
## ============================================================

signal replay_requested()
signal home_requested()

const COLOR_SCORE := Color("#31C463")
const COLOR_LEARNING := DesignTokens.ACCENT
const COLOR_HINT := Color("#FFB703")
const COLOR_RECORD := Color("#C77DFF")

var _content: VBoxContainer = null
var _score_label: Label = null
var _shown_score := 0.0:
	set(value):
		_shown_score = value
		if _score_label != null:
			_score_label.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(int(round(value))))


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_ui()
	_apply_theme()
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_play_score_animation()


func screen_title() -> String:
	return "مسابقه روزانه" if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition() else "نتیجه تمرین"


func handle_back() -> void:
	home_requested.emit()


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	_apply_theme()


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	var background := get_node_or_null("Background") as ColorRect
	if background != null:
		background.color = ScrambledTheme.page_tint()
	if _content != null:
		_fill_content()


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout --
func _build_ui() -> void:
	var background := ColorRect.new()
	background.name = "Background"
	background.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	background.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(background)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	add_child(scroll)

	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 40)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 26)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 60)
	scroll.add_child(margin)

	_content = VBoxContainer.new()
	_content.name = "Content"
	_content.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	margin.add_child(_content)
	_fill_content()


## The whole card set, rebuilt from the session (and on a theme change, since
## the colours of the labels come from the palette).
func _fill_content() -> void:
	for child in _content.get_children():
		_content.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	_score_label = null

	if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition():
		_fill_competition()
	else:
		_fill_learning()

	_content.add_child(_make_summary_card())
	_content.add_child(_make_word_list_card())
	_content.add_child(_make_action_row())


## --------------------------------------------------------------- the hero --
func _fill_competition() -> void:
	var total := ScrambledGameManager.total_score()
	var rating := ScrambledScoreManager.rating_for(total)
	_content.add_child(_make_hero(str(rating.get("emoji", "🏆")),
		str(rating.get("label", "")), "امتیاز امروز", COLOR_SCORE))

	var score_row := _make_score_row(COLOR_SCORE, str(ScrambledScoreManager.MAX_DAILY_SCORE))
	_content.add_child(score_row)
	if ScrambledGameManager.last_run_new_best:
		_content.add_child(_make_note("رکورد امروز بهتر شد!", COLOR_RECORD))


func _fill_learning() -> void:
	var book := ScrambledGameManager.book
	var lesson := ScrambledGameManager.lesson
	var lesson_title := ScrambledData.lesson_title_fa(book, lesson)
	var subtitle := "%s · درس %s" % [ScrambledData.book_label(book),
		MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(lesson))]
	if not lesson_title.is_empty():
		subtitle += " · %s" % lesson_title
	_content.add_child(_make_hero("📚", "تمرین کامل شد", subtitle, COLOR_LEARNING))
	_content.add_child(_make_score_row(COLOR_LEARNING,
		str(ScrambledData.word_count(book, lesson))))


## The big number, out of the day's maximum (competition) or the lesson's size.
func _make_score_row(accent: Color, maximum: String) -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.name = "ScoreRow"
	row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	_score_label = Label.new()
	_score_label.name = "ScoreLabel"
	_score_label.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(int(round(_shown_score))))
	_score_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.nunito())
	_score_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 150)
	_score_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	row.add_child(_score_label)
	var of_label := Label.new()
	of_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	of_label.text = "/ %s" % MenuStyle.persian_digits(maximum)
	of_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	of_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 56)
	of_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	of_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM
	row.add_child(of_label)
	return row


func _make_hero(emoji: String, headline: String, subtitle: String, accent: Color) -> VBoxContainer:
	var hero := VBoxContainer.new()
	hero.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	var emoji_label := Label.new()
	emoji_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	emoji_label.text = emoji
	emoji_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	emoji_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 96)
	hero.add_child(emoji_label)
	var title := Label.new()
	title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	title.text = headline
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	title.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 58)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	hero.add_child(title)
	var sub := Label.new()
	sub.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	sub.text = subtitle
	sub.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	sub.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	sub.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	sub.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	sub.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	hero.add_child(sub)
	return hero


func _make_note(text: String, accent: Color) -> Label:
	var note := Label.new()
	note.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	note.text = text
	note.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	note.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	note.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	note.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	return note


## The count-up: the score rolls from zero to its value once the card appears.
func _play_score_animation() -> void:
	if _score_label == null:
		return
	var target := _target_score()
	_shown_score = 0.0
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_method(_set_shown_score, 0.0, float(target), 0.9) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _set_shown_score(value: float) -> void:
	_shown_score = value


func _target_score() -> int:
	if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition():
		return ScrambledGameManager.total_score()
	return ScrambledGameManager.correct_count()


## -------------------------------------------------------------- the cards --
## A plain card that the caller fills. Returns the column INSIDE the card; the
## caller is responsible for parenting the returned PanelContainer (reachable
## through `column.get_parent().get_parent()`).
##
## WHY the caller parents it: this used to add the panel to `_content` itself
## AND hand it back, so `_fill_content` parented the same node a second time
## and Godot raised "already has a parent" on every Results load.
func _make_card(accent: Color) -> VBoxContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.name = "Card"
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", MenuStyle.card_style(accent, 28, false, true))
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 28)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 22)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 22)
	panel.add_child(margin)
	var column := VBoxContainer.new()
	column.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	margin.add_child(column)
	return column


func _make_card_title(text: String, accent: Color) -> Label:
	var title := Label.new()
	title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	title.text = text
	title.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	return title


## The numbers behind the run, one line each.
func _make_summary_card() -> PanelContainer:
	var competition := ScrambledGameManager.is_competition()
	var accent := COLOR_SCORE if competition else COLOR_LEARNING
	var column := _make_card(accent)
	column.add_child(_make_card_title("خلاصه", accent))
	var counts := ScrambledGameManager.score_band_counts()
	if competition:
		column.add_child(_make_progress_stat("پیشرفت امروز", ScrambledGameManager.correct_count(), ScrambledDailyPicker.WORDS_PER_DAY, accent))
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("بهترین امتیاز",
			digits(ScrambledScoreManager.best_score()), COLOR_RECORD))
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("روزهای مسابقه",
			digits(ScrambledScoreManager.played_days()), COLOR_RECORD))
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("۱۰۰ امتیازی (زیر ۱۰ ثانیه)",
			digits(int(counts["fast"])), COLOR_SCORE))
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("۶۰ امتیازی (زیر ۳۰ ثانیه)",
			digits(int(counts["quick"])), COLOR_SCORE))
	else:
		var lesson := ScrambledGameManager.lesson
		var practice := ScrambledScoreManager.practice_stats(ScrambledGameManager.book, lesson)
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("کلمه‌های درس %s" % digits(lesson),
			digits(ScrambledGameManager.correct_count()), accent))
		column.add_child(_make_stat_row("مجموع تمرین این درس",
			digits(int(practice["words"])), COLOR_RECORD))
	column.add_child(_make_stat_row("با راهنما",
		digits(ScrambledGameManager.hints_used()), COLOR_HINT))
	column.add_child(_make_stat_row("زمان کل",
		_format_seconds(ScrambledGameManager.session_seconds()), COLOR_RECORD))
	column.add_child(_make_stat_row("میانگین هر کلمه",
		_format_seconds(ScrambledGameManager.average_seconds()), COLOR_RECORD))
	return column.get_parent().get_parent() as PanelContainer


## A compact visual progress chart for the daily set.
func _make_progress_stat(label_text: String, value: int, maximum: int, accent: Color) -> VBoxContainer:
	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
	box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	var heading := HBoxContainer.new()
	var caption := Label.new()
	caption.text = label_text
	caption.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	caption.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	caption.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	caption.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	heading.add_child(caption)
	var amount := Label.new()
	amount.text = "%s / %s" % [digits(value), digits(maximum)]
	amount.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	amount.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	amount.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	heading.add_child(amount)
	box.add_child(heading)
	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.name = "StatisticsProgress"
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 18)
	bar.min_value = 0.0
	bar.max_value = float(maximum)
	bar.value = clampi(value, 0, maximum)
	bar.show_percentage = false
	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	track.bg_color = ScrambledTheme.track_color()
	track.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	var fill := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	fill.bg_color = accent
	fill.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", track)
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", fill)
	box.add_child(bar)
	return box


## Word by word: what was spelled, how long it took and what it was worth.
func _make_word_list_card() -> PanelContainer:
	var accent := COLOR_SCORE if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition() else COLOR_LEARNING
	var column := _make_card(accent)
	column.add_child(_make_card_title("کلمه به کلمه", accent))
	var results := ScrambledGameManager.results()
	if results.is_empty():
		column.add_child(_make_note("این بازی بدون پاسخ درست تمام شد.",
			MenuStyle.subtitle_color()))
	for i in results.size():
		column.add_child(_make_word_row(results[i] as Dictionary, i + 1))
	return column.get_parent().get_parent() as PanelContainer


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- buttons --
func _make_action_row() -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.name = "ActionRow"
	row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)

	var accent := COLOR_SCORE if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition() else COLOR_LEARNING
	var again := Button.new()
	again.name = "ReplayButton"
	again.text = "بازی دوباره"
	again.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 132)
	again.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	again.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	again.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	again.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.on_accent(accent))
	again.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _filled_style(accent, false))
	again.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _filled_style(accent, true))
	again.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _filled_style(accent, true))
	if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition() and ScrambledScoreManager.today_played():
		again.text = "چالش امروز انجام شد"
		again.disabled = true
		again.modulate = Color(0.68, 0.70, 0.74, 0.72)
	else:
		again.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			Sfx.click()
			replay_requested.emit())
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(again)
	row.add_child(again)

	var home := Button.new()
	home.name = "HomeButton"
	home.text = "بازگشت به منو"
	home.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 132)
	home.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	home.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	home.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 42)
	home.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		Sfx.click()
		home_requested.emit())
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(home)
	row.add_child(home)
	return row


## --------------------------------------------------------------- helpers --
func _filled_style(accent: Color, hover: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill := accent.lightened(0.10) if hover else accent
	var style := ScrambledTheme.chip_style(fill, 30, ScrambledTheme.tile_edge(accent), 3)
	style.content_margin_top = 18
	style.content_margin_bottom = 18
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.18, 0.28 if hover else 0.20)
	style.shadow_size = 24 if hover else 16
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 10.0 if hover else 6.0)
	return style


func _stat_row_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ScrambledTheme.track_color()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
	return style


func _make_stat_row(label_text: String, value_text: String, _accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _stat_row_style())
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 16)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 16)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 10)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 10)
	margin.add_child(row)
	panel.add_child(margin)
	var name_label := Label.new()
	name_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	name_label.text = label_text
	name_label.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	name_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	name_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	name_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	name_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	name_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	row.add_child(name_label)
	var value_label := Label.new()
	value_label.text = value_text
	value_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(112, 54)
	value_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	value_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	value_label.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	value_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 28)
	value_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	row.add_child(value_label)
	return panel


## "۰:۱۲" — the same mm:ss shape the gameplay timer uses.
func _format_seconds(seconds: float) -> String:
	var total := int(round(seconds))
	return MenuStyle.persian_digits("%d:%02d" % [int(floor(float(total) / 60.0)), total % 60])


func digits(value: int) -> String:
	return MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(value))


func _make_word_badge(text: String, _accent: Color) -> Label:
	var badge := Label.new()
	badge.text = text
	badge.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(104, 54)
	badge.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	badge.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	badge.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.vazir())
	badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 29)
	badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ScrambledTheme.track_color()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	badge.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
	return badge


func _make_word_row(entry: Dictionary, word_index: int) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _stat_row_style())
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	var margin := MarginContainer.new()
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", 14)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", 14)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", 10)
	margin.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", 10)
	margin.add_child(row)
	panel.add_child(margin)
	var word := Label.new()
	word.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	word.text = "%s. %s" % [MenuStyle.persian_digits(str(word_index)), str(entry.get("word", ""))]
	word.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	word.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	word.add_theme_font_override("font", MenuStyle.nunito())
	word.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	word.add_theme_color_override("font_color", MenuStyle.text())
	row.add_child(word)
	var metadata := HBoxContainer.new()
	metadata.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	metadata.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	if bool(entry.get("hint_used", false)):
		metadata.add_child(_make_word_badge("راهنما", COLOR_HINT))
	metadata.add_child(_make_word_badge(_format_seconds(float(entry.get("seconds", 0.0))), COLOR_RECORD))
	if ScrambledGameManager.is_competition():
		metadata.add_child(_make_word_badge("%s+" % digits(int(entry.get("points", 0))), COLOR_SCORE))
	row.add_child(metadata)
	return panel
```

```gdscript
class_name ScrambledScoreManager
extends RefCounted

const SAVE_PATH := "user://scrambled_words.json"
const SCHEMA := 1
const WORDS_PER_DAY := ScrambledDailyPicker.WORDS_PER_DAY
const MAX_WORD_POINTS := 100
const MIN_WORD_POINTS := 10
const HINT_PENALTY := 10
const MAX_DAILY_SCORE := MAX_WORD_POINTS * WORDS_PER_DAY
const MIN_DAILY_SCORE := MIN_WORD_POINTS * WORDS_PER_DAY
const SCORE_TABLE := [
	{"seconds": 10.0, "points": 100},
	{"seconds": 30.0, "points": 60},
	{"seconds": 50.0, "points": 40},
	{"seconds": 60.0, "points": 30},
]
const SLOWEST_POINTS := 20
const RATINGS := [
	{"min_score": 450, "label": "شگفت‌انگیز!", "emoji": ""},
	{"min_score": 350, "label": "خیلی خوب", "emoji": "🌟"},
	{"min_score": 250, "label": "خوب", "emoji": "👍"},
	{"min_score": 150, "label": "قابل قبول", "emoji": "🙂"},
	{"min_score": 0, "label": "دوباره تلاش کن", "emoji": ""},
]
static var _data: Dictionary = {}
static var _loaded := false

static func base_points_for(seconds: float) -> int:
	for row in SCORE_TABLE:
		if seconds <= float(row["seconds"]):
			return int(row["points"])
	return SLOWEST_POINTS

static func points_for(seconds: float, hint_used: bool) -> int:
	var points := base_points_for(seconds)
	if hint_used:
		points = int(floor(float(points) / 2.0))
	return maxi(MIN_WORD_POINTS, points)

static func rating_for(score: int) -> Dictionary:
	for band in RATINGS:
		if score >= int(band["min_score"]):
			return band
	return RATINGS[RATINGS.size() - 1]

static func today_key() -> String:
	return ScrambledDailyPicker.date_key()

static func today_score() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_today_entry().get("score", 0))

static func today_attempts() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_today_entry().get("attempts", 0))

static func today_played() -> bool:
	return today_attempts() > 0

static func best_score() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_data.get("best_daily", 0))

static func best_score_date() -> String:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return str(_data.get("best_daily_date", ""))

static func played_days() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return (_data.get("daily", {}) as Dictionary).size()

static func total_attempts() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var total := 0
	for entry in (_data.get("daily", {}) as Dictionary).values():
		if entry is Dictionary:
			total += int((entry as Dictionary).get("attempts", 0))
	return total

static func save_daily_attempt(score: int, words_played: int, hints_used: int, seconds: float) -> bool:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var key := today_key()
	var daily: Dictionary = _data["daily"]
	var entry: Dictionary = daily.get(key, {}) if daily.get(key) is Dictionary else {}
	var previous_best := int(entry.get("score", 0))
	var improved := score > previous_best
	entry["score"] = maxi(previous_best, score)
	entry["attempts"] = int(entry.get("attempts", 0)) + 1
	entry["words"] = maxi(0, words_played)
	entry["hints"] = maxi(0, hints_used)
	entry["seconds"] = snappedf(maxf(0.0, seconds), 0.1)
	daily[key] = entry
	_data["daily"] = daily
	_data["played_days"] = daily.size()
	if score > int(_data.get("best_daily", 0)):
		_data["best_daily"] = score
		_data["best_daily_date"] = key
	_save()
	return improved

static func daily_history(limit: int = 7) -> Array:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var keys: Array = (_data.get("daily", {}) as Dictionary).keys()
	keys.sort()
	var out: Array = []
	for i in range(keys.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		if out.size() >= limit:
			break
		var key := str(keys[i])
		var entry: Dictionary = (_data["daily"] as Dictionary).get(key, {})
		out.append({"date": key, "score": int(entry.get("score", 0)), "attempts": int(entry.get("attempts", 0))})
	return out

static func practice_key(book: int, lesson: int) -> String:
	return "%d_%d" % [book, lesson]

static func record_practice_word(book: int, lesson: int, hint_used: bool, seconds: float) -> void:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var key := practice_key(book, lesson)
	var practice: Dictionary = _data["practice"]
	var entry: Dictionary = practice.get(key, {}) if practice.get(key) is Dictionary else {}
	entry["plays"] = int(entry.get("plays", 0)) + 1
	entry["words"] = int(entry.get("words", 0)) + 1
	entry["hints"] = int(entry.get("hints", 0)) + (1 if hint_used else 0)
	entry["seconds"] = snappedf(float(entry.get("seconds", 0.0)) + maxf(0.0, seconds), 0.1)
	practice[key] = entry
	_data["practice"] = practice
	_save()

static func practice_stats(book: int, lesson: int) -> Dictionary:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var entry = (_data.get("practice", {}) as Dictionary).get(practice_key(book, lesson), {})
	var out := {"plays": 0, "words": 0, "hints": 0, "seconds": 0.0}
	if entry is Dictionary:
		out["plays"] = int(entry.get("plays", 0))
		out["words"] = int(entry.get("words", 0))
		out["hints"] = int(entry.get("hints", 0))
		out["seconds"] = float(entry.get("seconds", 0.0))
	return out

static func total_practice_words() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var total := 0
	for entry in (_data.get("practice", {}) as Dictionary).values():
		if entry is Dictionary:
			total += int((entry as Dictionary).get("words", 0))
	return total

static func practice_summary() -> Dictionary:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var out := {"lessons": 0, "words": 0, "hints": 0, "seconds": 0.0}
	for entry in (_data.get("practice", {}) as Dictionary).values():
		if not (entry is Dictionary):
			continue
		out["lessons"] = int(out["lessons"]) + 1
		out["words"] = int(out["words"]) + int((entry as Dictionary).get("words", 0))
		out["hints"] = int(out["hints"]) + int((entry as Dictionary).get("hints", 0))
		out["seconds"] = float(out["seconds"]) + float((entry as Dictionary).get("seconds", 0.0))
	return out

static func reset_cache() -> void:
	_data = {}
	_loaded = false

static func _today_entry() -> Dictionary:
	var entry = (_data.get("daily", {}) as Dictionary).get(today_key(), {})
	return entry if entry is Dictionary else {}

static func _default_data() -> Dictionary:
	return {"schema": SCHEMA, "best_daily": 0, "best_daily_date": "", "played_days": 0, "daily": {}, "practice": {}}

static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
	if _loaded:
		return
	_loaded = true
	_data = _default_data()
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH):
		return
	var text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SAVE_PATH)
	if text.is_empty():
		return
	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK or not (json.data is Dictionary):
		push_warning("ScrambledScoreManager: ignoring an unreadable %s" % SAVE_PATH)
		return
	var stored: Dictionary = json.data
	_data["schema"] = int(stored.get("schema", SCHEMA))
	_data["best_daily"] = maxi(0, int(stored.get("best_daily", 0)))
	_data["best_daily_date"] = str(stored.get("best_daily_date", ""))
	var daily = stored.get("daily", {})
	if daily is Dictionary:
		_data["daily"] = daily
	var practice = stored.get("practice", {})
	if practice is Dictionary:
		_data["practice"] = practice
	_data["played_days"] = (_data["daily"] as Dictionary).size()

static func _save() -> void:
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_warning("ScrambledScoreManager: cannot write %s" % SAVE_PATH)
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(_data, "  "))
	file.close()
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/scrambled_data.gd`

```gdscript
class_name ScrambledData
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  SCRAMBLED DATA — the word bank behind «بازی املا».
##
##  Reads res://data/scrambled_words.json, a book > lesson > word list that
##  mirrors how the game is played: pick a book, pick a lesson, spell that
##  lesson's words. The daily challenge uses the same bank through
##  all_words(), which flattens it in a fixed order — the daily picker slices
##  that order, so nothing here may sort or shuffle it.
##
##  Word entries carry `word` (the thing to spell), `meaning` (the English
##  meaning, shown as the hint) and `meaning_fa` (the Persian meaning, the
##  optional second half of the hint).
##
##  Every read is guarded: a missing or unreadable file yields an empty bank
##  and the screens show a friendly "no words" card instead of breaking.
## ============================================================

const DATA_PATH := "res://data/scrambled_words.json"

static var _books: Array = []
static var _all_words: Array = []
static var _loaded := false


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- books --
## Books in file order: [{book, title, grade_fa, lesson_count, word_count,
## lessons: [...]}].
static func books() -> Array:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _books


static func book_count() -> int:
	return books().size()


static func book_data(book_number: int) -> Dictionary:
	for entry in books():
		if int(entry["book"]) == book_number:
			return entry
	return {}


static func has_book(book_number: int) -> bool:
	return not book_data(book_number).is_empty()


static func book_label(book_number: int) -> String:
	var data := book_data(book_number)
	if data.is_empty():
		return "Vision %d" % book_number
	return str(data.get("title", "Vision %d" % book_number))


static func grade_label(book_number: int) -> String:
	return str(book_data(book_number).get("grade_fa", ""))


## -------------------------------------------------------------- lessons --
## Lessons of one book: [{lesson, title, title_fa, word_count, words: [...]}].
static func lessons(book_number: int) -> Array:
	var data := book_data(book_number)
	if data.is_empty():
		return []
	return data.get("lessons", [])


static func lesson_data(book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> Dictionary:
	for entry in lessons(book_number):
		if int(entry["lesson"]) == lesson_number:
			return entry
	return {}


static func has_lesson(book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> bool:
	return not lesson_data(book_number, lesson_number).is_empty()


## The Persian title of a lesson («شگفتی‌های آفرینش»), "" when it has none.
static func lesson_title_fa(book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> String:
	return str(lesson_data(book_number, lesson_number).get("title_fa", ""))


## ---------------------------------------------------------------- words --
## The lesson's words in file order: [{word, meaning, meaning_fa}].
static func words(book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> Array:
	var data := lesson_data(book_number, lesson_number)
	if data.is_empty():
		return []
	return data.get("words", [])


## The playable list of a lesson. `by_length` deals the short words first,
## which is the difficulty ramp learning mode plays.
static func words_ordered(book_number: int, lesson_number: int, by_length := true) -> Array:
	var list := words(book_number, lesson_number).duplicate()
	if by_length:
		list.sort_custom(func(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
			var la := str(a["word"]).length()
			var lb := str(b["word"]).length()
			if la == lb:
				return str(a["word"]) < str(b["word"])
			return la < lb)
	return list


static func word_count(book_number: int, lesson_number: int) -> int:
	return words(book_number, lesson_number).size()


## Every word of every book, in file order, each tagged with its book/lesson.
## The daily picker depends on that order staying stable.
static func all_words() -> Array:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _all_words


static func total_word_count() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _all_words.size()
## ------------------------------------------------------------ internals --
## Drops the parsed copy so the next read re-parses the file. Used by tests
## after the bank on disk has been swapped.
static func reset_cache() -> void:
	_books = []
	_all_words = []
	_loaded = false


static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
	if _loaded:
		return
	_loaded = true
	_books = []
	_all_words = []

	if not FileAccess.file_exists(DATA_PATH):
		push_warning("ScrambledData: %s is missing" % DATA_PATH)
		return
	var text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(DATA_PATH)
	if text.is_empty():
		push_warning("ScrambledData: cannot read %s" % DATA_PATH)
		return

	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK or not (json.data is Dictionary):
		push_warning("ScrambledData: %s is not readable JSON" % DATA_PATH)
		return
	var raw_books = (json.data as Dictionary).get("books", [])
	if not (raw_books is Array):
		return

	for raw_book in raw_books:
		if not (raw_book is Dictionary):
			continue
		var book_number := int(raw_book.get("book", 0))
		if book_number <= 0:
			continue
		var built_lessons: Array = []
		var book_words := 0
		for raw_lesson in raw_book.get("lessons", []):
			if not (raw_lesson is Dictionary):
				continue
			var lesson_number := int(raw_lesson.get("lesson", 0))
			if lesson_number <= 0:
				continue
			var built_words: Array = []
			for raw_word in raw_lesson.get("words", []):
				if not (raw_word is Dictionary):
					continue
				var spelling := str(raw_word.get("word", "")).strip_edges()
				if spelling.is_empty():
					continue
				var entry := {
					"word": spelling,
					"meaning": str(raw_word.get("meaning", "")).strip_edges(),
					"meaning_fa": str(raw_word.get("meaning_fa", "")).strip_edges(),
					# Tagged here, once: the controller and the practice record
					# both need to know which lesson a word came from.
					"book": book_number,
					"lesson": lesson_number,
				}
				built_words.append(entry)
				var flat := entry.duplicate()
				_all_words.append(flat)
			if built_words.is_empty():
				continue
			book_words += built_words.size()
			built_lessons.append({
				"lesson": lesson_number,
				"title": str(raw_lesson.get("title", "Lesson %d" % lesson_number)),
				"title_fa": str(raw_lesson.get("title_fa", "")),
				"word_count": built_words.size(),
				"words": built_words,
			})
		if built_lessons.is_empty():
			continue
		_books.append({
			"book": book_number,
			"title": str(raw_book.get("title", "Vision %d" % book_number)),
			"grade_fa": str(raw_book.get("grade_fa", "")),
			"lesson_count": built_lessons.size(),
			"word_count": book_words,
			"lessons": built_lessons,
		})
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/scrambled/scrambled_theme.gd`

```gdscript
class_name ScrambledTheme
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  SCRAMBLED THEME — the visual language of «بازی املا».
##
##  The game screens are skipped by the app-wide theme walk (they are listed
##  in ThemeSceneStyler.SELF_THEMED_SCRIPTS) because a game board must not lose
##  its colours to a restyle pass. Everything theme-dependent therefore comes
##  from here: the page tint, the card surfaces and the text roles read the
##  palette through MenuStyle, while the game parts — the letter tiles, their
##  candy palette, the solved green, the amber near-miss — are fixed, so a
##  board looks the same in Dark and Light and a live theme toggle never
##  repaints a puzzle in progress.
##
##  Tiles draw themselves (see ScrambledTile), so nothing here is ever
##  applied to a Panel or a Label by the walk.
## ==============================================## The letter-tile palette, retuned to the app's design language: the blue
## action colour and the warm gold lead, supported by muted slate, moss, teal,
## coral and cream. A flat face with a darker extruded edge and a big letter.
const TILE_COLORS := [
	Color("#4C8DF6"),   # design blue
	Color("#D9B36C"),   # warm gold
	Color("#6E8BB0"),   # slate blue
	Color("#6FAE7C"),   # moss
	Color("#5FB8C4"),   # teal
	Color("#D97A6C"),   # coral
	Color("#A98BB8"),   # mauve
	Color("#E3D7BD"),   # cream
]

## The dark outline around every tile block, in both themes — part of the
## tile's identity, like its colours.
const TILE_OUTLINE := Color("#2A2D33")

## A solved tile turns green, and the near-miss nudge is amber.
const SOLVED_COLOR := Color("#5FBF7F")
const NUDGE_COLOR := Color("#E0B96B")

## The meaning card wears a printed look — warm cream paper, gold frame, dark
## ink — matching the design system's paper surface in both themes.
const CARD_BG := Color(0.929, 0.902, 0.839)
const CARD_BORDER := Color(0.851, 0.702, 0.424)
const CARD_INK := Color(0.212, 0.200, 0.173)
const CARD_INK_DIM := Color(0.373, 0.392, 0.463)
const CARD_ACCENT := Color(0.298, 0.553, 0.965)


static func tile_color(index: int) -> Color:
	if TILE_COLORS.is_empty():
		return DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["accent"]
	return TILE_COLORS[absi(index) % TILE_COLORS.size()]


static func tile_edge(body: Color) -> Color:
	return body.darkened(0.34)


## The colour of the extruded bottom edge of a tile: a deeper shade of its
## face, which is what makes the tile read as a chunky 3D block.
static func tile_side(body: Color) -> Color:
	return body.darkened(0.30)


## Letters are always white on the candy colours, like the classic games.
static func tile_letter(_body: Color) -> Color:
	return Color(1, 1, 1)


## The page behind the game. Matches the app's other screens so the animated
## backdrop keeps reading the same way.
static func page_tint() -> Color:
	return DesignTokens.color_of(false, "bg")


## A soft plate behind a tile row: barely there in both themes.
static func track_color() -> Color:
	return Color(DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["surface_sunken"], 0.70)


## The empty slot the carried tile would drop into.
static func ghost_color(pulse: float) -> Color:
	var base := DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["accent"]
	return Color(base.r, base.g, base.b, 0.10 + 0.16 * pulse)


static func ghost_border_color(pulse: float) -> Color:
	var base := DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["accent"]
	return Color(base.r, base.g, base.b, 0.55 + 0.40 * pulse)


## Rounded panel used by the game's chips and cards.
static func chip_style(fill: Color, radius: int = 22, border: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
		border_width: int = 0) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = fill
	style.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	if border_width > 0:
		style.set_border_width_all(border_width)
		style.border_color = border
	style.content_margin_left = 20
	style.content_margin_right = 20
	style.content_margin_top = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8
	return style


## Filled, chunky, candy-style button — the game's own button look rather than
## the menu's: a solid block, a darker extruded edge, and a soft drop shadow
## that deepens on hover.
static func candy_button_style(color: Color, hover: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var fill := color.lightened(0.10) if hover else color
	var style := chip_style(fill, 30, tile_edge(fill), 3)
	style.content_margin_left = 34
	style.content_margin_right = 34
	style.content_margin_top = 20
	style.content_margin_bottom = 20
	style.shadow_color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.18, 0.30 if hover else 0.22)
	style.shadow_size = 26 if hover else 18
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0.0, 12.0 if hover else 8.0)
	return style


## The printed meaning card: cream paper with a green frame.
static func hint_card_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = CARD_BG
	style.set_corner_radius_all(36)
	style.set_border_width_all(DesignTokens.BORDER_PROMINENT)
	style.border_color = CARD_BORDER
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	style.shadow_size = DesignTokens.SHADOW_DEEP_SIZE
	style.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 10)
	style.content_margin_left = 34
	style.content_margin_right = 34
	style.content_margin_top = 26
	style.content_margin_bottom = 26
	return style


## Timer bar fill for a solve time: green while the word is still worth the
## top band, then amber, orange and red as the bands fall away.
static func timer_color(seconds: float) -> Color:
	if seconds <= 10.0:
		return DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["success"]
	if seconds <= 30.0:
		return DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["success"].darkened(0.12)
	if seconds <= 50.0:
		return NUDGE_COLOR
	if seconds <= 60.0:
		return DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["warning"].darkened(0.10)
	return DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["error"]


static func timer_track_color() -> Color:
	return Color(DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT["surface_sunken"], 0.85)


# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  THE GAME'S THEME
#
#  Every look of «بازی املا» is declared ONCE here, as a theme TYPE VARIATION,
#  and the game's scenes simply name the variation they want with
#  `theme_type_variation`. No component calls add_theme_*_override for a static
#  look any more, which is what the project's UI rules ask for: one place owns
#  a colour, a font or a shape, and the dark/light switch becomes a single
#  theme swap instead of a walk over every node.
#
#  WHAT STAYS AN OVERRIDE, and why: the board's tile colours (solved green,
#  the amber nudge, the per-tile candy palette) and the Wordle-style keyboard
#  states carry MEANING — they say "this letter is right" rather than "this is
#  how the app looks" — so they are computed per tile at runtime. Those are the
#  only overrides the game has left.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## Variation names. A scene names one of these; the look behind it lives here.
## Held as constants so a typo is a compile error rather than a node that
## silently falls back to the plain app look.
const V_CHIP_PROGRESS := &"ScrambledChipProgress"
const V_CHIP_MODE := &"ScrambledChipMode"
const V_CHIP_WORTH := &"ScrambledChipWorth"
const V_CHIP_SCORE := &"ScrambledChipScore"
const V_TIMER_BAR := &"ScrambledTimerBar"
const V_INSTRUCTION := &"ScrambledInstruction"
const V_HINT_CARD := &"ScrambledHintCard"
const V_HINT_CAPTION := &"ScrambledHintCaption"
const V_HINT_MEANING := &"ScrambledHintMeaning"
const V_HINT_PERSIAN := &"ScrambledHintPersian"
const V_HINT_WORTH := &"ScrambledHintWorth"
const V_CANDY_BUTTON := &"ScrambledCandyButton"
const V_REVEAL_BUTTON := &"ScrambledRevealButton"
const V_DANGER_BUTTON := &"ScrambledDangerButton"
const V_DIALOG_CARD := &"ScrambledDialogCard"
const V_DIALOG_TITLE := &"ScrambledDialogTitle"
const V_DIALOG_BODY := &"ScrambledDialogBody"
## The dialog's safe answer. Its own variation rather than the app's Button,
## because the game's theme carries no base theme to inherit one from.
const V_SAFE_BUTTON := &"ScrambledSafeButton"
const V_PRAISE := &"ScrambledPraise"
const V_POINTS := &"ScrambledPoints"

## The accents each variation wears. Fixed per meaning, so a number keeps its
## colour identity as it changes.
const CHIP_MODE_ACCENT := Color("#C77DFF")
const CHIP_WORTH_ACCENT := Color("#FFB703")
const CHIP_SCORE_ACCENT := Color("#31C463")
const DANGER_ACCENT := Color("#FF6B6B")
const CANDY_RADIUS := 30
const CANDY_FONT_SIZE := 40
const REVEAL_FONT_SIZE := 30
const DIALOG_RADIUS := 34
const DIALOG_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE := 36
const TIMER_RADIUS := 12
const PRAISE_FONT_SIZE := 84
const POINTS_FONT_SIZE := 62


## Builds the game's Theme.
##
## WHY IT DOES NOT CHAIN ONTO THE APP'S BASE THEME: `Theme.base_theme` cannot be
## assigned from script in this engine build — the assignment is rejected, and a
## rejected one aborts the builder outright, leaving the screen with no theme at
## all. So instead of inheriting, the theme states the few app-wide defaults the
## game's plain controls rely on, read from the SAME design tokens the app theme
## is built from: one source of colours and type, two readers. Nothing below
## invents a font, a grey or a radius of its own.
static func build_theme() -> Theme:
	var theme := Theme.new()
	theme.default_font = MenuStyle.vazir()
	theme.default_font_size = DesignTokens.FONT_BODY
	# A control that wears no variation still has to read on this screen, so the
	# Label defaults are set here rather than left to the engine's white.
	theme.set_color("font_color", "Label", MenuStyle.text())
	theme.set_color("font_shadow_color", "Label", Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	theme.set_color("font_outline_color", "Label", Color(0, 0, 0, 0))
	theme.set_constant("outline_size", "Label", 0)

	# The four standing chips, one variation each so a scene only has to name
	# which number it is showing.
	_pill(theme, V_CHIP_PROGRESS, DesignTokens.ACCENT, 30)
	_pill(theme, V_CHIP_MODE, CHIP_MODE_ACCENT, 28)
	_pill(theme, V_CHIP_WORTH, CHIP_WORTH_ACCENT, 28)
	_pill(theme, V_CHIP_SCORE, CHIP_SCORE_ACCENT, 30)

	# The clock: shape here, colour per tick (the bar's colour is the clock's
	# own reading, not a look).
	theme.set_type_variation(V_TIMER_BAR, &"ProgressBar")
	theme.set_stylebox("background", V_TIMER_BAR, _bar_box(timer_track_color()))
	theme.set_stylebox("fill", V_TIMER_BAR, _bar_box(timer_color(0.0)))

	_label(theme, V_INSTRUCTION, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 36, MenuStyle.subtitle_color())

	# The printed meaning card: fixed paper colours on purpose, so it reads the
	# same in both themes like a card dealt onto the board.
	theme.set_type_variation(V_HINT_CARD, &"PanelContainer")
	theme.set_stylebox("panel", V_HINT_CARD, hint_card_style())
	_label(theme, V_HINT_CAPTION, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 32, CARD_ACCENT)
	_label(theme, V_HINT_MEANING, &"Label", MenuStyle.jakarta_bold(), 40, CARD_INK)
	_label(theme, V_HINT_PERSIAN, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 32, CARD_INK_DIM)
	_label(theme, V_HINT_WORTH, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 28, CARD_ACCENT)

	_candy_button(theme, V_CANDY_BUTTON, Color("#FFB703"), CANDY_FONT_SIZE)
	_candy_button(theme, V_REVEAL_BUTTON, DesignTokens.ACCENT_BRIGHT, REVEAL_FONT_SIZE)
	_candy_button(theme, V_DANGER_BUTTON, DANGER_ACCENT, DIALOG_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE)

	theme.set_type_variation(V_DIALOG_CARD, &"PanelContainer")
	theme.set_stylebox("panel", V_DIALOG_CARD, MenuStyle.card_style(MenuStyle.accent(), DIALOG_RADIUS, true))
	_label(theme, V_DIALOG_TITLE, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 46, MenuStyle.text())
	_label(theme, V_DIALOG_BODY, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), 32, MenuStyle.subtitle_color())
	# Staying is the safe answer, so it wears the app accent; leaving wears the
	# one danger colour the dialog owns. Both are the game's candy button, so
	# the pair reads as one choice rather than two design languages.
	_candy_button(theme, V_SAFE_BUTTON, MenuStyle.accent(), DIALOG_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE)

	# Win feedback. Both colours carry meaning — the praise green is the solved
	# colour, the points amber the "worth" colour — so neither follows the theme.
	_label(theme, V_PRAISE, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), PRAISE_FONT_SIZE, SOLVED_COLOR, 10)
	_label(theme, V_POINTS, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), POINTS_FONT_SIZE, NUDGE_COLOR)

	return theme


## A pill chip: translucent accent fill, high-contrast text, fully rounded.
static func _pill(theme: Theme, variation: StringName, accent: Color, font_size: int) -> void:
	_label(theme, variation, &"Label", MenuStyle.vazir(), font_size, MenuStyle.pill_text(accent),
		0, MenuStyle.icon_chip(accent, 20))


## A filled, chunky candy button: the game's own button look rather than the
## menu's. The ink comes from the fill's luminance so a light block gets dark
## text and a saturated one gets white.
static func _candy_button(theme: Theme, variation: StringName, accent: Color,
		font_size: int) -> void:
	theme.set_type_variation(variation, &"Button")
	theme.set_font("font", variation, MenuStyle.vazir())
	theme.set_font_size("font_size", variation, font_size)
	var ink := MenuStyle.on_accent(accent)
	for slot in ["font_color", "font_hover_color", "font_pressed_color", "font_focus_color"]:
		theme.set_color(slot, variation, ink)
	# The same ink on hover and press: a label that flips colour mid-gesture
	# reads as a glitch, not as feedback.
	theme.set_stylebox("normal", variation, candy_button_style(accent, false))
	theme.set_stylebox("focus", variation, candy_button_style(accent, false))
	theme.set_stylebox("hover", variation, candy_button_style(accent, true))
	theme.set_stylebox("pressed", variation, candy_button_style(accent, true))
	theme.set_stylebox("disabled", variation, candy_button_style(accent.darkened(0.35), false))


static func _label(theme: Theme, variation: StringName, base_type: StringName, font: Font,
		font_size: int, color: Color, outline: int = 0, box: StyleBox = null) -> void:
	theme.set_type_variation(variation, base_type)
	theme.set_font("font", variation, font)
	theme.set_font_size("font_size", variation, font_size)
	theme.set_color("font_color", variation, color)
	theme.set_constant("outline_size", variation, outline)
	if box != null:
		theme.set_stylebox("normal", variation, box)


static func _bar_box(color: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(TIMER_RADIUS)
	style.bg_color = color
	return style
```
