## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_daily.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleDaily
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE DAILY — deterministic daily word engine.
##
##  TIMEZONE STRATEGY:
##  The daily cycle runs on UTC calendar days (midnight-to-midnight UTC).
##  A fixed reference timezone is deliberately chosen over the device's
##  local timezone so every user, on every device, gets the same daily
##  word on the same day.
##
##  SELECTION ALGORITHM (fully deterministic, no local state needed):
##    1. day_index = floor(unix_time_utc / 86400)  — changes exactly at
##       UTC midnight, one increment per calendar day.
##    2. The eligible word pool is sorted, then shuffled ONCE with a
##       FIXED seed (not randomize()). The shuffled sequence is identical
##       on every device and every session.
##    3. daily_word = shuffled_sequence[day_index % pool_size].
##
##  Consequences:
##    * The same date always yields the same word (derivable from the
##      date + master list alone — nothing is stored as source of truth).
##    * Consecutive days yield consecutive entries of the shuffled
##      sequence — no word repeats until the entire pool is exhausted.
##    * After exhaustion, the next cycle replays the same fixed order.
##
##  SERVER HOOK (anti-cheat, future):
##  All time reads go through `now_utc_unix()`. When a server becomes
##  available, replace its body with a trusted HTTP time response
##  (e.g. API.get("/time").server_unix) and fall back to the device
##  clock while offline. Nothing else in the engine needs to change.
## ============================================================

const SHUFFLE_SEED := 2917334520  # fixed — never call randomize() here
const SECONDS_PER_DAY := 86400

static var _sequence_cache: Array[String] = []


## Trusted "now" as a UTC unix timestamp in seconds.
## REPLACE THE BODY with a server time fetch to harden against clock
## tampering (see class docs). The fallback keeps the game offline-safe.
static func now_utc_unix() -> int:
	return int(Time.get_unix_time_from_system())


## Days since the Unix epoch, in UTC. The daily puzzle identifier.
static func day_index() -> int:
	@warning_ignore("integer_division")
	return now_utc_unix() / SECONDS_PER_DAY


## Human-readable puzzle id, e.g. "wordle-2026-09-15" (UTC date).
static func puzzle_id() -> String:
	var days := day_index()
	var dt := Time.get_datetime_dict_from_unix_time(days * SECONDS_PER_DAY)
	return "wordle-%04d-%02d-%02d" % [dt.year, dt.month, dt.day]


## The answer for the current UTC day. Deterministic and reproducible.
static func get_daily_word() -> String:
	var sequence := _shuffled_sequence()
	if sequence.is_empty():
		push_error("WordleDaily: word pool is empty")
		return ""
	return sequence[day_index() % sequence.size()]


## Seconds left until the daily cycle rolls over (next UTC midnight), i.e.
## until a brand-new word is in play. Always in 1..SECONDS_PER_DAY.
static func seconds_until_next_word() -> int:
	return (day_index() + 1) * SECONDS_PER_DAY - now_utc_unix()


## Human countdown to the next word, e.g. "۳ ساعت و ۱۲ دقیقه".
## Digits are converted to Persian numerals here so every call-site reads
## the same; pass the result through MenuStyle.persian_digits() if that
## ever changes.
static func format_until_next_word() -> String:
	var seconds := seconds_until_next_word()
	var minutes: int = int(seconds / 60.0)
	var hours: int = int(minutes / 60.0)
	minutes = minutes % 60
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	if hours > 0:
		parts.append("%d ساعت" % hours)
	if minutes > 0:
		parts.append("%d دقیقه" % minutes)
	if parts.is_empty():
		parts.append("کمتر از یک دقیقه")
	return MenuStyle.persian_digits(" و ".join(parts))


## The whole pool in its fixed shuffled order (cached per session).
## The shuffle is seeded deterministically, so every device produces
## the exact same sequence from the same sorted pool.
static func _shuffled_sequence() -> Array[String]:
	if not _sequence_cache.is_empty():
		return _sequence_cache
	# Answers come from the entry-word pool: the full pool also holds derived
	# forms (e.g. "quitted") that are fair guesses but poor daily puzzles.
	var sequence := WordleVocab.get_answer_pool().duplicate()
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = SHUFFLE_SEED
	# Fisher–Yates shuffle (deterministic for the fixed seed).
	for i in range(sequence.size() - 1, 0, -1):
		var j := rng.randi_range(0, i)
		var tmp: String = sequence[i]
		sequence[i] = sequence[j]
		sequence[j] = tmp
	_sequence_cache = sequence
	return _sequence_cache
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_evaluator.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleEvaluator
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE EVALUATOR — guess vs. answer letter evaluation.
##
##  Score codes (per position):
##    Score.ABSENT  — letter not in the answer (gray)
##    Score.PRESENT — letter in the answer, wrong position (yellow)
##    Score.CORRECT — letter in the right position (green)
##
##  Repeated letters are handled exactly like original Wordle's
##  two-pass algorithm:
##    Pass 1 — every position where guess[i] == answer[i] is CORRECT,
##             and that answer letter is "consumed".
##    Pass 2 — remaining positions can only be PRESENT if an unconsumed
##             answer letter matches; each match consumes one.
##  E.g. answer LEVER, guess LEVEL ->
##    L  E  V  E  L
##    G  G  G  G  .  (first four exact; the trailing L is absent because
##                     the answer's single L was not left over)
## ============================================================

enum Score { ABSENT, PRESENT, CORRECT }


## Evaluates `guess` against `answer` (case-insensitive) and returns one
## Score per position of `guess`.
##
## A length mismatch is a caller bug — WordleGame only ever submits rows of
## the answer's length. Rather than indexing past the end of `answer` (which
## would crash the game screen mid-animation) the whole guess is reported
## ABSENT, i.e. "nothing matched".
static func evaluate(answer: String, guess: String) -> Array[int]:
	var answer_u := answer.to_upper()
	var guess_u := guess.to_upper()
	var length := guess_u.length()
	var result: Array[int] = []
	result.resize(length)
	if length == 0 or answer_u.length() != length:
		result.fill(Score.ABSENT)
		return result

	var remaining := {}  # unconsumed answer letters -> count

	# Pass 1: exact matches (green), consume the answer letter.
	for i in length:
		if guess_u[i] == answer_u[i]:
			result[i] = Score.CORRECT
		else:
			result[i] = Score.ABSENT
			var letter := answer_u[i]
			remaining[letter] = int(remaining.get(letter, 0)) + 1

	# Pass 2: misplaced matches (yellow), limited by remaining counts.
	for i in length:
		if result[i] == Score.CORRECT:
			continue
		var letter := guess_u[i]
		var left: int = int(remaining.get(letter, 0))
		if left > 0:
			result[i] = Score.PRESENT
			remaining[letter] = left - 1

	return result


## True when every position is CORRECT.
## An empty evaluation is NOT a win: nothing was guessed, so nothing was
## solved. (Without this guard a zero-length evaluation — which a stale or
## corrupt save could produce — counted as a solved puzzle.)
static func is_win(evaluation: Array) -> bool:
	if evaluation.is_empty():
		return false
	for code in evaluation:
		if code != Score.CORRECT:
			return false
	return true
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_game.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleGame
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE GAME — game state machine + local persistence.
##
##  Pure logic: owns the answer, the guesses, the in-progress row and
##  the overall state (PLAYING / WON / LOST). Validation is delegated to
##  WordleVocab; evaluation to WordleEvaluator. Persistence goes to
##  user://wordle_save.json (same user:// JSON pattern as the rest of
##  the app) so progress survives closing the app mid-puzzle.
##
##  SAVE POLICY — only inputs are stored:
##  the file holds the puzzle id and the words the player typed. The answer
##  comes from the daily engine and every colour is a pure function of
##  (answer, guess), so both are recomputed on load. A stale or half-written
##  file therefore degrades into "less progress" — never into a wrong board,
##  and never into a save that only an older build can read.
## ============================================================

enum State { PLAYING, WON, LOST }

const MAX_GUESSES := 6
const SAVE_PATH := "user://wordle_save.json"

var puzzle_id: String = ""
var answer: String = ""
var guesses: Array[String] = []
## Derived: one Array[int] of WordleEvaluator scores per guess. Never loaded
## from disk — recomputed from (answer, guess) by _rebuild_evaluations().
var evaluations: Array = []
var current_row: String = ""
var state: State = State.PLAYING


func _init(p_answer: String, p_puzzle_id: String) -> void:
	answer = p_answer.to_upper()
	puzzle_id = p_puzzle_id
	# Validate: the answer must be a playable word. This catches
	# configuration errors early (e.g. empty pool, wrong word length).
	if answer.is_empty() or not is_valid_guess(answer):
		push_warning("WordleGame: answer '%s' is not a valid playable word" % answer)


func get_state() -> State:
	return state


func is_finished() -> bool:
	return state != State.PLAYING


func attempts_used() -> int:
	return guesses.size()


func remaining_attempts() -> int:
	return MAX_GUESSES - guesses.size()


## The word currently being typed on the board.
func get_current_row() -> String:
	return current_row


## True when `word` has the same number of letters as the answer.
## Guesses need not be dictionary words, so learners can try any letter
## combination and still receive positional feedback.
func is_valid_guess(word: String) -> bool:
	return word.length() == answer.length()


## Appends a letter to the current row (if room and still playing).
func add_letter(letter: String) -> bool:
	if is_finished() or current_row.length() >= answer.length():
		return false
	current_row += letter.to_upper()
	return true


## Removes the last letter of the current row.
func remove_letter() -> bool:
	if is_finished() or current_row.is_empty():
		return false
	current_row = current_row.substr(0, current_row.length() - 1)
	return true


## Submits the current row.
## Returns a result Dictionary:
##   { ok: bool, reason: "length" | "not_a_word" }  on rejection
##   { ok: true, evaluation: Array[int], won: bool }
## Rejected guesses do NOT consume an attempt.
func submit_current_row() -> Dictionary:
	if is_finished() or current_row.length() != answer.length():
		return { "ok": false, "reason": "length" }
	if not is_valid_guess(current_row):
		return { "ok": false, "reason": "not_a_word" }

	var guess := current_row
	var evaluation := WordleEvaluator.evaluate(answer, guess)
	guesses.append(guess)
	evaluations.append(evaluation)
	current_row = ""

	var won := WordleEvaluator.is_win(evaluation)
	if won:
		state = State.WON
	elif guesses.size() >= MAX_GUESSES:
		state = State.LOST

	save()
	return { "ok": true, "evaluation": evaluation, "won": won }


## Best score earned for every letter the player has already tried, used to
## colour the on-screen keyboard. A key is never downgraded:
## CORRECT > PRESENT > ABSENT. Letters never typed are absent from the
## dictionary, so the caller can fall back to a neutral style for them.
func get_keyboard_states() -> Dictionary:
	var best: Dictionary = {}
	for row_index in guesses.size():
		if row_index >= evaluations.size():
			break
		var evaluation: Array = evaluations[row_index]
		var word: String = guesses[row_index]
		for i in mini(word.length(), evaluation.size()):
			var letter := word[i]
			var score: int = int(evaluation[i])
			if score > int(best.get(letter, -1)):
				best[letter] = score
	return best


## ------------------------------------------------------------
##  PERSISTENCE
## ------------------------------------------------------------
func save() -> void:
	var payload := {
		"puzzle_id": puzzle_id,
		"guesses": guesses,
		"state": int(state),  # written for readability, never trusted
	}
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_warning("WordleGame: cannot write %s (%s)"
			% [SAVE_PATH, error_string(FileAccess.get_open_error())])
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(payload))
	file.close()


## Parsed save file, or {} when it is missing or unreadable.
static func read_save() -> Dictionary:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH):
		return {}
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return {}
	var text := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK or not (json.data is Dictionary):
		push_warning("WordleGame: ignoring an unreadable %s" % SAVE_PATH)
		return {}
	return json.data


## Restores the progress of the puzzle `p_puzzle_id` for `p_answer`.
## Returns null when there is nothing to restore: no file, an unreadable
## file, or — the usual case — a file written for another day's puzzle,
## which is ignored so today always starts clean.
static func load_for_puzzle(p_answer: String, p_puzzle_id: String) -> WordleGame:
	var data := read_save()
	if data.is_empty() or str(data.get("puzzle_id", "")) != p_puzzle_id:
		return null

	var game := WordleGame.new(p_answer, p_puzzle_id)
	var stored_guesses = data.get("guesses", [])
	if stored_guesses is Array:
		for value in stored_guesses:
			if game.guesses.size() >= MAX_GUESSES:
				break  # never restore more rows than the board has
			if value is String and not str(value).is_empty():
				game.guesses.append(str(value).to_upper())
	game._rebuild_evaluations()
	game._recompute_state()
	return game


## Removes a save that belongs to another day, so user:// never keeps a
## puzzle nobody can finish. Returns true when a file was deleted.
static func discard_stale_save(p_puzzle_id: String) -> bool:
	var data := read_save()
	if data.is_empty() or str(data.get("puzzle_id", "")) == p_puzzle_id:
		return false
	var error := DirAccess.remove_absolute(SAVE_PATH)
	if error != OK:
		push_warning("WordleGame: cannot delete the stale save (%s)" % error_string(error))
		return false
	return true


## Convenience: returns today's game — restored from disk when a save
## for today's puzzle exists, otherwise a fresh one (not yet saved).
static func load_or_create_today() -> WordleGame:
	var daily_answer := WordleDaily.get_daily_word()
	if daily_answer.is_empty():
		push_error("WordleGame: no daily word — the vocabulary pool is empty")
		return null
	var id := WordleDaily.puzzle_id()
	var restored := load_for_puzzle(daily_answer, id)
	if restored != null:
		return restored
	discard_stale_save(id)  # yesterday's board has no future
	return WordleGame.new(daily_answer, id)


## Recomputes every row's colours from the answer. Stored colours are never
## trusted: they are derived data, and JSON numbers come back as floats.
func _rebuild_evaluations() -> void:
	evaluations.clear()
	for guess in guesses:
		evaluations.append(WordleEvaluator.evaluate(answer, guess))


## Derives WON / LOST / PLAYING from the guesses that are on the board, so a
## restored game can never disagree with what the player sees.
func _recompute_state() -> void:
	state = State.PLAYING
	for evaluation in evaluations:
		if WordleEvaluator.is_win(evaluation):
			state = State.WON
			return
	if guesses.size() >= MAX_GUESSES:
		state = State.LOST
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_screen.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE SCREEN — the daily puzzle of «کلمه روز» (وردل).
##
##  This scene is the GAME CONTENT: board, keyboard, message line and the
##  two overlays (end-of-game vocabulary card, how-to-play). WordOfDay.tscn
##  instances it and owns the header bar and the back navigation — that is
##  why the کلمه روز hub button opens this game directly and why there is
##  no second Wordle entry point anywhere in the app.
##
##  What this script owns:
##    * the dynamic UI (board rows sized to the answer, QWERTY keys),
##    * the game loop (typing, submitting, revealing, feedback),
##    * persistence (through WordleGame) and the record on the end card.
##  Board state is drawn by WordleTile, which is immune to the app-wide
##  theme walk; panels, labels and buttons are left to that walk and are
##  only re-coloured here where meaning demands it.
## ============================================================

const TILE_SCENE := preload("res://scenes/word_game/wordle/WordleTile.tscn")

# QWERTY keyboard rows (data, not layout — the scene owns the containers).
const KEY_ROWS := [
	["Q", "W", "E", "R", "T", "Y", "U", "I", "O", "P"],
	["A", "S", "D", "F", "G", "H", "J", "K", "L"],
	["ENTER", "Z", "X", "C", "V", "B", "N", "M", "BACK"],
]
const KEY_SUBMIT := "ENTER"
const KEY_ERASE := "BACK"
## Labelled in Persian on purpose: "⏎" and "⌫" are not in the app font and
## rendered as empty boxes.
const KEY_SUBMIT_LABEL := "تأیید"
const KEY_ERASE_LABEL := "پاک"
@export_group("Keyboard")
@export var key_min_size: Vector2 = Vector2(88, 104)
@export var key_font_size: int = 46
@export var key_action_font_size: int = 34
@export var key_gap: int = 8
@export var key_corner_radius: int = 14

@export_group("Board")
## Board geometry. The tile size is measured from the box the scene layout
## actually gives the board, so a 5- and a 10-letter answer both fit.
@export var tile_gap: float = 12.0
@export var tile_max_size: float = 150.0
@export var tile_min_size: float = 44.0

@export_group("Pacing")
@export var reveal_step: float = 0.16
## Beat between the last flip and the vocabulary card, so the player gets to
## look at the row that just finished.
@export var end_panel_delay: float = 1.15
@export var message_flash_time: float = 2.6

const MESSAGE_NOT_A_WORD := "این کلمه در فهرست واژگان بازی نیست"
const MESSAGE_TOO_SHORT := "تعداد حروف کافی نیست"
const MESSAGE_WIN := "آفرین! درست بود"
const MESSAGE_LOSE := "پایان بازی — کلمه‌ی درست:"
const MESSAGE_LOAD_ERROR := "خطا در بارگذاری واژگان بازی"

@export_group("Vocabulary card")
## The end-of-game card wears its own look — a warm cream paper card with a
## thick green frame and centred dark ink — instead of the plain themed panel.
## Colours are fixed on purpose (not from the palette) so the card reads the
## same in both themes, like a printed card. They are exported so the card can
## be restyled from the Inspector without touching this script.
@export var card_bg: Color = Color(0.984, 0.953, 0.898)          # warm cream
@export var card_border: Color = Color(0.345, 0.780, 0.525)      # felt-tip green
@export var card_ink: Color = Color(0.208, 0.216, 0.290)         # dark blue-grey text
@export var card_ink_dim: Color = Color(0.373, 0.392, 0.463)     # muted captions
@export var card_accent: Color = Color(0.180, 0.639, 0.404)      # green emphasis
@export var card_radius: float = 44.0
@export var card_border_width: int = 6

## Which palette role a message line is painted with, so it stays legible in
## both themes.
enum MessageKind { INFO, ERROR, SUCCESS }

## Raised whenever the host's «کارت واژه» header button should be offered or
## hidden. The header belongs to the HOST scene (WordOfDay.tscn), so this
## content scene reports its own state upward instead of reaching into a
## sibling node's internals — see AGENTS "signal up, call down".
signal card_available_changed(available: bool)

@onready var board_container: VBoxContainer = $GameArea/BoardContainer
@onready var status_label: Label = $GameArea/StatusRow/StatusLabel
@onready var message_label: Label = $GameArea/MessageLabel
@onready var keyboard_container: VBoxContainer = $Keyboard
@onready var end_panel: PanelContainer = $EndPanel
@onready var end_scroll: ScrollContainer = $EndPanel/EndScroll
@onready var end_headline: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/Headline
@onready var end_word: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/WordLabel
@onready var end_phonetics: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/PhoneticsLabel
@onready var end_source: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/SourceLabel
@onready var end_audio_button: Button = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/AudioButton
@onready var end_meaning_fa: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/MeaningFaLabel
@onready var end_meaning_en: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/MeaningEnLabel
@onready var end_example: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/ExampleLabel
@onready var end_synonyms: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/SynonymsLabel
@onready var end_antonyms: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/AntonymsLabel
@onready var end_stats: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/StatsLabel
@onready var end_next_word: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/NextWordLabel
@onready var end_card_number: Label = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/CardNumber
@onready var end_close_button: Button = $EndPanel/EndScroll/EndBox/CloseButton
@onready var help_panel: PanelContainer = $HelpPanel
@onready var help_title: Label = $HelpPanel/HelpBox/HelpTitle
@onready var help_body: Label = $HelpPanel/HelpBox/HelpBody
@onready var help_close_button: Button = $HelpPanel/HelpBox/HelpCloseButton

var game: WordleGame = null
var _rows: Array = []                    # Array[Array[WordleTile]]
var _row_nodes: Array[HBoxContainer] = []
var _key_buttons: Dictionary = {}        # letter -> Button
var _input_locked := false               # a row is revealing
var _board_ready := false
## A MessageKind, kept as an int so _set_message() can take a plain int
## parameter without an enum cast at every call site.
var _message_kind: int = MessageKind.INFO
## Bumped whenever the message line changes, so a pending auto-clear can see
## that something newer replaced it.
var _message_token := 0
var _end_audio_filename := ""


func _ready() -> void:
	# The host header buttons trigger these overlays.
	end_panel.visible = false
	help_panel.visible = false
	end_audio_button.visible = false
	end_close_button.pressed.connect(close_panels)
	help_close_button.pressed.connect(close_panels)
	end_audio_button.pressed.connect(_on_audio_button_pressed)

	# The app-wide theme walk runs on scene load, not on a live toggle, so
	# anything colour-coded has to look after itself here.
	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)

	game = WordleGame.load_or_create_today()
	if game == null or game.answer.is_empty():
		status_label.text = ""
		_set_message(MESSAGE_LOAD_ERROR, MessageKind.ERROR)
		return

	await _build_game_ui()


## Builds the board and the keyboard once the host layout has run, so the
## tiles can be measured against the space they really get.
func _build_game_ui() -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_build_board()
	_build_keyboard()
	_restore_saved_progress()
	_refresh_status()
	if not board_container.resized.is_connected(_refit_tiles):
		board_container.resized.connect(_refit_tiles)


############################################################
# BOARD
############################################################
func _build_board() -> void:
	var columns := game.answer.length()
	var cell := _measure_cell(board_container.size)
	for row_index in WordleGame.MAX_GUESSES:
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.name = "Row%d" % row_index
		row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(tile_gap))
		var tiles: Array = []
		for column in columns:
			var tile: WordleTile = TILE_SCENE.instantiate()
			tile.name = "Tile%d_%d" % [row_index, column]
			tile.set_tile_size(cell)
			row.add_child(tile)
			tiles.append(tile)
		board_container.add_child(row)
		_row_nodes.append(row)
		_rows.append(tiles)
	board_container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", int(tile_gap))
	_board_ready = true


## The largest square cell that fits `columns` columns of MAX_GUESSES rows
## into `box` — capped so a 5-letter board doesn't balloon on a wide screen,
## floored so a long answer stays readable.
func _measure_cell(box: Vector2) -> float:
	if box.x <= 1.0 or box.y <= 1.0:
		# Layout has not settled. The build waits a frame so this should not
		# happen; the fallback keeps a first frame from producing absurd cells.
		box = Vector2(get_viewport_rect().size.x - 80.0, 800.0)
	var columns := maxi(game.answer.length(), 1)
	var rows := WordleGame.MAX_GUESSES
	var by_width := (box.x - tile_gap * float(columns - 1)) / float(columns)
	var by_height := (box.y - tile_gap * float(rows - 1)) / float(rows)
	return clampf(floorf(minf(minf(by_width, by_height), tile_max_size)),
		tile_min_size, tile_max_size)


## Keeps the board proportional when the window or the orientation changes.
func _refit_tiles() -> void:
	if not _board_ready:
		return
	var cell := _measure_cell(board_container.size)
	for tiles in _rows:
		for tile: WordleTile in tiles:
			tile.set_tile_size(cell)


func _row_tiles(row_index: int) -> Array:
	if row_index < 0 or row_index >= _rows.size():
		return []
	return _rows[row_index]


## Paints the word currently being typed into row `row_index`.
func _set_row_letters(row_index: int, word: String) -> void:
	var tiles := _row_tiles(row_index)
	for i in tiles.size():
		tiles[i].set_letter(word[i] if i < word.length() else "")


## Rejection shake. The tween runs on the row container (visual only), so the
## board's layout never actually moves — and an empty/absent row is a no-op
## instead of the out-of-range crash the old static helper could hit.
func _shake_row(row_index: int) -> void:
	if row_index < 0 or row_index >= _row_nodes.size():
		return
	var row := _row_nodes[row_index]
	var origin := row.position.x
	var tw := row.create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(row, "position:x", origin - 16.0, 0.05)
	tw.tween_property(row, "position:x", origin + 16.0, 0.09)
	tw.tween_property(row, "position:x", origin - 9.0, 0.07)
	tw.tween_property(row, "position:x", origin, 0.05)


############################################################
# KEYBOARD
############################################################
func _build_keyboard() -> void:
	for row_letters in KEY_ROWS:
		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
		row.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", key_gap)
		for key in row_letters:
			var button := _make_key_button(key)
			row.add_child(button)
			if key != KEY_SUBMIT and key != KEY_ERASE:
				_key_buttons[key] = button
		keyboard_container.add_child(row)
	_apply_keyboard_colors()


func _make_key_button(key: String) -> Button:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.name = "Key%s" % key
	button.custom_minimum_size = key_min_size
	button.pressed.connect(_on_key_pressed.bind(key))
	if key == KEY_SUBMIT or key == KEY_ERASE:
		button.text = KEY_SUBMIT_LABEL if key == KEY_SUBMIT else KEY_ERASE_LABEL
		button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", key_action_font_size)
		button.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	else:
		button.text = key
		button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", key_font_size)
	MenuStyle.wire_microinteractions(button)
	return button


## Paints every key: untried letters keep the neutral app button look, tried
## ones wear the best Wordle colour they earned (never downgraded). Re-run
## after a restore and after a theme change.
func _apply_keyboard_colors() -> void:
	var states: Dictionary = game.get_keyboard_states() if game != null else {}
	for letter in _key_buttons:
		var button: Button = _key_buttons[letter]
		var score: int = int(states.get(letter, -1))
		var style := _key_style(score)
		for slot in ["normal", "hover", "pressed", "focus"]:
			button.add_theme_stylebox_override(slot, style)
		var font: Color = WordleTile.COLOR_LETTER_REVEALED
		if score < 0:
			font = Global.get_theme_color("text")
		for slot in ["font_color", "font_hover_color", "font_pressed_color", "font_focus_color"]:
			button.add_theme_color_override(slot, font)


## `score` < 0 means "never tried": the key keeps the theme's own surface
## instead of a Wordle colour.
func _key_style(score: int) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(key_corner_radius)
	style.bg_color = _key_color(score)
	if score < 0:
		style.set_border_width_all(1)
		style.border_color = Global.get_theme_color("border")
	return style


func _key_color(score: int) -> Color:
	match score:
		WordleEvaluator.Score.CORRECT: return WordleTile.COLOR_CORRECT
		WordleEvaluator.Score.PRESENT: return WordleTile.COLOR_PRESENT
		WordleEvaluator.Score.ABSENT: return WordleTile.COLOR_ABSENT
		_: return Global.get_theme_color("surface_alt")


func _on_key_pressed(key: String) -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	if _input_locked or game == null or game.is_finished() or has_open_panel():
		return
	match key:
		KEY_SUBMIT:
			_submit_row()
		KEY_ERASE:
			if game.remove_letter():
				_set_row_letters(game.attempts_used(), game.get_current_row())
		_:
			if game.add_letter(key):
				_set_row_letters(game.attempts_used(), game.get_current_row())


## Physical keyboard support (desktop testing, hardware keyboards).
func _unhandled_key_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	var key := event as InputEventKey
	if key == null or not key.pressed or key.echo:
		return
	if key.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
		close_panels()
		return
	if has_open_panel():
		# A card is up: the board must not eat keystrokes aimed at it.
		return
	var keycode := key.keycode as int
	# KEY_ENTER / KEY_BACKSPACE here are Godot's key enums; KEY_SUBMIT and
	# KEY_ERASE are the on-screen key ids (deliberately not named KEY_ENTER /
	# KEY_BACK, which would shadow those enums and break this branch).
	if keycode == KEY_ENTER or keycode == KEY_KP_ENTER:
		_on_key_pressed(KEY_SUBMIT)
	elif keycode == KEY_BACKSPACE:
		_on_key_pressed(KEY_ERASE)
	elif keycode >= KEY_A and keycode <= KEY_Z:
		_on_key_pressed(char(65 + keycode - KEY_A))


############################################################
# SUBMIT / REVEAL
############################################################
func _submit_row() -> void:
	if game.get_current_row().length() != game.answer.length():
		_flash_message(MESSAGE_TOO_SHORT, MessageKind.ERROR)
		_shake_row(game.attempts_used())
		Sfx.wrong()
		return
	var result := game.submit_current_row()
	if not result.ok:
		# A rejected word never consumes an attempt (WordleGame guarantees
		# it) — say so, shake the row and leave the letters where they are.
		_flash_message(MESSAGE_NOT_A_WORD, MessageKind.ERROR)
		_shake_row(game.attempts_used())
		Sfx.wrong()
		return

	_set_message("", MessageKind.INFO)
	_reveal_row(result)


## Flips the row that was just submitted, then reacts to the outcome.
func _reveal_row(result: Dictionary) -> void:
	_input_locked = true
	var row_index := game.attempts_used() - 1
	var tiles := _row_tiles(row_index)
	for i in tiles.size():
		tiles[i].reveal(int(result.evaluation[i]), reveal_step * float(i))

	# Wait for the last flip of the row to land.
	var wait := reveal_step * float(tiles.size()) + WordleTile.FLIP_HALF_TIME * 2.0 + 0.08
	await get_tree().create_timer(wait).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	_apply_keyboard_colors()
	_input_locked = false
	_refresh_status()

	var won: bool = result.won
	if won:
		_set_message(MESSAGE_WIN, MessageKind.SUCCESS)
		_bounce_win_row(row_index)
		Sfx.correct()
	else:
		Sfx.wrong()
		if game.is_finished():
			_set_message("%s %s" % [MESSAGE_LOSE, game.answer], MessageKind.ERROR)

	if not game.is_finished():
		return

	# The record is written exactly once per day, and only here: never per
	# guess (which filed a mid-game guess as a loss and then blocked the real
	# result, since recording is idempotent per puzzle) and never on restore.
	WordleStats.record_result(won, game.attempts_used(), game.puzzle_id)

	# Let the player look at the finished row before the card covers it.
	await get_tree().create_timer(end_panel_delay).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_show_end_panel(game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON)


func _bounce_win_row(row_index: int) -> void:
	var tiles := _row_tiles(row_index)
	for i in tiles.size():
		tiles[i].play_win_bounce(0.1 * float(i))


############################################################
# FEEDBACK — message line, status line, card button
############################################################
## The only writer of the message line. Bumping the token invalidates any
## pending auto-clear, so a flash can never wipe a newer message.
func _set_message(text: String, kind: int) -> void:
	_message_kind = kind
	_message_token += 1
	message_label.text = text
	var color := Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
	match kind:
		MessageKind.ERROR: color = Global.get_theme_color("error")
		MessageKind.SUCCESS: color = Global.get_theme_color("success")
	message_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)


## Shows a message that clears itself after `seconds`.
func _flash_message(text: String, kind: int, seconds: float = message_flash_time) -> void:
	_set_message(text, kind)
	var token := _message_token
	await get_tree().create_timer(seconds).timeout
	if not is_inside_tree() or token != _message_token:
		return
	_set_message("", MessageKind.INFO)


## "تلاش‌ها: ۳ از ۶" — the player always knows where they stand.
func _refresh_status() -> void:
	if game == null:
		return
	status_label.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits(
		"تلاش‌ها: %d از %d\nکلمه‌ی بعدی در %s" % [
			game.attempts_used(), WordleGame.MAX_GUESSES,
			WordleDaily.format_until_next_word(),
		])
	status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("text_dim"))
	_notify_card_available()


## The vocabulary card can be dismissed, so a finished board offers a way
## back to it — otherwise the day's word would be lost for good. The host owns
## the header button, so this screen only reports whether it should be shown.
func _notify_card_available() -> void:
	card_available_changed.emit(game != null and game.is_finished() and not end_panel.visible)


## Re-opens the end-of-game vocabulary card. Called by the host (WordOfDay)
## when its header button is pressed — the same public API as show_help().
func show_card() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	if game != null and game.is_finished():
		_show_end_panel(game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON)


############################################################
# RESTORE
############################################################
## Replays the saved guesses instantly (no reveal animation), so a player who
## closed the app mid-puzzle comes back to the exact board they left.
func _restore_saved_progress() -> void:
	for row_index in game.guesses.size():
		var tiles := _row_tiles(row_index)
		if tiles.is_empty():
			break
		var word: String = game.guesses[row_index]
		var evaluation: Array = game.evaluations[row_index]
		for i in tiles.size():
			tiles[i].set_letter(word[i] if i < word.length() else "")
			if i < evaluation.size():
				tiles[i].set_revealed(int(evaluation[i]))
	_apply_keyboard_colors()

	if game.is_finished():
		if game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON:
			_set_message(MESSAGE_WIN, MessageKind.SUCCESS)
		else:
			_set_message("%s %s" % [MESSAGE_LOSE, game.answer], MessageKind.ERROR)
		_show_end_panel(game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON, true)


############################################################
# VOCABULARY CARD
############################################################
## The answer's dictionary entry. `won` only changes the headline — the word
## is shown either way, because this is a learning app and the day's answer
## is worth reading even when it beat you.
## `instant` skips the fade (an already finished day needs no animation).
func _show_end_panel(won: bool, instant: bool = false) -> void:
	_apply_panel_theme()
	end_headline.text = MESSAGE_WIN if won else MESSAGE_LOSE
	end_headline.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
		Global.get_theme_color("success" if won else "warning"))

	# A word can reach the pool through another entry's synonym list; in that
	# case show that entry — and say so — instead of a card full of dashes.
	var info := WordleVocab.get_word_info(game.answer)
	var meta: Dictionary = info.meta
	end_word.text = game.answer
	end_phonetics.text = _meta_text(meta, "phonetics", "")
	end_phonetics.visible = not end_phonetics.text.is_empty()
	end_source.text = ""
	if not bool(info.exact) and not str(info.source_word).is_empty():
		end_source.text = "برگرفته از مدخل «%s»" % str(info.source_word)
	end_source.visible = not end_source.text.is_empty()

	end_meaning_fa.text = "معنی: %s" % _meaning_fa(meta)
	end_meaning_en.text = "Meaning: %s" % _meta_text(meta, "meaning_en")
	end_example.text = "Example: %s" % _meta_text(meta, "example")
	end_synonyms.text = "مترادف‌ها: %s" % _vocab_list(meta, "synonyms")
	end_antonyms.text = "متضادها: %s" % _vocab_list(meta, "antonyms")
	end_stats.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits(_stats_text())
	end_next_word.text = "کلمه‌ی بعدی در %s" % WordleDaily.format_until_next_word()
	# The big bottom number of the printed card: the player's current streak,
	# zero-padded to two digits ("۰۱").
	end_card_number.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("%02d" % WordleStats.get_current_streak())

	# Pronunciation comes from a recorded clip, or from the TTS fallback that
	# Global speaks when the clip is missing — so only offer the button when
	# one of the two can really produce sound.
	_end_audio_filename = str(meta.get("audio", ""))
	var has_clip := not _end_audio_filename.is_empty()
	var can_speak := Global.tts_enabled and not Global.english_voice_id.is_empty()
	end_audio_button.visible = has_clip or can_speak

	end_panel.visible = true
	end_scroll.scroll_vertical = 0
	_notify_card_available()
	if instant:
		end_panel.modulate.a = 1.0
	else:
		end_panel.modulate.a = 0.0
		create_tween().tween_property(end_panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.28)


func _on_audio_button_pressed() -> void:
	Sfx.click()
	Global.play_word_audio(_end_audio_filename, game.answer)


## One compact line of the player's record, so the daily habit is visible
## without a separate statistics screen.
func _stats_text() -> String:
	var played := WordleStats.get_played()
	var wins := WordleStats.get_wins()
	var line := "بازی: %d · برد: %d" % [played, wins]
	if played > wins:
		line += " · باخت: %d" % (played - wins)
	line += " · پیاپی: %d" % WordleStats.get_current_streak()
	line += " · بهترین: %d" % WordleStats.get_best_streak()
	return line


## `key` as a display string, falling back when the field is absent or empty.
func _meta_text(meta: Dictionary, key: String, fallback: String = "—") -> String:
	var value := str(meta.get(key, ""))
	return value if not value.is_empty() else fallback


## The Persian meaning, or the entry's Persian synonyms when it has none.
func _meaning_fa(meta: Dictionary) -> String:
	var direct := _meta_text(meta, "meaning_fa", "")
	if not direct.is_empty():
		return direct
	var synonyms := _vocab_list(meta, "synonyms", "")
	return synonyms if not synonyms.is_empty() else "—"


## Joins a { fa: [...], en: [...] } list into one readable line.
func _vocab_list(meta: Dictionary, key: String, fallback: String = "—") -> String:
	var group = meta.get(key, {})
	if not group is Dictionary:
		return fallback
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	for lang in ["fa", "en"]:
		if group.get(lang) is Array:
			for value in group[lang]:
				if value is String and not value.is_empty():
					parts.append(value)
	return "، ".join(parts) if not parts.is_empty() else fallback


############################################################
# OVERLAYS — help card + the API the host scene drives
############################################################
## Opens the how-to-play card. Called by the host's header button.
func show_help() -> void:
	if game == null:
		return
	_apply_panel_theme()
	help_panel.visible = true


## Closes whichever card is up. Returns true when one was open, so the host's
## Android-back handler can consume the press instead of leaving the screen.
func close_panels() -> bool:
	var closed := false
	if help_panel.visible:
		help_panel.visible = false
		closed = true
	if end_panel.visible:
		end_panel.visible = false
		_notify_card_available()
		closed = true
	return closed


func has_open_panel() -> bool:
	return help_panel.visible or end_panel.visible


############################################################
# THEMING
############################################################
## The app-wide theme walk runs when a scene is entered, not on a live
## toggle, so a player who switches theme mid-puzzle is handled from here:
## the tiles repaint at once (they read the palette while drawing) and the
## coloured parts are re-applied once the host has re-walked the tree.
func _on_theme_changed() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	for tiles in _rows:
		for tile: WordleTile in tiles:
			tile.refresh_theme()
	call_deferred("_apply_theme_colors")


func _apply_theme_colors() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_keyboard_colors()
	_set_message(message_label.text, _message_kind)
	_refresh_status()
	_apply_panel_theme()


## Colours the overlay cards from the palette. The generic walk paints plain
## labels; the emphasis (headline, answer, muted captions) is only known here.
func _apply_panel_theme() -> void:
	_apply_card_style()
	var text := Global.get_theme_color("text")
	var dim := Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")

	for label in [end_meaning_fa, end_meaning_en, end_synonyms, end_antonyms]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text)
	for label in [end_example, end_phonetics, end_source, end_stats, end_next_word]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", dim)
	end_word.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))

	if game != null and game.is_finished():
		end_headline.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
			Global.get_theme_color("success" if game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON
				else "warning"))

	help_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Global.get_theme_color("accent_bright"))
	help_body.add_theme_color_override("font_color", text)


## Dresses the vocabulary card in its printed look: cream paper, thick green
## rounded frame and fixed dark ink so it stays readable in both themes.
## Re-run on every show and theme change because the app-wide walk repaints
## panels and labels behind our back.
func _apply_card_style() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = card_bg
	style.set_corner_radius_all(int(card_radius))
	style.set_border_width_all(card_border_width)
	style.border_color = card_border
	style.content_margin_left = 44.0
	style.content_margin_right = 44.0
	style.content_margin_top = 40.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 36.0
	end_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	# Fixed ink: the walk paints themed (light/dark) colours, which would be
	# unreadable on cream, so every card label is overridden here.
	for label in [end_headline, end_word, end_meaning_fa, end_meaning_en,
			end_synonyms, end_antonyms]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", card_ink)
	for label in [end_phonetics, end_source, end_example, end_stats, end_next_word]:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", card_ink_dim)
	end_word.add_theme_color_override("font_color", card_accent)
	end_card_number.add_theme_color_override("font_color", card_ink)
	if game != null and game.is_finished():
		end_headline.add_theme_color_override("font_color",
			card_accent if game.get_state() == WordleGame.State.WON
				else Color(0.851, 0.502, 0.239))
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_stats.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleStats
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE STATS — the player's daily-puzzle record.
##
##  Deliberately tiny: one JSON file next to the puzzle save holding four
##  counters plus a per-attempt histogram, so the end-of-game card can show
##  a streak without a separate statistics screen.
##
##  ROLLOVER RULE: a streak only survives when yesterday's puzzle was
##  played, which is why the day index of the last recorded puzzle is
##  stored alongside the streak. Recording is idempotent per puzzle id, so
##  re-opening a finished board (or restoring a save) can never inflate the
##  record.
##
##  Every read is guarded: a missing or corrupt file simply starts a fresh
##  record instead of breaking the game screen.
## ============================================================

const SAVE_PATH := "user://wordle_stats.json"

## Histogram buckets, one per possible attempt count (1..MAX_GUESSES).
const MAX_ATTEMPTS_BUCKETS := 6

static var _data: Dictionary = {}
static var _loaded := false


## ------------------------------------------------------------
##  RECORDING
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Records the outcome of one daily puzzle.
## Returns true when this call was the one that counted (false when the
## puzzle was already recorded, or when `puzzle_id` is empty).
static func record_result(won: bool, attempts: int, puzzle_id: String,
		day_index: int = -1) -> bool:
	_ensure_loaded()
	if puzzle_id.is_empty() or str(_data.get("last_puzzle_id", "")) == puzzle_id:
		return false
	if day_index < 0:
		day_index = WordleDaily.day_index()

	var previous_day := int(_data.get("last_day_index", -1))
	_data["last_puzzle_id"] = puzzle_id
	_data["last_day_index"] = day_index
	_data["played"] = int(_data["played"]) + 1

	if won:
		_data["won"] = int(_data["won"]) + 1
		# Consecutive only when the previous puzzle was the day before.
		_data["current_streak"] = (int(_data["current_streak"]) + 1) \
			if previous_day == day_index - 1 else 1
		_data["best_streak"] = maxi(int(_data["best_streak"]), int(_data["current_streak"]))
		var bucket := clampi(attempts - 1, 0, MAX_ATTEMPTS_BUCKETS - 1)
		var histogram: Array = _data["distribution"]
		histogram[bucket] = int(histogram[bucket]) + 1
	else:
		_data["current_streak"] = 0

	_save()
	return true


## ------------------------------------------------------------
##  READS
## ------------------------------------------------------------
static func get_played() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_data["played"])


static func get_wins() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_data["won"])


static func get_current_streak() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_data["current_streak"])


static func get_best_streak() -> int:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return int(_data["best_streak"])


## Wins per attempt count: index 0 = solved on the first try, ... index 5.
static func get_distribution() -> Array:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return (_data["distribution"] as Array).duplicate()


## Puzzle id of the last recorded game ("" when nothing was recorded yet).
static func get_last_puzzle_id() -> String:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return str(_data["last_puzzle_id"])


## Drops the in-memory copy so the next read re-parses the file.
## Used by the test runner after it puts the real file back.
static func reset_cache() -> void:
	_data = {}
	_loaded = false


## ------------------------------------------------------------
##  INTERNALS
## ------------------------------------------------------------
static func _default_data() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"played": 0,
		"won": 0,
		"current_streak": 0,
		"best_streak": 0,
		"last_day_index": -1,
		"last_puzzle_id": "",
		"distribution": [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
	}


static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
	if _loaded:
		return
	_loaded = true
	_data = _default_data()

	if not FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH):
		return
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return
	var text := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()

	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK or not (json.data is Dictionary):
		push_warning("WordleStats: ignoring an unreadable %s" % SAVE_PATH)
		return

	var stored: Dictionary = json.data
	_data["played"] = maxi(0, int(stored.get("played", 0)))
	_data["won"] = maxi(0, int(stored.get("won", 0)))
	_data["current_streak"] = maxi(0, int(stored.get("current_streak", 0)))
	_data["best_streak"] = maxi(0, int(stored.get("best_streak", 0)))
	_data["last_day_index"] = int(stored.get("last_day_index", -1))
	_data["last_puzzle_id"] = str(stored.get("last_puzzle_id", ""))

	var histogram: Array = _data["distribution"]
	var stored_histogram = stored.get("distribution", [])
	if stored_histogram is Array:
		for i in mini(stored_histogram.size(), MAX_ATTEMPTS_BUCKETS):
			histogram[i] = maxi(0, int(stored_histogram[i]))


static func _save() -> void:
	var file := FileAccess.open(SAVE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_warning("WordleStats: cannot write %s" % SAVE_PATH)
		return
	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(_data))
	file.close()
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_tile.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleTile
extends Control
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE TILE — one letter cell of the game board.
##
##  Visual states:
##    EMPTY  — not filled yet (soft outline)
##    FILLED — letter typed, awaiting submission (strong outline)
##    ABSENT / PRESENT / CORRECT — post-reveal Wordle colours
##
##  WHY IT DRAWS ITSELF instead of being a PanelContainer + Label:
##  the app-wide theme walk (ThemeService.style_scene) restyles every
##  PanelContainer/Panel/Label in a scene. Running over the board it turned
##  every cell into a plain card — erasing the reveal colours of restored
##  rows and repainting the letters in the theme colour. A self-drawing
##  Control is invisible to that walk, so the board keeps its state, works
##  in both themes, and survives a live theme toggle.
##
##  Colours: outlines and unrevealed letters come from the palette (so the
##  board sits naturally on the light or the dark page), while the three
##  reveal colours are fixed — they carry meaning and must not drift.
## ============================================================

enum TileState { EMPTY, FILLED, ABSENT, PRESENT, CORRECT }

## Classic Wordle palette — fixed on purpose.
const COLOR_CORRECT := Color("#6AAA64")
const COLOR_PRESENT := Color("#C9B458")
const COLOR_ABSENT := Color("#787C7E")
## Letters always read white on top of a reveal colour.
const COLOR_LETTER_REVEALED := Color("#FFFFFF")

## How long one half of the reveal flip takes. Public: the screen waits for
## a whole row of flips and must not guess at it.
const FLIP_HALF_TIME := 0.17

## Letter height as a fraction of the cell (Wordle uses roughly half).
const LETTER_SIZE_RATIO := 0.5
const MIN_LETTER_SIZE := 18
## Outline of an untouched cell, as a fraction of theme "text_dim".
const EMPTY_OUTLINE_ALPHA := 0.45
const BORDER_WIDTH := 3
const MIN_CORNER_RADIUS := 8.0

var _state: TileState = TileState.EMPTY
var _text := ""
var _cell_px := 120.0
var _letter_size := 34
var _style: StyleBoxFlat = StyleBoxFlat.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	# The cell is decoration: it must never swallow a click aimed at the
	# keyboard or at a panel behind it.
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	# Scaling (the flip) has to happen around the centre, and the cell can be
	# resized by the board layout after the first pass.
	resized.connect(_on_resized)
	_rebuild_style()


## Sizes the cell and its letter. Called by the board for every tile.
func set_tile_size(px: float) -> void:
	var size_vector := Vector2(px, px)
	if custom_minimum_size == size_vector:
		# Nothing to redo. Bailing out here also keeps the board's `resized`
		# signal from re-entering this method forever.
		return
	_cell_px = maxf(px, 32.0)
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(_cell_px, _cell_px)
	_letter_size = maxi(MIN_LETTER_SIZE, int(round(_cell_px * LETTER_SIZE_RATIO)))
	pivot_offset = Vector2(_cell_px, _cell_px) * 0.5
	_rebuild_style()


func _on_resized() -> void:
	pivot_offset = size * 0.5


func get_state() -> TileState:
	return _state


func get_letter() -> String:
	return _text


func is_revealed() -> bool:
	return _state in [TileState.ABSENT, TileState.PRESENT, TileState.CORRECT]


## Types a letter into the cell ("" clears it). A revealed cell keeps its
## colour: revealing is what the player is judging, typing is transient.
func set_letter(letter: String) -> void:
	_text = letter.to_upper()
	if _text.length() == 1 and 'A' <= _text[0] and _text[0] <= 'Z':
		if not is_revealed():
			_state = TileState.FILLED
	elif _text.is_empty():
		_state = TileState.EMPTY
	_rebuild_style()


## Applies a reveal colour instantly (used when restoring a saved board, and
## by `reveal()` at the midpoint of the flip).
func set_revealed(score: int) -> void:
	_state = _state_for_score(score)
	_rebuild_style()


## Staggered Wordle flip: the cell collapses flat while still showing its
## pre-reveal look, swaps colour exactly at the flat midpoint, then opens
## back up. `delay` staggers a row left to right.
##
## The colour swap has to happen on the tween's midpoint callback — applying
## it up front (as this used to) turned the whole row green before it flipped,
## which destroyed the point of the animation.
func reveal(score: int, delay: float) -> void:
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(maxf(delay, 0.0))
	tw.tween_property(self, "scale:y", 0.0, FLIP_HALF_TIME) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tw.tween_callback(set_revealed.bind(score))
	tw.tween_property(self, "scale:y", 1.0, FLIP_HALF_TIME) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


## Small pop used on the winning row.
func play_win_bounce(delay: float) -> void:
	pivot_offset = size * 0.5
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_interval(delay)
	tw.tween_property(self, "scale", Vector2(1.15, 1.15), 0.12) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(self, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.16) \
		.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


func _state_for_score(score: int) -> TileState:
	match score:
		WordleEvaluator.Score.CORRECT: return TileState.CORRECT
		WordleEvaluator.Score.PRESENT: return TileState.PRESENT
		_: return TileState.ABSENT


## Re-reads the palette and repaints. Called on a live theme toggle: the
## colours are looked up while drawing, so nothing else has to be tracked.
func refresh_theme() -> void:
	_rebuild_style()


## The single source of truth for the cell's look.
func _rebuild_style() -> void:
	_style.set_corner_radius_all(int(maxf(MIN_CORNER_RADIUS, _cell_px * 0.08)))
	_style.set_border_width_all(0)
	match _state:
		TileState.EMPTY, TileState.FILLED:
			# Unrevealed cells stay transparent, so the board reads as part
			# of the page in either theme: only the outline differs.
			_style.bg_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
			_style.border_color = _outline_color()
			_style.set_border_width_all(BORDER_WIDTH)
		TileState.CORRECT:
			_style.bg_color = COLOR_CORRECT
		TileState.PRESENT:
			_style.bg_color = COLOR_PRESENT
		TileState.ABSENT:
			_style.bg_color = COLOR_ABSENT
	queue_redraw()


## Empty cells wear the soft theme border, a typed cell the strong text
## colour — the same "the outline firms up as you type" cue as Wordle.
func _outline_color() -> Color:
	if _state == TileState.FILLED:
		return Global.get_theme_color("text")
	var dim := Global.get_theme_color("text_dim")
	dim.a = EMPTY_OUTLINE_ALPHA
	return dim


func _letter_color() -> Color:
	return COLOR_LETTER_REVEALED if is_revealed() else Global.get_theme_color("text")


## The letter is drawn, not a child Label, so the theme walk cannot
## re-colour it (see the class docs).
func _draw() -> void:
	draw_style_box(_style, Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size))
	if _text.is_empty():
		return
	var font := get_theme_default_font()
	if font == null:
		return
	var ascent := font.get_ascent(_letter_size)
	var descent := font.get_descent(_letter_size)
	var baseline := (size.y + ascent - descent) * 0.5
	draw_string(font, Vector2(0.0, baseline), _text,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, size.x, _letter_size, _letter_color())
```

## File: `res://scenes/word_game/wordle/wordle_vocab.gd`

```gdscript
class_name WordleVocab
extends RefCounted
## ============================================================
##  WORDLE VOCAB — vocabulary data layer for the Wordle game.
##
##  Loads data/v_dictionary.json exactly once per session, filters it
##  into a pool of valid game words, and exposes metadata lookups.
##
##  A valid GAME word must:
##    * be a single English word (letters only, no spaces / hyphens /
##      apostrophes / slashes / any punctuation)
##    * be at least 5 letters long
##    * not be a proper noun / abbreviation / phrase
##  Candidates come from the entry's main "word" plus every valid word
##  inside synonyms.en and antonyms.en. The final pool is deduplicated.
## ============================================================

const DICTIONARY_PATH := "res://data/v_dictionary.json"

## Supported Wordle answer/guess lengths.
const MIN_WORD_LENGTH := 5
const MAX_WORD_LENGTH := 7

## English-only alphabet guard: rejects spaces, hyphens, apostrophes,
## slashes, digits, accented letters, multi-word expressions, etc.
const _WORD_PATTERN := "^[a-z]{%d,%d}$" % [MIN_WORD_LENGTH, MAX_WORD_LENGTH]

## Cached processed data (built lazily on first access).
static var _word_set: Dictionary = {}
static var _word_pool: Array[String] = []
## Pool words that own a dictionary entry — the daily engine picks from these.
static var _answer_pool: Array[String] = []
## word -> the entry that IS this word (its own dictionary page).
static var _meta_index: Dictionary = {}
## word -> the first entry that mentioned it, whether as its own word or as
## one of its synonyms/antonyms. Only consulted when _meta_index has no
## answer, so a pool word always has something to show on the end card.
static var _origin_index: Dictionary = {}
## The filter regex, compiled once instead of once per candidate word.
static var _regex: RegEx = null
static var _loaded := false


## All eligible game words, sorted (stable order for the daily engine).
## Used to validate GUESSES: typing a derived form such as "quitted" is fine.
static func get_word_pool() -> Array[String]:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _word_pool


## The subset of the pool that has a dictionary entry of its own — the words
## allowed to become a daily ANSWER.
##
## The full pool is right for guesses but too rough for answers: it also
## contains words that only appear as somebody else's synonym (derived and
## irregular forms like "quitted"), which make for a poor puzzle. Entry words
## are the dictionary's own head words, so they stay recognisable.
## Falls back to the whole pool if the dictionary somehow yields none.
static func get_answer_pool() -> Array[String]:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _answer_pool if not _answer_pool.is_empty() else _word_pool


## True when `word` is a playable guess (in the processed dictionary).
static func is_valid_word(word: String) -> bool:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _word_set.has(word.to_lower())


## Vocabulary entry (Dictionary) for a word, or {} when the word only
## entered the pool via a synonym/antonym with no entry of its own.
static func get_entry_meta(word: String) -> Dictionary:
	_ensure_loaded()
	return _meta_index.get(word.to_lower(), {})


## Vocabulary info for `word`, always giving the end card something useful:
##   exact       — `word` has a dictionary page of its own
##   !exact      — `word` only entered the pool through another entry's
##                 synonym/antonym list, so that entry is shown instead
##                 (previously such an answer rendered as "—" everywhere)
## Returns { "meta": Dictionary, "source_word": String, "exact": bool }.
static func get_word_info(word: String) -> Dictionary:
	_ensure_loaded()
	var lower := word.to_lower()
	if _meta_index.has(lower):
		return { "meta": _meta_index[lower], "source_word": lower, "exact": true }
	var origin: Dictionary = _origin_index.get(lower, {})
	if origin.is_empty():
		return { "meta": {}, "source_word": "", "exact": false }
	return {
		"meta": origin,
		"source_word": str(origin.get("word", "")),
		"exact": false,
	}


static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
	if _loaded:
		return
	var raw: Array = _load_dictionary()
	var seen: Dictionary = {}
	var pool: Array[String] = []

	for entry in raw:
		if not entry is Dictionary:
			continue
		var entry_word := str(entry.get("word", "")).to_lower()
		var usable := _is_usable_entry(entry)
		for candidate in _collect_candidates(entry):
			var lower := candidate.to_lower()
			if not seen.has(lower):
				seen[lower] = true
				pool.append(lower)
			# First usable entry that produced the word — the info fallback.
			if usable and not _origin_index.has(lower):
				_origin_index[lower] = entry
			# A real page of its own (not a synonym of somebody else).
			if usable and lower == entry_word:
				_meta_index[lower] = entry

	# Sort for a stable, device-independent order (daily engine input).
	pool.sort()
	var answers: Array[String] = []
	for word in pool:
		if _meta_index.has(word):
			answers.append(word)  # keeps the sorted order
	_word_pool = pool
	_word_set = seen
	_answer_pool = answers
	# Only a successful parse is cached: a transient read failure (file not
	# imported yet on a cold start) can retry on the next access.
	_loaded = not pool.is_empty()


## Loads and parses the dictionary JSON once, via the cache.
static func _load_dictionary() -> Array:
	var file := FileAccess.open(DICTIONARY_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		push_error("WordleVocab: cannot open %s" % DICTIONARY_PATH)
		return []
	var text := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	var json := JSON.new()
	if json.parse(text) != OK:
		push_error("WordleVocab: JSON parse error — %s" % json.get_error_message())
		return []
	var data = json.data
	if not data is Array:
		push_error("WordleVocab: unexpected JSON format")
		return []
	return data


## Every filter-passing candidate word for one dictionary entry.
static func _collect_candidates(entry: Dictionary) -> Array[String]:
	var out: Array[String] = []
	# 1. The main word (skip proper nouns / abbreviations / junk types).
	if _passes_filter(str(entry.get("word", ""))) \
			and not _is_excluded_entry_type(entry):
		out.append(str(entry.get("word", "")))
	# 2. Valid words from synonyms.en / antonyms.en lists.
	for key in ["synonyms", "antonyms"]:
		var group = entry.get(key, {})
		if group is Dictionary and group.get("en") is Array:
			for value in group["en"]:
				if value is String and _passes_filter(value):
					out.append(value)
	return out


## The core word filter (see class docs for the full rule list).
## The cheap checks run first: the pool is built from a few thousand
## candidate strings, so nothing here should allocate.
static func _passes_filter(word: String) -> bool:
	var trimmed := word.strip_edges()
	if trimmed.length() < MIN_WORD_LENGTH:
		return false
	# Any uppercase character means a proper noun / name in this dataset.
	if trimmed != trimmed.to_lower():
		return false
	return _word_regex().search(trimmed) != null


## The compiled word pattern (built once per session).
static func _word_regex() -> RegEx:
	if _regex == null:
		_regex = RegEx.new()
		_regex.compile(_WORD_PATTERN)
	return _regex


## An entry good enough to describe one of its own synonyms on the end card:
## a normal page (not an abbreviation / proper noun / symbol / affix) whose
## own head word is a plain lowercase dictionary word.
static func _is_usable_entry(entry: Dictionary) -> bool:
	return not _is_excluded_entry_type(entry) \
		and _passes_filter(str(entry.get("word", "")))


## Excludes entry types that are clearly unusable as normal vocabulary.
## Checks both the primary type and compound types like "proper noun",
## "noun (possessive)", etc. by splitting on common delimiters.
static func _is_excluded_entry_type(entry: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var word_type := str(entry.get("word_type", "")).to_lower()
	# Check the full compound type first
	for bad in ["abbreviation", "proper", "symbol", "prefix", "suffix"]:
		if word_type.contains(bad):
			return true
	# Also check each component of compound types split by "/" or "("
	var parts := word_type.split("/", true)
	for part in parts:
		var trimmed := part.strip_edges()
		for bad in ["abbreviation", "proper", "symbol", "prefix", "suffix"]:
			if trimmed.contains(bad):
				return true
	return false
```
