## File: `res://scenes/workbook/workbook.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"
# ============================================================
# WORKBOOK SCENE — Each Part is a separate swipeable page
# Page 1: Part I (Reading Comprehension)
# Page 2: Part II (Vocabulary)
# Page 3: Part III (Grammar)
# Page 4: Part IV (Pronunciation)
# Page 5: Part V (Writing)
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

const FONT_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN    := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

# Teal accent for Workbook
const ACCENT := Color("#0D9488")

@onready var back_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var translation_toggle: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/TranslationToggleButton
@onready var page_view: PageView = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView

var _data: Dictionary = {}
var _current_book: int = 0
var _current_lesson: int = 0

# Master Farsi-translation switch. Starts off so translations are hidden on
# open; the header toggle flips it and shows/hides every passage, grammar
# note, and exercise translation.
var show_translation: bool = false
var _engines: Array = []       # ExerciseEngine instances on the current page
var _fa_labels: Array = []     # Farsi labels from passage/grammar-note cards
var _theme_targets: Array[Callable] = []  # restyle callbacks for dynamic nodes


func _ready() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold    = load(FONT_BOLD_PATH)
	font_farsi   = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)
	if font_bold: header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	translation_toggle.pressed.connect(_on_translation_toggle_pressed)
	page_view.set_accent(ACCENT)
	# Workbook has many tabs — use the smaller legacy font so every part name
	# stays fully visible without clipping.
	page_view.tab_font_size = 31
	page_view.tab_font_min = 20
	page_view.tab_font_padding = 26.0

	_current_book = Global.current_book
	_current_lesson = Global.current_lesson
	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nکتاب کار" % _current_lesson)
	_update_toggle_button_text()

	Global.on_theme_changed(_on_theme_changed)
	_apply_theme()

	_data = Global.load_category("workbook", _current_book, _current_lesson)
	
	if _data.is_empty():
		_show_empty_message()
		return
	
	_build_workbook_pages()


# ============================================================
# THEME
# ============================================================
# Returns the given fixed color in dark mode (identical to today) or the
# matching palette role in light mode.
func _palette(dark_color: Color, role: String) -> Color:
	return dark_color if Global.theme_is_dark() else Global.get_theme_color(role)


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	# Full-screen page background.
	var background := get_node_or_null("Background") as ColorRect
	if background:
		background.color = Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")
	# Restyle every dynamically built themed node for the current mode.
	for target in _theme_targets:
		target.call()


func _on_theme_changed(_mode: int) -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_apply_theme()


# ============================================================
# SHOW MESSAGE IF NO DATA
# ============================================================
func _show_empty_message() -> void:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	style.set_content_margin_all(28)
	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	
	var icon := Label.new()
	icon.text = "📝"
	icon.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 72)
	icon.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(icon)
	
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = "Workbook"
	title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 50)
	title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_bold: title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	vb.add_child(title)
	
	banner.add_child(vb)
	page.add_child(banner)
	
	var msg := Label.new()
	msg.text = "📚 Workbook content for Lesson %d is not available yet.\n\nPlease check that the workbook.json file exists at:\nres://data/workbook.json" % _current_lesson
	msg.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	msg.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)
	msg.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#64748B"), "text_dim"))
	msg.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		msg.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#64748B"), "text_dim")))
	if font_regular: msg.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	page.add_child(msg)
	
	page_view.add_page("empty", "Workbook", "📝", page)


# ============================================================
# BUILD WORKBOOK PAGES — One page per Part
# ============================================================
func _build_workbook_pages() -> void:
	var lesson_title: Dictionary = _data.get("lesson_title", {})
	var parts: Array = _data.get("parts", [])
	
	if parts.is_empty():
		_show_empty_message()
		return
	
	# Create a page for each part
	for i in parts.size():
		var part: Dictionary = parts[i]
		var page := _build_part_page(i + 1, part, lesson_title)
		page_view.add_page("part_%d" % (i + 1), "Part %s" % _number_to_roman(i + 1), "📄", page)


# ============================================================
# BUILD SINGLE PART PAGE
# ============================================================
# ============================================================
# BUILD SINGLE PART PAGE
# ============================================================
func _build_part_page(part_num: int, part: Dictionary, lesson_title: Dictionary) -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 24)
	
	# Part banner
	var part_title: Dictionary = part.get("part_title", {})
	page.add_child(_make_part_banner(part_num, part_title, lesson_title))
	
	# --- NEW: Show reading passage if it exists (Part I) ---
	if part.has("passage"):
		var passage: Dictionary = part["passage"]
		var passage_card := _make_passage_card(passage)
		page.add_child(passage_card)
	
	# --- NEW: Show grammar note if it exists (Part III) ---
	if part.has("grammar_note"):
		var grammar_note: Dictionary = part["grammar_note"]
		var note_card := _make_grammar_note_card(grammar_note)
		page.add_child(note_card)
	
	# Exercises for this part
	var exercises: Array = part.get("exercises", [])
	for exercise in exercises:
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		
		# Choose which exercise types show the audio button.
		# Must be set BEFORE build().
		engine.audio_types = [
			"multiple_choice",
			"fill_blank",
			"cloze",
		]
		
		engine.audio_panel_scene_path = "res://scenes/shared/AudioPanel.tscn"
		
		page.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)
		engine.set_show_translation(show_translation)
		_engines.append(engine)
	
	# Bottom spacer
	var spacer := Control.new()
	spacer.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 120)
	spacer.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	page.add_child(spacer)
	
	return page

# ============================================================
# WIDGETS
# ============================================================
func _make_part_banner(part_num: int, part_title: Dictionary, lesson_title: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	style.set_content_margin_all(28)
	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	
	# Part number
	var num_label := Label.new()
	num_label.text = "Part %s" % _number_to_roman(part_num)
	num_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 50)
	num_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE)
	num_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_bold: num_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	vb.add_child(num_label)
	
	# Part title (EN)
	var title_en := Label.new()
	title_en.text = part_title.get("en", "")
	title_en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	title_en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 38)
	title_en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95))
	title_en.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_regular: title_en.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	vb.add_child(title_en)
	
	# Part title (FA)
	var title_fa := Label.new()
	title_fa.text = part_title.get("fa", "")
	title_fa.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	title_fa.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	title_fa.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85))
	title_fa.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	title_fa.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_farsi: title_fa.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	vb.add_child(title_fa)
	
	# Lesson title (smaller, at bottom)
	var lesson_en := Label.new()
	lesson_en.text = "Lesson: " + lesson_title.get("en", "")
	lesson_en.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	lesson_en.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 30)
	lesson_en.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7))
	lesson_en.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if font_regular: lesson_en.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	vb.add_child(lesson_en)
	
	banner.add_child(vb)
	return banner


# ============================================================
# PASSAGE CARD (for Reading Comprehension parts)
# ============================================================
func _make_passage_card(passage: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _palette(Color("#F8FAFC"), "surface")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	style.border_width_left = 5
	style.border_color = ACCENT
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		style.bg_color = _palette(Color("#F8FAFC"), "surface"))
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	
	# Header
	var header := Label.new()
	header.text = "📖 Reading Passage"
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", ACCENT)
	if font_bold: header.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	vb.add_child(header)
	
	# English and Farsi are split into paragraphs and interleaved, so each
	# English paragraph is immediately followed by its Farsi translation
	# instead of showing the whole text in English and then all in Farsi.
	var en_text: String = passage.get("en", "")
	var fa_text: String = passage.get("fa", "")
	var en_paras := _split_paragraphs(en_text)
	var fa_paras := _split_paragraphs(fa_text)

	if fa_paras.size() > 0 and fa_paras.size() == en_paras.size():
		for i in en_paras.size():
			vb.add_child(_make_passage_en_label(en_paras[i]))
			vb.add_child(_make_passage_fa_label(fa_paras[i]))
	else:
		# Fallback: show the full English text then the full Farsi text.
		if en_text != "":
			vb.add_child(_make_passage_en_label(en_text))
		if fa_text != "":
			vb.add_child(_make_passage_fa_label(fa_text))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


# Splits text into non-empty paragraphs on blank lines ("\n\n").
func _split_paragraphs(text: String) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for p in text.split("\n\n"):
		var s := p.strip_edges()
		if s != "":
			out.append(p)
	return out


func _make_passage_en_label(text: String) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#1E293B"), "text"))
	if font_regular:
		label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#1E293B"), "text")))
	return label


func _make_passage_fa_label(text: String) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.text = text
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#64748B"), "text_dim"))
	label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	if font_farsi:
		label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
	label.visible = show_translation
	_fa_labels.append(label)
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#64748B"), "text_dim")))
	return label


# ============================================================
# GRAMMAR NOTE CARD (for Grammar parts)
# ============================================================
func _make_grammar_note_card(grammar_note: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _palette(Color("#FEF9C3"), "surface")
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	style.border_width_left = 5
	style.border_color = _palette(Color("#CA8A04"), "border")
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		style.bg_color = _palette(Color("#FEF9C3"), "surface")
		style.border_color = _palette(Color("#CA8A04"), "border"))
	
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	
	# Header
	var header := Label.new()
	header.text = "📐 Grammar Note"
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#92400E"), "accent"))
	if font_bold: header.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	vb.add_child(header)
	_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
		header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#92400E"), "accent")))
	
	# English explanation
	var en_text: String = grammar_note.get("en", "")
	if en_text != "":
		var en_label := Label.new()
		en_label.text = en_text
		en_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		en_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 34)
		en_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#1E293B"), "text"))
		if font_regular: en_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)
		vb.add_child(en_label)
		_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
			en_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#1E293B"), "text")))
	
	# Farsi explanation
	var fa_text: String = grammar_note.get("fa", "")
	if fa_text != "":
		var fa_label := Label.new()
		fa_label.text = fa_text
		fa_label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
		fa_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 32)
		fa_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#78716C"), "text_dim"))
		fa_label.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
		fa_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
		if font_farsi: fa_label.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)
		fa_label.visible = show_translation
		_fa_labels.append(fa_label)
		vb.add_child(fa_label)
		_theme_targets.append(func() -> void:
			fa_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _palette(Color("#78716C"), "text_dim")))
	
	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


func _persian_numeral(num: int) -> String:
	const PERSIAN := ["۰", "۱", "۲", "۳", "۴", "۵", "۶", "۷", "۸", "۹"]
	var result := ""
	var n := num
	while n > 0:
		result = PERSIAN[n % 10] + result
		n /= 10
	return result if result != "" else "۰"


func _number_to_roman(num: int) -> String:
	match num:
		1: return "I"
		2: return "II"
		3: return "III"
		4: return "IV"
		5: return "V"
		6: return "VI"
		7: return "VII"
		8: return "VIII"
		9: return "IX"
		10: return "X"
		_: return str(num)


# ============================================================
# TRANSLATION TOGGLE
# ============================================================
# Flips the master switch and applies it to every Farsi label already on
# the page: workbook passage/grammar-note labels plus each exercise
# engine's translations. Toggling only changes .visible, so the layout
# (which already reserves space for the labels) never reflows.
func _on_translation_toggle_pressed() -> void:
	show_translation = !show_translation
	_update_toggle_button_text()
	for label in _fa_labels:
		if is_instance_valid(label):
			label.visible = show_translation
	for engine in _engines:
		if is_instance_valid(engine):
			engine.set_show_translation(show_translation)


func _update_toggle_button_text() -> void:
	if translation_toggle == null:
		return
	Global.set_translation_toggle_state(translation_toggle, show_translation)


# Returns the user to the main menu.
func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")


# ============================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ============================================================
func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	back_button.pivot_offset = back_button.size / 2.0
	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(back_button, "scale", Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)
	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_button_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scenes/writing/writing.gd`

```gdscript
extends "res://autoload/BackButtonHandler.gd"

# ============================================================
# WRITING SCENE — three swipeable pages via PageView
# Page 1 "Concept"  → definition + category cards
# Page 2 "Forms"    → tables
# Page 3 "Practice" → interactive exercises
#
# Dark-theme harmonized version.
# Titles are kept on one line with wrapping disabled.
# ============================================================

const SCENE_LESSON_MENU := "res://scenes/lesson_menu/LessonMenu.tscn"

# Global scale applied to every text size so fonts render larger.
const FONT_SCALE := 1.25

const FONT_REGULAR_PATH := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Regular.ttf"
const FONT_BOLD_PATH    := "res://ui/fonts/PlusJakartaSans-Bold.ttf"
const FONT_VAZIRMATN    := "res://ui/fonts/Vazirmatn-Regular.ttf"

# ---------- Dark theme ----------
const APP_BG := Color("#0b1229")
const PANEL_BG := Color("#0f1b3d")
const PANEL_BORDER := Color("#2d3a6a")

const TEXT_LIGHT := Color("#F1F5F9")
const TEXT_SOFT := Color("#CBD5E1")
const TEXT_MUTED := Color("#94A3B8")

const SUCCESS := Color("#34D399")
const INFO := Color("#22D3EE")

# Distinct pink accent — writing = creative expression.
const ACCENT := Color("#DB2777")

# Color palette for category chips / table type badges.
const CATEGORY_COLORS := [
	Color("#2563EB"),
	Color("#16A34A"),
	Color("#9333EA"),
	Color("#EA580C"),
	Color("#0891B2"),
	Color("#CA8A04"),
]

var font_regular: FontFile
var font_bold: FontFile
var font_farsi: FontFile

@onready var background: ColorRect = $Background
@onready var back_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/BackButton
@onready var home_button: Button = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HomeButton
@onready var header_title: Label = $HeaderBar/HeaderContent/HeaderTitle
@onready var page_view: PageView = $MarginContainer/MainLayout/PageView

var _page_reveals: Dictionary = {}
var _page_revealed: Dictionary = {}
var _data: Dictionary = {}


func _ready() -> void:
	font_regular = load(FONT_REGULAR_PATH)
	font_bold = load(FONT_BOLD_PATH)
	font_farsi = load(FONT_VAZIRMATN)

	if font_bold:
		header_title.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	# The bar owns its title's type ramp; see HeaderBarStyler.
	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)

	back_button.pressed.connect(_on_back_button_pressed)
	home_button.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)
	page_view.page_changed.connect(_on_page_changed)
	page_view.set_accent(ACCENT)

	# Put a dark background behind the whole PageView.
	_add_page_view_background()

	# Theme-aware styling + live re-theme on toggle (runs for all data paths).
	Global.on_theme_changed(_apply_theme)
	_apply_theme()

	header_title.text = MenuStyle.persian_digits("درس %d\nنوشتن" % Global.current_lesson)

	_data = Global.load_category(
		"writing",
		Global.current_book,
		Global.current_lesson
	)

	if _data.is_empty():
		return

	page_view.add_page("concept", "مفهوم", "💡", _build_concept_page())
	page_view.add_page("forms", "فرم‌ها", "📋", _build_forms_page())
	page_view.add_page("practice", "تمرین", "✏️", _build_practice_page())

	# Force themed backgrounds for PageView scroll areas.
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)

	_play_reveal(0)


# ============================================================
# DARK THEME HELPERS
# ============================================================

func _add_page_view_background() -> void:
	if page_view.has_meta("dark_bg"):
		return

	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = _app_bg()
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	bg.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	page_view.add_child(bg)
	page_view.move_child(bg, 0)
	page_view.set_meta("dark_bg", bg)


func _apply_dark_scroll_background(root: Control) -> void:
	for child in root.get_children():
		if child is ScrollContainer:
			var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
			style.bg_color = _app_bg()
			child.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

		if child is Control:
			_apply_dark_scroll_background(child)


func _apply_theme() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree():
		return

	if background != null:
		background.color = _navy_bg()

	HeaderBarStyler.style_title(header_title)
	_apply_dark_scroll_background(page_view)


# ---------- Theme-aware color helpers ----------
# All colors resolve through Global (the single theme source).
func _navy_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

func _app_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("bg_base")

func _panel_bg() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("surface")

func _panel_border() -> Color:
	return Global.get_theme_color("border")

func _text_color() -> Color:
	# Pure white in dark theme, pure black in light theme — maximum contrast.
	return Color.WHITE if Global.theme_is_dark() else Color.BLACK

func _text_soft() -> Color:
	# Pure white in dark theme, pure black in light theme — maximum contrast.
	return Color.WHITE if Global.theme_is_dark() else Color.BLACK

func _text_muted() -> Color:
	# Pure white in dark theme, pure black in light theme — maximum contrast.
	return Color.WHITE if Global.theme_is_dark() else Color.BLACK


func _dark_tint(color: Color, amount := 0.16) -> Color:
	# Creates a dark panel color tinted by the given accent color.
	return _panel_bg().lerp(Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 1.0), amount)


func _contrast_color(bg: Color) -> Color:
	# Chooses readable text color for colored banners/buttons.
	if bg.get_luminance() > 0.6:
		return Color("#0b1229")
	return Color.WHITE


func _get_en(val: Variant) -> String:
	if val is Dictionary:
		return str(val.get("en", ""))
	return str(val)


func _get_fa(val: Variant) -> String:
	if val is Dictionary:
		return str(val.get("fa", ""))
	return ""


# ============================================================
# PAGE 1 — CONCEPT
# ============================================================

func _build_concept_page() -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)

	_page_reveals[0] = []

	# Topic banner.
	var topic_en := str(_data.get("topic", {}).get("en", "Writing"))
	var topic_fa := str(_data.get("topic", {}).get("fa", "نوشتن"))

	page.add_child(_make_topic_banner("✍️", topic_en, topic_fa))

	# Definition card.
	var concept: Dictionary = _data.get("concept", {})

	if not concept.is_empty():
		var def: Dictionary = concept.get("definition", {})

		if not def.is_empty():
			var card := _make_text_card(
				str(def.get("en", "")),
				str(def.get("fa", "")),
				_dark_tint(ACCENT),
				ACCENT
			)

			page.add_child(card)
			_page_reveals[0].append(card)

		# Key points.
		var points: Array = concept.get("key_points", [])

		for point in points:
			page.add_child(_make_bullet(
				str(point.get("en", "")),
				str(point.get("fa", ""))
			))

		# Category cards.
		var categories: Array = concept.get("categories", [])

		if not categories.is_empty():
			page.add_child(_make_section_title("Types of Nouns"))

			var grid := GridContainer.new()
			grid.columns = 2
			grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 14)
			grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 14)
			grid.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

			for i in categories.size():
				var cat: Dictionary = categories[i]
				var color: Color = CATEGORY_COLORS[i % CATEGORY_COLORS.size()]

				var card := _make_category_card(
					cat.get("name", {}),
					cat.get("examples", []),
					color
				)

				grid.add_child(card)
				_page_reveals[0].append(card)

			page.add_child(grid)

	return page


# ============================================================
# PAGE 2 — FORMS
# ============================================================

func _build_forms_page() -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)

	_page_reveals[1] = []

	page.add_child(_make_topic_banner("📋", "Forms & Rules", "شکل‌ها و قواعد"))

	var forms: Array = _data.get("forms", [])

	if forms.is_empty():
		var empty := _make_label("No forms available yet.", 36, _text_muted(), false)
		page.add_child(empty)
		return page

	for form in forms:
		var card := _make_form_card(form)
		page.add_child(card)
		_page_reveals[1].append(card)

	return page


# ============================================================
# PAGE 3 — PRACTICE
# ============================================================

func _build_practice_page() -> VBoxContainer:
	var page := VBoxContainer.new()
	page.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)

	_page_reveals[2] = []

	page.add_child(_make_topic_banner("✏️", "Practice", "تمرین"))

	var intro := _make_text_card(
		"Writing is a skill. The more you practice, the better you become!",
		"نوشتن یک مهارت است. هرچه بیشتر تمرین کنید، بهتر می‌شوید!",
		_dark_tint(SUCCESS, 0.10),
		SUCCESS
	)

	page.add_child(intro)
	_page_reveals[2].append(intro)

	for exercise in _data.get("exercises", []):
		var engine := ExerciseEngine.new()
		page.add_child(engine)
		engine.build(exercise)
		_page_reveals[2].append(engine)

	return page


# ============================================================
# WIDGETS
# ============================================================

func _make_topic_banner(icon: String, en: String, fa: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var banner := PanelContainer.new()

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(20)
	style.set_content_margin_all(26)

	banner.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)

	var ic := Label.new()
	ic.text = icon
	ic.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(72 * FONT_SCALE))
	ic.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	ic.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	vb.add_child(ic)

	var text_color := _contrast_color(ACCENT)
	var sub_color := Color(text_color.r, text_color.g, text_color.b, 0.85)

	# Banner title: one line, no wrapping.
	var en_l := _make_label(en, 50, text_color, true)
	en_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(en_l)

	var fa_l := _make_fa_label(fa, 36, sub_color)
	fa_l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vb.add_child(fa_l)

	banner.add_child(vb)
	return banner


func _make_text_card(en: String, fa: String, bg: Color, border: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = bg
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_left = 4
	style.border_color = border
	style.set_content_margin_all(18)

	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)

	# Body text stays wrapped.
	vb.add_child(_make_label(en, 36, _text_color(), false))
	vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(fa, 31, _text_muted()))

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


func _make_bullet(en: String, fa: String) -> VBoxContainer:
	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)

	vb.add_child(_make_label("•  " + en, 34, _text_soft(), false))
	vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(fa, 29, _text_muted()))

	return vb


func _make_category_card(category_name: Dictionary, examples: Array, color: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _panel_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.border_width_top = 5
	style.border_color = color
	style.set_content_margin_all(16)

	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)

	# Category title: one line, no wrapping.
	var badge := Label.new()
	badge.text = str(category_name.get("en", ""))
	badge.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	badge.clip_text = false
	badge.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING
	badge.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(34 * FONT_SCALE))
	badge.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color.lightened(0.25))

	if font_bold:
		badge.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	vb.add_child(badge)

	vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(str(category_name.get("fa", "")), 28, _text_muted(), false))

	# Examples stay wrapped.
	for ex in examples:
		var ex_label := _make_label("·  " + str(ex), 30, _text_soft(), false)
		vb.add_child(ex_label)

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


func _make_form_card(form: Dictionary) -> PanelContainer:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _panel_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(16)
	style.border_width_left = 5
	style.border_color = ACCENT
	style.set_content_margin_all(20)

	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)

	var vb := VBoxContainer.new()
	vb.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)

	# Form title: one line, no wrapping.
	vb.add_child(_make_label(_get_en(form.get("title", "")), 38, _text_color(), true, false))
	vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(_get_fa(form.get("title", "")), 30, _text_muted(), false))

	# Subtitle can wrap.
	vb.add_child(_make_label(_get_en(form.get("subtitle", "")), 32, _text_muted(), false))
	vb.add_child(_make_fa_label(_get_fa(form.get("subtitle", "")), 28, _text_muted()))

	# Table.
	var table: Array = form.get("table", [])

	if not table.is_empty():
		var grid := GridContainer.new()
		grid.columns = 3
		grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 10)
		grid.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 8)
		grid.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

		# Header row.
		grid.add_child(_make_table_header("Type"))
		grid.add_child(_make_table_header("Singular"))
		grid.add_child(_make_table_header("Plural"))

		# Data rows.
		for row in table:
			var row_type := str(row.get("type", "")).to_lower()

			var type_color := INFO
			if row_type != "regular" and row_type != "common":
				type_color = ACCENT.lightened(0.25)

			grid.add_child(_make_table_cell(str(row.get("type", "")), type_color, true))
			grid.add_child(_make_table_cell(str(row.get("singular", "")), _text_color(), false))
			grid.add_child(_make_table_cell(str(row.get("plural", "")), _text_color(), false))

		vb.add_child(grid)

	card.add_child(vb)
	return card


func _make_table_header(text: String) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text

	# Table headers are titles, so keep them on one line.
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	l.clip_text = false
	l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING

	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(30 * FONT_SCALE))
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", _contrast_color(ACCENT))
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	l.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = ACCENT
	style.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	style.set_content_margin_all(10)

	l.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)

	if font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)

	return l


func _make_table_cell(text: String, color: Color, bold: bool) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", int(30 * FONT_SCALE))
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER

	# Cell content stays wrapped.
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	l.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = _app_bg()
	style.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	style.border_width_left = 1
	style.border_width_right = 1
	style.border_width_top = 1
	style.border_width_bottom = 1
	style.border_color = _panel_border()
	style.set_content_margin_all(8)

	l.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)

	if bold and font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)

	return l


func _make_section_title(en: String) -> HBoxContainer:
	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	row.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

	var bar := ColorRect.new()
	bar.color = ACCENT
	bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(6, 44)
	bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	row.add_child(bar)

	# Section title: one line, no wrapping, fills horizontally.
	var title := _make_label(en, 40, _text_color(), true)
	title.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	row.add_child(title)

	return row


func _make_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color, bold: bool, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	# Disable wrapping for titles when requested.
	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING

	# Apply global scale, then slightly shrink very long one-line titles.
	var base := int(float(font_size) * FONT_SCALE)
	var final_size := base
	if not do_wrap:
		if text.length() > 30:
			final_size = int(float(base) * 0.85)
		if text.length() > 55:
			final_size = int(float(base) * 0.72)

	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", final_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)

	if bold and font_bold:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_bold)
	elif not bold and font_regular:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_regular)

	return l


func _make_fa_label(text: String, font_size: int, color: Color = TEXT_MUTED, do_wrap := true) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.text = text
	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE

	if do_wrap:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD
	else:
		l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
		l.clip_text = false
		l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_NO_TRIMMING

	# Apply global scale, then slightly shrink very long one-line Persian titles.
	var base := int(float(font_size) * FONT_SCALE)
	var final_size := base
	if not do_wrap:
		if text.length() > 34:
			final_size = int(float(base) * 0.85)
		if text.length() > 60:
			final_size = int(float(base) * 0.72)

	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", final_size)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	l.text_direction = Control.TEXT_DIRECTION_RTL
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT

	if font_farsi:
		l.add_theme_font_override("font", font_farsi)

	return l


# ============================================================
# ENTRANCE ANIMATION
# ============================================================

func _on_page_changed(index: int, _page_id: String) -> void:
	_play_reveal(index)


func _play_reveal(index: int) -> void:
	if _page_revealed.get(index, false):
		return

	_page_revealed[index] = true

	var cards: Array = _page_reveals.get(index, [])

	for i in cards.size():
		var card: Control = cards[i]
		card.modulate.a = 0.0

		var t := create_tween()
		t.tween_property(
			card,
			"modulate:a",
			1.0,
			0.3
		).set_delay(0.07 * i).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)


# ============================================================
# NAVIGATION
# ============================================================

func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	TransitionManager.change_scene("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")

func _on_back_button_pressed() -> void:
	back_button.pivot_offset = back_button.size / 2.0

	var t := create_tween()
	t.tween_property(back_button, "scale", Vector2(0.96, 0.96), 0.08)

	TransitionManager.change_scene(SCENE_LESSON_MENU)


func _on_android_back_pressed() -> void:
	_on_back_button_pressed()
```

## File: `res://scripts/resources/type_scale.gd`

```gdscript
class_name TypeScale
extends Resource
## ============================================================
##  TYPE SCALE — the app's font sizes and families as a Resource.
##
##  Screens used to carry literals such as
##  `add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 58)` in dozens of places, so a
##  typography change meant a hunt through the whole codebase. Every size the
##  UI uses now lives here and is read through the shared instance at
##  res://resources/typography/type_scale.tres, which a designer can retune in
##  the Inspector without touching a script.
##
##  Colour deliberately stays OUT of this resource: text colour is a theme
##  concern (Dark / Light), while size and family are not.
## ============================================================

# ── Latin family ───────────────────────────────────────────────
## Regular weight — body copy, paragraphs, list items.
@export var font_regular: FontFile
## Bold / display weight — titles, headings, emphasis.
@export var font_display: FontFile

# ── Persian family ────────────────────────────────────────────
## Persian text is set in Vazirmatn so RTL shaping is correct.
@export var font_farsi: FontFile

# ── Steps ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
@export_group("Sizes")
## Hero number / score on a results screen.
@export_range(16, 160, 1) var hero: int = 92
## Screen title (page heading).
@export_range(16, 120, 1) var title: int = 62
## Section heading inside a page.
@export_range(12, 100, 1) var heading: int = 52
## Button / label text.
@export_range(12, 90, 1) var label: int = 38
## Default body text.
@export_range(12, 90, 1) var body: int = 34
## Secondary body text (captions under a heading).
@export_range(10, 80, 1) var small: int = 30
## Hint / badge text.
@export_range(8, 70, 1) var tiny: int = 26
## Long-form reading text (paragraph body, passages).
@export_range(12, 100, 1) var reading: int = 55
## Persian translation body text.
@export_range(12, 100, 1) var translation: int = 45

## Line height multiplier applied to reading text.
@export_range(1.0, 2.5, 0.05) var reading_line_spacing: float = 1.35


## The shared instance. All app UI should read sizes from this rather than
## carrying literals, so one edit in the Inspector retypes the whole app.
static func shared() -> TypeScale:
	return load("res://resources/typography/type_scale.tres") as TypeScale
```

## File: `res://scripts/resources/ui_motion_profile.gd`

```gdscript
class_name UiMotionProfile
extends Resource
## ============================================================
##  UI MOTION PROFILE — one reusable, Inspector-editable motion recipe.
##
##  Every interaction animation in the app (pop-in, shake, pop, pulse,
##  slide-in, page fade, page slide, wordle reveal) reads its timing and
##  geometry from a profile resource instead of hardcoding numbers inside a
##  script. A designer can retune the whole app's feel from
##  res://resources/motion/ without touching GDScript, and two screens that
##  should move the same way share literally the same resource.
##
##  The profiles are consumed by UiMotion (res://ui/motion/ui_motion.gd) and
##  by TransitionManager. See res://resources/motion/ for the shipped set.
## ============================================================

## Length of the animation's main leg, in seconds.
@export_range(0.01, 3.0, 0.01) var duration: float = 0.34

## Seconds to wait before the animation starts. Used to stagger a list.
@export_range(0.0, 2.0, 0.01) var delay: float = 0.0

## Tween interpolation curve.
@export var transition: Tween.TransitionType = Tween.TRANS_CUBIC

## Tween easing at the ends of the curve.
@export var easing: Tween.EaseType = Tween.EASE_OUT

## Second leg of a two-part animation (settle / return). 0 disables it.
@export_range(0.0, 3.0, 0.01) var settle_duration: float = 0.0

## Curve + easing for the settle leg.
@export var settle_transition: Tween.TransitionType = Tween.TRANS_ELASTIC
@export var settle_easing: Tween.EaseType = Tween.EASE_OUT

## Scale the node starts at (pop-in) or overshoots to (pop).
@export var from_scale: float = 0.86
@export var peak_scale: float = 1.12

## Alpha the node starts at.
@export_range(0.0, 1.0, 0.01) var from_alpha: float = 0.0

## Horizontal travel distance in pixels, for slide-style motions.
@export var distance: float = 90.0

## Diminishing offsets for a shake, in pixels. A trailing 0.0 returns the
## node home; the step time is `duration / offsets.size()`.
@export var shake_offsets: PackedFloat32Array = PackedFloat32Array(
	[14.0, -12.0, 9.0, -6.0, 3.0, 0.0]
)

## How many times a looping motion repeats. 0 = forever.
@export_range(0, 20, 1) var loop_count: int = 0

## True when the animation repeats until stopped (pulse loops).
@export var loops_forever: bool = false
```

## File: `res://tests/probe_scene_load.gd`

```gdscript
extends Node
## ============================================================
##  SCENE LOAD PROBE — diagnostic utility (not part of the test suite).
##
##  Loads every app scene while printing a marker to STDERR before each load,
##  so the engine's own load-time diagnostics interleave with the markers in
##  the captured stderr and you can see exactly WHICH scene produced a warning.
##
##  Run it when a scene-related warning appears without a file name:
##    godot --path <project> res://tests/ProbeSceneLoad.tscn --quit-after 600
##  then read stderr. A healthy project prints only PROBE_* lines.
##
##  It exists because TestSceneTheming can assert THAT the scenes are clean but
##  cannot name the culprit — stderr interleaving is what pins it down.
## ============================================================

func _ready() -> void:
	var paths := _collect("res://scenes")
	paths.sort()
	printerr("PROBE_BEGIN scenes=", paths.size())
	for path in paths:
		printerr("PROBE_LOAD ", path)
		var packed = load(path)
		if packed == null:
			printerr("PROBE_NULL ", path)
	printerr("PROBE_END")


func _collect(dir: String) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var handle := DirAccess.open(dir)
	if handle == null:
		return out
	handle.list_dir_begin()
	var entry := handle.get_next()
	while entry != "":
		if entry.begins_with("."):
			entry = handle.get_next()
			continue
		var full := dir.path_join(entry)
		if handle.current_is_dir():
			out.append_array(_collect(full))
		elif entry.ends_with(".tscn") and not entry.to_lower().contains("test"):
			out.append(full)
		entry = handle.get_next()
	handle.list_dir_end()
	return out
```

## File: `res://tests/test_bottom_navigation.gd`

```gdscript
extends Node
class_name BottomNavigationRegressionTests

const NAVIGATION_BAR_SCENE: PackedScene = preload("res://scenes/bottom_navigation/NavigationBar.tscn")


func _spawn_ready_bar() -> VisionNavigationBar:
	var bar: VisionNavigationBar = NAVIGATION_BAR_SCENE.instantiate() as VisionNavigationBar
	bar.auto_navigate = false
	add_child(bar)
	# _ready() awaits two frames while it lays out and captures positions.
	for _i: int in range(4):
		await get_tree().process_frame
	return bar


func test_menu_keeps_primary_selection_and_selector_position() -> void:
	var navigation_bar: VisionNavigationBar = await _spawn_ready_bar()
	navigation_bar.visible = true
	navigation_bar.current_index = 1
	VisionNavigationBar._last_primary_index = 1
	navigation_bar.call("_set_selector_position", 1, false)
	var selector: Control = navigation_bar.get_node("Selector") as Control
	var selector_position_before: Vector2 = selector.position

	navigation_bar.call("select_item", 5)

	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("current_index")) == 1,
		"Opening Menu keeps the primary selector index"
	)
	_check(
		VisionNavigationBar._last_primary_index == 1,
		"Opening Menu keeps the last primary index"
	)
	_check(
		selector.position.is_equal_approx(selector_position_before),
		"Opening Menu does not move the selector"
	)
	_check(
		bool(navigation_bar.get("menu_panel_open")),
		"Opening Menu shows the popup"
	)
	navigation_bar.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame


func test_apply_scene_path_tracks_the_active_scene() -> void:
	var navigation_bar: VisionNavigationBar = await _spawn_ready_bar()

	navigation_bar.apply_scene_path("res://scenes/book_menu/BookSelection.tscn")
	_check(navigation_bar.visible, "The bar shows on a scene that owns it")
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("current_index")) == 1,
		"Books selects the Books tab"
	)
	_check(
		VisionNavigationBar._last_primary_index == 1,
		"Books updates the last primary index"
	)

	# Side-menu destinations select the Menu tab and highlight their popup item.
	navigation_bar.apply_scene_path("res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn")
	await get_tree().create_timer(VisionNavigationBar.MOVE_DURATION + 0.05).timeout
	_check(navigation_bar.visible, "The bar shows on a side-menu scene")
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("current_index")) == 5,
		"A side-menu destination moves the selector to Menu"
	)
	_check(
		VisionNavigationBar._last_primary_index == 1,
		"A side-menu destination remembers the previous primary tab"
	)
	var menu_selector: Control = navigation_bar.get_node("Selector") as Control
	var menu_target_position: Vector2 = navigation_bar.call("_get_selector_position", 5)
	_check(
		menu_selector.position.is_equal_approx(menu_target_position),
		"The selector circle is positioned over the Menu tab"
	)
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("active_menu_index")) == 2,
		"Settings highlights its menu destination icon"
	)
	var menu_highlights: Array[Panel] = navigation_bar.get("menu_item_highlights")
	_check(
		menu_highlights.size() == 4 and menu_highlights[2].visible,
		"The matching menu icon has a rounded highlight"
	)
	_check(
		not bool(navigation_bar.get("_is_navigating")),
		"Menu destinations leave navigation enabled"
	)
	navigation_bar.select_item(0)
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("current_index")) == 0,
		"Primary navigation remains selectable from a menu destination"
	)

	# A scene that does not own the bar hides it.
	navigation_bar.apply_scene_path("res://scenes/exam/FinalExam.tscn")
	_check(not navigation_bar.visible, "The bar hides on a scene without navigation")

	navigation_bar.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame


func test_menu_destination_highlight_tracks_each_side_scene() -> void:
	var navigation_bar: VisionNavigationBar = await _spawn_ready_bar()
	var menu_scene_paths: Array[String] = [
		"res://scenes/auth/Auth.tscn",
		"res://scenes/purchase/Purchase.tscn",
		"res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn",
		"res://scenes/about_me/AboutMe.tscn"
	]
	var menu_highlights: Array[Panel] = navigation_bar.get("menu_item_highlights")

	for menu_index: int in range(menu_scene_paths.size()):
		navigation_bar.apply_scene_path(menu_scene_paths[menu_index])
		_check(
			int(navigation_bar.get("active_menu_index")) == menu_index,
			"Menu scene %d sets the matching active index" % menu_index
		)
		for highlight_index: int in range(menu_highlights.size()):
			var menu_highlight: Panel = menu_highlights[highlight_index]
			_check(
				menu_highlight.visible == (highlight_index == menu_index),
				"Only the current menu destination is highlighted"
			)
		_check(
			not bool(navigation_bar.get("_is_navigating")),
			"Navigation unlocks after menu scene %d" % menu_index
		)

	navigation_bar.apply_scene_path("res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn")
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("active_menu_index")) == -1,
		"Returning to a primary scene clears the menu highlight"
	)
	_check(
		int(navigation_bar.get("current_index")) == 0,
		"Returning to Home moves the selector back to Home"
	)
	navigation_bar.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame


func test_bottom_tab_scene_paths_remain_primary_destinations() -> void:
	var navigation_bar: VisionNavigationBar = await _spawn_ready_bar()
	var home_index: int = int(navigation_bar.call(
		"_target_primary_index",
		"res://scenes/main_menu/MainMenu.tscn"
	))
	var books_index: int = int(navigation_bar.call(
		"_target_primary_index",
		"res://scenes/book_menu/BookSelection.tscn"
	))
	var menu_destination_index: int = int(navigation_bar.call(
		"_target_primary_index",
		"res://scenes/settings/Settings.tscn"
	))
	_check(home_index == 0, "Home remains a primary tab destination")
	_check(books_index == 1, "Books remains a primary tab destination")
	_check(menu_destination_index == 5, "Side-menu scenes remain outside the primary tabs")
	navigation_bar.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame


func _check(condition: bool, label: String) -> void:
	assert(condition, label)
	print("PASS  " + label)
```

## File: `res://tests/test_design_system.gd`

```gdscript
extends Node
## ============================================================
##  DESIGN SYSTEM TESTS — run with run_scene on TestDesignSystem.tscn.
##
##  Guards the app-wide restyle. Three layers of protection:
##
##   1. The palettes and token scales stay complete and self-consistent, so a
##      half-finished edit can't ship white-on-white.
##   2. Every component factory returns a StyleBoxFlat with the properties the
##      reference sheet specifies (opaque fills, pill buttons, three shadows).
##   3. The Theme that ThemeService installs on the tree root actually carries
##      the redesign, and every theme item name is VALID for its control type.
##
##  Layer 3 matters most: a wrong item name is silently accepted by Godot
##  (it just stores an unused entry), so a typo'd stylebox name would restyle
##  nothing, raise no error, and be invisible until someone looked at the
##  screen. test_theme_items_are_valid() makes that failure loud.
## ============================================================

var _failures := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	# The test runner enumerates and invokes every test_* method itself, so
	# `_ready` must NOT also run them there — that would execute the whole
	# suite twice. A direct WINDOWED run has no runner to drive it, so it
	# orchestrates itself; that is also the only path where the GPU render
	# check can actually execute, because the runner is headless.
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		return
	print("Running the design-system suite directly (windowed, so the render check will execute).")
	test_palettes_complete()
	test_token_scales()
	test_button_states()
	test_cards_and_insets()
	test_table_rows()
	test_modal_composition()
	test_toggle_and_progress()
	test_header_bar()
	test_menu_style_components()
	test_base_theme_carries_design()
	test_theme_items_are_valid()
	await test_theme_cascades_to_live_controls()
	await test_button_states_render()
	_report()


############################################################
# 1. PALETTES & TOKENS
############################################################
func test_palettes_complete() -> void:
	_check(DesignTokens.missing_roles().is_empty(),
		"the Light palette defines every role (missing: %s)" % str(DesignTokens.missing_roles()))
	_check(DesignTokens.PALETTE_LIGHT.size() == DesignTokens.PALETTE_ROLES.size(),
		"the Light palette defines all %d semantic roles" % DesignTokens.PALETTE_ROLES.size())


func test_token_scales() -> void:
	_check(DesignTokens.RADIUS_XS < DesignTokens.RADIUS_SM
			and DesignTokens.RADIUS_SM < DesignTokens.RADIUS_MD
			and DesignTokens.RADIUS_MD < DesignTokens.RADIUS_LG
			and DesignTokens.RADIUS_LG < DesignTokens.RADIUS_XL,
		"the radius scale rises monotonically")
	_check(DesignTokens.SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE < DesignTokens.SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE
			and DesignTokens.SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE < DesignTokens.SHADOW_DEEP_SIZE,
		"the three shadow levels rise monotonically")
	_check(DesignTokens.SPACE_XS < DesignTokens.SPACE_SM
			and DesignTokens.SPACE_SM < DesignTokens.SPACE_MD
			and DesignTokens.SPACE_MD < DesignTokens.SPACE_LG
			and DesignTokens.SPACE_LG < DesignTokens.SPACE_XL,
		"the spacing scale rises monotonically")
	_check(DesignTokens.ICON_SM < DesignTokens.ICON_MD and DesignTokens.ICON_MD < DesignTokens.ICON_LG,
		"the icon size scale rises monotonically")
	# A pill must exceed the largest real radius, i.e. it really is "fully round".
	_check(DesignTokens.RADIUS_PILL > DesignTokens.RADIUS_XL * 4,
		"the pill radius is effectively infinite")


############################################################
# 2. COMPONENT FACTORIES
############################################################
func test_button_states() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:
		var which := "dark" if dark else "light"
		var resting := DesignTokens.button_default(dark)
		var hover := DesignTokens.button_hover(dark)
		var pressed := DesignTokens.button_pressed(dark)
		var disabled := DesignTokens.button_disabled(dark)
		var focus := DesignTokens.button_focus(dark)

		# The reference's default state: cream, pill, gold rim, warm glow.
		_check(resting.bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: default button fill is opaque" % which)
		_check(resting.corner_radius_top_left == DesignTokens.RADIUS_PILL, "%s: default button is a pill" % which)
		_check(resting.border_width_left == DesignTokens.BORDER_STANDARD, "%s: default button wears the gold rim" % which)
		_check(resting.border_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "gold_rim"), "%s: the rim is the gold token" % which)
		_check(resting.shadow_size > 0, "%s: default button is elevated" % which)

		# Hover is the blue state, and it must glow harder than resting.
		_check(hover.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"), "%s: hover fill is the accent" % which)
		_check(hover.shadow_size > resting.shadow_size, "%s: hover glows harder than resting" % which)

		# Pressed differs from hover, and disabled loses contrast AND its shadow.
		_check(pressed.bg_color != hover.bg_color, "%s: pressed differs from hover" % which)
		_check(disabled.shadow_size == 0, "%s: disabled button has no shadow" % which)
		_check(disabled.border_width_left == 0, "%s: disabled button has no rim" % which)

		# The focus ring is transparent so it layers over any other state.
		_check(focus.bg_color.a == 0.0, "%s: focus ring body is transparent" % which)
		_check(focus.border_width_left >= DesignTokens.BORDER_STANDARD, "%s: focus ring outline is visible" % which)

		# Cream needs dark ink; the blue states need white.
		_check(DesignTokens.button_text_color("default", dark) == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "ink"),
			"%s: default button uses ink type" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.button_text_color("hover", dark) == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "on_accent"),
			"%s: hover button uses white type" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.button_text_color("disabled", dark) == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "text_muted"),
			"%s: disabled button uses muted type" % which)

		_check(DesignTokens.button_primary(dark).bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"),
			"%s: primary button is the accent blue" % which)


func test_cards_and_insets() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:
		var which := "dark" if dark else "light"
		var card := DesignTokens.card(dark)
		_check(card.bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: card fill is opaque" % which)
		_check(card.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "surface"), "%s: card fill is the surface role" % which)
		_check(card.border_width_left == DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE, "%s: card has a hairline border" % which)
		_check(card.shadow_size == DesignTokens.SHADOW_SOFT_SIZE, "%s: card carries the soft elevation" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.card(dark, true).shadow_size == DesignTokens.SHADOW_MEDIUM_SIZE,
			"%s: a lifted card elevates one level" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.card(dark, false, true).shadow_size == 0,
			"%s: a flat card has no elevation" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.card_paper(dark).bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: paper card is opaque" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.card_paper(dark).border_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "gold_rim"),
			"%s: paper card wears the gold rim" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.card_accent(dark).bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: accent card is opaque" % which)

		var ins := DesignTokens.inset(dark)
		_check(ins.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "surface_sunken"),
			"%s: inset uses the sunken role" % which)
		_check(ins.border_width_top > ins.border_width_left, "%s: inset has a lit top edge" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.input_focus(dark).border_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"),
			"%s: a focused input gets the blue ring" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.input_focus(dark).shadow_size > 0,
			"%s: the focus ring glows (always visible, per the sheet)" % which)


func test_table_rows() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:
		var which := "dark" if dark else "light"
		var plain := DesignTokens.table_row("default", dark)
		var hover := DesignTokens.table_row("hover", dark)
		var selected := DesignTokens.table_row("selected", dark)
		_check(plain.bg_color != hover.bg_color
				and hover.bg_color != selected.bg_color
				and plain.bg_color != selected.bg_color,
			"%s: the three table row states are visually distinct" % which)
		_check(hover.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"), "%s: hover row fills with the accent" % which)
		_check(selected.border_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "gold_rim"),
			"%s: selected row wears the gold rim" % which)
		for state in ["default", "hover", "selected"]:
			_check(DesignTokens.table_row(state, dark).bg_color.a >= 0.999,
				"%s: '%s' row fill is opaque" % [which, state])
		_check(DesignTokens.table_row_text_color("hover", dark) == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "on_accent"),
			"%s: hover row type is white" % which)


func test_modal_composition() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:
		var which := "dark" if dark else "light"
		var parts := DesignTokens.modal(dark)
		var head := parts["header"] as StyleBoxFlat
		var body := parts["body"] as StyleBoxFlat
		_check(head != null and body != null, "%s: the modal yields a header and a body" % which)
		if head == null or body == null:
			continue
		_check(head.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"), "%s: modal header is the accent band" % which)
		_check(head.corner_radius_top_left > 0 and head.corner_radius_bottom_left == 0,
			"%s: modal header rounds its top corners only" % which)
		_check(body.corner_radius_bottom_left > 0 and body.corner_radius_top_left == 0,
			"%s: modal body rounds its bottom corners only" % which)
		_check(body.corner_radius_bottom_left == head.corner_radius_top_left,
			"%s: the modal's top and bottom corners match" % which)
		_check(body.shadow_size == DesignTokens.SHADOW_DEEP_SIZE,
			"%s: the modal floats on the deep shadow" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.modal_text_color(dark).get_luminance() < 0.5,
			"%s: modal type is dark ink (its body is always paper)" % which)


func test_toggle_and_progress() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:
		var which := "dark" if dark else "light"
		var on := DesignTokens.toggle_track(true, dark)
		var off := DesignTokens.toggle_track(false, dark)
		_check(on.bg_color != off.bg_color, "%s: the toggle has distinct on/off tracks" % which)
		_check(on.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"), "%s: the ON track is the accent" % which)
		_check(on.shadow_size > 0 and off.shadow_size == 0, "%s: only the ON track glows" % which)
		_check(DesignTokens.toggle_knob(dark).bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: the toggle knob is opaque" % which)

		var fill := DesignTokens.progress_fill(dark)
		var track := DesignTokens.progress_track(dark)
		_check(fill.bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"), "%s: progress fill is the accent" % which)
		_check(track.bg_color.a >= 0.999, "%s: progress track is opaque" % which)
		_check(track.bg_color != fill.bg_color, "%s: track and fill are distinguishable" % which)
		_check(fill.corner_radius_top_left == DesignTokens.RADIUS_PILL, "%s: the progress fill is rounded" % which)

		# A Slider grabber must be a Texture2D, not a stylebox.
		_check(DesignTokens.slider_grabber_texture(dark) is Texture2D,
			"%s: the slider grabber is a texture" % which)


func test_header_bar() -> void:
	for dark in [false]:

		var bar := DesignTokens.header_bar(dark)

func test_menu_style_components() -> void:
	var dark := MenuStyle.is_dark()
	_check(MenuStyle.card_bg() == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "surface"),
		"MenuStyle card fill follows the surface token")

	var card := MenuStyle.card_style(Color("#4C8DF6"))
	_check(card.bg_color.a >= 0.999, "MenuStyle card fill is opaque")
	_check(card.border_width_left == DesignTokens.BORDER_SUBTLE, "MenuStyle card has a hairline border")
	_check(card.content_margin_left == 0,
		"MenuStyle card adds no padding of its own (its MarginContainer owns the insets)")
	_check(MenuStyle.card_hover_style(Color("#4C8DF6")).shadow_size > card.shadow_size,
		"MenuStyle card hover elevates further than resting")

	# Every component the reference sheet adds must build without a scene.
	# Each one is a CanvasItem, so they are all collected and freed below: an
	# orphaned Control keeps its canvas RID alive to shutdown, which makes the
	# whole suite report as failed even though every assertion passed.
	var section := MenuStyle.make_section_header("Cards", "sub")
	var row := MenuStyle.make_table_row("Default", "default")
	var empty := MenuStyle.make_empty_state("Nothing here", "yet")
	var toast := MenuStyle.make_toast("Saved")
	var toggle := MenuStyle.make_toggle_row("Sound", true)
	var progress := MenuStyle.make_progress(0.4)
	_check(section != null, "section header builds")
	_check(row != null, "table row builds")
	_check(empty != null, "empty state builds")
	_check(toast != null, "toast builds")
	_check(toggle != null, "toggle row builds")
	_check(progress != null, "progress indicator builds")

	var primary := MenuStyle.make_button("Continue", "primary")
	var secondary := MenuStyle.make_button("Cancel", "secondary")
	_check(primary.get_theme_stylebox("normal").bg_color == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "accent"),
		"a primary button is the accent blue")
	_check(secondary.get_theme_stylebox("normal").bg_color != primary.get_theme_stylebox("normal").bg_color,
		"a secondary button's fill differs from the primary one")

	var modal := MenuStyle.make_modal("Title", "Body copy", "Cancel", "Content")
	_check(modal.has("root") and modal.has("cancel") and modal.has("confirm"),
		"the modal exposes root / cancel / confirm")

	for node in [section, row, empty, toast, toggle, progress, primary, secondary, modal.get("root")]:
		var control := node as Node
		if control != null:
			control.free()

func test_base_theme_carries_design() -> void:

	_check(resting != null and resting.corner_radius_top_left == DesignTokens.RADIUS_PILL,
		"the base Theme's button is the designed pill")
	_check(theme.get_color("font_color", "Button") == DesignTokens.button_text_color("default", dark),
		"the base Theme's button type matches its cream fill")
	_check(theme.get_color("font_color", "Label") == DesignTokens.color_of(dark, "text"),
		"the base Theme's label type is the text role")

	# The boxes and controls from the reference sheet.
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("panel", "Panel") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles Panel")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("panel", "PanelContainer") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles PanelContainer")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("normal", "LineEdit") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles LineEdit")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("focus", "LineEdit") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the focused LineEdit")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("background", "ProgressBar") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the progress track")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("fill", "ProgressBar") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the progress fill")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("slider", "HSlider") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the slider track")
	_check(theme.get_icon("grabber", "HSlider") is Texture2D, "the base Theme gives the slider a grabber texture")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("scroll", "VScrollBar") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the scrollbar trough")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("grabber", "VScrollBar") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles the scrollbar handle")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("panel", "PopupMenu") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles popup menus")
	_check(theme.get_stylebox("panel", "AcceptDialog") is StyleBoxFlat, "the base Theme styles dialogs")


## A theme item whose NAME is not defined on its control type is silently
## accepted by Godot and simply never used — so a typo restyles nothing and
## raises no error. This walks the whole theme and fails on any such item.
func test_theme_items_are_valid() -> void:
	var theme: Theme = Global.get_base_theme()
	if theme == null:
		_check(false, "a base Theme exists to audit")
		return
	var built_in := ThemeDB.get_default_theme()
	var bogus: Array = []
	for type_name in theme.get_type_list():
		for item in theme.get_stylebox_list(type_name):
			if not built_in.get_stylebox_list(type_name).has(item):
				bogus.append("%s.stylebox:%s" % [type_name, item])
		for item in theme.get_color_list(type_name):
			if not built_in.get_color_list(type_name).has(item):
				bogus.append("%s.color:%s" % [type_name, item])
		for item in theme.get_icon_list(type_name):
			if not built_in.get_icon_list(type_name).has(item):
				bogus.append("%s.icon:%s" % [type_name, item])
		for item in theme.get_constant_list(type_name):
			if not built_in.get_constant_list(type_name).has(item):
				bogus.append("%s.constant:%s" % [type_name, item])
	_check(bogus.is_empty(), "every theme item name is valid on its control type (bogus: %s)" % str(bogus))


## The end-to-end proof: a Control added to the live tree resolves the designed
## styles through the theme cascade, with no styling call of its own.
func test_theme_cascades_to_live_controls() -> void:
	var probe := Button.new()
	add_child(probe)
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	add_child(panel)
	await get_tree().process_frame

	var sb: StyleBox = probe.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
	# Report the observed values in the label: if this ever regresses, the
	# message should say WHAT was resolved, not merely that it was wrong.
	var radius := -1
	if sb is StyleBoxFlat:
		radius = (sb as StyleBoxFlat).corner_radius_top_left
	_check(radius == DesignTokens.RADIUS_PILL,
		"a live Button inherits the designed pill (radius=%d, box=%s)" % [radius, sb.get_class()])
	_check(panel.get_theme_stylebox("panel") is StyleBoxFlat,
		"a live PanelContainer inherits the designed card")
	var expected := DesignTokens.button_text_color("default", Global.theme_is_dark())
	var got := probe.get_theme_color("font_color")
	_check(got == expected,
		"a live Button inherits the designed type colour (got %s, want %s)" % [got, expected])

	# Detach and free immediately: a queued_free here would never be processed
	# (the scene ends first) and would leave canvas items alive at exit.
	remove_child(probe)
	probe.free()
	remove_child(panel)
	panel.free()


############################################################
# 4. RENDER CHECK
############################################################
## Renders real Buttons into a SubViewport and samples the result, proving the
## styles PAINT rather than merely exist. The corner sample is the important
## one: it only reads as background if the pill radius truly clipped the box,
## and the channel comparisons prove the warm cream and the blue actually land.
##
## Skipped (not failed) under a headless harness, where there is no GPU and the
## viewport texture comes back empty.
func test_button_states_render() -> void:
	# A headless display server has no GPU and never emits the post-draw signal,
	# so awaiting it would hang the whole suite. Skip cleanly instead: this
	# check is meaningful on a real window, which is where it should run.
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		print("SKIP  button render check (headless display server)")
		return

	var viewport := SubViewport.new()
	viewport.size = Vector2i(400, 120)
	# A SubViewport that is never displayed must be told to render every frame;
	# the default UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE leaves it blank, which would make every
	# pixel read as black and let the colour checks pass vacuously.
	viewport.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
	add_child(viewport)

	var backdrop := ColorRect.new()
	backdrop.color = Color.BLACK
	backdrop.position = Vector2.ZERO
	backdrop.size = Vector2(400, 120)
	viewport.add_child(backdrop)

	var dark := Global.theme_is_dark()
	var resting := Button.new()
	resting.text = ""
	resting.position = Vector2(20, 20)
	resting.size = Vector2(360, 80)
	resting.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", DesignTokens.button_default(dark))
	viewport.add_child(resting)

	var hot := Button.new()
	hot.text = ""
	hot.position = Vector2(20, 20)
	hot.size = Vector2(360, 80)
	hot.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", DesignTokens.button_hover(dark))
	hot.visible = false
	viewport.add_child(hot)

	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var image := viewport.get_texture().get_image()
	if image == null or image.is_empty():
		print("SKIP  button render check (headless harness: no viewport texture)")
		remove_child(viewport)
		viewport.free()
		return

	# ── Resting: the warm cream default, with a clipped pill corner ──
	var resting_px := image.get_pixel(200, 60)
	_check(resting_px.a > 0.9, "the resting button paints an opaque fill")
	# Prove something PAINTED before judging its hue: on a blank viewport every
	# pixel is black, which would satisfy a naive r>=b comparison trivially.
	_check(resting_px.v > 0.2,
		"the resting button painted rather than leaving the backdrop (got %s)" % resting_px)
	_check(resting_px.r >= resting_px.b, "the resting button paints the warm cream default")
	_check(image.get_pixel(22, 22).v < 0.2, "the pill radius clips the corner back to the background")

	# ── Hover: the blue accent ──
	resting.visible = false
	hot.visible = true
	# TWO draws: one frame to absorb the visibility swap, the next to have the
	# changed tree actually painted before the texture is read back.
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	image = viewport.get_texture().get_image()
	var hot_px := image.get_pixel(200, 60)
	_check(hot_px.b > hot_px.r, "the hover button paints the blue accent (got %s)" % hot_px)
	_check(hot_px.b > resting_px.b,
		"hover is measurably bluer than the resting state (hover %s vs resting %s)" % [hot_px, resting_px])

	remove_child(viewport)
	viewport.free()


############################################################
# HARNESS
############################################################
func _check(condition: bool, label: String) -> void:
	if not condition:
		_failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if condition else "FAIL  ") + label)


func _report() -> void:
	print("---")
	print("ALL TESTS PASSED" if _failures == 0 else "%d TEST(S) FAILED" % _failures)
```

```gdscript
extends Node
# ============================================================
# Phase A regression tests: "Try Again" resets the existing exercise
# controls in place, WITHOUT calling build() again.
#
# These tests instantiate a real ExerciseEngine, answer it, grade it, then
# drive the retry path (_on_check_pressed when already graded) and assert that
# the answers/selections/inputs return to their initial state and that transient
# grading presentation (feedback labels, score banner, inline cloze colours) is
# cleared — while the UI tree itself is not rebuilt.
# ============================================================

func _new_engine(exercise: Dictionary) -> ExerciseEngine:
	var e := ExerciseEngine.new()
	add_child(e)
	e.build(exercise)
	return e

func _collect(root: Node, predicate: Callable, out: Array) -> Array:
	if predicate.call(root):
		out.append(root)
	for c in root.get_children():
		_collect(c, predicate, out)
	return out

func _toggle_buttons(root: Node) -> Array:
	return _collect(root, func(n: Node) -> bool: return n is Button and not (n is ExerciseDropdown) and (n as Button).toggle_mode, [])

func _line_edits(root: Node) -> Array:
	return _collect(root, func(n: Node) -> bool: return n is LineEdit, [])

func _dropdowns(root: Node) -> Array:
	return _collect(root, func(n: Node) -> bool: return n is ExerciseDropdown, [])

func _buttons_with_text(root: Node, label: String) -> Array:
	return _collect(root, func(n: Node) -> bool: return n is Button and (n as Button).text == label, [])


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# multiple_choice
# ------------------------------------------------------------
func test_multiple_choice_retry_resets_selection() -> void:
	var ex := {
		"type": "multiple_choice",
		"exercise_id": "t_mc",
		"items": [{"question": "Pick one", "options": ["a", "b", "c"], "answer": 1}],
	}
	var e := _new_engine(ex)
	var btns := _toggle_buttons(e)
	assert(btns.size() == 3, "expected 3 option buttons, got %d" % btns.size())

	(btns[1] as Button).button_pressed = true
	assert(int(e._items[0]["get"].call()) == 1, "answer should read option 1 before grading")

	e.grade_all()
	assert(e._is_graded, "engine should be graded after grade_all()")
	assert(e._score_banner != null and e._score_banner.visible, "score banner visible after grading")
	var fb: Label = e._items[0]["feedback"]
	assert(fb.visible, "feedback label visible after grading")

	# Try Again path.
	e._on_check_pressed()
	assert(not e._is_graded, "engine not graded after retry")
	assert(int(e._items[0]["get"].call()) == -1, "selection cleared after retry")
	for b in btns:
		assert(not (b as Button).button_pressed, "no option button stays pressed after retry")
	assert(not fb.visible, "feedback label hidden after retry")
	assert(e._score_banner != null and not e._score_banner.visible, "score banner hidden after retry")
	assert(e._check_btn.text == e._t("check_answer"), "Check button restored to Check Answer")

	(edits[0] as LineEdit).text = "go"
	e.grade_all()
	e._on_check_pressed()
	assert((edits[0] as LineEdit).text == "", "line edit cleared after retry")

		"passage": "I (1) ______ to school and (2) ______ books.",

		],
	}

	for g in e._cloze_graded:
		assert(not bool(g), "every cloze graded flag cleared after retry")

	e.grade_all()

	assert(str(e._items[0]["get"].call()) == "", "dropdown answer empty after retry")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# text_highlight (word toggles)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
func test_text_highlight_retry_clears_word_toggles() -> void:
	var ex := {
		"type": "text_highlight",

		"passage": "the cat sat",
		"answer_indices": [0],
	}
	var e := _new_engine(ex)
	var btns := _toggle_buttons(e)
	assert(btns.size() == 3, "expected three word toggles")
	(btns[0] as Button).button_pressed = true
	e.grade_all()
	e._on_check_pressed()
	for b in btns:
		assert(not (b as Button).button_pressed, "word toggle cleared after retry")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# The UI tree must NOT be rebuilt by a retry.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
func test_retry_preserves_ui_tree() -> void:
	var ex := {
		"type": "multiple_choice",
		"exercise_id": "t_tree",
		"items": [{"question": "Pick one", "options": ["a", "b"], "answer": 0}],
	}
	var e := _new_engine(ex)
	var before := _toggle_buttons(e)
	assert(before.size() == 2)
	e.grade_all()

	var after := _toggle_buttons(e)
	assert(after.size() == before.size(), "button count unchanged after retry")
	for i in before.size():
```
